title: Diffu-LoRA: A Novel Low-Rank Adaptation for Personalized Diffusion Models
summary: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models from a few reference images requires preserving subject identity while following prompts that describe new contexts. Full-model fine-tuning is parameter-intensive, whereas low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the number of trainable parameters but leaves open how adaptation capacity should be distributed across layers. We introduce Diffu-LoRA, a parameter-efficient method that learns this allocation through gated low-rank adaptation. Diffu-LoRA inserts trainable low-rank components into the linear layers of Transformer blocks and assigns a learnable gate to each component. Bilevel optimization updates the adaptation weights and gate parameters on separate data splits, while progressive pruning removes components with the lowest gate values to meet a prescribed rank budget. This procedure allocates adaptation capacity nonuniformly across layers while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. Experiments with Stable Diffusion on subjects from DreamBooth and additional collected datasets show improved overall subject fidelity and prompt alignment relative to the evaluated fine-tuning baselines. Ablation studies examine the contributions of bilevel optimization, progressive pruning, and adapter placement. These results support learned rank allocation as a practical approach to parameter-efficient diffusion model personalization.

AI.tldr: Diffu-LoRA 提出一种参数高效的文本到图像扩散模型个性化方法，通过门控低秩适配和双层优化自动分配各层适配容量，在保持主体身份的同时提升提示对齐。
AI.motivation: 从少量参考图像个性化扩散模型时，既要保留主体身份，又要遵循描述新场景的提示。全模型微调参数开销大，而 LoRA 虽减少可训练参数，但如何在不同层间分配适配容量尚不明确。
AI.method: 在 Transformer 块的线性层中插入可训练低秩组件，并为每个组件分配可学习门控。采用双层优化在独立数据划分上更新适配权重和门控参数，并通过渐进剪枝移除门控值最低的组件以满足预设秩预算。预训练主干保持冻结。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 上使用 DreamBooth 及额外收集数据集进行实验，相比评估的微调基线，整体主体保真度和提示对齐均有提升。消融实验分析了双层优化、渐进剪枝和适配器放置的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 学习式秩分配是一种实用的参数高效扩散模型个性化方法，支持在冻结主干的情况下实现更好的主体保持与提示遵循。

title: Safe Learning of Adaptive Control Policies for Remote Patient Monitoring
summary: Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) enables continuous observation of patients in their daily environments, improving both health outcomes and quality of life. A key challenge in RPM is determining the optimal monitoring intensity, while balancing patient safety and monitoring costs. This problem is further complicated when system parameters, such as transition probabilities and costs, are initially unknown. We develop a learning-based control framework that estimates these parameters and adapts the monitoring policy in real time. The proposed approach is an online model-based reinforcement learning algorithm tailored to RPM, with patient safety explicitly prioritized during exploration. We provide theoretical guarantees on safety and convergence to the optimal policy. Simulation results show that the algorithm converges to the optimal threshold-based policy, maintains low treatment costs, and reduces the risk of patients reaching critical health states.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向远程患者监测的在线基于模型的强化学习控制框架，在系统参数未知时实时估计并调整监测策略，兼顾患者安全与监测成本。
AI.motivation: RPM需要确定最优监测强度，以平衡患者安全与监测成本；当转移概率和成本等系统参数初始未知时，该问题更加复杂。
AI.method: 开发基于学习的控制框架，使用在线基于模型的强化学习算法估计系统参数并实时自适应调整监测策略，在探索过程中显式优先保障患者安全，并提供安全性与收敛到最优策略的理论保证。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该算法能够收敛到最优阈值策略，保持较低的治疗成本，并降低患者进入危重健康状态的风险。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在参数未知的RPM场景中安全有效地学习最优监测策略，实现患者安全与监测成本之间的平衡。

title: Moving Horizon Estimation of Hybrid Systems Using Hybrid Zonotopes and Mixed-Integer Quadratic Programs
summary: Moving horizon estimation (MHE) is an estimation technique that formulates an optimization problem over a past horizon to find the states that require the minimum disturbances and noise to be feasible with the dynamics and measurements. For hybrid systems with both continuous and discrete states, this yields a mixed-integer program for the MHE, which can be difficult both to formulate and solve online under computational limitations. This paper shows how the hybrid zonotope representation for mixed-integer sets can be used to efficiently construct the feasible space for the program using reachability-based calculations for piecewise affine systems, without requiring conversion to a mixed logical dynamical system. A method for lifting the state space to explicitly estimate the dynamic mode is also presented. The proposed approach is evaluated in two numerical examples. Comparison against a standard mixed logical dynamical systems approach shows the proposed method can be solved orders of magnitude faster for one of the example problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合系统的移动 horizon 估计（MHE），提出利用混合 zonotope 表示混合整数集合，并结合分段仿射系统的可达性计算来高效构造 MHE 的可行空间，从而避免转换为混合逻辑动态系统。
AI.motivation: 混合系统同时包含连续和离散状态，传统 MHE 会形成混合整数规划，在线建模和求解计算困难，尤其在计算资源受限时。
AI.method: 使用 hybrid zonotope 表示混合整数集合；针对 piecewise affine 系统，通过 reachability-based 计算构造可行空间，无需转换为 mixed logical dynamical system；并提出提升状态空间的方法以显式估计动态模式。
AI.result: 在两个数值算例中评估了所提方法，并与标准混合逻辑动态系统方法比较；其中一个算例的求解速度提升可达数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能更高效地构建和求解混合系统 MHE 问题，避免 MLD 转换，并在部分场景下显著加快在线计算。

title: Compute-Constrained Safety Filters with Neuromorphic Event Triggering
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, submitted to 2027 IEEE American Control Conference
summary: Safety filters that rely on control barrier function (CBF) quadratic programs (QPs) are typically analyzed under the assumption that the QP is solved instantaneously, although nonzero computation time can render a computed input unsafe by the time it is applied. This paper develops a dual leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) event-triggered safety filter for linear systems that accounts for this delay. Two LIF states monitor a shifted CBF residual and the deviation of the held input from the nominal feedback law. A computation is initiated when either LIF state reaches its threshold; the previous input remains applied until the prescribed application time, and any solution returned earlier is stored until then. A closed-form charging profile relates the safety-LIF threshold to residual-growth bounds, ensuring sufficient residual margin over the application delay. Under the stated assumptions, the resulting hybrid system guarantees forward invariance, completeness, and non-Zeno execution, with positive lower bounds on computation-initiation and input-application times. A spacecraft terminal-approach simulation demonstrates safety with fewer optimizer calls than a delay-tightened periodic filter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双泄漏积分放电（LIF）事件触发的安全滤波器，用于线性系统，以解决CBF-QP安全滤波中计算时延导致输入失效的问题，并通过航天器终端接近仿真验证了其安全性和计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于控制屏障函数（CBF）二次规划（QP）的安全滤波器通常假设QP瞬时求解，但实际计算耗时会使计算出的输入在施加时已不再安全，这一时延问题亟需解决。
AI.method: 设计双LIF事件触发安全滤波器：两个LIF状态分别监测偏移后的CBF残差和保持输入与名义反馈律的偏差；当任一LIF达到阈值时启动计算，旧输入保持至规定施加时刻，提前返回的解暂存至该时刻；通过闭式充电曲线将安全LIF阈值与残差增长界关联，确保在施加时延内留有足够残差裕度。
AI.result: 在给定假设下，所得混合系统保证前向不变性、完备性和非芝诺执行，且计算启动与输入施加时间均有正下界；航天器终端接近仿真表明，相比时延收紧的周期滤波器，该方法在保持安全的同时减少了优化器调用次数。
AI.conclusion: 双LIF事件触发安全滤波器能有效补偿计算时延，在保证安全性的同时提升计算效率，适用于线性系统的实时安全控制。

title: High-Fidelity Baseline Design and Station Keeping Analyses for Earth-Moon Vertical Orbits
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to the 2027 AAS/AIAA Space Flight Mechanics Meeting
summary: Earth-Moon vertical orbits are periodic solutions of the circular restricted three-body problem (CR3BP) with substantial out-of-plane motion, considered for high-latitude lunar observation and cislunar navigation. This work develops an end-to-end framework for high-fidelity reference generation under rotating-frame geometry constraints and receding-horizon model predictive control. A representative $L_2$ vertical orbit yields a 5.5-year reference with negligible deterministic correction and remains maintainable in five-year Monte Carlo simulations under realistic uncertainties. The workflow produces locally optimal solutions across 90 consecutive daily start epochs and 200 catalog cases. Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent along the reference and stable/unstable CR3BP directions interpret station-keeping behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究地月垂直轨道作为圆型限制性三体问题（CR3BP）的周期解，面向高纬月球观测与地月空间导航，提出旋转坐标系几何约束下高保真参考生成与滚动时域模型预测控制的端到端框架。
AI.motivation: 地月垂直轨道具有显著面外运动，可用于高纬月球观测和地月空间导航，但需要高保真参考轨道与可靠的站保持控制方法。
AI.method: 基于CR3BP，在旋转坐标系几何约束下生成高保真参考轨道；采用滚动时域模型预测控制进行站保持；利用有限时间Lyapunov指数以及CR3BP稳定/不稳定方向分析站保持行为；在90个连续每日起始历元和200个编目案例中生成局部最优解，并进行蒙特卡洛仿真。
AI.result: 代表性L2垂直轨道可生成5.5年参考轨道，确定性修正可忽略；在现实不确定性下，五年蒙特卡洛仿真中仍可维持；工作流在90个连续每日起始历元和200个编目案例中均产生局部最优解。
AI.conclusion: 该端到端框架能够为地月垂直轨道生成高保真参考并实现长期站保持，且FTLE与CR3BP稳定/不稳定方向可有效解释站保持行为。

title: SLVR: Structured Latent Visual Reasoning via Human-like Reasoning Flows
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often answer visual reasoning questions by relying on linguistic priors rather than task-relevant visual evidence. Textual chain-of-thought reasoning can partially mitigate this issue by encouraging models to decompose visual questions into intermediate evidence-seeking steps, but generating these steps autoregressively increases inference cost. Latent reasoning avoids explicit rationale generation, but existing approaches provide limited control over what intermediate states encode, making it difficult to impose separate supervision for planning, grounding, and evidence selection. We propose Structured Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a training framework that bridges explicit chain-of-thought and latent reasoning by organizing multimodal reasoning into typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and reasoning integration.
  SLVR first trains the model to rely on the image by masking answer-revealing text and contrasting the correct answer with visually plausible distractors. It then organizes reasoning into latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration, supervising each stage with the corresponding signal: plans, boxes, visual evidence, and final rationales. This gives latent reasoning an explicit functional structure while avoiding generated textual chains at inference time.
  Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SLVR improves consistently across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with absolute gains of +9.4 on MMVP and +14.2 on BLINK Relation, as well as improvements on V*, MathVista, and ChartQA. These results suggest that structured latent supervision can improve fine-grained visual reasoning without the decoding overhead of textual CoT. Project page is available \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{here}.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化潜在视觉推理（SLVR）训练框架，通过类型化潜在阶段（规划、定位、证据选择、整合）监督，提升多模态视觉推理，避免文本CoT解码开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型常依赖语言先验而非视觉证据；文本CoT可缓解但推理成本高；现有潜在推理对中间状态控制有限，难以分别监督规划、定位和证据选择。
AI.method: SLVR将推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择、整合四个潜在阶段，每阶段用对应信号监督（计划、框、视觉证据、最终理由）；先通过掩码答案文本和对比正确/视觉合理干扰项，迫使模型依赖图像；推理时不生成文本链。
AI.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B，在多个基准上提升：MMVP +9.4，BLINK Relation +14.2，V*、MathVista、ChartQA也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化潜在监督可提升细粒度视觉推理，且无需文本CoT的解码开销。

title: Adapting Appearance-Based Gaze Estimation to Narrow-Range, Long-Duration Screen Viewing
summary: Appearance-based gaze estimation offers a low-cost alternative to infrared eye tracking for screen-based behavioral and clinical applications, however existing models are typically developed for wide ranges of gaze angle and head pose. Prolonged screen viewing presents a distinct regime in which gaze remains near the screen center, head motion is limited, and calibration drift accumulates over time. In this work, we benchmark six published estimators along with a proposed differential-gaze model on 140 long-duration facial video recordings with synchronized eye tracking under subject-disjoint evaluation and a common budget of calibration frames. Differential estimation was the only static method that significantly improved upon a baseline predictor of each recording's mean gaze, and was further boosted by addition of temporal context. It also yielded the strongest agreement with reference fixations and saccades, demonstrating that low angular error alone could not validate eye movement reconstruction. These findings establish differential estimation as a promising foundation for reliable gaze tracking in long-duration, narrow-range settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长时间屏幕观看场景，提出差分凝视估计模型，并与六种已发表估计器在140个长时面部视频上进行比较，发现差分估计能显著优于基线，且结合时序信息后效果更好。
AI.motivation: 现有基于外观的凝视估计模型主要针对大范围凝视角度和头部姿态，而长时间屏幕观看是一个独特场景：凝视接近屏幕中心、头部运动有限、标定漂移随时间累积。因此需要针对此场景评估和开发更可靠的模型。
AI.method: 使用140个长时面部视频记录，同步眼动追踪数据，进行被试独立评估，并统一标定帧预算。基准测试六种已发表估计器，并与提出的差分凝视模型对比，同时考虑时序上下文。
AI.result: 差分估计是唯一显著优于每个记录平均凝视基线的静态方法，加入时序上下文后进一步提升。它在参考注视和扫视的一致性上也表现最佳，表明低角度误差不足以验证眼动重建。
AI.conclusion: 差分估计为长时间、窄范围场景下的可靠凝视追踪提供了有前景的基础。

title: Deceptive Stochastic Patrolling via Markov Chain Lifting
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: In this paper we propose lifted Markov Chains (MCs) as a new paradigm for deriving patrol strategies for mobile agents on an environment represented as a graph. Lifted MCs operate on a state space that can be larger than the set of nodes of the graph, and a projection operation maps the MC state to the corresponding node of the graph. We prove bounds on the performance improvement of lifted MCs over non-lifted MCs, where the performance is measured by the Kemeny constant, and show a corresponding monotonicity for the Stackelberg game capture probability and return-time entropy. These bounds yield a result of independent interest that relates the Kemeny constant and the MC conductance for general MCs. We also provide a tractable method for optimizing lifted MCs on general graphs with edge weights encoding travel times. Simulation results on randomly generated and real-world graphs verify that lifted MCs achieve substantial improvements, particularly on sparse graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出提升马尔可夫链（Lifted MCs）作为移动智能体在图环境上巡逻策略的新范式，通过将状态空间扩展到图节点之上并投影回节点，证明其在Kemeny常数等指标上优于非提升MC，并给出优化方法与实验结果。
AI.motivation: 传统基于图节点的马尔可夫链巡逻策略性能受限，尤其在稀疏图上；作者希望借助比节点集更大的状态空间来提升巡逻、追捕或覆盖性能。
AI.method: 定义提升MC及其到图节点的投影操作；以Kemeny常数衡量性能，证明提升MC相对非提升MC的性能改进界，并分析Stackelberg博弈捕获概率和返回时间熵的单调性；推导Kemeny常数与MC电导的一般关系；提出在带边权（旅行时间）的一般图上优化提升MC的可处理方法。
AI.result: 理论上得到提升MC的性能改进界、相关单调性以及Kemeny常数与电导的关系；优化方法可行；在随机生成图和真实世界图上的仿真表明提升MC能显著提升性能，尤其在稀疏图上。
AI.conclusion: 提升马尔可夫链是一种有效且可优化的巡逻策略范式，能够突破传统节点级MC的性能限制，并为图上的移动智能体巡逻提供理论保证和实用方法。

title: An Explainable Header-Centric Framework for Large-Scale Semantic Table Interpretation and Data Quality Assessment
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, Workshop on Quality of Knowledge Graphs at ESWC 2026, May 11, 2026, Dubrovnik, Croatia
summary:
Knowledge Graph (KG) quality depends not only on downstream graph validation, but also on the quality of tabular metadata used before integration. In metadata-only Semantic Table Interpretation (STI), where cell values are unavailable, noisy, or unsuitable, column headers become a critical source of semantic evidence for traceable KG preparation.
  We present an explainable, header-centric framework for metadata-only Column Type Annotation (CTA) and Data Quality Assessment (DQA). The framework maps headers to 39 interpretable FinalFormat types using curated lexical resources and preserves token-level traceability through SourceKeywords. Each assigned type activates validation rules based on a taxonomy of Data Quality Issues (DQIs), producing detections such as missing data, duplicates, domain violations, wrong data type, and temporal mismatch. These detections are aggregated into HeadersIQ, a lightweight, unweighted data source-level quality metric.
  The framework was evaluated across heterogeneous benchmarks, including UCI, Prague, Kaggle, VizNet/Sato, SOTAB, T2Dv2, and the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, comprising around 120,000 header columns. The results show broad practical coverage across noisy real-world metadata, while a parallel KG-mapping pathway supports alignment to DBpedia and Schema.org. On the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, the official GT-strict evaluation was modest. However, a blinded diagnostic audit indicates that many mismatches reflect benchmark granularity, aliasing, and ontology-selection effects rather than wholly implausible header-centric predictions. We report this audit as diagnostic evidence on disagreement patterns, not as revised benchmark performance. Overall, the paper presents a reusable workflow for metadata-driven semantic annotation, data source-level quality monitoring, and KG-oriented benchmark diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释、以列头为中心的框架，用于元数据-only的列类型标注（CTA）和数据质量评估（DQA），并在多个基准上验证，同时通过诊断审计分析不匹配原因。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱质量不仅取决于下游图验证，还依赖于集成前表格元数据的质量。在元数据-only语义表格解释（STI）中，单元格值不可用或噪声大时，列头成为可追溯知识图谱准备的关键语义证据。
AI.method: 框架将列头映射到39个可解释的FinalFormat类型，使用词典资源和SourceKeywords保持词元级可追溯性。每个类型激活基于数据质量问题（DQI）分类的验证规则，检测缺失数据、重复、域违规、错误数据类型和时间不匹配，并聚合为轻量级未加权数据源级质量指标HeadersIQ。
AI.result: 在UCI、Prague、Kaggle、VizNet/Sato、SOTAB、T2Dv2和SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG等异构基准上评估，约12万列头。结果显示对噪声现实元数据广泛覆盖，KG映射路径支持对齐DBpedia和Schema.org。SemTab 2024官方GT-strict评估表现一般，但盲诊断审计表明许多不匹配源于基准粒度、别名和本体选择效应，而非完全不合理预测。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一个可重用工作流，用于元数据驱动的语义标注、数据源级质量监控和面向知识图谱的基准诊断。

title: Does Dynamic-Point Filtering Help When Texture Is Scarce? A Controlled Study of ORB-SLAM2 Front-Ends in Synthetic Indoor Scenes
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, submitted to IROS 2026. Open-source code and dataset available
summary: Dynamic-point filters are routinely added to feature-based visual SLAM, and several recent systems argue that removing dynamic features can leave too few static features in low-texture regions. So far, these systems have been evaluated only on texture-rich benchmark sequences. We present a controlled study that isolates this interaction. We render synthetic indoor sequences in which surface texture (four levels, quantified by FAST-corner density and image-gradient entropy) and scene dynamics (three levels) are varied factorially along identical camera trajectories, with stereo, RGB-D, ground-truth poses and dynamic masks. On this grid we compare ORB-SLAM2 without filtering, with an optical-flow and epipolar-residual filter (FLOW), and with a multi-view depth-consistency filter (GEOM), and report trajectory error, tracking completeness and surviving static features over five runs. Because the masks give per-keypoint ground truth, we also measure each filter's dynamic-point precision and recall and its static-feature false-removal rate, so that mechanistic explanations can be tested directly. We do not propose a new filter. On 720 runs over 24 sequences, filtering helped mainly in the most dynamic cells; the benefit did not decline monotonically with texture, but at the lowest level filtering reduced tracking completeness, and ORB-SLAM2 never initialised in static L3 scenes. Contrary to our hypothesis, GEOM discarded more static keypoints than FLOW (median FRR 6.8% vs. 1.5% for RGB-D, 19.6% vs. 1.5% for stereo); its RGB-D advantage tracked dynamic-point recall and vanished in stereo mode. Data and code are available at https://github.com/felixxxue/texture-dynamics-slam.

AI.tldr: 该研究在合成室内序列中系统改变表面纹理和动态程度，比较无过滤、FLOW光流/对极残差过滤和GEOM多视图深度一致性过滤在ORB-SLAM2中的表现，重点分析动态点过滤与纹理的交互。
AI.motivation: 动态点过滤常用于特征法视觉SLAM，近期系统认为去除动态特征可能在低纹理区域导致静态特征过少，但此前只在纹理丰富的数据集上评估，缺乏对纹理与动态交互的受控研究。
AI.method: 在相同相机轨迹下因子化生成4档纹理、3档动态程度的合成室内序列，提供双目、RGB-D、真值位姿和动态掩码；在720次运行、24个序列上比较ORB-SLAM2无过滤、FLOW和GEOM，统计轨迹误差、跟踪完整度、存活静态特征，并利用逐关键点真值测量动态点精度/召回率和静态特征误删率。
AI.result: 过滤主要在最动态场景中有效；收益并未随纹理降低而单调下降；最低纹理档中过滤降低了跟踪完整度，且ORB-SLAM2在静态L3场景中从未初始化成功。与假设相反，GEOM比FLOW丢弃更多静态关键点，RGB-D下中位误删率为6.8%对1.5%，双目下为19.6%对1.5%；GEOM在RGB-D中的优势与动态点召回率相关，但在双目模式下消失。
AI.conclusion: 动态点过滤并非在所有纹理和动态条件下都带来收益，纹理与动态存在复杂交互；低纹理下过滤可能损害跟踪完整性；GEOM的静态特征误删率高于FLOW，且其RGB-D优势不能推广到双目模式。

title: Teaching a Robot Dog New Tricks: Diverse Quadruped Skills via Combined Reinforcement and Imitation Learning with Adversarial Task Selection
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled legged robots to perform a range of skills in single-task settings. However, applications such as farm robotics or space exploration require diverse skills such as locomotion, digging, or close-range surveying. Training an end-to-end policy to address this problem remains difficult due to challenges such as sample inefficiency and gradient conflict between tasks in multi-task learning. We propose a three-stage method that trains a single policy to perform distinct tasks such as walking, digging, and hopping, and compose them into novel behaviors such as crawling. First, multiple teacher policies are trained using RL on narrowly defined tasks. Then, two additional stages train a student policy with a multi-teacher distillation setup that uses a combined RL and Imitation Learning (IL) objective under an adversarial task selection process that focuses training on the worst-performing task. With this method, we train a student policy that performs 22 tasks using 8 teachers. Evaluations show our method preserves motion quality and tracks commands more accurately than PPO and distill-then-finetune baselines, and in some cases generalizes to new tasks without explicit training. Finally, we demonstrate real-world robustness by deploying the resulting policy on a Unitree B1 quadruped. Video: https://youtu.be/V9yX04EBcFA

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种三阶段方法，用强化学习训练多个教师策略，再通过多教师蒸馏、RL与模仿学习联合目标以及对抗式任务选择，训练出能执行22种任务的单一学生策略，并部署于Unitree B1四足机器人。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人在农业、太空探索等场景需要行走、挖掘、近距离勘测等多种技能，但端到端多任务策略训练面临样本效率低和任务间梯度冲突等困难。
AI.method: 方法分为三阶段：先用RL在窄任务上训练多个教师策略；再通过多教师蒸馏训练学生策略，结合RL与模仿学习目标；同时采用对抗式任务选择，将训练重点放在表现最差的任务上。最终用8个教师训练出执行22种任务的学生策略。
AI.result: 评估表明，该方法在动作质量和命令跟踪精度上优于PPO和“先蒸馏后微调”基线，部分情况下还能泛化到未显式训练的新任务；并在Unitree B1四足机器人上验证了真实世界鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该三阶段多教师蒸馏与对抗任务选择框架能够训练单一策略掌握多种机器人技能，并能组合出新行为，如爬行，同时具备一定的泛化能力和实机部署潜力。

title: Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation for Thin Curvilinear Structures
summary: Accurate segmentation of thin curvilinear structures is vital for various real-world applications, from vessel analysis to road extraction. Yet their intricate geometry makes even minor pixel-wise errors enough to break the global topology, and this structural fragility turns severe domain shifts into catastrophic failures. The difficulty is most acute under cross-modality gaps, where the imaging process itself differs fundamentally between source and target. While test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical source-free remedy, existing methods adapt feature statistics and confidence, neither of which constrains connectivity, and thus degrade under such extreme gaps. To address this, we propose Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation (SGP-TTA). Progressive Batch Normalization (ProgBN) shifts normalization from frozen source statistics toward current target estimates under a sample-count schedule, so that the source-target balance follows the stage of adaptation rather than a fixed coefficient. Consensus Skeleton Recall (CSR) then derives a structural target from geometrically aligned multi-view predictions and updates only the BN affine parameters to preserve connected structures. Extensive experiments show that SGP-TTA consistently outperforms existing TTA methods in topological connectivity, with the largest margins under cross-modality shift. The project page is available at https://boa-jang.github.io/SGP-TTA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation (SGP-TTA)，用于薄曲线结构分割中的跨模态域偏移问题，通过渐进式批归一化与骨架引导的结构约束提升拓扑连通性。
AI.motivation: 薄曲线结构（如血管、道路）分割对像素级误差非常敏感，微小错误即可破坏全局拓扑；跨模态域偏移下该问题更严重。现有测试时自适应方法主要调整特征统计或置信度，无法约束连通性，因此在极端域偏移下性能下降。
AI.method: 提出 SGP-TTA，包含两个核心模块：Progressive Batch Normalization (ProgBN) 按样本数调度，将归一化从冻结源域统计逐步转向目标域估计；Consensus Skeleton Recall (CSR) 从几何对齐的多视角预测中提取结构目标，并仅更新 BN 仿射参数以保持连通结构。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SGP-TTA 在拓扑连通性上持续优于现有 TTA 方法，尤其是在跨模态偏移场景下取得最大提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: SGP-TTA 通过渐进式归一化和骨架共识约束，有效缓解跨模态域偏移下薄曲线结构分割的拓扑断裂问题，是一种实用的无源测试时自适应方案。

title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
summary: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distributional fidelity without per-domain authoring. We introduce **Synthesis Through Simulation** (STS), a **schema--free** data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments. Because data is generated through the same environment that defines what is valid, STS guarantees structural validity by construction while decoupling validity enforcement from distribution modeling, allowing each to be addressed independently. The **Generalist Populator** (GP), STS's domain-agnostic agent, addresses the remaining challenges of distributional fidelity and synthesis scalability: GP achieves **0.88** average marginal fidelity and **100\% constraint satisfaction** across all ten environments *without access to DB schemas*, while statistical synthesizers are inapplicable to seven due to necessary seed data requirements, and schema-privileged agents fail 82\% of trajectories on airline environment's tightly coupled workflows due to brittle task composition. We open-source the full framework, all ten environments, and generated datasets at https://github.com/SAP/synthesis-through-simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出“通过模拟合成”（STS）的无模式数据合成范式，让LLM代理在模拟企业环境中执行策略API操作来生成数据；其通用填充器GP在十个环境中实现0.88平均边际保真度和100%约束满足，且无需数据库模式。
AI.motivation: 企业AI中的工具调用代理训练与评估因商业和法律限制难以规模化；表格数据合成受结构有效性和模式可用性制约，而基于流程的方法又缺乏分布保真度且需逐域编写。
AI.method: STS范式：LLM代理在策略约束的模拟企业环境中执行API操作生成数据，因数据由定义有效性的同一环境产生而天然保证结构有效性，并将有效性执行与分布建模解耦；提出领域无关代理Generalist Populator（GP）解决分布保真度与合成可扩展性问题。
AI.result: GP在全部十个环境中无需数据库模式即达到平均边际保真度0.88和100%约束满足；统计合成器因需种子数据在七个环境中不适用；模式特权代理在航空环境因任务组合脆弱导致82%轨迹失败。
AI.conclusion: STS通过构造保证结构有效性，解耦有效性与分布建模，使二者可独立处理；GP验证了无模式、高保真、高约束满足的数据合成可行性，并开源框架、十个环境和生成数据集。

title: A Camera-Native Stereo VR180 Dataset
summary: Immersive VR180 video is increasingly produced with professional stereo fisheye cameras, yet public VR180 research resources are mostly collected from online platforms such as YouTube: already stitched, projected and compressed by unknown pipelines, and without lens calibration. We present a firsthand-captured stereo VR180 dataset recorded with two Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive cameras. It contains 1,211 samples -- 636 stereo video clips (2,220.8 s, mostly 90 fps) and 575 stereo stills -- each released as camera-native Blackmagic RAW, separate-eye native fisheye HEVC (8160x7200 per eye) and half-equirectangular HEVC (7200x7200 per eye), together with the factory lens calibration, portable fisheye/half-equirectangular conversion tools and AI-generated scene and visual-challenge annotations. Re-encoding the released fisheye and half-equirectangular renders with x265 over 24 clips, both eyes, four rate points and nine viewing directions, native-fisheye coding needed more bitrate than half-equirectangular coding at equal viewport quality for all 24 clips (median +38%), in every part of the field of view. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lulinxuan/VR180 ; code: https://github.com/lulinxuan/vr180-dataset-tools

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个第一手拍摄的立体VR180数据集，包含视频和静态图，提供相机原生RAW、原生鱼眼与半等距柱状HEVC、镜头标定、转换工具及AI标注，并比较两种编码格式的码率需求。
AI.motivation: 现有公开VR180资源多来自YouTube等平台，已被未知流程拼接、投影和压缩，且缺少镜头标定，难以支撑对原始采集、编码和视觉质量的研究。
AI.method: 使用两台Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive相机拍摄，发布1211个样本：636个立体视频片段（2220.8秒，多为90fps）和575张立体静态图。每个样本提供Blackmagic RAW、单眼原生鱼眼HEVC（8160x7200）和半等距柱状HEVC（7200x7200），并附工厂镜头标定、可移植鱼眼/半等距柱状转换工具及AI生成的场景和视觉挑战标注。对24个片段、双眼、4个码率点、9个观察方向用x265重编码比较。
AI.result: 在相同视口质量下，原生鱼眼编码在全部24个片段和整个视场范围内均比半等距柱状编码需要更高码率，中位数高出38%。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为VR180研究提供了原生标定、多格式素材和工具，并表明直接对原生鱼眼视频编码在等质量下码率效率低于半等距柱状编码。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Preparation of Transportation Management Plans: A Case Study with WisDOT WisTMP System
summary: Work zones are critical yet hazardous components of transportation infrastructure, requiring carefully designed Transportation Management Plans (TMPs) to ensure safety and mobility. However, TMP preparation remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on practitioner expertise. This paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to automate TMP content generation, leveraging the WisDOT WisTMP system as the application context. The framework fine-tunes multiple open-source LLMs across different model scales and deploys them locally to ensure data security. To support model training, we construct a domain-specific dataset from historical WisTMP documents by converting PDF files into structured question-answer pairs in JSON format. Experimental results show that fine-tuning significantly improves performance across standard text generation metrics. Further section-wise and strategy-level analyses reveal that, while LLMs achieve strong overall performance, they tend to over-generate strategies and struggle to produce project-specific justifications and accurate cost estimates. In addition, scaling from 7B/8B to 14B yields limited gains. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs to improve TMP preparation efficiency while highlighting remaining challenges in LLM-assisted TMP development. The source code and demo videos will be publicly available at https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，用于自动生成交通管理计划（TMP）内容，并以WisDOT WisTMP系统为应用场景，通过构建领域数据集并微调多个开源LLM来提升TMP编制效率。
AI.motivation: 工作区是交通基础设施中关键但高风险的部分，TMP编制劳动密集且高度依赖从业者经验，因此需要自动化辅助手段。
AI.method: 将历史WisTMP文档中的PDF转换为JSON格式的问答对，构建领域数据集；微调不同规模的开源LLM并本地部署以保障数据安全；从标准文本生成指标、分节和策略层面进行评估。
AI.result: 微调显著提升了标准文本生成指标；LLM整体表现较强，但倾向于过度生成策略，难以生成项目特定的论证和准确成本估算，且从7B/8B扩展到14B收益有限。
AI.conclusion: LLM有潜力提高TMP编制效率，但在LLM辅助TMP开发中仍存在挑战；源代码和演示视频将公开。

title: Improving Image-Based Nutrition Estimation Through Multimodal Food-Item Verification and Recovery
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Single-image nutrition estimation can fail silently when visible foods are missed. Even when a food is correctly identified, its proposed region may not support portion estimation. We propose a framework that uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to inventory visible foods and separately verify food identity and whether each proposed 2D region supports portion estimation. One whole-image review uses these verification results to identify unresolved gaps and omitted foods, triggering at most one targeted recovery pass. Recovered regions are re-verified without access to the recovery prompt, then reconciled into a final item set for nutrition estimation. The framework requires no task-specific fine-tuning. Matched evaluation on common valid-output samples shows that item-level grounding improves mass accuracy across all tested settings and energy accuracy relative to an adapted retrieval baseline, with item-identity precision and recall also improving, while post-recovery visual coverage is assessed separately at inference time without ground-truth annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需任务特定微调的MLLM框架，先盘点可见食物，再分别验证食物身份和2D区域是否支持份量估计；通过整图审查发现遗漏并最多触发一次定向恢复，最终合并为食物项集用于营养估计。
AI.motivation: 单图营养估计可能因漏掉可见食物而静默失败；即使食物被正确识别，其候选区域也可能无法支持份量估计。
AI.method: 利用多模态大语言模型盘点可见食物，并分别验证食物身份与区域是否支持份量估计。通过一次整图审查识别未解决缺口和遗漏食物，触发至多一次定向恢复；恢复区域在不访问恢复提示的情况下重新验证，再协调为最终食物项集用于营养估计。
AI.result: 在常见有效输出样本的匹配评估中，item-level grounding 在所有测试设置下提升质量准确率，并相对 adapted retrieval baseline 提升能量准确率；食物身份精确率和召回率也提升。恢复后视觉覆盖率可在推理时无需真实标注单独评估。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能减少漏检和无效区域导致的静默失败，提升营养估计准确性，且无需任务特定微调。

title: EnergyNet in Practice: Long Grid, Short Grids and Mobility-Based Energy Peering
summary:
Electrification is planned as a network problem: more demand, more upstream capacity, local resources waiting for reinforcement. We argue that a material part of that bill, in money and time, follows from architecture, not electrification itself, and propose the Short Grid as the deployment unit: a locally controlled building, block or campus whose demand, generation, storage and local market operate behind Energy Routers enforcing an approved connection envelope to the Long Grid. Because the envelope governs exchange, not installed capacity, local resources can grow and many sites can build in parallel at the pace of PV and EV installation, not grid reinforcement. PV and EV batteries dominate today, but the architecture is general: any generation or storage, fixed or mobile, fits behind the same boundary and interfaces. EnergyNet Operators coordinate exchange among Short Grids and with the Long Grid; protection stays local; Vehicle-to-EnergyNet (V2EN) and Mobility-Based Energy Peering (MEP) make mobility-financed batteries accessible within and between them; priority-based operation protects critical services in shortage.
  We test it in models, not yet the field: a ten-building neighbourhood in Lund, Sweden; a bus-linked microgrid pair at Stanford and Half Moon Bay; and a proposed 20-site network in Rockaway, New York. Households and services are the largest demand category in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, California and New York (484 TWh/yr); halving their grid imports would be about 242 TWh. Europe's network investment to 2040 is estimated above EUR 1.2 trillion; modelling shows it depends on system design. Negagrid value, following the negawatt, counts network investment avoided, downsized or deferred, net of local substitute costs. "Don't pay twice": build coordinated local capability first; reinforce the Long Grid for what remains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以“短电网”为部署单元的电气化网络架构：本地建筑、街区或园区在能源路由器控制下，通过获批的连接包络与长电网交换电力，从而让本地发电、储能和移动储能先发展，减少对上游电网加固的依赖。
AI.motivation: 电气化常被当作电网扩容问题，导致大量资金和时间用于上游加固。作者认为其中很大一部分成本源于架构而非电气化本身，因此需要新的部署单元来并行建设本地资源。
AI.method: 提出短电网架构，由能源路由器执行连接包络，EnergyNet运营商协调短电网之间及与长电网的交换；保护保持本地化；引入V2EN和MEP利用移动储能；采用优先级运行保障短缺时的关键服务。通过模型测试三个案例：瑞典隆德十栋建筑社区、斯坦福与半月湾的公交连接微电网对、纽约Rockaway拟议20站点网络，并估算欧洲2040年前网络投资及负电网价值。
AI.result: 家庭与服务是瑞典、丹麦、挪威、加州和纽约最大需求类别，合计484 TWh/年；若将其电网进口减半，约为242 TWh。欧洲到2040年网络投资估计超过1.2万亿欧元，建模显示该投资取决于系统设计。负电网价值按避免、缩减或推迟的网络投资扣除本地替代成本计算。
AI.conclusion: 应“不要重复付费”：优先建设协调的本地能力，再对剩余需求加固长电网。短电网架构具有通用性，可适配固定或移动的发电与储能，并支持多站点并行部署。

title: TacHair: Tactile Contact-Distribution Guided Online Correction for Robotic Hair Stroking and Perception
summary: Hair stroking is common in daily grooming and personal care, and is also widely used in hair-product evaluation, motivating robots with similar physical interaction capabilities. Existing robotic hair-care and surface-following methods mainly rely on trajectory planning, compliance, force regulation, or tactile-conditioned policies, but deformable hair can remain in contact while gradually drifting across the end-effector, making local interaction difficult to regulate. We propose TacHair, a tactile contact-distribution guided online correction framework that represents high-resolution tactile observations as a spatial hair-contact distribution. A visuotactile imitation policy generates the nominal stroking motion, while a separately trained residual module corrects local contact deviations, separating task progression from contact recovery. We evaluate TacHair in 525 real-robot trials across five head geometries and three hair conditions. A successful stroke requires both sufficient task progression and contact maintenance; our method improves success from 42.9% to 62.3% and contact maintenance from 59.4% to 88.0% over the same visuotactile policy without correction. These results demonstrate spatial tactile contact distributions as an effective feedback representation for contact-preserving interaction with deformable and visually occluded surfaces. Demos, code, and datasets are available at https://tachair.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出TacHair，一种基于触觉接触分布引导的在线修正框架，用于机器人梳理头发。通过视觉触觉模仿策略生成名义梳理运动，残差模块修正局部接触偏差，在525次真实机器人试验中显著提升成功率和接触维持率。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人头发护理和表面跟随方法依赖轨迹规划、柔顺控制、力调节或触觉条件策略，但可变形头发可能在接触中逐渐漂移出末端执行器，导致局部交互难以调节。
AI.method: 将高分辨率触觉观测表示为空间头发接触分布；视觉触觉模仿策略生成名义梳理运动；单独训练的残差模块修正局部接触偏差，分离任务推进与接触恢复。
AI.result: 在5种头部几何和3种头发条件下进行525次真实机器人试验。成功梳理需同时满足任务推进和接触维持。相比无修正的视觉触觉策略，成功率从42.9%提升到62.3%，接触维持率从59.4%提升到88.0%。
AI.conclusion: 空间触觉接触分布是处理可变形且视觉遮挡表面时保持接触交互的有效反馈表示。演示、代码和数据集已公开。

title: Wieszcz-XIX: A 3.1-Billion-Word Corpus of Pre-1918 Polish and Temporally Bounded Language Models Trained From Scratch
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Corpus: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SKocur/polish-pre1918-corpus ; code: https://github.com/SKocur/wieszcz-xix ; weights: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22099358
summary: Historical Polish is well documented as a language but annotated in machine-readable form only to about a million words for the period this paper covers; the rest sits behind optical character recognition of variable quality. We present Wieszcz-XIX, a corpus of 6.75 billion tokens (about 3.1 billion words) in 294,369 documents, most of them periodical issues, of Polish published from 1800 to 1918, assembled from Wolne Lektury and the Internet Archive by a pipeline that filters, deduplicates, audits for post-1918 leakage and splits at the document level. It is over three orders of magnitude larger than the annotated corpus of the same period, and we quantify its defects: recognition corruption against a false-positive floor, near-identical duplication, which is removed, and post-1918 leakage, which is excluded from the training corpus itself down to a known residue of 0.04 to 0.38% of its bytes, found in the transcribed source, so the published corpus is the trained one document for document. On a hand-corrected sample the character error rate is 0.68% where the text is legible, and 45% of the sampled passages cannot be corrected. On it we train a ladder of decoder-only models from 47M to 349M parameters from scratch, and measure their temporal boundedness. Against two modern Polish base models, one far larger, the 349M shows a crossover, as does the 107M against the comparator of its size: post-1918 vocabulary costs them about 3.1 bits per byte more than period vocabulary, a gap the comparators do not show, and period vocabulary costs them fewer bits than it costs the comparators. Shown period text, the models keep its spelling and the comparators only partly. Adding parameters gains about twice as much as a second pass over the data. We release the corpus, code and weights. Content warning: the models reproduce period prejudice, including antisemitic statements.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 Wieszcz-XIX，一个 1800—1918 年波兰语历史语料库，含 67.5 亿词元、约 31 亿词、294369 份文档，并训练 47M—349M 参数的仅解码器模型，评估其时间边界性。
AI.motivation: 历史波兰语虽有文献记录，但机器可读标注仅约百万词，其余多依赖质量不稳定的 OCR；因此需要大规模、可审计的历史时期语料与模型来研究该时期语言。
AI.method: 从 Wolne Lektury 和 Internet Archive 构建语料库，流程包括过滤、去重、1918 年后内容泄漏审计、按文档切分；量化 OCR 损坏、重复和泄漏；在手改样本上评估字符错误率；从零训练 47M—349M 参数解码器模型，并与两个现代波兰语基座模型比较时间边界性、比特/字节和拼写保持能力。
AI.result: 语料库比同期标注语料大三个数量级以上；后 1918 年泄漏降至已知字节残差 0.04%—0.38%；可读文本字符错误率 0.68%，但 45% 样本段落无法校正。349M 模型和同尺寸比较中 107M 模型出现交叉：后 1918 年词汇多耗约 3.1 bits/byte，而比较模型无此差距；时期词汇对本文模型成本更低。模型能保持时期拼写，比较模型仅部分保持；增加参数收益约为再训练一轮数据的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 发布语料、代码和权重。大规模历史波兰语语料可训练出具有时间边界性的模型，使其更适配时期词汇与拼写，但模型也会复现时期偏见，包括反犹言论。

title: Constructive Safety-Critical Control for a Class of Underactuated Systems: A Hierarchical Approach
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. To appear at the IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC), 2026
summary: Underactuated systems with nontrivial geometry are abundant in practical robotic problems. However, little is known about constructive safety-critical control design in the presence of underactuation. In this work, we provide a constructive framework for synthesizing safe control architectures and control barrier functions for a class of quadrotor-like underactuated systems. By studying the geometry of their underactuation, we characterize when these systems have natural layered architectures useful for safety-critical control design. Using these architectures, we devise a constructive, hierarchical CBF synthesis procedure and provide conditions under which it succeeds.

AI.tldr: 本文针对四旋翼类欠驱动系统，利用欠驱动几何特性提出一种构造性安全控制与控制障碍函数（CBF）综合框架。
AI.motivation: 欠驱动且具有非平凡几何的系统在机器人中普遍存在，但如何在欠驱动条件下构造性地设计安全关键控制仍缺乏系统方法。
AI.method: 通过分析四旋翼类欠驱动系统的欠驱动几何，刻画其具有自然分层架构的条件，并基于该架构提出分层式CBF构造综合流程。
AI.result: 给出了系统具备可用于安全关键控制设计的自然分层架构的几何条件，并提供了分层CBF综合方法成功的充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为四旋翼类欠驱动系统提供了构造性安全控制架构与CBF设计框架，推动了欠驱动系统安全关键控制理论的发展。

title: Seeing Through the Glare: A Multi-Source Benchmark and Ocular-Adaptive Pixel MeanFlow for Eyeglass Reflection Removal
summary: Eyeglass reflection removal is important across smartphone imaging, video conferencing, and other face-centric visual applications. The task is challenging because reflections range from mild photometric contamination to severe ocular occlusion, requiring selective correction and plausible reconstruction without altering identity or natural appearance. Existing datasets cover limited reflection conditions, constraining generalization to complex real-world scenes and systematic evaluation. We introduce \textbf{OcuBench}, a multi-source benchmark comprising 10,280 controllable synthetic pairs, 732 real-input pseudo-pairs, and 458 independent real-world test images, supporting both paired evaluation and assessment beyond generated supervision. We further propose \textbf{OcuFlow}, an ocular-adaptive pixel MeanFlow (pMF) framework for efficient, detail-preserving restoration. It combines geometry-adaptive representation with one-step pMF to focus reconstruction on reflection-obscured ocular regions, together with native-resolution frequency-preserving synthesis to retain reliable observed details. Experiments across diverse reflection conditions demonstrate that OcuFlow achieves consistent advantages in reflection removal quality, ocular fidelity, and efficiency. In a blind user study, it receives $67.32\%$ of selections, $6.2\times$ the next-best share. Both the code and dataset will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文针对眼镜反光去除提出OcuBench基准和OcuFlow方法，兼顾合成与真实场景评估，并实现高效、保细节的眼部区域修复。
AI.motivation: 眼镜反光从轻微光度污染到严重眼部遮挡不等，现有数据集覆盖条件有限，难以泛化到复杂真实场景并进行系统评估。
AI.method: 构建OcuBench多源基准，包含10,280个可控合成对、732个真实输入伪对和458张独立真实测试图；提出OcuFlow眼部自适应像素MeanFlow框架，结合几何自适应表示、一步pMF和原生分辨率频率保持合成。
AI.result: 在多种反光条件下，OcuFlow在反光去除质量、眼部保真度和效率上均取得一致优势；盲测用户研究中获67.32%选择，为次优方法的6.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为眼镜反光去除提供了更全面的评估基准和高效复原方法，代码与数据集将公开。

title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Code and research artifacts: https://github.com/boldprojekte/agent-forgetting-research
summary: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user instructions and assistant messages from these operations. In an exploratory OpenTelemetry debugging case followed by an unrelated implementation task, the method ended with 231,951 provider-reported prompt tokens versus 912,492 under retained history, used 50% fewer cumulative input tokens, and had an estimated API cost of USD 1.28-1.44 versus approximately USD 4.38. Both arms passed the two-case primary behavioral oracle; neither fully satisfied the follow-up evaluation. The method made more requests and took 17% longer. A contrasting application-development pair produced no context or cost saving, and an earlier continuation exhibited lower manually assessed quality despite reduced context. These observations demonstrate substantial resource savings in noisy tool-use trajectories and identify workload dependence as a central consideration for reversible context management.

AI.tldr: 论文研究由智能体自身控制的遗忘机制：将此前观察到的工具调用结果替换为简短备注，并把原始内容存入可恢复存档。在 OpenTelemetry 调试与后续实现任务中显著节省 token 与成本，但效果依赖工作负载，且可能带来更多请求、耗时增加与质量风险。
AI.motivation: 工具使用智能体反复接收大量观察结果，其中真正有用的内容往往远小于原始负载，导致上下文冗长、token 消耗和 API 成本过高。因此需要一种可逆的上下文管理方法，在保留恢复能力的同时减少冗余历史。
AI.method: 提出智能体控制的遗忘方法：由行动模型选择此前观察到的工具结果，在原位置用短备注替换，并将完整原文保存在可恢复档案中。实现为 Python harness，支持批量归档和显式恢复，无需任务特定训练；同时保护用户指令和助手消息不被操作。
AI.result: 在 OpenTelemetry 调试案例及无关实现任务中，方法结束时 provider-reported prompt tokens 为 231,951，而保留完整历史为 912,492；累计输入 token 减少 50%；估计 API 成本为 1.28–1.44 美元，对比约 4.38 美元。两组均通过两案例主要行为 oracle，但都未完全满足后续评估。方法发起更多请求，耗时增加 17%。另一组应用开发任务没有上下文或成本节省，且早期延续在减少上下文情况下人工评估质量更低。
AI.conclusion: 可逆的智能体控制遗忘能在噪声较大的工具使用轨迹中带来显著资源节省，但效果高度依赖工作负载。工作负载依赖性是可逆上下文管理的核心考虑因素，同时需权衡请求次数、延迟与输出质量。

title: A Unified Score Matching Paradigm for Video Anomaly Detection and Anticipation
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a fundamental and safety-critical task in computer vision. Recent generative approaches detect anomalies from a distributional perspective, but remain limited by local anomaly modes. Meanwhile, video anomaly anticipation (VAA), as a proactive extension beyond post-hoc detection, introduces additional challenges. In particular, the contrastive inference paradigm in VAD, which relies on ground-truth frames, is not applicable to VAA, hindering its development. To address these challenges, we propose a unified score-driven framework, termed Uni-DSM, based on denoising score matching (DSM), which models anomaly patterns through likelihood estimation and score functions over the learned data distribution. Within this unified framework, we adopt a shared noise-conditioned score transformer backbone with scene-dependent embeddings and motion-aware weighting for distribution-level modeling. Instead of introducing separate architectures, Uni-DSM unifies VAD and VAA through different inference and supervision paradigms built upon the same score-based formulation. For VAD, we instantiate an autoregressive denoising score matching (ADSM) mechanism, which progressively accumulates anomalous evidence via autoregressive denoising, enabling enhanced perception of local modes beyond visual cues. For VAA, we extend the same architecture by incorporating a lightweight auxiliary decoder and a novel self-distilled denoising score matching (SDSM) mechanism. By constructing supervision from output discrepancies instead of relying on unavailable future ground truth, our method achieves efficient training suitable or early anomaly anticipation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both VAD and VAA while maintaining high efficiency, establishing a unified and scalable pipeline from anomaly detection to anticipation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一的分值驱动框架 Uni-DSM，基于去噪分值匹配（DSM）同时处理视频异常检测（VAD）与视频异常预判（VAA），并在多个基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式VAD方法从分布角度检测异常，但受局部异常模式限制；VAA作为主动扩展面临未来真值不可用的问题，传统依赖真值帧的对比推理范式不适用，阻碍其发展。
AI.method: 提出Uni-DSM统一框架，使用共享的噪声条件分值Transformer主干，结合场景相关嵌入与运动感知加权进行分布级建模。VAD采用自回归去噪分值匹配（ADSM）逐步累积异常证据；VAA在同一架构上加入轻量辅助解码器和自蒸馏去噪分值匹配（SDSM），利用输出差异构造监督，避免依赖未来真值。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在VAD和VAA任务上均达到最先进性能，同时保持高效率。
AI.conclusion: Uni-DSM建立了从异常检测到异常预判的统一且可扩展的流程，验证了基于分值匹配的统一建模在不同推理与监督范式下的有效性。

title: Cognitive Thermometers: Machine Learning and Logical Complexity
summary: How does the human mind represent semantic categories? Why do natural languages favor certain meanings over others? Prior explanations have relied on logical definability and complexity, but these are highly sensitive to the choice of logical language, rendering some design choices unmotivated. In this article, we propose that machine learning provides a somewhat more agnostic approach to measuring semantic complexity. We review emerging evidence that logic and machine learning often yield converging results on relative complexity and its resulting effects in semantic typology. Where they diverge, learning appears to be a better explanation than logical complexity. We argue that treating machine learning models as ``cognitive thermometers'' enables a unified approach to complexity that bridges symbolic logic and connectionist AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用机器学习衡量语义复杂度，并综述逻辑与机器学习在语义类型学中常得到一致结果的证据。
AI.motivation: 已有解释依赖逻辑可定义性和复杂度，但这些指标对所选逻辑语言高度敏感，导致部分设计选择缺乏合理依据。
AI.method: 将机器学习模型视为“认知温度计”，以更中立的方式度量语义复杂度，并比较逻辑方法与机器学习方法在语义类型学中的结果。
AI.result: 逻辑与机器学习在相对复杂度及其对语义类型学的影响上常呈现收敛结果；当二者分歧时，学习比逻辑复杂度更能解释现象。
AI.conclusion: 以机器学习模型度量语义复杂度，有助于统一符号逻辑与连接主义人工智能，并为语义范畴和语言偏好提供更合理的解释框架。

title: Masked Generative Motion Planning with Geometry-Guided Token Search
summary: Generative motion planners typically use learned trajectory priors for initial generation, while leaving test-time repair to local continuous refinement. We introduce Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP), which extends the learned prior from efficient parallel generation to structural repair. A masked generative transformer generates discrete trajectory candidates in parallel, and Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS) uses scene geometry to target where to edit and which prior-supported alternatives to evaluate. This turns refinement into an efficient search over discrete motion alternatives, enabling route-level restructuring beyond local trajectory deformation. MGMP achieves 96% success on Ring Maze and 82% repair success on Controlled Route Invalidation on Kuka, exceeding the strongest external baselines by 23 and 25 percentage points, respectively. It further generalizes to unseen layouts, additional obstacles, unseen geometries, single- and dual-arm planning, and real-world Baxter tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出掩码生成式运动规划（MGMP），将学习到的轨迹先验从并行生成扩展到结构修复，通过离散轨迹候选的并行生成与几何引导的令牌搜索实现路线级重规划，并在多个任务上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式运动规划器通常仅用学习先验做初始生成，测试时修复依赖局部连续优化，难以进行路线级结构修复。
AI.method: MGMP 使用掩码生成式 Transformer 并行生成离散轨迹候选；Geometry-Guided Token Search（GGTS）利用场景几何决定编辑位置和评估哪些先验支持的离散替代方案，将修复转化为离散运动替代方案的高效搜索。
AI.result: 在 Ring Maze 上达到 96% 成功率，在 Kuka 的 Controlled Route Invalidation 上达到 82% 修复成功率，分别超过最强外部基线 23 和 25 个百分点；并泛化到未见布局、额外障碍物、未见几何、单臂和双臂规划以及真实 Baxter 任务。
AI.conclusion: MGMP 通过离散搜索实现超出局部轨迹变形的路线级结构修复，在多种规划与修复场景中表现出高效性和强泛化能力。

title: LinSlot: Exploiting Linear Representation hypothesis for unsupervised attribute discovery from slot based object representation
summary: This paper studies the problem of learning disentangled representations of objects and their attributes from raw, unstructured image data. Slot-based methods have shown considerable success in unsupervised learning of object representations from images. Block-slot attention-based methods extend this framework to attribute representations by assuming a uniform factorization of object representations into attributes, which may be suboptimal and consequently limit the quality of the learned representations. We therefore investigate a framework for jointly discovering object and attribute representations. Our key contribution is leveraging the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which postulates that composable concepts can be represented as linearly additive subspaces in slot representations. Based on this insight, we propose a probabilistic model connecting images, slots (objects), and blocks (attributes). We present an architecture that leverages block attention to connect attribute representations to slots and incorporates LRH in both object and attribute representation spaces. This architecture effectively optimizes the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) of the proposed graphical model. Our experiments demonstrate (i) effective discovery of disentangled object and attribute representations, (ii) empirical evidence for LRH in slot space, and (iii) the ability to perform image editing owing to the disentangled and interpretable nature of the learned representations. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improvements in DCI scores over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究从原始图像中解耦学习对象及其属性的表示，提出基于线性表示假设（LRH）的块-槽注意力框架，联合发现对象与属性表示，并在多个数据集上提升DCI指标。
AI.motivation: 现有槽式方法能无监督学习对象表示，而块-槽注意力方法假设对象表示可均匀分解为属性，这种假设可能次优，限制了表示质量，因此需要更好地联合学习对象与属性表示。
AI.method: 利用线性表示假设（LRH），即组合概念可在槽表示中以线性可加子空间表示，构建连接图像、槽（对象）和块（属性）的概率模型；设计基于块注意力的架构，将属性表示连接到槽，并在对象与属性表示空间中融入LRH，从而优化证据下界（ELBO）。
AI.result: 实验表明：能有效发现解耦的对象与属性表示；为槽空间中的LRH提供实证支持；由于表示解耦且可解释，可进行图像编辑；在多个数据集上DCI分数优于当前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架可联合学习解耦的对象与属性表示，验证了LRH在槽表示中的有效性，并提升了表示质量与下游图像编辑能力。

title: Lossy Compressive Text Autoencoders
summary: Our work explores learning a compressed latent representation of text, at the intersection of data compression and representation learning. We propose an autoencoder architecture that performs residual downscaling and upscaling of hidden representations along the time axis, with a residual low-dimension discrete bottleneck. We analyze our approach for different quantization methods, training objectives, and datasets. For different levels of compression, we evaluate the similarity between the original and reconstructed text both at the surface-level (BLEU) and at the semantic-level (LLM-based judge). Additionally, we evaluate our models on downstream question-answering and semantic text similarity benchmarks. Our approach results in compressed representations which are on par with lossless text compression algorithms at 2.24 bits per byte on web text data, while having good reconstruction and downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究文本的压缩潜在表示，提出一种在时间轴上进行残差降采样和上采样的自编码器架构，并带有残差低维离散瓶颈。在不同量化方法、训练目标和数据集上进行了分析，压缩表示在Web文本上达到2.24 bits/byte，与无损压缩算法相当，同时保持较好的重建和下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 探索数据压缩与表示学习的交叉点，学习文本的压缩潜在表示，以在压缩率、重建质量和下游任务性能之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出一种自编码器架构，沿时间轴对隐藏表示进行残差降采样和上采样，并使用残差低维离散瓶颈；分析不同量化方法、训练目标和数据集。
AI.result: 在Web文本数据上达到2.24 bits/byte，与无损文本压缩算法相当；在不同压缩级别下，通过BLEU评估表层相似度，并通过基于LLM的评判评估语义相似度；下游问答和语义文本相似度基准上也表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 该压缩表示方法能够在接近无损压缩的压缩率下，保持较好的文本重建质量和下游任务性能。

title: TAPNAV: Humanoid Navigation through Tactile Active Perception
summary: Navigation in vision-denied environments is challenging for humanoid robots because proprioceptive odometry drifts and localization uncertainty accumulates rapidly. We present TAPNAV, a tactile active-perception framework that enables humanoid navigation toward a goal by actively probing surrounding structures without relying on vision. TAPNAV maintains a pose belief from odometry, IMU, and tactile contact observations, and couples uncertainty-aware global route planning with information-gain-driven local probing. The global planner searches for routes that keep predicted localization uncertainty bounded by exploiting opportunities for tactile correction, while the local planner selects probe actions that maximize expected information gain. A whole-body controller coordinates the humanoid's locomotion and end-effector contact to execute the planned navigation and probe motions. We evaluate TAPNAV in simulation and on a Unitree G1 across different floor plans and obstacle geometries. TAPNAV achieves lower state estimation error and a higher task completion rate than baselines. These results demonstrate that actively planning physical interactions with the environment can provide localization cues for reliable humanoid navigation without vision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAPNAV，一种不依赖视觉的触觉主动感知框架，使人形机器人通过主动触碰周围结构进行导航，结合定位不确定性规划与信息增益驱动的局部探测。
AI.motivation: 视觉受限环境下，人形机器人仅靠本体感受里程计会产生漂移，定位不确定性快速累积，导致导航不可靠。
AI.method: TAPNAV利用里程计、IMU和触觉接触观测维护位姿信念，将不确定性感知的全局路径规划与信息增益驱动的局部探测相结合；全局规划器利用触觉校正机会限制预测定位不确定性，局部规划器选择最大化期望信息增益的探测动作，并由全身控制器协调行走与末端接触。
AI.result: 在仿真和Unitree G1机器人上，针对不同楼层平面与障碍物几何形状进行评估，TAPNAV比基线方法具有更低的状态估计误差和更高的任务完成率。
AI.conclusion: 主动规划与环境物理交互可为无视觉人形机器人导航提供定位线索，实现可靠导航。

title: MESSENGER: Memory-Enhanced Sequential Scene Flow Estimation via Autoregressive Next-Frame Forecasting
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code will be released at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger
summary: Scene flow can capture low-level 3D motion displacements in dynamic scenarios. Early pairwise estimators relying on instantaneous two-frame motion lack long-term temporal correlation and also struggle with poor extrapolation ability in future prediction. Although some recent methods attempt to explore multi-frame scene flow estimation in a sequence-to-sequence manner, they typically suffer from heavy computational overhead with increasing input frames and long-horizon prediction degradation due to ineffective motion propagation. To address these problems, we propose a novel memory-enhanced sequential scene flow pipeline, called MESSENGER. To sufficiently mine long-term temporal dependencies naturally within consecutive sequences, a memory buffer is designed by explicitly storing multiple history flow estimates and latent states. For each input frame, the temporally stored flows and states are correlated and retrieved to predict the current initialized flow in a next-frame forecasting manner. Furthermore, we develop an uncertainty-aware reweighting module to filter unreliable retrievals and mitigate accumulated errors. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of our MESSENGER, reducing EPE3D by 71.6% on nuScenes and 67.7% on Argoverse 2 in long-horizon future extrapolation. This superiority can be attributed to our designed autoregressive forecasting paradigm, which naturally forces the network to progressively learn the next-frame distribution based on history observations. Code will be released at https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MESSENGER，一种记忆增强的序列化场景流估计框架，通过存储历史流和隐状态并进行检索，实现长时未来预测，并在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 早期双帧场景流估计缺乏长期时序关联和未来外推能力；近期多帧序列方法又面临输入帧增加带来的计算开销大、运动传播无效导致长时预测退化等问题。
AI.method: 设计记忆缓冲区，显式存储多个历史流估计和隐状态；对每帧输入，关联并检索时序存储的流和状态，以预测下一帧方式初始化当前流；并引入不确定性感知重加权模块，过滤不可靠检索、缓解累积误差。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上的大量实验表明达到最优性能，长时未来外推中EPE3D分别降低71.6%和67.7%。
AI.conclusion: 优越性源于自回归预测范式，该范式自然迫使网络基于历史观测逐步学习下一帧分布；MESSENGER有效提升长时序列场景流估计与外推能力。代码将开源。

title: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization via Complex-Valued Fusion
comment: Accepted to British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization (OV-AVEL) labels each video segment with an event class, including classes that were never seen during training. The dominant pipeline uses a frozen multimodal foundation model (e.g. ImageBind) to embed the visual frame, the audio mel-spectrogram, and each candidate class name into a shared space, then computes two cosine similarities for each segment against each class: visual-text and audio-text. Existing methods then collapse this pair into a single scalar score with a fixed rule (geometric mean, weighted average) before taking the argmax. Instead, we compute complex-valued similarities and learn their fusion using a complex-valued neural network (CVNN). Each modality's standard representation becomes the real part of our pipeline, and a paired companion stream supplies the imaginary part. We use imaginary part of iHSV for visual modality and CycleGAN-translated phase spectrogram for audio modality as these companion streams. This results in two complex similarities, which are then fused. While the vision and audio encoders remain frozen, only the temporal-attention blocks and the fusion CVNN are trained. The four-stream complex architecture sets a new state of the art on both OV-AVEL benchmarks. On the open (unseen-class) split of OV-AVEBench we reach 66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1 (+1.6/+4.1/+6.6 over the previously reported fine-tuned baseline), with consistent gains for seen classes as well. We also modify AVE dataset for this task and observe that our architecture reaches 60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1, achieving state-of-the-art OV-AVEL results on it as well. We also propose a two-stream alternative, which also sees great improvements over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文研究开放词汇音频-视觉事件定位（OV-AVEL），提出用复数相似度与复数神经网络（CVNN）融合视觉-文本和音频-文本匹配分数，在多个OV-AVEL基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有主流方法将视觉-文本与音频-文本两个余弦相似度用固定规则（如几何平均、加权平均）合并为单一标量，再取argmax，限制了跨模态融合的灵活性。
AI.method: 为每个模态构造复数表示：标准表示作为实部，视觉模态使用iHSV虚部，音频模态使用CycleGAN转换的相位谱图作为虚部；得到两个复数相似度后，用CVNN学习融合。视觉与音频编码器保持冻结，仅训练时序注意力模块和融合CVNN。同时提出一个双流替代方案。
AI.result: 在OV-AVEBench开放（未见类）划分上达到66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，较此前微调基线提升+1.6/+4.1/+6.6，已见类也一致提升；在修改后的AVE数据集上达到60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，同样取得最优OV-AVEL结果。双流替代方案也显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 复数相似度与CVNN融合能有效改进开放词汇音频-视觉事件定位，四流复数架构在多个基准上达到新的最优性能。

title: A Latent Space Optimization Approach for Symbolic Discovery of Dynamical Models
summary: In this paper, we propose a hybrid latent-space Bayesian Optimization (BO) and global optimization framework for solving symbolic regression tasks to discover dynamical models from data. Symbolic regression can discover equations from data without fixing the functional form of the expression a priori. The proposed framework uses the fact that if the functional form of the expression is fixed, the symbolic regression task reduces to a parameter estimation problem, which must be solved to global optimality. Motivated by this structure, first, we train a VAE to map the discrete space of expression trees into a continuous latent space. Then, we use BO to search this latent space while assessing a candidate expression's prediction error by solving the parameter estimation problem to global optimality. We evaluate our framework across two case studies: static reaction rate law discovery and dynamic concentration identification in a continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR). The results show that our framework identifies the true governing equations faster than MINLP formulations without solver timeouts and achieves higher sample efficiency than evolutionary baselines under tight evaluation budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合潜空间贝叶斯优化与全局优化的混合框架，用于从数据中发现动力系统的符号回归模型。
AI.motivation: 符号回归可在不预设函数形式的情况下从数据中发现方程；但若固定函数形式，问题可转化为需全局最优求解的参数估计问题，这一结构启发了潜空间搜索与参数优化结合的方法。
AI.method: 先训练VAE将表达式树的离散空间映射到连续潜空间，再用贝叶斯优化搜索潜空间，并对候选表达式通过全局优化求解参数估计问题以评估预测误差。
AI.result: 在静态反应速率定律发现和连续搅拌釜反应器动态浓度识别两个案例中，该框架比MINLP公式更快找到真实控制方程且无求解器超时，在严格评估预算下比进化基线具有更高样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提混合潜空间贝叶斯优化与全局优化框架能有效加速符号回归，并更高效地发现动力系统模型。

title: Centrality-based Structural-Electrical Contingency Screening and Transmission Reinforcement Prioritization
comment: Accepted for IAS Annual Meeting 2026, Vancouver, Canada
summary: Rapid contingency screening is essential for secure transmission system operation and planning. Although full AC contingency analysis provides accurate system assessment, it requires high computational effort for large contingency sets. Topology-based screening methods reduce this burden but may not accurately represent operating-point-dependent electrical stress. In addition, conventional single-contingency screening does not quantify interactions among simultaneous outages or provide a direct criterion for reinforcement prioritization. This paper presents a hybrid structural-electrical screening approach that combines a computationally efficient, dispatch-independent structural analysis based on reactance-weighted centrality measures with a flow-based severity assessment using line outage distribution factors. Two indices are evaluated using the flow-based severity: a synergy index to quantify super-additive interactions among simultaneous line outages and a tolerance index to rank reinforcement candidates based on their reduction in aggregate post-contingency severity. The correspondence between structural indicators and electrical severity is evaluated quantitatively. Tests on the IEEE 39-bus system identify 115 super-additive line pairs beyond a 5% threshold, with the most severe interaction exceeding seven times the linear combination of individual outage effects. The highest-ranked reinforcement reduces the mean post-contingency thermal severity by 7.5%. The structural rankings show limited correlation with flow-based severity, with a Spearman coefficient of approximately 0.2. The proposed approach provides an efficient pre-screening method to reduce contingency and reinforcement search spaces before detailed AC and economic evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合结构-电气筛选方法，结合基于电抗加权中心性的结构分析与基于线路停运分布因子的潮流严重性评估，用于快速筛选预想事故和加固候选。
AI.motivation: 全AC预想事故分析计算量大，拓扑筛选法难以准确反映运行点相关的电气应力，且传统单事故筛选无法量化同时停运的交互作用或为加固优先排序提供直接准则。
AI.method: 结合电抗加权中心性结构分析与线路停运分布因子潮流严重性评估；定义协同指数量化同时停运的超加性交互，容忍度指数基于事故后总体严重性降低来排序加固候选；定量评估结构指标与电气严重性的对应关系。
AI.result: 在IEEE 39节点系统上识别出115对超过5%阈值的超加性线路对，最严重交互超过单个停运效应线性组合的7倍；最高排名加固使平均事故后热严重性降低7.5%；结构排名与潮流严重性相关性有限，Spearman系数约0.2。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为在详细AC和经济评估前缩小预想事故和加固搜索空间提供高效预筛选手段。

title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
summary: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种针对交互式场景探索的逐场景框架，利用相对位姿引导的RGB-D图像复用替代邻近视角的重复渲染，从而降低查询延迟。
AI.motivation: 交互式场景探索需要频繁更新视角，但小幅度相机运动仍保留大量可见内容；传统3D高斯泼溅仍对每个目标视角完整渲染，未利用图像重叠，导致重复计算。单纯几何变形又无法恢复新暴露区域且对深度误差敏感。
AI.method: 提出逐场景框架：对邻近视角使用相对位姿引导的RGB-D图像复用；通过深度和相对位姿进行几何变形来迁移源内容；使用轻量级多尺度网络预测RGB残差以修正伪影并推断缺失外观；同时缓存源特征以减少重复计算。
AI.result: 在GS-render上，残差细化相比纯变形将PSNR提升0.72 dB；在捕获场景和渲染场景上的评估表明查询延迟较低。
AI.conclusion: 将场景渲染与局部视角更新分离，可支持响应式场景探索，并在增强现实和虚拟现实中有潜在应用。

title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures. Includes proofs and reproducibility artifacts
summary: Agentic AI systems can improve by searching longer, receiving additional support, or modifying how they propose and verify outputs. A performance score does not distinguish these mechanisms. We compare these changes through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness. A stage specifies admissible transcripts, polynomial bounds, an alternating verification protocol, and a terminal checker. Its native reach uses default support; its closure frontier permits all support already admitted by the interface. Under a uniform pointwise probability gap and task-relative soundness, these are well-defined languages. We prove that independent majority amplification preserves both languages, whereas existential acceptance over random tapes can admit incorrect outputs. Exact verification is the zero-randomness case, with placement and completeness results. The randomized-verifier classes satisfy $Σ_k^{\mathrm{P}}\subseteqΣ_k^{\mathrm{RV}}\subseteqΣ_{k+1}^{\mathrm{P}}$; strict enlargement and depth separation require explicit complexity assumptions, while $\mathrm{BPP}=\mathrm{P}$ yields exact companions with the same frontiers. Representation analysis separates invariant acceptance from core-versus-support labels that can change under refactoring. For recursive self-improvement, uniformly bounded self-modification under a common sound interpreter and fixed verification protocol remains within the same verification class. A separate conditional-error budget controls false selection across adaptively chosen candidates. A quota-enforced XOR-synthesis family separates unbounded ratios of search success from changes in the accepted languages; exact and probabilistic audits check the resulting evidence requirements. The framework ties self-improvement claims to obligations on correctness, admissible evidence, verification resources, and selection error.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个带隐藏终端随机性的有界验证框架，用于区分智能体AI系统性能提升的不同机制，例如更长时间搜索、额外支持、修改提议与验证方式。该框架把自我改进主张与正确性、可允许证据、验证资源和选择错误等义务绑定起来。
AI.motivation: 单纯的性能分数无法说明智能体AI提升来自更长搜索、额外支持，还是改变了提议与验证机制，因此需要一个能比较这些机制并约束自我改进声明的验证理论框架。
AI.method: 定义“阶段”、可允许转录、多项式界、交替验证协议和终端检查器；区分默认支持下的原生可达与接口允许所有支持下的闭包前沿。在均匀点态概率差和任务相对可靠性下定义语言，引入随机验证类Sigma_k^RV，并研究独立多数放大、存在接受随机带、精确验证、表示分析、有界自修改、条件误差预算和配额强制XOR合成族。
AI.result: 证明独立多数放大保持原生可达与闭包前沿语言，而存在接受随机带可能引入不正确输出；精确验证是零随机情形并给出版本位置与完备性结果。随机验证类满足Sigma_k^P⊆Sigma_k^RV⊆Sigma_{k+1}^P；严格扩大和深度分离需要显式复杂性假设，BPP=P时精确伴随类具有相同前沿。表示分析区分不变接受与重构下变化的核-支持标签；均匀有界自修改在共同可靠解释器和固定验证协议下仍属同一验证类；XOR合成族分离搜索成功无界比率与接受语言变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将智能体AI自我改进的主张转化为对正确性、可允许证据、验证资源和选择错误的具体义务，从而更精细地分析性能提升机制及其理论边界。

title: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
summary: Language models trained with long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning can generalize knowledge through reasoning, express precise actions, and pursue goals over many steps, raising the ceiling on what an embodied agent can understand and decide. Physical interaction, however, remains the domain of action policies, which provide dense, low-latency control. We present NavGPT-3, a harness that connects the two models, with an OS-like runtime built above it: reasoning, acting, and monitoring run as threads with their own context, tools, and permissions, while the runtime schedules them and decides which thread controls the robot's motion, so that the robot can react to sudden real-world events through interruption and thread switching. Beneath it, our action policy NavGPT VLA, trained on 19.28M examples, allocates visual tokens using codec allocation, in proportion to scene change; its 8B model alone reaches 74.51 SR on R2R-CE and leads RxR-CE with 78.19 SR. With the complete harness, NavGPT-3 sets the state of the art on R2R-CE (81.51 SR) and, for the first time, brings an autonomous agent to human level: on RxR-CE it matches human followers in success (90.43 vs. 90.4 SR) and path fidelity (78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW) at 1 min 22 s per episode, versus roughly 3 min for a human. We comprehensively ablate the harness design and the interaction between the two models, showing how tools and the action policy shape the path from language-model reasoning to physical control: when NavGPT VLA executes the route, the reasoning loop shortens and the system's minimum reaction time falls from 3-19 s per language-model decision to 0.5-1 s per action-policy step (1-2 Hz). These results show that designing this embodied interface is central to connecting frontier language-model intelligence with low-level physical control. We will release all models, code, and evaluation records.

AI.tldr: 提出NavGPT-3框架，将语言模型的推理能力与动作策略的物理控制能力结合，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE导航任务上取得最优结果，并首次让自主智能体达到人类水平。
AI.motivation: 长时域智能体强化学习训练的语言模型能推理和追求目标，但物理交互仍依赖提供密集、低延迟控制的动作策略，因此需要连接语言模型与动作策略并设计具身接口。
AI.method: 构建NavGPT-3框架及类操作系统运行时，将推理、行动、监控作为独立线程运行，由运行时调度并决定哪个线程控制机器人运动，支持中断与线程切换。底层动作策略NavGPT VLA在1928万样本上训练，采用码本分配按场景变化比例分配视觉token，为8B模型。
AI.result: NavGPT VLA单独在R2R-CE达74.51 SR，RxR-CE达78.19 SR；完整框架下R2R-CE达81.51 SR，RxR-CE达90.43 SR、78.47 nDTW，与人类（90.4 SR、77.7 nDTW）持平，每回合1分22秒，人类约3分钟。消融显示动作策略执行路径时，系统最小反应时间从每次语言模型决策3-19秒降至每动作步0.5-1秒（1-2 Hz）。
AI.conclusion: 设计具身接口是连接前沿语言模型智能与底层物理控制的核心，将开源所有模型、代码与评估记录。

title: Clarify, Then Focus: Statement Normalization for Conversation Analytics at Scale
summary: Enterprise conversation analytics asks many questions of millions of interactions. Each question can require reconstructing what people mean and identifying which information matters, repeating costly interpretive work across the same transcripts. We propose a simple principle: clarify the text, then focus the reader. Statement normalization transforms dialogue into short, speaker-attributed statements with source references and semantic tags. The statements make meaning more explicit; the tags support selecting evidence for a particular question. Downstream models can use the full representation or a relevant subset, depending on what helps them make the decision. In an offer-suppression task on customer-service calls, normalization improves a supervised classifier without selection, while weaker prompted readers benefit from both normalization and selection. A small model can learn the normalization contract, while lightweight encoders handle tagging and downstream decisions. Sharing this preparation across questions supports an inference pipeline built entirely from small models, making analytics over millions of conversations substantially less expensive.

AI.tldr: 提出“先澄清文本，再聚焦读者”的原则，将对话归一化为带说话人、来源引用和语义标签的短陈述，并可按问题选择相关证据，从而用小型模型低成本完成百万级企业对话分析。
AI.motivation: 企业对话分析需要对海量交互回答许多问题，而每个问题都可能重复进行昂贵的语义重建和信息筛选，导致同一批转录文本被反复解释，成本很高。
AI.method: 提出语句归一化：把对话转换成简短的、带说话人归属、来源引用和语义标签的陈述；下游模型可使用完整表示或与特定问题相关的子集。并在客服电话的报价抑制任务上评估归一化与证据选择的效果。
AI.result: 在报价抑制任务中，归一化无需选择即可提升有监督分类器；较弱的提示式阅读器则同时受益于归一化和选择。小模型可学会归一化契约，轻量编码器可处理标签和下游决策。
AI.conclusion: 将这种准备工作在多个问题间共享，可构建完全由小模型组成的推理流水线，使对数百万对话的分析显著降低成本。

title: DOGS: Design-Space Sampling for Prompt-Driven Logo Generation
summary: Prompt optimization for text-to-image (T2I) generation has been pursued almost entirely as text rewriting, in which a short user brief is expanded into a longer, model-preferred token sequence. We argue that such a language-space formulation is ill-suited to structured visual design tasks such as logo creation, where a one-line brief leaves most design decisions unspecified. These decisions depend on relational priors that a linear sequence cannot encode, and they leave an uncontrolled channel through which protected marks may be reproduced. We therefore recast logo prompting as sampling within a structured design space, and instantiate this idea as DOGS (Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler). From a large corpus of real-world logos, we mine a typed, graph-structured design grammar whose edges record empirical co-occurrence. A GFlowNet sampler then generates design graphs with probability proportional to a terminal reward that combines recognizability, aesthetics, and corpus-relative originality. Every slot draws only from a closed design-level vocabulary, and any infringement-inducing or harmful token is removed during parsing. The originality reward further penalizes proximity to existing logos, thereby incorporating infringement avoidance into the method by construction. On two open-source renderers and against nine baselines, DOGS produces logos that are more recognizable and aesthetic, substantially more diverse, and far less prone to trademark infringement.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Logo生成中的提示优化从文本改写重新定义为结构化设计空间采样，提出DOGS方法，利用GFlowNet采样设计图，以提升可识别性、美学性、多样性并降低商标侵权风险。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图提示优化多将简短用户需求改写为更长文本序列，但这种方式不适用于Logo等结构化视觉设计任务。一行简短需求无法指定大量设计决策，线性序列难以编码关系先验，并可能通过不受控通道复制受保护商标。
AI.method: 从真实Logo语料中挖掘带类型、图结构的设计语法，边记录经验共现关系。使用GFlowNet采样器生成设计图，采样概率与终局奖励成正比，奖励综合可识别性、美学性和相对于语料的原创性。每个槽位仅从封闭的设计级词表取值，解析时移除侵权或有害token，原创性奖励进一步惩罚与现有Logo接近。
AI.result: 在两个开源渲染器上、与九个基线方法对比，DOGS生成的Logo更具可识别性和美学性，多样性显著更高，并且更不易涉及商标侵权。
AI.conclusion: 将Logo提示建模为结构化设计空间采样，并通过GFlowNet结合原创性奖励与封闭词表约束，可有效避免线性文本改写的局限，在生成质量、多样性和侵权规避方面均优于现有方法。

title: Speaking the Navigator's Language: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents
summary: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents are typically trained on detail-rich, trajectory-aligned commands, whereas users issue short, intent-driven instructions; on a frozen OpenFly navigator, this \emph{instruction gap} drops success rate (SR) from $31.03\%$ to $11.33\%$. To scale translator training, we prompt a language model with human-written style examples to convert original commands into paired, intent-centered Weak commands, which yield $15.27\%$ SR. We introduce the \textbf{Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT)}, a front-end that keeps the navigator frozen and translates Weak inputs into agent-executable commands by learning from its trajectory outcomes. The resulting Weak-trained translator raises Weak-input SR to $37.93\%$ and transfers zero-shot to real human instructions ($11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$); it also improves held-out OpenFly ($4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$) and yields recovery on CityNav and AirVLN.

AI.tldr: 论文研究空中视觉语言导航中的指令差距问题，提出轨迹锚定指令翻译器TGIT，将简短意图型弱指令翻译为导航器可执行的详细指令，从而显著提升冻结导航器的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有空中VLN智能体通常使用细节丰富、与轨迹对齐的指令训练，但真实用户给出的是简短、意图驱动的指令，这种指令差距导致在冻结OpenFly导航器上成功率从31.03%降至11.33%。
AI.method: 通过语言模型结合人工风格示例，将原始指令转换为配对的、以意图为中心的Weak指令；提出TGIT作为前端，保持导航器冻结，并利用导航轨迹结果学习将Weak输入翻译为智能体可执行指令。
AI.result: Weak命令初始成功率为15.27%；TGIT将Weak输入成功率提升至37.93%，并零样本迁移到真实人类指令，成功率从11.33%提升至32.51%；在留出OpenFly上从4.95%提升至20.79%，并在CityNav和AirVLN上实现性能恢复。
AI.conclusion: TGIT能够有效弥合指令差距，作为一种即插即用的前端提升冻结导航器对弱指令和真实人类指令的鲁棒性，并具备跨数据集迁移能力。

title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
comment: 14 pages, 5 tables. Code, configuration and per-run outputs: https://github.com/rav11l/cace-bench (v0.6.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23207546)
summary: Self-improving LLM agents can adapt a credit pipeline to a changed rule, but an agent that rewrites itself destroys the artefact a supervisor reviews: a named change, a recorded test, an approval. We argue that self-evolution is reviewable only if it is confined to the runtime harness (instruction text, tool-call logic and primitive composition) while model weights stay fixed, so that every adaptation is a diff with a cause and a test attached. We give a dual-loop engine built on that bound, with one admission gate that writes a hash-chained record before deployment, and we measure the gate in simulation, with a simulated agent and a seeded-search proposer rather than language models. Across three families of supervisory re-interpretation at three severities, 10 seeds each, the gated loop admitted 144 of 7,449 candidate changes, none of which worsened error on held-out history, and restored the false-positive rate to the oracle level without raising missed flags in every low- and mid-severity cell. With the gate replaced by the check an unbounded system applies (fewer errors visible in recent traces), the same loops admitted 309 harmful changes and left missed flags above 10% in 49 of 90 runs: false positives fell because the screen was loosened. Evaluated on pre-shift labels, the gate rejected every candidate, so a re-interpretation must be encoded as a rule that relabels history. Parametric and scope shifts were repaired locally, a structural one only by primitive replacement; at the highest structural severity the gate's fixed tolerance blocked the correct replacement in half the seeds. We map the mechanisms to the EU AI Act's provisions for high-risk credit scoring and note that the April 2026 US model-risk guidance excludes agentic AI from its scope.

AI.tldr: 论文主张，自进化LLM智能体只有把自我修改限制在运行时框架（指令文本、工具调用逻辑、原语组合）而保持模型权重不变，才可审查；并提出带哈希链记录的双环引擎与准入闸门，用模拟智能体和种子搜索验证。
AI.motivation: 自改进智能体虽能适应规则变化，但若重写自身，会破坏监督者审查所需的可追溯工件：具名变更、测试记录与批准。研究希望让每次适应都成为附原因和测试的diff，从而可审查。
AI.method: 将自进化边界限定在运行时框架，权重固定；设计双环引擎，部署前由准入闸门写入哈希链记录。实验不用语言模型，而用模拟智能体和种子搜索提议器，在3类监督重解释、3种严重度、每类10个种子下，比较闸门与无界系统检查。
AI.result: 闸门在7,449个候选变更中只准入144个，均未在留出历史上恶化错误，并在所有低/中严重度单元把假阳性率恢复到oracle水平且未增加漏报。替换为无界检查时，同一循环准入309个有害变更，90次运行中49次漏报高于10%，假阳性下降只是因为筛选变松。用偏移前标签评估时，闸门拒绝所有候选，说明重解释必须编码为可重标历史的规则。参数型和范围型偏移可局部修复，结构型只能靠原语替换；最高结构严重度下，闸门固定容差在一半种子中阻止了正确替换。
AI.conclusion: 可审查的自进化应被限定在运行时框架内，权重不变；准入闸门在低/中严重度有效，但固定容差限制最高结构严重度的修复。论文还映射到EU AI Act高风险信用评分条款，并指出2026年4月美国模型风险指南将代理式AI排除在适用范围外。

title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs),
  but it typically assumes a static training environment. As the actor improves, fixed tasks drift out of its learning frontier: many
  become trivial, others remain unsolvable; and the learning signal collapses. We argue that VLM post-training should evolve the
  visual environment alongside the actor, not just the actor itself. We propose VICO, a co-evolutionary framework in which an actor
