  and an Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) are trained jointly: the EnvRewriter edits verifiable image-side structures, such as
  scene graphs, chart tables, or protected region masks, and re-renders them to produce label-valid training samples whose difficulty
  is calibrated to the actor's current ability through a pass-rate-based reward. This loop continuously realigns task difficulty with
  actor capability without any additional human annotation. Across nine multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and
  visually grounded understanding, VICO-8B improves over its base model by up to +5.0% on out-of-domain tasks, surpasses the strongest
  self-evolution and text-editing co-evolution baselines by +4.3% and +8.4% respectively, and stays comparable to chart-specialized
  RLVR methods using 16-160 times fewer labeled samples. By shifting from human-labeled supervision to image-editing co-evolution,
  VICO offers a scalable path beyond static-corpus RLVR for visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VICO，一个让视觉语言模型与视觉环境共同演化的RLVR后训练框架，通过环境重写器动态生成匹配当前模型能力的可验证训练样本。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR通常假设静态训练环境，随着模型能力提升，固定任务会变得过于简单或始终不可解，导致学习信号崩溃；因此需要让视觉环境随模型共同演化。
AI.method: VICO联合训练actor和Environment-as-Rewriter（EnvRewriter）。EnvRewriter编辑图像侧可验证结构，如场景图、图表表格或受保护区域掩码，并重新渲染为标签有效的训练样本；同时利用基于通过率的奖励，将任务难度校准到actor当前能力，无需额外人工标注。
AI.result: 在九个多模态基准上，VICO-8B在域外任务上比基座模型最高提升5.0%；比最强自演化和文本编辑共同演化基线分别高4.3%和8.4%；以少16至160倍的标注样本达到与图表专用RLVR方法相当的效果。
AI.conclusion: 从人工标注监督转向图像编辑共同演化，VICO为超越静态语料RLVR的视觉推理提供了一条可扩展路径。

title: A User-Triggered UAV Dispatching System for Precise and Timely Mountain Search Missions
summary: Smartphones carried by hikers routinely record routes, locations, and requests for assistance, and these records can provide precise clues for mountain search. However, they are rarely transformed in a direct and timely way into unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) missions that support search and rescue. This paper presents a user-triggered UAV dispatching system that integrates mobile information collection, ground station mission management, and UAV search into a single workflow. In our system, a mobile application is designed to continuously track user records and synchronize these records to the cloud database, thereby initiating all subsequent search events and UAV-dispatch missions. A control platform is developed to retrieve records from the cloud database for operator verification and mission scheduling. A UAV prototype is implemented to execute the approved mission, follow waypoints, report status, relay phone records when available, and record downward-facing video for later inspection. Simulations are conducted for UAV-dispatching missions using a terrain-following flight altitude of $80$~m above ground level and demonstrate successful route generation, ordered waypoint traversal, and return to the launch site for landing of the UAV dispatching. Local software tests verified timeout detection with a 1s threshold and phone-record transfer from the mobile application through the UAV to the ground station. Outdoor trials showed that the UAV could fly autonomously and capture downward-facing imagery in which a person, a nearby footpath, and surrounding vegetation were clearly discernible, providing visual cues for operator assessment and further inspection of the search area.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用户触发的无人机调度系统，将手机信息采集、地面站任务管理和无人机搜索整合为单一流程，用于山地搜救。
AI.motivation: 徒步者随身手机会记录路线、位置和求助信息，这些记录可为山地搜索提供精确线索，但目前很少能直接、及时地转化为无人机搜救任务。
AI.method: 设计手机应用持续跟踪用户记录并同步至云数据库；开发控制平台供操作员验证记录和调度任务；实现无人机原型执行航点、报告状态、中继手机记录并录制下视视频。还进行了80米离地高度地形跟随仿真、本地软件测试和户外试验。
AI.result: 仿真成功生成路线、按序穿越航点并返航降落；软件测试验证了1秒超时检测及手机记录从应用到无人机再到地面站的传输；户外试验中无人机自主飞行并拍摄下视影像，可清晰辨认人员、附近步道和周围植被。
AI.conclusion: 该系统能为操作员评估和进一步检查搜索区域提供视觉线索，展示了将手机记录直接转化为无人机山地搜救任务的可行性。

title: Grammar Concept Annotation at Scale: Deployed Fine-Tuned Small Language Models Outperform Prompted Frontier Models
summary: Corrective feedback is among the best-evidenced drivers of second-language acquisition, yet corrections delivered during lessons rarely accumulate into an actionable view of grammar mastery. Prompted frontier models can provide such a view from learner--tutor lesson transcripts, but they are costly at scale. We close this gap by fine-tuning Qwen3.5 small language models (SLMs) on filtered and rebalanced teacher-generated supervision, then deploying an efficient 0.8B model in an end-to-end grammar mastery tracker for all English learners on our platform. Internalizing the annotation contract into adapter weights enables pairing the 0.8B model with a compact matched prompt rather than verbose instructions. On two human-curated benchmarks, both the deployed 0.8B model and a 4B reference comparator outperform prompted GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6 Sol in precision and recall under nested matching criteria of increasing strictness: concept, evidence span, and correctness. The deployed 0.8B SLM reduces serving cost by approximately 16$\times$. A feature-level online experiment shows significant gains in learner engagement ($+15.8\%$) and key business metrics, including scheduled hours ($+2.1\%$) and GMV from new lessons ($+13.2\%$).

AI.tldr: 该研究通过微调Qwen3.5小语言模型（SLM），构建了一个端到端的语法掌握度追踪器，在两项人工标注基准上以更低的成本超越了提示式GPT-5.4和GPT-5.6 Sol，并在线上实验中显著提升了学习者参与度与关键业务指标。
AI.motivation: 纠正性反馈是二语习得最有力的驱动因素之一，但课堂中产生的纠正很少能累积成可操作的语法掌握视图。前沿大模型虽能从师生对话转录中生成该视图，但规模化使用成本过高。
AI.method: 在过滤并重平衡的教师生成监督数据上微调Qwen3.5 SLM，将标注契约内化至适配器权重，从而用紧凑匹配提示替代冗长指令；最终部署0.8B模型至端到端语法掌握追踪器，并与4B参考模型及提示式GPT-5.4、GPT-5.6 Sol对比。
AI.result: 在两项人工标注基准上，0.8B与4B模型在概念、证据跨度、正确性三层递进嵌套匹配标准下的精确率与召回率均优于提示式GPT-5.4和GPT-5.6 Sol；部署的0.8B模型服务成本降低约16倍；线上特征级实验显示学习者参与度提升15.8%，排课时长增加2.1%，新课程带来的GMV增长13.2%。
AI.conclusion: 小语言模型经教师监督微调后，可在语法掌握度追踪任务上以极低成本取代前沿大模型，并带来显著的学习者参与度与业务收益。

title: Reference-Filter-Driven Transition Probabilities for IMM-Based Satellite Maneuver Detection
summary: Maneuver detection of non-cooperative satellites is an essential task of space situational awareness. The interacting multiple model (IMM) filter has been applied to detect unannounced maneuvers, but the standard IMM assumes a fixed Markov transition probability matrix (TPM) that must be tuned without knowledge of the maneuver rate of the target. To avoid this tuning, adaptive-TPM approaches update the TPM online from statistics computed inside the IMM. However, these statistics already depend on the TPM through the mixing step, and this dependence forms a feedback loop. Under the dynamics mismatch of orbit tracking, the loop can keep the maneuver probability high in the absence of a maneuver or suppress its rise when a maneuver occurs. In this paper, the TPM is driven by the normalized innovation squared (NIS) of a reference coast filter that is not mixed with the IMM, and the NIS is mapped continuously to the coast-to-maneuver transition probability. The reference-driven IMM (RD-IMM) is evaluated with four space-based optical sensors tracking a geosynchronous target. RD-IMM detects small burns that the fixed-TPM IMM fails to detect, with few false declarations in maneuver-free runs, and avoids both failures of the closed-loop adaptation. Moreover, RD-IMM reduces the position error after a small in-track burn by more than 50% compared with the single-filter approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参考驱动的交互多模型滤波器（RD-IMM），利用不与IMM混合的参考滑行滤波器的归一化新息平方（NIS）在线驱动转移概率矩阵，用于非合作卫星机动检测。
AI.motivation: 标准IMM使用固定马尔可夫转移概率矩阵，需在未知目标机动率下人工调参；自适应TPM方法虽可在线更新，但统计量受TPM混合步骤影响形成反馈环，在轨道跟踪动力学失配时会导致机动概率虚高或抑制机动概率上升。
AI.method: RD-IMM用独立于IMM混合过程的参考滑行滤波器的NIS，将NIS连续映射为滑行到机动的转移概率，从而驱动TPM。并用四个天基光学传感器跟踪地球同步目标进行评价。
AI.result: RD-IMM能检测到固定TPM IMM漏检的小型点火，在无机动运行中误报少，并避免闭环自适应的两类失败；相比单滤波器方法，小幅度沿迹点火后位置误差降低超过50%。
AI.conclusion: RD-IMM通过参考滤波器NIS驱动TPM，避免了固定TPM调参和闭环自适应缺陷，提高了非合作卫星机动检测与跟踪性能。

title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
summary: Planning is increasingly important for long-horizon agents, where successful execution requires coordinating subgoals, tool use, and intermediate outcomes over many steps. Yet assumptions made during planning may be invalidated by the environment, tools may return unexpected results, or actions may fail. Effective agents must therefore not only generate plans, but also revise them. Such revisions often affect only part of a plan, leaving the preceding and subsequent structure intact. Rather than regenerate the entire plan and risk unnecessary changes, repair can regenerate the affected region conditioned on the preserved prefix and suffix. We introduce Plan-and-Patch, a plan-and-act framework in which a diffusion language model (dLLM) generates a structured, program-like plan through parallel unmasking and repairs it by filling in selected regions while keeping the surrounding steps fixed. We compare DreamReasoner-8B and Qwen3-8B as diffusion and autoregressive (AR) planners. On Natural Plan without task-specific training, diffusion (53.7%) achieves nearly twice the plan repair success rate of AR (27.0%). After task-specific training on agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and TextCraft, the planners achieve similar observed success in plan generation, while diffusion reduces mean plan-generation latency by 39-46% relative to AR. Our results show that Plan-and-Patch provides a framework for faster plan generation and effective plan repair in long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 Plan-and-Patch 框架，利用扩散语言模型生成结构化程序式计划，并通过局部修补而非全量重生成来修复计划，从而提升长程智能体规划效率与修复能力。
AI.motivation: 长程任务规划需协调多步子目标、工具调用和中间结果，但环境变化、工具返回异常或动作失败会使原计划部分失效。全量重新规划可能改动无关部分，因此需要只修复受影响区域并保留前后结构。
AI.method: 提出 Plan-and-Patch 计划-执行框架：扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过并行去掩码生成结构化、类程序计划，并在修复时固定前后步骤、填充选定区域。实验对比 DreamReasoner-8B（扩散）与 Qwen3-8B（自回归）作为规划器，在 Natural Plan、ALFWorld 和 TextCraft 上评估。
AI.result: 在 Natural Plan 无任务特定训练时，扩散规划器的计划修复成功率为 53.7%，约为自回归规划器 27.0% 的两倍。在 ALFWorld 和 TextCraft 任务特定训练后，两者计划生成成功率相近，但扩散将平均计划生成延迟降低 39-46%。
AI.conclusion: Plan-and-Patch 为长程智能体提供了一个兼顾更快计划生成与有效计划修复的框架。

title: Same Action, Different Outcome: Variability in Dynamic Cloth Manipulation
summary: Although cloth is known to exhibit different outcomes under repeated fast dynamic motions, even when the same trajectory is applied, this variability has not yet been systematically characterized. Quantifying it is essential to assess the reliability of learned manipulation policies and the extent to which simulation can reproduce real-world behavior. To study this, we execute the same trajectory ten times across four dynamic tasks, two of which are novel, each tested with three cloths of very different properties and at up to three execution speeds, with a total of 269 recorded rollouts. For all of them, we record small marker positions on the cloth and synchronized stereo camera. We then formalize different metrics to quantify variability, and our results show how it is significant in every test condition, in most cases one to three orders of magnitude above the repeatability inherent to the robot and sensing noise. Our results also show variability is driven mainly by the cloth physical properties but also grows with speed. By replaying all the rollouts in four calibrated modern cloth simulators, we show that none of them can reproduce the variability magnitude we observed in real cloth, nor its ordering. Together with our analysis, we publish the dataset with synchronized OptiTrack, vision and robot logs and their corresponding simulator twins.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了布料在重复快速动态操作中的变异性：通过269次真实实验记录，量化相同轨迹下布料结果差异，并评估四种现代布料模拟器复现该变异性的能力。
AI.motivation: 布料在相同轨迹重复执行时仍会产生不同结果，但这一变异性尚未被系统量化；量化它对于评估学习型操作策略的可靠性以及判断仿真能否复现真实世界行为至关重要。
AI.method: 在四种动态任务（含两种新任务）中，使用三种性质差异很大的布料、最多三种执行速度，对同一轨迹重复执行10次，共记录269次rollout；记录布料标记点位置和同步立体相机数据；形式化定义多种变异性度量；并在四种校准过的现代布料模拟器中回放全部rollout。
AI.result: 所有测试条件下均观察到显著变异性，多数情况下比机器人本体和传感噪声导致的固有重复性高1至3个数量级；变异性主要由布料物理属性驱动，并随执行速度增加而增大；四种模拟器均无法复现真实布料变异性的幅度，也无法复现其排序。
AI.conclusion: 真实布料在快速动态操作中具有不可忽略且难以仿真复现的变异性；当前布料模拟器在再现真实变异行为方面仍有明显不足；作者发布了包含同步OptiTrack、视觉、机器人日志及对应模拟器孪生数据的数据集。

title: Whose Ground Truth? Embracing Ambiguity in Human-Centered AI
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
summary: As AI systems increasingly interact with people and make decisions about them, understanding human interpretations becomes an important part of developing human-centered AI. Conventional machine learning and AI systems are largely developed under the assumption that a single definitive ground truth exists, with variability in human annotations often resolved through aggregation or treated as noise. However, for many human-centered tasks, human interpretation is inherently ambiguous, and multiple interpretations of the same input may be simultaneously reasonable and valid. Reducing such ambiguity to a single target risks overlooking meaningful information about the diversity of human perception, judgment, and experience. In this position paper, we call for a shift towards modeling the interpretation space of plausible human judgments, while distinguishing meaningful ambiguity from annotation noise. We argue that this perspective should guide how AI systems are represented, learned, evaluated, deployed, and governed, supporting more human-centered AI that better reflects the diversity of human interpretation.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，呼吁AI系统不应只追求单一真值，而应建模人类合理解释的空间，并区分有意义的歧义与标注噪声，从而发展更以人为本的AI。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习和AI假设存在唯一确定性真值，常将人类标注差异通过聚合消除或视为噪声。但在许多以人为本的任务中，人类解释本质上具有歧义性，同一输入可能有多个同时合理有效的解释，压缩为单一目标会丢失关于人类感知、判断和经验多样性的重要信息。
AI.method: 采用立场论文的方式，主张转向建模合理解释空间，并区分有意义的歧义与标注噪声；提出该视角应指导AI系统的表示、学习、评估、部署和治理。
AI.result: 论文论证了单一真值假设的局限，指出建模人类解释空间更能反映人类判断的多样性，并强调需区分真实歧义和噪声。
AI.conclusion: 应推动AI系统从单一真值范式转向对人类多种合理解释的建模，以支持更以人为本、更能体现人类解释多样性的AI。

title: Skill-SLM: Agent Skill-driven Small Language Models for Reliable Robot Operation
summary: Small language models (SLMs) have been increasingly adopted for onboard robot operation because they enable intelligent decision-making. However, existing approaches are mainly distillation-oriented and rely on enumerating representative task-solution pairs. This makes dataset construction difficult and limits generalization to diverse robot tasks whose possible forms grow rapidly. This paper proposes Skill-SLM, a framework that reformulates SLM-driven robot operation as a task-decomposition and skill-composition problem. Given a natural language task instruction, Skill-SLM decomposes the task into subtasks, selects appropriate skills from the skill library, and orchestrates the selected skills into executable robot operations. First, to support the skill-driven workflow, we propose a novel robot operational skill aware context-free grammar (CFG) to extract the skills required to accomplish tasks and build the skill library accordingly. Then, we configure LLM teachers to induce and synthesize training datasets for the SLMs, enabling SLMs to decompose tasks and orchestrate skills reliably. Additionally, we employ a progressive skill orchestration strategy to improve the reliability of skill implementation and overall robot operation. Experiments on UAV operation tasks indicate that Skill-SLM substantially outperforms distillation-oriented baselines, especially on unseen tasks that require generalization of capabilities. Additional experiments on ground vehicle tasks further demonstrate that Skill-SLM can be applied to different robot platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出Skill-SLM框架，将SLM驱动机器人操作重构为任务分解与技能组合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有SLM上机方法多为蒸馏导向，依赖枚举代表性任务-解决方案对，导致数据集构建困难，且难以泛化到形式快速增长的多样机器人任务。
AI.method: 设计机器人操作技能感知的上下文无关文法（CFG）以提取技能并构建技能库；配置LLM教师诱导和合成SLM训练数据集；采用渐进式技能编排策略提升技能执行与整体操作可靠性。
AI.result: 在无人机操作任务上显著优于蒸馏导向基线，尤其在未见过的需泛化任务上；在地面车辆任务上进一步验证可应用于不同机器人平台。
AI.conclusion: Skill-SLM通过技能库、任务分解和技能编排，提升了SLM机器人操作的泛化能力与可靠性，并可迁移到不同机器人平台。

title: Diagnosing and Recovering from Observation-Space Shift at Long-Horizon Skill Seams
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation is often built by chaining independently trained skills. Although each skill can be reliable in isolation, performance degrades sharply when skills are chained: each downstream skill must start from the state its predecessor leaves behind rather than from its training distribution. We study this failure mode, Observation-Space Shift (OSS), and ask what causes these skill-seam failures. Using privileged simulator resets, we find that the dominant shift comes from displaced scene state (e.g., an open drawer or secondary objects left behind by earlier skills), not from the robot's joint configuration or the object the downstream skill manipulates. To test this diagnosis, we build a fully learned detect-restore-resume system: a task-progress monitor detects the stall, a learned policy restores the displaced scene components, and seam-robust fine-tuning lets the skill resume. It recovers the seam where every tested alternative fails, which we treat as evidence for the diagnosis rather than as a general-purpose method. On the BOSS-44 benchmark, the system improves full-chain success from 7.6% to 26.5%, a 3.5x improvement over the base policy and 51% of a privileged restoration oracle, whereas best-of-K resampling, a Diffusion Policy, and world-model baselines fail to recover from the evaluated seam states. On a real Franka arm running a fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policy, the same monitor is limited by exterior-camera observability, yet closing the loop still recovers some otherwise-terminal failures, motivating wrist and gripper sensing. These results suggest that some long-horizon composition failures are better addressed by restoring the scene before resuming the policy than by retrying from an off-support state.

AI.tldr: 研究长时程机器人操作中技能链拼接的失效模式（观测空间偏移 OSS），发现主要来源是前置技能留下的场景状态位移；提出检测-恢复-续跑系统，在 BOSS-44 上将全链成功率从 7.6% 提升到 26.5%，并在真机 Franka 上验证。
AI.motivation: 独立训练的技能单独使用时可靠，但链式执行时性能急剧下降：下游技能需从上游遗留状态开始，而非其训练分布。作者希望弄清这种技能接缝处的失效成因。
AI.method: 利用特权仿真重置进行诊断，定位 OSS 的主导来源；构建完全学习的 detect-restore-resume 系统：任务进度监控器检测停滞、学习策略恢复被位移的场景组件、接缝鲁棒微调使技能续跑；在 BOSS-44 基准和微调 π0.5 的真机 Franka 上评估，并与 best-of-K 重采样、Diffusion Policy、世界模型基线及特权恢复 oracle 对比。
AI.result: 主导偏移来自场景状态（如打开的抽屉、遗留次物体），而非机器人关节构型或下游操作对象。BOSS-44 上全链成功率从 7.6% 提升至 26.5%（3.5 倍，达特权 oracle 的 51%），而基线方法在评估接缝状态均无法恢复。真机上同一监控器受外置相机可观测性限制，但闭环仍能恢复部分原本终态的失败。
AI.conclusion: 部分长时程组合失败更适合在续跑策略前先恢复场景，而不是从 off-support 状态重试；结果支持该诊断，并提示腕部与夹爪传感的必要性。

title: Velocity Scaling in Flow Matching
summary: Scaling a learned flow-matching velocity field $v_θ$ by a gain $γ(t)$ was recently shown to greatly improve generation quality. Prior work argued that velocity fields trained with mean-squared error (MSE) systematically underestimate velocity magnitude and that scaling corrects this error. We show that MSE training does not create a velocity-magnitude deficit. We find instead that velocity scaling reduces population time lag: sampled states at model time $t$ resemble training states from an earlier time. Velocity scaling and moving model time back are two ways to address this population time lag. Across architectures and model sizes, measuring population time lag and using it to select a gain greatly improves generation quality, reducing FID from 28.0 to 12.2 (estimated by linear interpolation between FID measurements at neighboring gains) on ImageNet-256 at NFE 25 without guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究流匹配速度场按增益 γ(t) 缩放为何能提升生成质量，指出原因并非MSE训练低估速度幅值，而是速度缩放能够缓解总体时间滞后，并据此选择增益显著降低FID。
AI.motivation: 先前工作认为MSE训练会系统性地低估速度幅值，因此需要通过速度缩放来校正该误差。作者希望验证这一解释，并进一步理解速度缩放有效的原因。
AI.method: 分析MSE训练与速度幅值的关系；提出并测量总体时间滞后，即模型时间 t 的采样状态类似更早时间的训练状态；将速度缩放与把模型时间前移视为解决时间滞后的两种方式；跨不同架构和模型规模测量时间滞后，并用其选择增益 γ(t)。
AI.result: MSE训练并未造成速度幅值不足；速度缩放可减少总体时间滞后。在ImageNet-256、NFE 25、无引导条件下，根据时间滞后选择增益使FID从28.0降至12.2（由相邻增益的FID测量线性插值估计）。
AI.conclusion: 速度缩放提升生成质量的主要机制是缓解总体时间滞后。测量并校正该滞后可有效选择增益，从而改进流匹配生成质量，并为相关采样方法提供新的解释和依据。

title: Real Long-Term Memory for AI: A 50-Million-Token Window That Is Faster and Cheaper Than Recompute
summary: A large language model can only use the text that fits in its context window, and it recomputes its internal key-value (KV) state for a prompt every time the prompt is sent. We test a memory layer, the public package galahad-kv, that saves the KV state of each block of about 16,000 tokens to encrypted local NVMe disk and loads it back later, byte-exact, without recomputing it. We ran it on 50,000,000 tokens of real public text, served through vLLM on one NVIDIA H100, with Gemma 4 12B and Gemma 4 31B. Every block we probed was loaded back from the encrypted store with no recompute (100 of 100, at depths from 0 to 50M tokens) on both models. Loading a block was 2.8x to 4.3x faster than recomputing it and used 8.8x to 12.3x less GPU energy, and GPU memory stayed flat over the whole 50M-token stream. Asked about facts planted millions of tokens earlier, the 12B model gave the right answer 82 times out of 100 and the 31B model 98 times out of 100. Neither model made up an answer. The limits are as follows. This is reuse of stored state, not a wider attention window: one block is loaded at a time, and how well a question is answered depends on the model. Writing the memory is a one-time cost, and the store takes terabytes of local NVMe disk. We describe the test protocol, which is built to resist common ways of gaming long-context benchmarks, and give a single-GPU reproduction that uses public software and a free licence for the package.

AI.tldr: 论文测试了 galahad-kv 记忆层：将每约 16,000 token 的 KV 状态加密保存到本地 NVMe，之后按字节精确加载而无需重算。在 50M token 真实文本、单张 H100、Gemma 4 12B/31B 上验证，加载更快、更省能，显存占用平稳，并能回答数百万 token 前植入的事实。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型只能使用上下文窗口内的文本，且每次发送提示都要重新计算内部 KV 状态，造成重复计算、能耗和显存开销。研究希望用存储复用 KV 状态来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 使用公开包 galahad-kv，在 vLLM 和单张 NVIDIA H100 上服务 Gemma 4 12B 与 31B。将每块约 16,000 token 的 KV 状态加密写入本地 NVMe，之后字节精确加载，不重新计算。测试覆盖 50,000,000 token 真实公开文本，并采用抗长上下文基准作弊的测试协议。
AI.result: 在 0 到 50M token 深度范围内，探测的每个块都从加密存储加载且无需重算，两个模型均为 100/100。加载块比重算快 2.8x 到 4.3x，GPU 能耗低 8.8x 到 12.3x，整个 50M token 流中 GPU 显存保持平稳。对数百万 token 前植入事实的提问，12B 模型 100 次中答对 82 次，31B 模型答对 98 次，且均未编造答案。
AI.conclusion: 该方法表明复用已存储 KV 状态可显著降低长上下文中的重算成本与能耗，并在 50M token 规模上维持显存平稳和较好的事实召回。但它不是扩大注意力窗口，而是一次加载一个块；回答质量依赖模型本身。写入记忆是一次性成本，且存储需要数 TB 本地 NVMe。作者还提供了单 GPU 可复现方案，使用公开软件和免费许可证。

title: Causal-fate dynamics of unrealized influence
comment: 39 pages (20-page main text and 19-page Supplementary Information), 6 figures, 14 supplementary tables. Code: https://github.com/Hotaru366/causal-fate-code
summary: Many dynamical systems generate influences whose consequences are not fully exhausted in the realized trajectory at the moment they arise. Such consequences are often treated as absent, delayed or statically stored, leaving unclear how unrealized influence retains future relevance as the system evolves. Here we formulate causal-fate dynamics, in which generated influence may be realized, remain latent, or be transformed by subsequent dynamics, and give an exact finite-transport representation when the relevant maps are specified. A connectome-constrained Caenorhabditis elegans model first motivates the biological hypothesis that unresolved inter-neuronal influence may persist and contribute to later propagation; it does not establish such a mechanism in living animals. We next examine operational Internet routing, where a dynamically updated cross-observer history retains predictive information beyond the current local route state. We then use the representation to construct a Transformer architecture that explicitly transports and selectively realizes latent contextual influence while retaining language-modeling function. The three studies distinguish a model-motivated scientific hypothesis, an observational phenomenon compatible with future-relevant history and an executable construction for carrying unrealized influence through subsequent computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“因果命运动力学”，描述动态系统中已产生但未在当下轨迹中实现的影响如何保持潜在并影响未来；通过线虫模型、互联网路由观测和Transformer构造三个案例，区分科学假设、观测现象与可执行架构。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常把未实现影响视为不存在、延迟或静态存储，未说明其如何在系统演化中保持未来相关性。
AI.method: 形式化因果命运动力学，允许影响被实现、保持潜伏或被后续动态转化；在映射明确时给出精确有限传输表示。用连接组约束的秀丽隐杆线虫模型、动态更新的互联网路由跨观察者历史，以及显式传输并选择性实现潜在上下文影响的Transformer架构进行案例研究。
AI.result: 线虫模型提示未解决的神经元间影响可能持续并参与后续传播，但未证明活体机制；互联网路由中跨观察者历史在本地路由状态之外仍有预测信息；Transformer可在保持语言建模功能的同时传输并选择性实现潜在上下文影响。
AI.conclusion: 三个研究分别对应模型启发的科学假设、与未来相关历史兼容的观测现象，以及将未实现影响带过后继计算的可执行构造，为理解未实现影响的未来相关性提供统一框架。

title: Enabling Preference-driven Unlearning in Few-step Distilled Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distilled into few-step variants and being deployed to enable fast inference. However, their ability to generate harmful or undesired content poses significant safety risks. Data-driven unlearning methods suppress targeted generations by fine-tuning model weights using specialized unlearning objectives. Crucially, these objectives implicitly rely on multi-step denoising dynamics, an assumption that breaks down for few-step distilled (FSD) models, resulting in ineffective forgetting. Furthermore, performing unlearning on the non-distilled base model and subsequently re-distilling it to obtain an unlearned FSD model incurs substantial computational and time overhead, making it impractical in many settings. Hence, we address this limitation with a preference-driven unlearning framework that revisits Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for diffusion models. We show that standard DPO and its unlearning derivatives, formulated around noise-prediction error, transfer poorly to FSD models due to their altered generation dynamics. To overcome this, we introduce a modified preference optimization formulation explicitly aligned with the few-step generation properties, enabling direct concept removal in FSD models while preserving few-step efficiency and maintaining strong retention of desirable (non-targeted) capabilities. We evaluate our framework primarily on identity and NSFW (nudity) removal tasks and also extend our method to object-level unlearning. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent and effective forgetting, and strong retention performance, establishing our method as a practical and principled solution for unlearning in FSD models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究少步蒸馏文本到图像扩散模型中的概念遗忘问题，提出一种与少步生成特性对齐的偏好优化遗忘框架，可在保持少步推理效率的同时有效移除目标概念并保留其他能力。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏扩散模型便于快速推理，但可能生成有害或不良内容，存在安全风险。现有数据驱动遗忘方法依赖多步去噪动态，在少步蒸馏模型上失效；若先在基座模型上遗忘再重新蒸馏，则计算与时间开销过大。
AI.method: 提出偏好驱动的遗忘框架，重新审视扩散模型中的直接偏好优化（DPO）。指出标准DPO及其基于噪声预测误差的遗忘变体因生成动态改变而难以迁移到少步蒸馏模型。为此提出与少步生成特性显式对齐的改进偏好优化公式，直接在少步蒸馏模型中移除概念。
AI.result: 主要在身份移除和NSFW（裸露）移除任务上评估，并扩展到对象级遗忘。实验表明该方法能持续有效地遗忘目标概念，同时保持较强的不相关能力保留性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为少步蒸馏扩散模型中的遗忘提供了一种实用且有原则的解决方案，兼顾遗忘效果、少步效率和理想能力保留。

title: Disentangling Linguistic and Paralinguistic Information with Routed Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Self-supervised speech encoders contain linguistic and paralinguistic information in a shared, entangled representation space. We combine a TopK sparse autoencoder with route-specific supervision and cross-factor adversaries. Across frozen SPEAR and WavLM encoders, independent probes show factor-specific retention and suppression: linguistic information remains stronger in the linguistic route, while paralinguistic factors, including speaker identity, emotion, and prosody, are retained in the paralinguistic route and substantially reduced in the linguistic route. The route organisation learned on LibriSpeech persists on MSP-Podcast without representation-side retraining. Feature-space route interventions further transfer the swapped factor while largely preserving the information carried by the unchanged route. These results show consistent route-selective separation across encoders, corpora, independent probes, and representation-level interventions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出结合TopK稀疏自编码器、路由特定监督和跨因素对抗的方法，在冻结的SPEAR与WavLM语音编码器中分离语言信息与副语言信息。
AI.motivation: 自监督语音编码器将语言和副语言信息纠缠在共享表示空间中，难以区分和控制不同因素，因此需要实现表示层面的因素解耦。
AI.method: 使用TopK稀疏自编码器，加入路由特定监督与跨因素对抗训练，并在冻结的SPEAR和WavLM编码器上进行独立探针评估、跨语料验证和特征空间路由干预。
AI.result: 独立探针显示：语言信息在语言路由中更强；说话人身份、情感、韵律等副语言因素在副语言路由中保留，并在语言路由中显著减少。LibriSpeech上学习的路由组织可泛化到MSP-Podcast，无需表示侧再训练；特征空间干预可迁移交换的因素，同时基本保留未变路由的信息。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，该方法能在不同编码器、语料、独立探针和表示级干预之间实现一致的路由选择性分离，为语音自监督表示解耦提供了有效途径。

title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI. 23 pages
summary: We study whether small LLM agents can operate effectively under explicit wall-clock time budgets by both respecting the allocated runtime and using available time productively. We evaluate Qwen3.6-27B on five competitions from MLE-Bench Lite and Qwen3-4B on Zork I (Jericho), two agentic benchmarks where additional computational time can meaningfully improve performance. In the simplest setting, where the budget is stated only in the prompt, agents fail to translate the stated budget into controlled use of time. These failures arise from gaps in time awareness, since the harness provides no timing feedback, but also because they cannot reliably anticipate the duration of actions, and do not have a learned mapping from available time to an appropriate strategy. We investigate two complementary classes of interventions: harness-based mechanisms that expose timing information and enforce deadlines, and reinforcement learning with budget-aware rewards. Injecting timing information through the harness substantially improves budget adherence for Qwen3.6-27B without measurable loss in performance, while enforcement hooks tighten adherence further. RL with GRPO achieves near-perfect budget adherence on Zork I and generalizes to held-out budgets not seen during training, but does not improve task performance over the untrained harness on MLE-Bench. Once agents are made to respect the budget, they still fail to use additional time to improve task performance. RL-trained policies learn when to stop but often fill extra time with repeated actions, and GRPO training on multiple budgets tends to collapse toward the strategy learned for the shortest budget. Our results reveal a gap between time adherence and productive time allocation, which remains a central challenge for budget-conditioned agents.

AI.tldr: 本文研究小型LLM智能体能否在明确的墙钟时间预算下有效工作，即遵守时间限制并利用额外时间提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体在有时间预算的场景中，可能既无法遵守截止时间，也无法把可用时间转化为有效策略。
AI.method: 在MLE-Bench Lite五个竞赛上用Qwen3.6-27B评估，在Zork I（Jericho）上用Qwen3-4B评估；比较提示中给出预算、通过harness提供计时反馈与强制执行截止时间、以及基于预算感知奖励的GRPO强化学习等干预。
AI.result: 仅提示预算时智能体无法有效控制时间；harness注入计时信息显著提升Qwen3.6-27B的预算遵守且无明显性能损失，强制执行可进一步提高遵守率。GRPO在Zork I上接近完美遵守并泛化到未见预算，但在MLE-Bench上未提升任务表现。智能体即使遵守预算，也未能用额外时间提升表现：会重复动作，且多预算GRPO易坍缩到最短预算策略。
AI.conclusion: 时间遵守与有效时间分配之间存在明显鸿沟，这是预算条件智能体面临的核心挑战。

title: Battery Second Life : A Review of Experimental Studies
summary: As electric vehicle volume increase, the interest for reusing their retired batteries grow. Giving a second life to batteries reduce their environmental impact and provide access to more affordable energy storage systems. This lifespan extension is of interest in a wide range of fields as the reuse offer a solution for end-of-life batteries management and the development of renewable energies. Although several review articles have described opportunities and barriers related to reuse, to our knowledge none have synthesized insights from studies that conducted experiments on retired batteries. This article aims to address this gap by providing a detailed analysis of more than 150 articles. This article's main findings are the proposition of a new vocabulary for batteries end-of-life, an evaluation of state of health and dispersion in retired batteries as well as the synthesis of aging and safety studies on these batteries. In a nutshell, this review show that the performance of retired batteries can be high, their dispersion should be managed and their degradation can be slow and safe. Limitations of current battery research ideas for future experiments and ideas for future studies are also presented.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了150多篇关于退役电动汽车电池二次利用的研究，提出退役电池术语，评估其健康状态与离散性，并总结老化与安全实验，指出退役电池性能可较高、需管理离散性且退化可缓慢安全。
AI.motivation: 电动汽车数量增长导致退役电池增多，二次利用可降低环境影响并提供更经济的储能方案，同时有助于电池报废管理和可再生能源发展；但现有综述未系统综合退役电池实验研究。
AI.method: 对150多篇文献进行详细分析，综合退役电池相关的实验研究，提出电池寿命终结阶段的新术语，评估退役电池的SOH与离散性，并总结其老化与安全性研究。
AI.result: 退役电池的性能可以较高；其不一致性/离散性应加以管理；其退化过程可能缓慢且安全。同时指出现有电池研究的局限，并提出未来实验与研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 退役电池二次利用具有重要价值，但需关注性能离散性与老化安全，未来应加强实验研究以推动其安全高效再利用。

title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
summary: The diversity of robot embodiments and action spaces makes it challenging to build robot world models that generalize across different embodiments. We introduce the Latent Action-Conditioned Robot World Model (LAC-WM), which operates within a learned unified latent action space shared across diverse embodiments. This unified action space improves the world model's performance when adapted to previously unseen robot embodiments. We compare LAC-WM with an Explicit Action-Conditioned World Model (EAC-WM), which conditions on explicit motion labels. Our results show that explicit action conditioning leads to disjoint action representations across embodiments, limiting downstream performance when adapting to new robots. We evaluate both models on dexterous manipulation tasks and a modified LIBERO benchmark. LAC-WM improves downstream performance over EAC-WM by up to 46.7% on dexterous manipulation and 11.7% on LIBERO. Crucially, the unified latent action space allows LAC-WM's downstream performance to scale positively with the number of embodiments used during pretraining. In contrast, the disjoint action space in EAC-WM leads to decreased performance as the number of pretraining embodiments increases. These results highlight the importance of a unified action space for efficient cross-embodiment learning, addressing a key challenge in robotics. Project website: https://lacwm.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出LAC-WM，在跨具身共享的潜在动作空间中学习机器人世界模型，提升对未见具身的适应性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人具身与动作空间多样，导致世界模型难以跨不同具身泛化。
AI.method: 学习统一的潜在动作空间，LAC-WM在该空间中进行动作条件建模；与使用显式运动标签的EAC-WM对比，并在灵巧操作任务和修改的LIBERO基准上评估。
AI.result: 显式动作条件导致跨具身动作表示不连贯，限制适应新机器人。LAC-WM下游性能比EAC-WM在灵巧操作上提升最多46.7%，在LIBERO上提升11.7%。统一潜在动作空间使LAC-WM性能随预训练具身数量增加而正向扩展，而EAC-WM性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 统一动作空间对高效跨具身学习至关重要，解决了机器人学中的关键挑战。

title: Sparse Attention Is Matrix Approximation, Not Choosing from a Bag of Values
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many domains, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic cost of attention with respect to prompt length. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retaining only a small fraction of query-key interactions to approximate the full attention matrix. However, existing methods are trapped in a mathematically wrong view: they simply keep large scalar entries or high-mass regions of the attention matrix. This treats the attention matrix as a bag of values, ignoring that it is used as a structured matrix whose entries jointly determine the attention output through multiplication with value vectors. We argue that this is the core conceptual issue: sparse attention should be formulated as matrix approximation, not as blindly choosing the largest values from a bag of entries. Based on this view, we propose Matrix Approximation Sparse Attention (MASA). MASA replaces raw attention-mass ranking with a closed-form score that measures how much each sparse unit reduces matrix-product approximation error. As a theory-grounded plug-in correction, MASA can be added to existing sparse attention frameworks without changing their sparse kernels or budgets. Extensive experiments across multiple sparse attention methods, benchmarks, and LLM backbones show consistent accuracy gains, supporting both MASA and the matrix-approximation view of sparse attention.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出稀疏注意力不应只看注意力矩阵中的大值或高权重区域，而应将其视为矩阵近似问题，并提出即插即用的 MASA 方法，在不改变原有稀疏核与预算的情况下提升多种稀疏注意力方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽表现强劲，但注意力计算随提示长度呈二次增长，效率受限。现有稀疏注意力方法仅保留注意力矩阵中较大的标量值或高权重区域，忽略了注意力矩阵作为结构化矩阵与 value 向量相乘决定输出的本质，因此存在概念性错误。
AI.method: 作者将稀疏注意力重新表述为矩阵近似问题，并提出 Matrix Approximation Sparse Attention（MASA）。MASA 用闭式分数替代原始注意力权重排序，衡量每个稀疏单元能减少多少矩阵乘积近似误差；作为理论驱动的插件式修正，可直接接入现有稀疏注意力框架，无需改变其稀疏核或预算。
AI.result: 在多种稀疏注意力方法、基准任务和 LLM 主干模型上的大量实验表明，MASA 能带来一致的准确率提升，支持其方法有效性与稀疏注意力的矩阵近似视角。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力应被形式化为矩阵近似，而非简单选择注意力矩阵中的最大值；MASA 作为通用修正方法验证了这一观点，并能兼容现有稀疏注意力框架以提升性能。

title: SPLIT-RL: Staged Perception-Language Reasoning Training with Claim-Level Advantages
summary: Vision-Language (VL) reasoning requires a model to both extract relevant and accurate information from an image (visual reasoning, VR), and to infer the answer from it (language reasoning, LR). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically trains both through a single chain-of-thought with a final-answer reward. This gives every CoT token the same sequence-level advantage, failing to distinguish capability specific errors. We propose SPLIT-RL, a staged post-training approach that trains VR and LR in disjoint phases. Because a group's rollouts differ along one capability at a time, the group-relative advantage isolates it, and each phase is optimized using phase-specific reward. We further introduce Claim-Level Advantage (CLA-GRPO), which decomposes VR-phase rollouts into atomic visual claims and provides a fine-grained advantage at claim level based on visual-type group formation. Although trained in two phases, trained policy is evaluated like GRPO model, with a single CoT call at inference time. Under this protocol, SPLIT-RL improves average accuracy over GRPO by 1.4-6.1 points across Qwen3-VL models from 2B to 30B-A3B and InternVL3.5-8B. Evaluating each capability using an oracle based diagnostic shows that answer-only GRPO leaves perception unchanged, whereas SPLIT-RL improves both VR and LR.

AI.tldr: 提出SPLIT-RL分阶段后训练方法，将视觉推理与语言推理解耦训练，并引入CLA-GRPO细粒度优势，在多个VL模型上提升平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习通常用单一思维链和最终答案奖励训练，导致所有CoT token共享同一序列级优势，无法区分视觉推理与语言推理的能力特定错误。
AI.method: SPLIT-RL将视觉推理和语言推理放在互不重叠的阶段训练，使每组rollout仅沿一种能力变化，从而用组相对优势隔离该能力，并使用阶段特定奖励；进一步提出CLA-GRPO，将VR阶段rollout分解为原子视觉主张，基于视觉类型分组形成claim级细粒度优势；推理时仍采用单次CoT调用。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL 2B至30B-A3B及InternVL3.5-8B上，SPLIT-RL相比GRPO平均准确率提升1.4-6.1点；基于oracle的诊断表明，仅答案奖励的GRPO未改善感知，而SPLIT-RL同时提升视觉推理和语言推理。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段解耦训练与claim级细粒度优势能有效区分并优化VL推理中的视觉和语言能力，且不增加推理时的调用次数。

title: Certified Scalable Enclosures for Uncertain Underdetermined Systems
summary: The central challenge in underdetermined models with bounded uncertainty, such as in nonlinear design and estimation, is certifying the solution sets. Conventional solution methodologies, such as those based on Newton's method or on sampling-based uncertainty quantification, are either not applicable due to the underdetermined nature or do not give guarantees that all solutions have been found, assuming they converge. We addressed this issue for a problem that arises in nonlinear design, where a target steady-state box is prescribed and the parameters have to be found. We developed a trapezoidal linearisation method that rigorously encloses all solutions and combined it with a tractable linear programming method to compute the component-wise bounds. We showed that the resulting families of linear programs can iteratively contract an initial parameter region. A subdivision of the target state and the initial parameter region can improve the contraction and provide tighter enclosures. The trapezoidal relaxation gives a family of linear programs that can also be used for finding solutions for interval linear systems via the Oettli-Prager characterisation. We demonstrate the generality of the method through different applications, including nonlinear design in biomolecular circuits, a sensitivity analysis method, and in a compressed sensing context, and discuss the trade-off between enclosure tightness and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 针对有界不确定性下的欠定模型解集认证问题，提出一种基于梯形线性化与线性规划的严格包围方法，可迭代收缩参数区域并给出所有解的包围。
AI.motivation: 传统牛顿法或采样不确定性量化方法在欠定模型中或不适用，或即使收敛也无法保证找到所有解，因此需要能严格认证解集的方法。
AI.method: 提出梯形线性化方法严格包围所有解，并结合可处理的线性规划计算逐分量边界；通过迭代求解线性规划族收缩初始参数区域，并利用目标状态和初始参数区域细分提高收缩效果；该方法还可借助Oettli-Prager刻画用于区间线性系统求解。
AI.result: 所得线性规划族能迭代收缩初始参数区域，细分可提供更紧的包围；方法在生物分子电路非线性设计、灵敏度分析和压缩感知等应用中展示了通用性，并讨论了包围紧度与计算成本之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为有界不确定性下的欠定非线性设计与估计问题提供了一种能够严格包围所有解的通用框架，并可在多种应用中扩展使用。

title: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
summary: Video-language models commonly assume that more temporal observations lead to more reliable reasoning. We question this assumption and argue that the key challenge is not merely processing more video frames efficiently, but learning to reason reliably under limited temporal evidence. We propose SAVER, a dense-to-sparse post-training framework that uses dense video views as training-time references for sparse-frame inference. During reinforcement post-training, paired dense and sparse views are optimized with grounding rewards and a reliability-gated reference reward, encouraging sparse view predictions to preserve task-relevant temporal evidence. Notably, SAVER is trained only on 1,250 randomly sampled temporal grounding examples, without using any video question answering annotations. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks and six video question-answering benchmarks, SAVER consistently improves performance across frame budgets. In particular, SAVER can match or surpass dense-frame Qwen3.5 baselines while using substantially fewer frames. These results show that temporal grounding can serve as an effective evidence-localization proxy for learning sparse video reasoning that transfers to broader video understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAVER，一个从密集到稀疏的视频语言模型后训练框架，利用密集视频视图作为训练参考，提升模型在稀疏帧推理下的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型常假设更多时序观察会带来更可靠推理，但本文质疑这一假设，认为关键挑战不是高效处理更多帧，而是在有限时序证据下仍能可靠推理。
AI.method: SAVER采用密集到稀疏的后训练框架：训练时使用成对的密集与稀疏视频视图，并进行强化后训练，结合grounding rewards和reliability-gated reference reward，促使稀疏视图预测保留任务相关时序证据。训练仅使用1250个随机采样的时序定位样本，不使用任何视频问答标注。
AI.result: 在三个时序定位基准和六个视频问答基准上，SAVER在不同帧预算下均持续提升性能；尤其能用显著更少的帧匹配或超越密集帧Qwen3.5基线。
AI.conclusion: 时序定位可作为有效的证据定位代理，用于学习稀疏视频推理，并能迁移到更广泛的视频理解任务。

title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) in non-Markovian environments is a challenging problem because policies have to reason over contextual information over long horizons. Existing policy architectures rely on recurrent or attention-based mechanisms to capture long-term dependencies. However, recurrent models suffer from hidden-state collapse and gradient instability under backpropagation through time, while attention-based models are fundamentally limited by context length. To address these issues, we propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a novel self-supervised method that $\textit{discovers}$ a set of information-critical observations ($\textit{mnemonics}$) by learning an objective from randomly sampled past observations and using it as a reward for keyframe selection. We then train a BC policy that conditions on the discovered keyframes to model the action distribution. Under certain task-structure assumptions, our formulation provides context retention guarantees over an infinite horizon, while maintaining a small set of decision-relevant keyframes in the policy's working memory. We evaluate our method on synthetic memory domains, where mnemonic-conditioned BC policies achieve $100$% success rates (SR) and generalize to horizons orders of magnitude beyond training without performance degradation. Additionally, we evaluate on memory-intensive robot manipulation benchmark, achieving a $13.9$% average absolute SR improvement over the strongest baseline across $23$ tasks and retaining $80$% SR at $20\times$ longer horizons on a real robot. Code and videos are available at https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 Keyframe Mnemonics，一种自监督发现关键观测作为记忆的方法，用于非马尔可夫环境中的行为克隆，并在合成记忆任务和机器人操作任务上显著提升长时程表现。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆在非马尔可夫环境中需要长时程上下文推理。现有循环策略存在隐藏状态坍塌和梯度不稳定问题，注意力策略则受限于上下文长度。
AI.method: 通过从随机采样的过去观测中学习目标，发现信息关键观测（mnemonics），并将其作为关键帧选择的奖励；再训练以这些关键帧为条件的行为克隆策略。理论上在某些任务结构假设下可提供无限时程的上下文保留保证，同时仅在工作记忆中保留少量决策相关关键帧。
AI.result: 在合成记忆域中达到100%成功率，并能泛化到比训练长数个数量级的时程而无性能下降；在23个记忆密集型机器人操作任务上，比最强基线平均绝对成功率提升13.9%；在真实机器人上，时程延长20倍仍保持80%成功率。
AI.conclusion: Keyframe Mnemonics 能有效缓解非马尔可夫行为克隆中的长时程依赖和上下文限制问题，在仿真与真实机器人任务中均表现优异，代码和视频已公开。

title: Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from a stronger teacher to a student language model through dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts and has shown promise on complex tasks such as mathematical reasoning. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student decisions shape subsequent observations, causing early errors to accumulate across turns. The resulting trajectories can drift away from the teacher's rollout distribution, making the teacher's token-level supervision less reliable or even counterproductive for OPD training. To address this issue, we introduce STI-OPD, a stochastic teacher intervention framework for multi-turn agentic OPD. During multi-turn interaction, STI-OPD uses teacher intervention guided by teacher-student policy discrepancy to replace the student's proposed action with a teacher-generated one to maximize the acquisition of reliable supervision. We further develop a stochastic intervention strategy, addressing the limitations of previous threshold-based or fixed-schedule approaches, that estimates policy discrepancy using KL divergence and maps it to an intervention probability. By sampling whether to intervene from this probability, STI-OPD adaptively balances teacher control with student exploration. To learn from the resulting mixed-policy trajectories, we introduce an Importance-Weighted Reverse KL objective that corrects the token sampling mismatch between teacher-generated responses and the student policy to preserve the original OPD objective. Across tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon interaction, STI-OPD outperforms the strongest prior OPD baseline on every evaluated benchmark and student size. Ablations further show that both discrepancy-guided intervention and importance weighting contribute to these gains.

AI.tldr: 提出STI-OPD，用于多轮智能体on-policy蒸馏；通过教师随机干预和重要性加权反向KL，缓解学生轨迹漂移导致的教师监督不可靠问题。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体任务中，学生动作会影响后续观测，早期错误会跨轮累积，使轨迹偏离教师 rollout 分布，导致教师 token 级监督不可靠甚至产生反效果。
AI.method: 用师生策略差异估计KL散度并映射为干预概率，随机决定是否用教师动作替换学生动作，以自适应平衡教师控制与学生探索；再引入 Importance-Weighted Reverse KL 目标，校正混合策略轨迹中教师生成响应与学生策略间的采样不匹配，保持原始OPD目标。
AI.result: 在工具集成推理和长程交互任务上，STI-OPD在所有评估基准和学生规模上均优于最强先前OPD基线；消融表明差异引导干预和重要性加权均带来增益。
AI.conclusion: STI-OPD能有效提升多轮智能体OPD训练的监督可靠性，在自适应平衡教师控制与学生探索的同时，改善复杂长程任务表现。

title: OmniHOI: Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction from Monocular Human Video
comment: The project page is available at https://hydrofoooil.github.io/OmniHOI/
summary: Monocular videos of human manipulation provide abundant dexterous demonstrations, yet reconstructing hand-object interaction from a single view and transferring it to robot hands remain difficult, limiting their direct use for robot execution. Prior methods either require task-specific RL training, limiting scalability, or assume clean motion-capture trajectories and thus cannot operate directly on video. We present OmniHOI, a pipeline that turns an RGB video of hand-object interaction into an interaction-faithful trajectory on dexterous hands. The key idea is to enforce physical consistency using the evidence available at each stage: image evidence during reconstruction, contact geometry during retargeting, and dynamics during physics-in-the-loop refinement. Each stage optimizes the corresponding representation directly, correcting errors before they propagate downstream or must be absorbed by a learned policy. Across 150 motion-capture trajectories transferred to each of five dexterous hands with 6 to 22 DoF, we achieve 39-89% success, compared with at most 31% for prior transfer methods. On 60 monocular video clips, we achieve 53% success, compared with 28% for the best prior video-to-robot pipeline. Its trajectories also execute on a real bimanual robot across diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: OmniHOI 是一个将人手-物体交互 RGB 视频转化为灵巧手交互轨迹的流水线，通过分阶段物理一致性约束实现从视频到机器人的直接迁移。
AI.motivation: 单目人手操作视频提供了丰富灵巧演示，但从单视角重建手-物交互并迁移到机器人手仍很困难。已有方法要么依赖任务特定强化学习、扩展性差，要么假设干净动捕轨迹、无法直接处理视频。
AI.method: 提出 OmniHOI 流水线：在重建阶段利用图像证据，在重定向阶段利用接触几何，在物理在环细化阶段利用动力学，逐步优化对应表示，避免误差向下游传播。评估包括 150 条动捕轨迹迁移到 5 种 6 至 22 自由度的灵巧手，以及 60 段单目视频片段。
AI.result: 在 150 条动捕轨迹迁移任务中成功率为 39-89%，优于先前迁移方法最高 31%；在 60 段单目视频上成功率为 53%，优于最佳先前视频到机器人流水线的 28%；轨迹还能在真实双臂机器人上执行多种任务。
AI.conclusion: OmniHOI 通过分阶段强制物理一致性，实现了从单目视频到灵巧手及真实机器人执行的交互保真轨迹迁移，并显著优于现有方法。

title: Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design for Sim-to-Real System Identification
summary: Sampling-based system identification estimates physically meaningful parameters by tuning a simulator to reproduce the target system dynamics, providing an interpretable approach to improving sim-to-real transfer. Yet when the collected trajectories do not distinguish the effects of different parameters, multiple parameter combinations can reproduce those trajectories, leading to unreliable parameter estimates. To address this challenge, we introduce an Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design framework (IDTD), which formulates the objective for the exploration policy built on the Schur complement score derived from the Fisher information matrix. To faithfully reflect parameter separability in the exploration objective, IDTD normalizes the score against the per-parameter information, selects the most favorable trajectory segment for each parameter, and aggregates the resulting scores logarithmically. The optimized trajectory is therefore composed of complementary intervals, each exposing a distinct subset of parameters whose contribution to the motion over that interval can be attributed unambiguously. Across diverse simulation environments, ranging from a linear-dynamics system to the Go2 quadruped, G1 humanoid, and Crazyflie quadrotor, IDTD reduces the parameter identification error by 39.6% on average relative to the strongest prior active-exploration baseline and attains improved downstream policy transfer. Furthermore, we validate the proposed trajectory design on a real K1 humanoid, demonstrating that the resulting identified parameters accurately capture the real-system dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出信息解耦轨迹设计框架 IDTD，通过基于 Fisher 信息矩阵 Schur 补的探索目标生成互补轨迹区间，使不同参数影响可被清晰区分，从而提升采样系统辨识与 sim-to-real 迁移。
AI.motivation: 采样系统辨识虽能估计有物理意义的参数，但当轨迹无法区分不同参数影响时，多个参数组合都可复现同一轨迹，导致参数估计不可靠。
AI.method: IDTD 以 Fisher 信息矩阵的 Schur 补分数构造探索策略目标；对分数按每个参数的信息进行归一化，为每个参数选择最有利的轨迹片段，并以对数方式聚合分数，最终优化出由互补区间组成的轨迹。
AI.result: 在线性系统、Go2 四足、G1 人形和 Crazyflie 四旋翼等仿真环境中，IDTD 相对最强主动探索基线平均降低参数辨识误差 39.6%，并改善下游策略迁移；在真实 K1 人形上也验证了辨识参数能准确反映真实系统动力学。
AI.conclusion: IDTD 能有效解耦轨迹中的参数信息，提高采样系统辨识的可靠性，并增强 sim-to-real 迁移效果。

title: GHARP: Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 35 pages (14 main + references + 15 pages supplementary), 14 figures, 17 tables
summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject's geometry and appearance offline, and an animation stage that predicts expression-dependent residuals on top of it at runtime. This separation offers a favorable trade-off with respect to fidelity, quality and runtime: the identity stage can be expensive while the animation stage runs a lightweight network, optimized for mobile devices. Our method performs animation in a semantically structured latent space of a pretrained reconstruction model, where expression changes remain spatially contained, making residual prediction efficient. This reconstruction prior provides a consistent spatial layout, allowing fusion of multiple input views into a compact, fixed-size canonical Gaussian representation. While this two-stage design improves the runtime-quality trade-off, it still inherits a problem common to all expression-driven avatar methods: expression codes describe only the face and thus omit body pose and clothing position, making these regions underspecified in the input. The animation network faces an ill-posed mapping and resorts to averaging over conflicting body appearances, producing blur and temporal flicker. We address this with a body alignment network that learns to align the person's body in the target image with the input reference images, removing the ambiguity from the training signal. Our method achieves state-of-the-art quality on the Ava-256 benchmark while running up to 13x faster on an A100 GPU with 8x fewer Gaussians.

AI.tldr: 提出GHARP，一种从少量输入图像和驱动表情信号实时生成3D人头动画的方法。它将问题解耦为离线的身份建模阶段和运行时的表情残差预测阶段，并引入身体对齐网络以解决身体与衣物区域欠约束导致的模糊和闪烁问题。
AI.motivation: 现有表情驱动虚拟人方法通常只由表情编码描述面部，忽略身体姿态和衣物位置，导致这些区域在输入中欠指定；动画网络面临不适定映射，只能对冲突的身体外观取平均，造成模糊和时间闪烁。
AI.method: 方法分为两阶段：离线身份阶段构建受试者的几何与外观表示，运行时动画阶段在预训练重建模型的语义结构化潜空间中预测表情相关残差。该重建先验提供一致空间布局，可将多视角输入融合为紧凑固定大小的规范高斯表示。另引入身体对齐网络，学习将目标图像中人物身体与输入参考图像对齐，从而消除训练信号中的歧义。
AI.result: 在Ava-256基准上达到最先进质量，同时在A100 GPU上运行速度最高提升13倍，且高斯数量减少8倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过身份与动画解耦、在重建先验潜空间中进行残差预测，并加入身体对齐，GHARP在实时性、模型紧凑性和生成质量之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Narrow and Deep: An Ontology Tower as the Knowledge of an LLM Agent for an Industrial Equipment System
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to operate industrial energy equipment, and what they get right depends on what they are told about the plant. Established building ontologies name many kinds of points across many sites, whereas an industrial equipment system needs few entities with much knowledge about each. This study proposes the ontology tower, a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system whose knowledge deepens in two ways: through quantities derived from the measured points by physical relations, and through lessons from the operating journal incorporated as knowledge nodes. On a real low-humidity air-handling test plant operated daily through a programmable logic controller, agents received a text projected from its tower in a preregistered evaluation of nine tasks replayed from the plant's records, using four open-weight models from 9 to about 750 billion parameters. This knowledge raised the rate at which the agents avoided the most plausible misjudgment of each task by about 20 percentage points, and the overall task score of the 9-billion-parameter model as much as that of the largest. Operating lessons were used when incorporated into the tower or placed in the prompt as records, but seldom when left in the journal behind a search tool. In live runs through an invariant safety layer, the agents brought the controlled variable into its target band in 12 of 14 runs. An ontology narrow in entities but deep in what is known about them can thus supply the knowledge that an agent for an industrial equipment system needs.

AI.tldr: 研究提出面向单一工业设备系统的“窄而深”本体塔，将物理关系推导量和运行日志经验整合为知识节点，以提升LLM智能体操作工业能源设备的判断与任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体开始操作工业能源设备，其表现取决于被提供的工厂知识；既有建筑本体覆盖广但不够深，而工业设备系统需要少量实体及其深入知识。
AI.method: 在真实低湿度空气处理试验平台上，通过PLC日常运行，构建“本体塔”：从测点经物理关系推导量，并将运行日志经验作为知识节点。开展预注册评估，回放9项任务，使用4个开放权重模型（9B至约750B参数），向智能体提供本体塔投射的文本。
AI.result: 知识使智能体避免各任务最可能误判的比例提高约20个百分点；9B参数模型的总体任务得分可达到最大模型水平。运行经验在纳入本体塔或作为记录放入提示时会被使用，但留在日志中并由搜索工具访问时很少被使用。在带不变安全层的实时运行中，14次有12次将控制变量带入目标区间。
AI.conclusion: 实体数量窄、但关于实体知识深的本体，能够为工业设备系统智能体提供其所需知识。

title: Instrumentation and Stabilization of Electric Arcs for Plasma Smelting Reduction
summary: The Hydrogen Plasma Smelting Reduction (HPSR) is a promising technology for low-CO$_2$ steel production. However, unstable arc conditions limit energy efficiency, hydrogen utilization, and electrode wear. In this paper, we discuss the influence of the electrical supply characteristics, which can be a source of additional instability. For active stabilization, a fast current controller using a buck converter with an adaptive state controller is used. For analyzing arc stability, a stereoscopic measurement system for reconstructing the arc is presented. The results show a clear correlation between the arc lengths and the measured arc voltage at constant current. Therefore, arc stability can be determined by the measured voltage. These findings build the basis for dynamic arc control by fast electrical interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究氢等离子体熔融还原（HPSR）中电弧不稳定性问题，分析供电特性影响，并提出基于快速电流控制与立体电弧测量的稳定化与监测方法。
AI.motivation: HPSR是低CO2炼钢的潜力技术，但电弧条件不稳定会限制能效、氢气利用率和电极寿命；供电特性可能进一步加剧不稳定性。
AI.method: 采用带自适应状态控制器的Buck变换器实现快速电流控制以主动稳定电弧；同时提出立体测量系统重建电弧，并分析恒流下电弧长度与电弧电压的关系。
AI.result: 结果显示，在恒定电流下电弧长度与测得电弧电压之间存在明显相关性，因此可通过电压测量判定电弧稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为通过快速电干预实现动态电弧控制奠定了基础，有助于提升HPSR过程的稳定性和效率。

title: Reading the Room: Foundations, Design, and Challenges of Normative Competence in LLMs
summary: Human communities are governed by normative systems: shared standards that produce \textit{norms} dictating acceptable behavior, enforced through community sanctioning. Aligning increasingly autonomous AI systems with these norms is a central alignment challenge, complicated by the fact that norms are vast in number, change quickly, and are often arbitrary (e.g., dress or language conventions). Thus, alignment requires \textit{normative competence}: the ability to discern from interaction alone what norms a community enforces without relying on static pretrained knowledge. We introduce a multi-agent community debate setting, where access to debate is governed by synthetic norms, to study normative competence in isolation from pretraining exposure. We show that baseline LLM agents fail to learn norms even when doing so would improve their accuracy. We then experiment with various \textit{normative modules} -- architectural components for norm inference -- finding that norm-following is highly sensitive to both the style of norm and the model powering the normative module, suggesting a lack of generalizability. Furthermore, when idiosyncratic, non-normative behaviors accompany the true norm, LLM agents exhibit an unselective attribution failure: they indiscriminately copy idiosyncratic noise alongside enforced rules, a pattern that persists even when imitating unnecessary behaviors is explicitly penalized. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to operationalize and evaluate normative competence in LLMs, demonstrating that current AI systems excel at behavioral mimicry but lack the capacity to discern socially enforced order.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大语言模型是否具备规范能力，即仅通过互动推断社区所执行的规范，而非依赖预训练知识；作者提出多智能体社区辩论环境，发现当前LLM擅长行为模仿但难以辨别并遵循社会强制规范。
AI.motivation: 人类社区由规范系统治理，而AI对齐需适应数量庞大、变化快且常具任意性的规范，因此需要规范能力。现有研究未在隔离预训练暴露的条件下系统评估LLM这一能力。
AI.method: 构建多智能体社区辩论场景，辩论准入受合成规范控制，以隔离预训练影响；测试基线LLM；并引入多种“规范模块”作为规范推断架构组件，考察规范风格与模块模型能力的影响，同时加入伴随真实规范的独特非规范性行为。
AI.result: 基线LLM即使学习规范能提升准确率也未能学会规范；规范遵循高度依赖规范风格和规范模块所用模型，显示泛化不足；当存在非规范行为时，LLM表现出无选择性归因失败，会连同噪声一起模仿，即使惩罚模仿无必要行为也仍持续。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次操作化并评估LLM的规范能力，表明当前AI系统擅长行为模仿，但缺乏辨别社会强制执行秩序的能力，这对AI规范对齐提出重要挑战。

title: Large Language Models for Machine Translation Quality Annotation: Humans and Models Are Both Challenged
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are considered to be a more efficient and cost-effective alternative to human judgment for Machine Translation (MT) evaluation. With MT evaluation spanning a large number of language pairs, domains and levels of annotation granularity, LLMs must be thoroughly evaluated across these dimensions before being reliably used as alternatives to human evaluation. In this paper, we evaluate the performance of LLMs for two prominent MT quality evaluation schemes: Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) and Error Span Annotation (ESA) by comparing their agreement with human annotators. We present results on a long-context test set of 70 language pairs and the publicly available WMT23 and WMT25 data, investigating both score and error span annotation agreement across a variety of language pairs and domains. Our results show that while LLM agreement with human annotators exceeds agreement between human annotators for some evaluation tasks, both vary substantially across annotation schemes, language pairs and domains and remain unreliable for most settings. Furthermore, we identify challenges facing both human and LLM annotators: humans are particularly challenged by fine-grained MQM annotations and low-resource language pairs, while LLMs struggle with minor errors, wrong language variants and error span annotation. Our results highlight the potential for improvement for both human and LLM annotation performance, possibly through human-LLM collaborative annotation pipelines that address the reliability issues identified in this work.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了大语言模型在机器翻译质量评估中两种方案（MQM和ESA）的表现，通过比较其与人类标注者的一致性，发现LLM在某些任务上超过人类间一致性，但在多数设置下仍不可靠，并识别了人类和LLM各自的挑战。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被视为比人工判断更高效、经济的机器翻译评估替代方案，但机器翻译评估涉及大量语言对、领域和标注粒度，因此需要在这些维度上全面评估LLM的可靠性。
AI.method: 在包含70个语言对的长上下文测试集以及WMT23和WMT25公开数据上，评估LLM在MQM和ESA两种评估方案下与人类标注者在分数和错误跨度标注上的一致性。
AI.result: LLM与人类标注者的一致性在某些评估任务上超过了人类标注者之间的一致性，但该一致性因标注方案、语言对和领域的不同而差异显著，在大多数设置下仍不可靠。人类标注者面临细粒度MQM标注和低资源语言对的挑战，而LLM在细微错误、错误语言变体和错误跨度标注上表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 人类和LLM的标注性能均有提升空间，可能通过人类-LLM协作标注流程来解决本研究中发现的可靠性问题。

title: GPU-Accelerated Computation of Persistent Homology for Topological Analysis of Image Data
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Includes supplementary material (8 pages) after the main paper. Code: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data
summary: In recent years, persistent homology has seen rapid adoption in deep learning, yet its computation remains a major bottleneck in network training. This paper introduces TopoGPU, a GPU streaming pipeline that computes persistence diagrams of cubical complexes induced by 2D and 3D images. TopoGPU streams the input image chunk by chunk, processing each chunk with massively parallel GPU kernels on a grid of GPU blocks; the resulting boundary relations are accumulated in host memory, where the CPU performs the boundary matrix reduction. TopoGPU introduces a stratification-aware discrete Morse matching that provably preserves persistent homology under streaming, together with a parallel topological sorting algorithm and a parallel V-path parity algorithm for deriving Morse boundaries on the GPU. TopoGPU outperforms Cubical Ripser, a state-of-the-art method for persistent homology computation, on every benchmark evaluated, achieving an average end-to-end speedup of 53.24x and a maximum of 198.01x. We further integrate TopoGPU into a topology-preserving deep network, demonstrating that it substantially reduces the cost of persistent homology computation during network training. TopoGPU is open source, with pre-built binaries, Google Colab notebooks, and Docker images available at the project's GitHub page: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data.

AI.tldr: TopoGPU 是一种面向 2D/3D 图像诱导立方复形的 GPU 流式持续同调计算管线，通过分块流式处理与 GPU 并行核显著加速持久图计算，并能集成到拓扑保持深度网络中。
AI.motivation: 持续同调在深度学习中的应用日益广泛，但其计算效率仍是网络训练的主要瓶颈，亟需更高效的 GPU 加速方法。
AI.method: 提出 TopoGPU：按块流式读取图像，在 GPU 块网格上并行处理每个块，将边界关系累积到主机内存，再由 CPU 执行边界矩阵约简；同时引入分层感知的离散 Morse 匹配以在流式处理下保持持续同调，并设计并行拓扑排序算法和并行 V-path 奇偶算法以在 GPU 上导出 Morse 边界。
AI.result: 在所有评估基准上均优于当前最先进的 Cubical Ripser，端到端平均加速 53.24 倍，最高加速 198.01 倍；集成到拓扑保持深度网络后，可大幅降低网络训练中持续同调计算的开销。
AI.conclusion: TopoGPU 能有效加速图像数据的持续同调计算，并适用于拓扑保持深度学习训练；其代码、预编译二进制、Colab 笔记本和 Docker 镜像已开源。

title: When Listening Becomes Easier: Scrubbing Visual Cues for Shortcut-Free VLAs
summary: Shortcut learning is a prevalent issue in robot learning. The limited diversity of robot demonstration datasets can mislead policies into exploiting spurious correlations between tasks and irrelevant features, such as viewpoint or background. Collecting sufficiently diverse robot demonstrations is costly and inefficient, motivating algorithmic alternatives. We focus on vision-language-action (VLA) models and discover that different vision-language model backbones exhibit substantially different levels of susceptibility to visual shortcut learning. We find that model behavior correlates with our proposed representation-level metric, action margin, which requires no policy rollouts. Visual shortcuts consistently enter action representations in early layers, with models differing in the extent to which later layers correct them by incorporating language information. To boost models' attention to language, we introduce task scrubbing, a new domain-adversarial training method that decreases models' likelihood of using visual shortcuts and improves VLAs' generalization. Experiments in both simulation and the real world across multiple VLAs and visual cues show that task scrubbing improves out-of-distribution robustness and often eliminates visual shortcut learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的视觉捷径学习问题，提出动作边际指标来预测模型对视觉捷径的敏感性，并提出任务擦除（task scrubbing）方法提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示数据多样性不足，导致策略容易利用任务与无关视觉特征（如视角、背景）之间的虚假关联；而收集足够多样的机器人演示成本高、效率低，因此需要算法层面的解决方案。
AI.method: 聚焦VLA模型，发现不同视觉-语言模型骨干对视觉捷径的敏感性差异显著；提出无需策略 rollout 的表征级指标“动作边际”；分析捷径进入动作表征的层间机制；提出任务擦除，一种域对抗训练方法，降低模型使用视觉捷径的可能性。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界中，跨多个VLA模型和视觉线索的实验表明，任务擦除提升了分布外鲁棒性，并通常能消除视觉捷径学习；视觉捷径常进入早期层的动作表征，后续层通过语言信息进行不同程度纠正。
AI.conclusion: 任务擦除能有效减少VLA模型对视觉捷径的依赖，提升泛化能力，为机器人学习中缓解捷径学习提供了可行算法方案。

title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning environments are now a primary lever for improving large language model (LLM) capabilities in post-training, yet most agentic benchmarks remain static: the world moves only when the agent acts, the reward is a terminal verdict, and the pass bar is set arbitrarily. We introduce StoreBench, a live-commerce environment in which an agent runs a mid-size online apparel store on a production-grade commerce backend, testing long-horizon planning and economic judgment under uncertainty. Customers order around the clock, suppliers reprice and fail, and market shocks arrive with partial or no warning. The agent acts through the same 29 merchant tools a human operator would use, under a windowed operation budget that makes simulated time a function of actions taken, so model latency cannot influence simulated time. Pass thresholds are calibrated against scripted anchor policies, the reward is hardened against a catalogue of reward hacks, and every episode replays identically given a sequence of actions. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs on 11 scenarios of 30 to 45 days and a full simulated year, over three world seeds at matched reasoning effort. No model matches the scripted smart-triage policy on average: the best, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, passes 49% of task-seed cells against the heuristic's 97%. Human experts working through the same tools and budgets outscore every model (mean composite 0.708 vs. 0.700). Over a full simulated year under the Claude Code harness, most models show dramatic performance improvement. In a GRPO post-training run, Qwen3.5-27B trained on only five disjoint tasks raises its mean composite on the held-out evaluation tasks from 0.136 to 0.373. We release five example training-split tasks, ten sample trajectories, and the scoring and verification tooling; the full environment and evaluation suite are withheld to keep the benchmark uncontaminated.

AI.tldr: 提出 StoreBench：一个让 LLM 智能体在真实级电商后端经营中型服装网店的实时强化学习环境，用于评测长时程规划与不确定性下的经济决策能力。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准多为静态——世界仅在智能体行动时变化，奖励只是终局判定，通过门槛设定随意，无法真实衡量长期经济决策与不确定性应对能力。
AI.method: 构建生产级商业后端与 29 个商家工具；采用窗口化操作预算，使模拟时间由动作数量决定而非模型延迟；通过脚本锚点策略校准通过阈值，加固奖励以防 reward hack，并保证给定动作序列可完全复现。评测 7 个前沿 LLM，覆盖 11 个场景（30-45 天及整模拟年）、3 个世界种子，并保持推理投入一致。
AI.result: 无模型平均能匹敌脚本 smart-triage 策略：最佳模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 仅通过 49% 的任务-种子单元，而启发式为 97%；人类专家以相同工具与预算得分最高（平均综合分 0.708 对模型 0.700）。整模拟年下多数模型性能大幅提升；GRPO 后训练中，仅用 5 个不重叠任务训练的 Qwen3.5-27B 在留出评测任务上的平均综合分从 0.136 升至 0.373。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 在长时程经济决策上仍落后于脚本策略，但更长的模拟时间与针对性训练可带来显著提升。发布 5 个训练集示例任务、10 条样本轨迹及评分验证工具，完整环境与评测套件暂不公开以防污染。

title: AI4Fire: Evaluating Large Language Models on Wildfire Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are entering wildfire management, where overstated evaluations can cost property and lives. How do they perform on wildfire tasks, with and without grounding? Bare means a model receives the task input alone. Grounded means it also receives one task-specific addition: for smoke detection, a smoke-free reference frame from the same camera. AI4Fire runs six core models bare and grounded on five wildfire tasks, zero-shot; a sweep adds 29 more. Our literature search on fire tasks found 138 works; none combines this roster, task coverage, and paired bare and grounded runs. We report three findings. (1) Grounding helped most where the addition carried the answer: a read-only SQL tool lifted every core model's database accuracy from at most 16 to at least 88 percent. (2) Simple rules were hard to beat: no core model outperformed repeating today's staffing count, and two open-weight models mostly copied the median of similar earlier fire-days, a worse forecast. (3) Public releases carry hazards: a fire-danger column separates the holdout perfectly, and 67 aerial fire frames carry smoldering or fire-free labels read from a clipped thermal maximum. We release prompts, responses, scores, code, and the survey record.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AI4Fire基准，在野火管理任务上对多个大语言模型进行零样本评估，比较裸输入与任务特定接地输入下的表现，并揭示接地有效性、简单规则竞争力及公开数据风险。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正进入野火管理领域，但被高估的评估可能造成财产和生命损失，因此需要严格检验其在野火任务中、尤其有无接地时的真实能力。
AI.method: AI4Fire让6个核心模型在5类野火任务上以裸模式和接地模式零样本运行，并扩展扫描29个模型；同时进行文献检索，发现138项相关工作，但无研究结合该模型阵容、任务覆盖与配对裸/接地运行。
AI.result: （1）接地在附加信息直接包含答案时帮助最大：只读SQL工具将核心模型数据库准确率从至多16%提升到至少88%。（2）简单规则难以击败：没有核心模型优于重复今日人员配置数，两个开源权重模型大多复制相似历史火灾日的中位数，预测更差。（3）公开数据存在风险：一个火灾危险列能完美区分留出集，67个航拍火灾帧带有从裁剪热最大值读取的阴燃或无火标签。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在野火任务上能力有限，接地可显著提升特定任务，但简单规则仍有竞争力，且公开数据集可能含泄漏或标签隐患；作者发布提示、响应、评分、代码和调查记录以支持可复现评估。

title: Higher-Order Morphology Priors for Quadruped Reinforcement Learning Under Actuator Degradation
summary: Actuator degradation turns quadruped locomotion into a coordination problem requiring joints to compensate for lost actuation. Prior work suggests that morphology-aware graph policies improve learning and generalization under body perturbations. We ask whether these benefits can be strengthened by explicitly modeling higher-order mechanical structure. We represent the Unitree Go1 as a cell complex with limb- and body-level rank-2 cells and apply Hodge-based message passing. Under degradation training, the node-edge-face Hodge actor achieves the highest return on unseen actuator degradations, with higher survival and lower velocity-tracking error. These results support higher-order morphology as a useful inductive bias for whole-body compensation under actuator degradation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究四足机器人在执行器退化下的运动补偿问题，提出用高阶形态结构（胞腔复形与Hodge消息传递）建模Unitree Go1，并验证其在未见执行器退化中的优势。
AI.motivation: 执行器退化使四足运动变成需要关节相互补偿的协调问题；已有研究表明形态感知图策略能提升身体扰动下的学习与泛化，作者进一步探究显式建模高阶机械结构是否能增强这种收益。
AI.method: 将Unitree Go1表示为包含肢体级和身体级rank-2胞腔的胞腔复形，采用基于Hodge的消息传递，并在退化训练下对比节点-边-面Hodge actor等策略。
AI.result: 在未见执行器退化下，节点-边-面Hodge actor取得最高回报，同时存活率更高、速度跟踪误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 高阶形态可作为执行器退化下全身补偿的有效归纳偏置。

title: Learning How to Search for Plans with Exponentially Less Space
summary: Heuristic search for a plan can store exponentially many states, even when its heuristic is almost perfect. We instead learn search control, one specification per domain, written as an indexical policy: a generalized policy with registers that hold objects and modes that sequence its rules. We add the choose rule, which loads an object into a register and marks a backtracking point, where one candidate suffices; every other rule must work for all of its outcomes and needs no search. Our main result is that structural termination, which rules out infinite executions, also bounds every execution by a polynomial in the number of objects. A depth-first procedure then finds a plan in polynomial space, however large the state space, with no list of visited states. The cost is time, exponential only in the choice depth, the number of real choices along an execution. Any class that such a policy solves therefore lies in NP, and in P at constant choice depth. We learn these policies with a language model in a counterexample-guided loop that certifies termination, verifies the training tasks, and keeps the choice depth small. With the learned policies, the procedure solves 1,709 of 1,890 test tasks of the IPC 2023 Learning Track and the Autoscale Agile suite, more than LAMA, BFWS, and Levitron, and most of them within one second and 100 MiB.

AI.tldr: 论文提出学习搜索控制，使用索引式策略和choose规则，实现多项式空间规划，在IPC 2023等任务上超越LAMA等规划器。
AI.motivation: 启发式搜索可能存储指数级状态，即使启发式几乎完美，因此需要更高效的搜索控制方法。
AI.method: 学习索引式策略（含寄存器和模式），添加choose规则进行回溯；用语言模型在反例引导循环中学习策略，并认证终止性、验证任务、保持选择深度小。
AI.result: 结构终止保证执行受对象数量多项式限制；深度优先过程在多项式空间内找到计划，时间仅与选择深度指数相关。学到的策略解决1890个测试任务中的1709个，超过LAMA、BFWS和Levitron，多数在1秒和100MiB内。
AI.conclusion: 此类策略解决的问题属于NP，常数选择深度下属于P；方法有效，优于现有规划器。

title: Redefining fuel poverty: Introducing the temporal equity framework (TEF)
summary: The definition and quantification of fuel (or energy) poverty remain contentious, particularly within the English policy landscape. The current official definition - Low Income Low Energy Efficiency (LILEE) - systematically underestimates the condition in low- and middle-income households, effectively obfuscating changing energy affordability norms. This paper presents a sensitivity analysis of fuel poverty trajectories in Nottingham, UK, across competing definitions and diverging optimistic domestic efficiency upgrades) and pessimistic (energy price inflation) scenarios. Results demonstrate that LILEE overstates the efficacy of efficiency upgrades while failing to adequately reflect the impact of price shocks. To address these deficiencies, we propose the Temporal Equity Framework (TEF), a budget standard-based approach paired with a proportional energy expenditure indicator that captures shifting affordability norms more equitably. The TEF also introduces continuous expenditure-based depth indicators to evaluate the entrenchment of fuel-poor households (the fuel poverty gap) and the resilience of non-fuel-poor households (the fuel poverty buffer). We argue that responsive definitions which also recognise fuel poverty as a continuum of vulnerability, rather than a static, dichotomous state, are paramount to ensuring the equitability of energy transitions. Further, we suggest that the early identification of fuel poverty and spatial targeting of remedial resources could be markedly improved by adopting the TEF. We conclude that the adoption of a multidimensional budget standard-based definition is essential to facilitate a more accurate and just evaluation of energy transitions in England.

AI.tldr: 本文以英国诺丁汉为例，对现行燃料贫困定义LILEE进行敏感性分析，比较不同定义及乐观与悲观情景，指出其低估中低收入家庭且误判能效升级与价格冲击影响，并提出TEF框架以更公平地衡量燃料贫困。
AI.motivation: 燃料贫困的定义和量化仍存争议，现行官方LILEE定义系统性低估低中收入家庭的燃料贫困状况，并掩盖能源可负担性规范的变化。
AI.method: 对诺丁汉燃料贫困轨迹进行敏感性分析，涵盖竞争性定义及乐观（家庭能效升级）和悲观（能源价格上涨）情景；提出Temporal Equity Framework（TEF），采用基于预算标准的方法和比例能源支出指标，并引入连续支出深度指标：燃料贫困缺口与燃料贫困缓冲。
AI.result: 结果表明，LILEE高估能效升级效果，却未能充分反映价格冲击影响；TEF能更公平地捕捉可负担性规范变化，评估燃料贫困家庭的固化程度和非燃料贫困家庭的韧性，并改善早期识别与空间精准干预。
AI.conclusion: 采用多维、基于预算标准的定义，对英格兰能源转型进行更准确和公正的评估至关重要；应将燃料贫困视为脆弱性连续谱，而非静态二分状态。

title: When Citations Mislead? A Claim-Level Benchmark for Legal Hallucination Detection
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Published in the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), Singapore. Dataset: https://github.com/mmikaildemir/PARCEL
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in legal research and drafting, but they can still produce claims that sound convincing without being supported by the cited source. We introduce PARCEL, a benchmark for checking whether a legal claim is supported by the underlying authority. Using recent New York State Court of Appeals decisions, we build a dataset of 3,396 parenthetical-style claims labeled as Supported, Refuted, or Not Found. We cast this task as a three-way natural language inference problem and evaluate several state-of-the-art LLMs in a zero-shot setting. Although the strongest models reach up to 0.97 accuracy, the results also show an important weakness: models still incorrectly mark unsupported claims as supported, even when the full opinion text is provided. Across models, missing support is harder to detect than direct contradiction, and fabricated but plausible citations cause the largest drop in performance. Overall, PARCEL provides a practical benchmark for testing claim-level groundedness in legal RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PARCEL基准，用于检验法律声明是否被权威来源支持。基于纽约州上诉法院近期判决构建3,396条括号式声明，标注为Supported、Refuted或Not Found，并零样本评估多个先进LLM。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于法律研究和起草，但可能生成听起来可信却缺乏引用来源支持的声明，因此需要测试法律声明层面的来源支撑性。
AI.method: 使用纽约州上诉法院近期判决构建数据集，将任务建模为三分类自然语言推理问题，并在零样本设置下评估多个先进LLM；提供完整意见文本等条件进行测试。
AI.result: 最强模型准确率可达0.97，但仍会将无支持声明误判为有支持，即使提供完整意见文本；缺失支持比直接矛盾更难检测，虚构但合理的引证导致最大性能下降。
AI.conclusion: PARCEL为法律RAG系统中的声明级 groundedness 提供了实用基准，同时揭示当前LLM在检测法律声明是否被来源支持方面仍存在重要局限。

title: LVSPM: Long Sequence View Synthesis and Pose Estimation Model
summary: We present LVSPM, a generalizable model that jointly estimates camera poses and synthesizes novel views from uncalibrated image collections. Trained with only RGB images and pose supervision, LVSPM avoids dense 3D ground truth and employs test-time training (TTT) layers to scale seamlessly to hundreds of input views. On RealEstate10k, Co3Dv2, and DL3DV, LVSPM surpasses VGGT in pose estimation across 16-256 views, with especially large margins at strict thresholds. For novel view synthesis under a practical protocol where more views cover larger scenes, LVSPM achieves state-of-the-art pose-free quality---surpassing even pose-dependent models in PSNR---and still maintains high quality as scene scale grows, while baselines collapse. The code is available at https://burningdust21.github.io/Projects/LVSPM .

AI.tldr: LVSPM 是一种可泛化模型，能从无标定图像集合中联合估计相机位姿并合成新视角，利用测试时训练层扩展到数百张输入视图。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常依赖密集3D真值，难以从无标定图像中同时完成位姿估计与新视角合成，并扩展到大量视图和更大场景。
AI.method: 提出LVSPM，仅用RGB图像和位姿监督训练，避免密集3D真值；采用测试时训练（TTT）层，实现从16到256视图的可扩展联合位姿估计与新视角合成。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10k、Co3Dv2和DL3DV上，LVSPM在16-256视图位姿估计上超过VGGT，严格阈值下优势更明显；在实用协议下新视角合成达到无位姿方法最优，PSNR甚至超过依赖位姿的模型，并随场景规模增长保持高质量。
AI.conclusion: LVSPM在无标定、多视图和大场景条件下实现了领先的无位姿新视角合成与位姿估计，且基线方法在场景扩大时性能崩溃，而LVSPM保持稳定。

title: From Asymptotic to Designer-Assigned-Time Control: A Review of Stability Notions, Design Mechanisms, and Controller Architectures
summary: Many control tasks require a target to be reached not only eventually but on time. Finite-, fixed-, predefined-, and prescribed-time control address this need, yet the labels are used loosely: a settling time that grows with the initial condition, a bound that holds for all initial conditions, a deadline chosen by the designer, and a limit attained only at the terminal instant often share one name. This review aims to make such claims comparable. It separates three questions that are often conflated: what temporal property is promised, which feature of the Lyapunov analysis produces it, and which controller architecture carries it into the closed loop. A recurring question is whether a guarantee proven for an idealized loop survives once observers, adaptation, disturbances, actuator limits, and digital implementation are included. The examined studies are therefore audited one by one, recording what each claims, which variable is actually certified, and how the result is validated. The audit shows that estimation and approximation errors often reduce an exact guarantee to a practical one, and that experimental evidence comes mostly from fast electromechanical systems. A scalar benchmark with two complementary tunings shows how much of the apparent difference between methods stems from conservative bounds, initial-condition dependence, and numerical tolerance, and how saturation and sampling can delay or remove a deadline.
