We study closed-loop bias governance for Dutch government documents, where a system must detect biased language, ground decisions in legal and contextual evidence, rewrite problematic sentences when intervention is warranted, and verify that the rewrite mitigates harm without distorting meaning. Existing methods face three challenges: (i) discriminative classifiers capture surface regularities but lack normative grounding; (ii) zero-shot LLMs often adopt generic viewpoints and over-flag ambiguous administrative language; and (iii) fixed taxonomies inherit the Closed-World Assumption, missing emerging local targets. We propose MARS-Gov, a standpoint-aware multi-agent framework that combines legal retrieval, open-set target screening, specialized jurors, conservative routing, and rewrite verification. When screening finds an uncovered group, MARS-Gov instantiates a dynamic "10th juror" to deliberate outside the fixed panel. On DGDB, MARS-Gov sets a new SOTA with 0.880 F1, outperforming the strongest zero-shot LLM detector by 20.2 points (29.8% relative) and the best supervised Dutch encoder by 6.8 points, while reducing unnecessary interventions to 2.5%. Leave-One-Category-Out (LOCO) evaluation recovers held-out categories with 85.1% Correct@1 and 93.8% Correct@3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MARS-Gov，一个面向荷兰政府文档的闭环偏见治理多智能体框架，可检测偏见语言、依据法律与上下文证据决策、在必要时改写并验证改写效果。
AI.motivation: 预设偏见边界本身就是一种偏见；现有方法存在三个问题：判别式分类器缺乏规范依据、零样本大模型易过度标记行政语言、固定分类体系受封闭世界假设限制而漏掉新出现的本地目标群体。
AI.method: MARS-Gov 采用立场感知的多智能体框架，结合法律检索、开放集目标筛查、专门陪审员、保守路由和改写验证；当筛查发现未覆盖群体时，动态实例化“第10名陪审员”在固定小组之外进行审议。
AI.result: 在 DGDB 上，MARS-Gov 达到新 SOTA，F1 为 0.880，比最强零样本大模型检测器高 20.2 分（相对提升 29.8%），比最佳监督荷兰语编码器高 6.8 分，同时将不必要干预降至 2.5%；留一类别评估中，对未见过类别的恢复达到 85.1% Correct@1 和 93.8% Correct@3。
AI.conclusion: MARS-Gov 能有效进行闭环偏见治理，处理新兴目标群体，并在不扭曲原意的情况下减轻有害表达。

title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark and Type-Aware Evaluation for AI-Generated Game Commentary
summary: Game commentary is an open-ended generation task requiring multimodal perception, strategic reasoning, and contextual knowledge. Existing AI-Generated Game Commentary (AI-GGC) studies remain fragmented across games, modalities, and evaluation protocols, while overlap-based or holistic evaluators fail to capture the functional heterogeneity of commentary. We introduce \textsc{GameCommBench}, a unified benchmark spanning board games, sports, and esports, with commentary aligned to heterogeneous game contexts and annotated by commentary type. We further propose Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE), a structured framework for evaluating different types of commentary. We then validate TACE for reliability and human agreement, and use it to benchmark representative AI commentators. Results reveal non-uniform capability profiles, with live observation and strategic analysis emerging as major bottlenecks. Together, \textsc{GameCommBench} and TACE provide a diagnostic foundation for comparable and interpretable AI-GGC evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出统一基准 GameCommBench 和类型感知评估框架 TACE，用于评估 AI 生成游戏解说，覆盖棋类、体育和电子竞技，并揭示现有模型能力不均衡。
AI.motivation: 游戏解说需要多模态感知、策略推理和上下文知识，但现有 AI-GGC 研究在游戏、模态和评估协议上较为分散；基于重叠或整体性的评估无法捕捉不同类型解说的功能差异。
AI.method: 构建 GameCommBench 统一基准，使解说与异构游戏上下文对齐，并按解说类型标注；提出 Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE) 结构化评估框架，并验证其可靠性与人类一致性，进而对代表性 AI 解说模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 基准测试显示 AI 解说能力分布不均衡，其中实时观察和策略分析是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: GameCommBench 与 TACE 为 AI-GGC 提供了可比较、可解释的诊断性评估基础。

title: Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision
summary: Active robot vision requires controlling the camera to reveal task-relevant information that is hidden from the current viewpoint. For example, determining what is inside a box may require raising the camera and looking down into it. For viewpoint-dependent question answering, the challenge is to select camera motions that expose the visual evidence needed to answer the question. Although vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret observed images, selecting such motions requires anticipating the usefulness of unseen views. We quantify this usefulness as answerability, a VLM's estimate that a view suffices to answer the question, and present Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL), a viewpoint-selection policy that ranks candidate camera motions by predicted future answerability. RFL transfers visual lookahead from deployment to offline training. At training, a privileged teacher renders candidate future views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and uses a frozen VLM to compute one- and two-step answerability targets. Through two-stage distillation, a student learns to predict these action values from the question, recent visual observations, and a candidate camera motion. At deployment, RFL uses these predicted values to select camera motions without rendering future views. On 377 E3VS-Bench test episodes in unseen environments, RFL improves the mean judge score by 43\% over a direct-action baseline using the same VLM. These results support learning camera-control policies from privileged visual lookahead for viewpoint-dependent question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rendering-Free Lookahead（RFL），一种用于视角依赖视觉问答的主动相机控制策略。它通过学习预测候选相机运动后未来视角的“可回答性”，在部署时无需渲染未来视角即可选择最优相机运动。
AI.motivation: 主动机器人视觉需要控制相机以揭示当前视角下隐藏的任务相关信息。对于视角依赖的问答，关键挑战在于选择能暴露回答问题所需视觉证据的相机运动。虽然 VLM 能理解已观测图像，但选择运动需要预判未观测视角是否有用。
AI.method: 将视角有用性量化为 answerability，即 VLM 对某视角是否足以回答问题的估计。训练时，特权教师使用 3D Gaussian Splatting 渲染候选未来视角，并用冻结 VLM 计算一步和两步 answerability 目标；通过两阶段蒸馏，学生模型根据问题、近期视觉观测和候选相机运动预测动作价值。部署时，RFL 直接使用预测值选择相机运动，无需渲染未来视角。
AI.result: 在未见环境的 377 个 E3VS-Bench 测试片段上，RFL 相比使用同一 VLM 的直接动作基线，平均评判分数提升 43%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，从特权视觉前瞻中学习相机控制策略，可有效提升视角依赖问答任务的表现。

title: A Physics-Informed Collision Learning Framework for Collaborative Robot Motion Generation
summary: Close-proximity multi-arm manipulation requires collision models that are both geometrically accurate and differentiable enough for real-time optimization. Classical geometry checkers provide reliable distances but are difficult to use inside gradient-based model predictive control, while conservative proxy models can restrict tightly coupled motion. We present PI-UDF, a physics-informed unified differentiable framework for body-to-body collision distance prediction between articulated robots. PI-UDF combines analytical forward kinematics with learnable link-geometry embeddings and a shared residual network to predict pairwise inter-arm distances directly from robot configurations. To improve safety-critical fidelity, we combine quota-driven boundary mining with an asymmetric boundary-crossing penalty that emphasizes false-safe sign errors near the collision boundary. The learned distance field is integrated into nonlinear MPC as a differentiable inter-arm clearance term. We validate the framework on a real dual-Franka platform through high-speed close-proximity 14-DoF dual-arm swapping, sustained single-arm dynamic evasion, and dynamic-evasion planning configurations with frozen, predicted, and target-switching treatments of the moving arm. Hardware experiments and offline Drake/FCL replay show that PI-UDF provides a differentiable inter-arm clearance estimate suitable for closed-loop collision-aware collaborative robot motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出PI-UDF，一种物理信息统一可微框架，用于预测多关节机器人身体间碰撞距离，并将其集成到非线性MPC中，实现碰撞感知的双臂协作运动生成。
AI.motivation: 近距离多臂操作需要既几何准确又可微的碰撞模型以支持实时优化；传统几何检查器距离可靠但难以用于梯度MPC，保守代理模型又会限制紧密耦合运动。
AI.method: PI-UDF结合解析正运动学、可学习连杆几何嵌入和共享残差网络，直接从机器人构型预测臂间成对距离；采用配额驱动边界挖掘和非对称边界穿越惩罚减少碰撞边界附近的假安全符号错误；将学习到的距离场作为可微臂间间隙项集成到非线性MPC中。
AI.result: 在真实双Franka平台上验证了高速近距离14-DoF双臂交换、持续单臂动态避让，以及含冻结、预测和目标切换移动臂处理的动态避让规划；硬件实验和离线Drake/FCL回放表明PI-UDF能提供适合闭环碰撞感知协作机器人运动生成的可微臂间间隙估计。
AI.conclusion: PI-UDF可为闭环碰撞感知协作机器人运动生成提供可微且有效的臂间间隙估计，适用于安全关键的近距离多臂操作。

title: OmniDex: Scaling Dexterous Hand Grasping to Diverse Cluttered Scenes
summary: Dexterous grasping is the foundational primitive in embodied AI, demanding massive data to train robust models. As real-world data collection is expensive, simulation has become the mainstream paradigm. Yet, while cluttered scenes best reflect real-world applications, learning to grasp within them is bottlenecked by a critical scarcity of large-scale data. To resolve this, we curate high-quality 3D objects and supporting bases, proposing a scalable seed-and-filter strategy that bypasses sluggish scene-level optimization. This yields an unprecedented benchmark comprising over 2.6 million scenes and 0.4B scene-specific grasp ground truths, featuring diverse realistic layouts paired with rich semantic and geometric observations. Furthermore, we introduce the OmniDex model to overcome the grasp multimodality and last-millimeter precision errors plaguing current generative models. By coupling Soft Winner-Takes-All learning with human-inspired physical constraints during training, and utilizing physics-driven ranking, our approach achieves robust dexterous grasping without the latency of post-optimization. Experimental results show that OmniDex model achieves state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization across diverse scenes, views, and unseen objects.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对杂乱场景中灵巧抓取数据稀缺问题，构建了超260万场景、4亿抓取标注的大规模基准，并提出OmniDex模型，实现SOTA性能与强泛化。
AI.motivation: 灵巧抓取是具身AI的基础能力，但真实数据采集昂贵，仿真成为主流；杂乱场景最贴近现实应用，却因大规模数据稀缺而成为学习瓶颈。
AI.method: 整理高质量3D物体与支撑底座，提出可扩展的seed-and-filter策略以避开缓慢的场景级优化；构建含丰富语义与几何观测的基准；OmniDex结合Soft Winner-Takes-All学习、类人物理约束训练和物理驱动排序。
AI.result: 构建了超过260万场景和0.4B场景特定抓取真值的基准；OmniDex在多样场景、视角和未见物体上达到SOTA，并具备强泛化能力，且无需后优化延迟。
AI.conclusion: 大规模高质量杂乱场景数据与结合物理约束的生成模型，可有效提升灵巧抓取的鲁棒性、精度与泛化能力。

title: Local Prototype Reconstruction for Text-Compatible Speech-to-LLM Bridge Pretraining
summary: Speech-to-LLM systems often connect a frozen speech encoder to a frozen large language model (LLM) through a small trainable bridge. The bridge is usually treated as plumbing, but it in fact defines the geometry of the speech-to-LLM interface, and the pretraining objective decides whether that interface provides a reusable initialization for downstream tasks. We study a transferable bridge through two complementary properties: global alignment with the text side, and local lexical manifold compatibility, where bridge embeddings remain close to the frozen LLM's input-embedding neighbourhoods. We make this property measurable with a fixed, head-free, timestamp-free diagnostic that applies to any objective, and show that next-word prediction (NWP) and sentence-level contrastive pretraining do not fully capture token-level lexical compatibility. We then introduce Local Prototype Reconstruction (LPR), a lightweight training-only regularizer that requires each aligned bridge token to be reconstructable from a small neighbourhood of frozen LLM token embeddings, with a hard single-prototype anchor as its limiting case. On multilingual ASR and speech translation, LPR improves transfer, with the largest gains on translation and low-resource adaptation. Crucially, our independent diagnostic correlates with downstream gains across objectives, suggesting that lexical manifold compatibility is predictive of reusability for speech-to-LLM bridges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语音到LLM系统中桥接模块的可迁移性，提出局部原型重构（LPR）正则化方法，并设计诊断指标证明词汇流形兼容性可预测下游任务的可重用性。
AI.motivation: 桥接模块常被视为管道，但其定义了语音到LLM接口的几何结构，预训练目标决定该接口能否为下游任务提供可重用初始化。现有目标（如下一词预测和句子级对比学习）未充分捕捉词级词汇兼容性。
AI.method: 提出局部原型重构（LPR），一种仅训练时的轻量正则化器，要求每个对齐的桥接标记可由冻结LLM标记嵌入的小邻域重构，并以硬单原型锚作为极限情况。同时设计固定、无头、无时间戳的诊断指标，测量全局对齐和局部词汇流形兼容性。
AI.result: 在多语言ASR和语音翻译任务上，LPR提升了迁移性能，在翻译和低资源适应上增益最大。独立诊断指标与不同目标的下游增益相关，表明词汇流形兼容性可预测桥接的可重用性。
AI.conclusion: 局部词汇流形兼容性是语音到LLM桥接可重用性的有效预测指标，LPR能改善桥接的迁移能力，为桥接预训练目标设计提供了新方向。

title: Can a System-One LLM Perform Knowledge Tracing When Few or No Learners Are Logged?
comment: 41 pages, 7 figures. Code and result summaries: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/jevkt-coldstart
summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) models need many logged learners, so a new course or platform starts without a usable model. In LLM-based KT the LLM generates the answer, which we call System-Two; it is either fine-tuned on the target data or reasons and votes over ten samples, which is slow and gives coarse probabilities. We ask whether an off-the-shelf System-One LLM, which returns a probability for a typed question directly in a single pass, can perform KT when few or no learners are logged. On seven datasets, Jev without any data from the target platform reaches a mean AUC of .706, above the best of 28 deep KT models trained on 8 learners (.689) and above System-Two Thinking-KT on all seven datasets (.650) at about 1/100 of its API cost. Adding examples and a similar-learner statistic from the logged learners (JevKT) raises this to .722; JevKT stays significantly ahead of deep KT up to 16 learners and ahead on average up to 64, and supervised KT catches up between 64 and 128 learners. Among the readers we tested, the gain is specific to Jev, since three other LLMs queried with the byte-identical typed request through the official System-One adapter fall below it on all seven datasets, and reader swaps and contamination checks find no evidence that the input format or memorised data explain the gain. For new learners the advantage holds from their first interactions, whereas on unseen items with all learners logged, deep KT remains ahead.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在冷启动、极少或无学习者日志时，现成System-One LLM能否直接单次输出概率来做知识追踪。提出Jev与JevKT，在七个数据集上优于少样本深度KT和System-Two Thinking-KT，且API成本极低。
AI.motivation: 知识追踪通常依赖大量学习者日志，新课程或新平台初期没有可用模型。现有LLM知识追踪多为System-Two，需要微调或在十个样本上推理投票，速度慢且概率粗糙，因此作者希望验证现成System-One LLM能否在少日志甚至无日志条件下直接完成知识追踪。
AI.method: 将打字题目直接输入现成System-One LLM，单次前向返回正确概率，称为Jev；JevKT在此基础上加入已记录学习者的示例和相似学习者统计。在七个数据集上与28个用8名学习者训练的深度KT模型、System-Two Thinking-KT比较，并进行三个其他LLM的同字节请求对照、reader替换和污染检查，分析冷启动学习者与未见题目表现。
AI.result: Jev不使用目标平台数据即达到平均AUC 0.706，高于8名学习者训练下28个深度KT模型的最佳值0.689，也高于Thinking-KT的0.650，且API成本约为其1/100。JevKT提升到0.722，在不超过16名学习者时显著领先深度KT，平均到64名学习者仍领先，监督KT在64至128名学习者之间追平。其他三个LLM在七个数据集上均低于Jev，reader替换与污染检查未发现输入格式或记忆数据可解释该增益。新学习者从首次交互起即有优势，但在所有学习者已记录且题目未见时，深度KT仍更好。
AI.conclusion: 现成System-One LLM可在少日志或无日志冷启动知识追踪中有效，Jev/JevKT提供了低成本、早期可用的方案。但其优势具有模型特异性，且主要适用于冷启动或新学习者场景，不能替代全量日志下深度KT对未见题目的表现。

title: FAITH: Feasibility-Aware Safety-Filtered RL for High-Dimensional Systems
summary: Safe reinforcement learning commonly places safety and task performance in the same policy objective, where they can introduce competing updates. Safety filters separate them at action execution, but classical designs require an analytic safety function and dynamics model, and standard minimal-intervention filters are myopic to long-horizon task return because they minimize only instantaneous action deviation. Hard projections are also undefined when no safe action exists. We present FAITH, a feasibility-aware, model-free framework that approximates the optimal state-action safety value and amortizes minimal-intervention filtering with a feedforward network. The task policy optimizes the task return through the filtered dynamics, which recovers the feasible constrained problem without a competing safety term in the task-policy update. When no action satisfies the learned safety condition, the same filter approaches the action with minimum predicted peak harm. On a double integrator example and a Safety Gym environment, FAITH achieves the highest return among methods with no feasible-start violations and matches the lowest harm from infeasible starts. On a 29-DoF humanoid, it reaches a 99.95% safety rate while retaining 97% of the unfiltered return in Walking-Avoid, and obtains the highest measured safety rate in Push-Avoid by learning to sacrifice balancing and fall away from the protected region. The same policies are also demonstrated on a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FAITH，一种可行性感知、无模型的强化学习安全框架，通过学习状态-动作安全值并用前馈网络摊销最小干预安全过滤，在避免安全项干扰任务策略更新的同时，处理无安全动作可用的极端情况。
AI.motivation: 现有安全强化学习常将安全与任务性能放入同一策略目标，导致更新冲突；传统安全过滤器需要解析安全函数和动力学模型，且最小干预过滤器只关注瞬时动作偏差，对长期回报短视；当不存在安全动作时，硬投影方法也无法定义。
AI.method: FAITH 近似最优状态-动作安全值，并用前馈网络摊销最小干预过滤。任务策略在过滤后的动力学上优化任务回报，从而恢复可行约束问题，且任务策略更新中不含竞争性安全项。当没有动作满足学习到的安全条件时，同一过滤器选择预测峰值伤害最小的动作。
AI.result: 在双积分器和 Safety Gym 环境中，FAITH 在无不安全起始违规的方法中取得最高回报，并在不安全起始下匹配最低伤害。在 29 自由度人形机器人上，Walking-Avoid 达到 99.95% 安全率并保留 97% 未过滤回报；Push-Avoid 中通过牺牲平衡并远离保护区域跌倒，取得最高实测安全率。相同策略也在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上展示。
AI.conclusion: FAITH 是一种有效的无模型安全强化学习框架，能够在保持任务性能的同时实现高安全率，并具备处理不可行状态和真实人形机器人部署的能力。

title: SatFix: Absolute Visual Localization of UAVs in Satellite Maps from a Single Oblique Image
summary: We study absolute metric UAV localization within a provided geo-referenced satellite region, recovering continuous map position and viewing heading from a single oblique image or a short multi-view clip. Existing cross-view geo-localization methods retrieve the most similar satellite tile from a gallery and report Recall@K, but retrieval depends on gallery sampling, provides no heading estimate, and returns a tile index rather than a continuous coordinate. We propose SatFix, a feed-forward UAV--satellite localization framework built on VGGT-$Ω$. Satellite-grid features act as queries that aggregate UAV visual evidence, and two lightweight heads regress a 3-DoF pose in the satellite-map frame: continuous 2D position and heading. SatFix requires no explicit 3D map, rendered bird's-eye image, auxiliary sensor, or test-time pose alignment. A single model supports both single- and multi-view inputs, with trajectory constraints used during multi-view training. For metric evaluation, we introduce University-Metric, where satellite imagery is re-collected over a region up to 10.7$\times$ longer on a side (about 114$\times$ the ground area) than the original University-1652 tiles, with continuous position and heading labels for the original UAV tours. With one UAV view, SatFix localizes 52.08% of test frames within 50 m and 17.34% within 10 m, with median position and heading errors of 45.66 m and $20.81^\circ$, respectively. Inference takes under 0.1 s per single-view query on an NVIDIA RTX 4090. With nine UAV views, the median position error falls to 21.96 m and the median heading error to $8.73^\circ$. Compared with a fine-tuned VGGT-$Ω$ baseline, SatFix reduces median position error by 34.0% and nine-view median heading error from $25.43^\circ$ to $8.73^\circ$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SatFix，一个基于 VGGT-Ω 的前馈式无人机—卫星绝对度量定位框架，可从单张斜视图像或短多视角片段回归卫星地图坐标系下的连续二维位置与航向，并引入 University-Metric 基准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法多从卫星图库中检索最相似瓦片并报告 Recall@K，但依赖图库采样、无法估计航向，且只返回瓦片索引而非连续坐标，难以满足无人机绝对度量定位需求。
AI.method: SatFix 以卫星网格特征作为查询，聚合无人机视觉证据，并用两个轻量头回归卫星地图坐标系下的 3-DoF 位姿，即连续二维位置和航向。它无需显式 3D 地图、渲染鸟瞰图、辅助传感器或测试时位姿对齐；单一模型支持单视角和多视角输入，多视角训练中使用轨迹约束。同时提出 University-Metric 基准，覆盖更大卫星区域，并为原始无人机轨迹提供连续位置和航向标签。
AI.result: 单视角下，SatFix 在 50 m 内定位 52.08% 的测试帧，在 10 m 内定位 17.34%，位置和航向中位误差分别为 45.66 m 和 20.81 度；在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上单视角推理低于 0.1 秒。使用九个无人机视角时，位置中位误差降至 21.96 m，航向中位误差降至 8.73 度。相比微调后的 VGGT-Ω 基线，SatFix 将位置中位误差降低 34.0%，并将九视角航向中位误差从 25.43 度降至 8.73 度。
AI.conclusion: SatFix 能实现连续、实时的无人机绝对度量定位，多视角输入显著提升精度，并在所提出的 University-Metric 基准上优于 VGGT-Ω 微调基线。

title: Demonstrating Arena 5.0: A Photorealistic ROS2 Simulation Framework for Developing and Benchmarking Social Navigation
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures. Published at Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2025
summary: Building upon the foundations laid by our previous work, this paper introduces Arena 5.0, the fifth iteration of our framework for robotics social navigation development and benchmarking. Arena 5.0 provides three main contributions: 1) The complete integration of NVIDIA Isaac Gym, enabling photorealistic simulations and more efficient training. It seamlessly incorporates Isaac Gym into the Arena platform, allowing the use of existing modules such as randomized environment generation, evaluation tools, ROS2 support, and the integration of planners, robot models, and APIs within Isaac Gym. 2) A comprehensive benchmark of state-of-the-art social navigation strategies, evaluated on a diverse set of generated and customized worlds and scenarios of varying difficulty levels. These benchmarks provide a detailed assessment of navigation planners using a wide range of social navigation metrics. 3) Extensive scenario generation and task planning modules for improved and customizable generation of social navigation scenarios, such as emergency and rescue situations. The platform's performance was evaluated by generating the aforementioned benchmark and through a comprehensive user study, demonstrating significant improvements in usability and efficiency compared to previous versions. Arena 5.0 is open source and available at https://github.com/Arena-Rosnav.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍机器人社会导航开发与基准测试框架 Arena 5.0，主要贡献包括集成 NVIDIA Isaac Gym、综合基准测试先进社会导航策略，以及可定制的场景生成与任务规划模块。
AI.motivation: 在前期工作基础上，为进一步提升机器人社会导航开发与基准测试的真实感、训练效率、可定制性和可用性。
AI.method: 提出 Arena 5.0 框架，集成 Isaac Gym 并兼容原有模块（随机环境生成、评估工具、ROS2、规划器、机器人模型和 API）；对多种先进社会导航策略在生成和定制场景中进行综合基准测试；开发场景生成与任务规划模块；通过基准测试和用户研究评估平台性能。
AI.result: 实现了逼真仿真和更高效训练，提供了覆盖不同难度场景的社会导航指标评估，并在用户研究中显示出相比前版本在可用性和效率上的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: Arena 5.0 是一个开源的社会导航开发与基准测试平台，能够有效支持社会导航策略的评估、场景定制和任务规划。

title: Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury
summary: Non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) is prevalent among adolescents with depression, but the rapid brain-state dynamics linking social distress to maladaptive behavior remain unclear. We combine an experimental pain paradigm, electroencephalography (EEG) microstate analysis, and interpretable deep sequence modeling to investigate NSSI-related neurodynamics in 106 adolescents with depression, including 67 with NSSI (DN+) and 39 without NSSI (DN-), during social pain, physical pain, and resting-state conditions. A model integrating disease-specific, domain-adversarial, consistency, and contrastive learning captures higher-order dependencies in microstate sequences. Social pain yields the strongest NSSI discrimination, with 68.55% accuracy, outperforming the best baseline by 8.94% points. Model interpretation and conventional microstate analyses reveal weakened bidirectional transitions between MS3 and MS5 in DN+ adolescents during social pain. Source reconstruction associates MS3 with emotional/interoceptive processing and MS5 with action preparation, suggesting disrupted emotion-action coupling. Time-resolved analyses show greater early-to-middle action-state recruitment and later emotion-state recruitment in DN+ adolescents. In DN- adolescents, MS5-to-MS3 dynamics mediate associations between social-evaluation sensitivity and affective outcomes, whereas this mediation is absent in DN+; conversely, MS3-to-MS5 transitions are associated with greater negative affect in DN+. Together, these findings identify disrupted emotion-action coupling as a key neurodynamic mechanism underlying altered social pain processing in adolescents with NSSI, providing a mechanistically interpretable neural signature for objective identification of NSSI.

AI.tldr: 研究结合疼痛实验、EEG微状态分析和可解释深度序列建模，探讨伴抑郁青少年非自杀性自伤（NSSI）的社会疼痛相关脑动态，发现MS3-MS5情绪-动作耦合异常可作为NSSI的神经标志。
AI.motivation: NSSI在抑郁青少年中常见，但社会痛苦如何通过快速脑状态动态导致适应不良行为，其机制仍不清楚。
AI.method: 纳入106名抑郁青少年，其中67名伴NSSI（DN+）、39名不伴NSSI（DN-），在社会疼痛、生理疼痛和静息态下采集EEG并进行微状态分析；使用整合疾病特异、域对抗、一致性和对比学习的深度序列模型捕捉微状态序列高阶依赖，并结合源重建、时间分辨分析和中介分析。
AI.result: 社会疼痛对NSSI区分效果最强，准确率68.55%，比最佳基线高8.94个百分点。DN+青少年在社会疼痛中MS3与MS5双向转换减弱；MS3关联情绪/内感受加工，MS5关联动作准备，提示情绪-动作耦合受损。DN+早期至中期动作状态招募更多、后期情绪状态招募更多。DN-中MS5→MS3动态中介社会评价敏感性与情感结局，而DN+中该中介缺失；DN+中MS3→MS5转换与更高负性情感相关。
AI.conclusion: 破坏的情绪-动作耦合是NSSI青少年社会疼痛加工改变的关键神经动态机制，为客观识别NSSI提供了具有机制解释性的神经标志。

title: Learning What to Trust in Multimodal Learning under Noisy Supervision
summary: Multimodal classification processes and relates information from multiple modalities to achieve more accurate predictions. However, existing methods typically rely on high-quality ground-truth labels, which are difficult to obtain in real-world scenarios. While sample-selection methods for learning with noisy labels aim to identify correctly labeled examples from noisy data, traditional methods primarily focus on unimodal settings and fail to exploit multimodal information fully. This motivates us to build a more reliable noise detector in multimodal learning. To this end, we theoretically analyze the relationship between representation structure and noise detection capability. Based on this analysis, we propose REFINE, which is a multimodal label-noise detection framework that jointly uses fused and unimodal representations for label-noise detection. Specifically, REFINE constructs discriminative eigenvectors through discriminative analysis of the target and background classes and selects trusted representation spaces with better noise detection capability for each class. Within each trusted space, REFINE measures the alignment between each instance representation and the discriminative eigenvectors. It then combines the subsets selected from these spaces. The combined set provides cleaner supervision for updating the multimodal classifier, thereby reducing the influence of mislabeled examples during training and improving model generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate REFINE's superiority compared to baseline methods. The source code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 REFINE，一个多模态标签噪声检测框架，联合融合表示与单模态表示来检测噪声标签，从而为多模态分类器提供更干净的监督并提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常依赖高质量真实标签，而传统噪声标签样本选择方法主要面向单模态场景，未能充分利用多模态信息，因此需要构建更可靠的多模态噪声检测器。
AI.method: 作者首先从理论上分析表示结构与噪声检测能力之间的关系。基于此提出 REFINE：通过目标类与背景类的判别分析构造判别特征向量，为每个类选择噪声检测能力更优的可信表示空间；在每个可信空间内度量实例表示与判别特征向量的对齐度，并合并各空间选出的子集，用于更新多模态分类器。
AI.result: 在多种任务上的大量实验表明，REFINE 相比基线方法具有更优性能。
AI.conclusion: REFINE 通过联合融合与单模态表示进行标签噪声检测，减少错误标签在训练中的影响，提高模型泛化能力；源代码将公开。

title: How Firm Should a Grasp Be?
summary: An ideal robot grasp is firm enough to securely handle an object, yet gentle enough to avoid damaging it. Achieving this balance requires knowledge of the object's material properties, such as its mass, elasticity, and surface friction. These properties, however, are seldom precisely known a priori. In this work, we propose a visuotactile approach to estimating material properties in real time, during the process of grasping. Our method uses these estimated properties to determine the minimum grasp force required to handle the object. We contribute a new dataset of real-world objects (fruits and vegetables) with measured physical properties (shape, mass, elasticity, and friction), which we use to construct our force estimation model via simulations. We experimentally validate our approach to grasp force control using a robot with a parallel-jaw gripper. We demonstrate our system's ability to gently grasp a wide variety of objects, in each case adapting to their unique physical properties.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在抓取过程中实时估计物体材料属性（如质量、弹性、表面摩擦）的视触觉方法，并据此确定最小抓取力，实现稳定且不损伤物体的抓取。
AI.motivation: 理想抓取需要既牢固又不损伤物体，但这依赖于物体的质量、弹性和表面摩擦等材料属性，而这些属性通常无法预先精确获知。
AI.method: 使用视触觉方法在抓取过程中实时估计材料属性；构建包含水果和蔬菜等真实物体及其形状、质量、弹性和摩擦测量值的新数据集；通过仿真构建抓取力估计模型；在配备平行夹爪的机器人上实验验证抓取力控制。
AI.result: 系统能够根据物体的独特物理属性自适应调整抓取力，成功轻柔抓取多种物体，验证了实时估计材料属性并控制最小抓取力的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 视触觉实时估计材料属性可用于确定最小抓取力，使机器人能够稳定且无损地抓取不同物体。

title: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Following retrieved evidence does not guarantee factual correctness: misleading evidence can induce a model to replace an answer it previously gave correctly. Standard accuracy measures obscure this behavior by combining answer replacement with preexisting errors. We introduce RAG-Stress, a controlled diagnostic protocol for examining the limits of evidence reliance in retrieval-augmented generation. The protocol holds the question and reference answer fixed, edits one assertion to support a designated incorrect answer, and crosses two source priority policies with three positions of the answer span within the evidence text. We measure misleading rate (MR) on each model's subset of questions answered correctly without retrieval, alongside clean accuracy on the full evaluation set. We evaluate fifteen systems spanning API models, open models, and search agents trained with reinforcement learning on TriviaQA-RC, HotpotQA, and SearchQA, with additional English and Chinese MedQA evaluations. Instructions that prioritize documents consistently produce higher MR than those permitting reliance on prior knowledge. Averaged over models and positions, the gap ranges from 10.9 to 13.5 percentage points across the three QA datasets. Mean MR follows End $>$ Beginning $>$ Middle under both policies, although individual models do not uniformly follow this ordering. A separate paired audit of 500 questions and two checkpoints supports increased harmful override without establishing a corresponding improvement in beneficial correction. These findings distinguish evidence adherence from factual reliability and motivate evaluating whether retrieved evidence preserves, replaces, or corrects a model's answers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RAG-Stress，一个受控诊断协议，用于检验检索增强生成中模型对检索证据的依赖极限，并区分证据遵循与事实可靠性。
AI.motivation: 标准准确率会掩盖模型因误导性证据而替换原本正确答案的行为，因此需要专门衡量检索证据是否会导致有害覆盖。
AI.method: 固定问题与参考答案，编辑证据中的某个断言以支持指定错误答案，并交叉两种来源优先级策略与答案片段在证据文本中的三种位置；在 TriviaQA-RC、HotpotQA、SearchQA 及中英文 MedQA 上评估 15 个系统，包括 API 模型、开源模型和强化学习搜索代理，测量误导率（MR）与干净准确率。
AI.result: 优先使用文档的指令比允许依赖先验知识产生更高 MR，三个 QA 数据集上平均差距为 10.9 至 13.5 个百分点。平均 MR 在两种策略下均呈 End > Beginning > Middle，但单个模型并不总遵循该顺序。对 500 个问题和两个检查点的配对审计显示有害覆盖增加，但未证明有益纠正相应提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果区分了证据遵循与事实可靠性，并主张评估检索证据是保留、替换还是纠正模型答案。

title: Refine Connections, Close the Gap: A Reliable Enhancement Framework for Driving Scene Topology
summary: In autonomous driving, understanding scene topology - the connectivity between lanes and traffic elements - is critical for safe path planning and motion control. While current methods excel at detecting individual map elements, their connectivity reasoning often falls short of its theoretical potential, leaving a significant performance gap relative to the theoretical upper-bound achievable given the underlying detections. Furthermore, the decision-ready topology graphs passed to downstream tasks often remain unreliable. Current approaches typically derive connectivity by thresholding continuous topology scores; however, these scores often fail to reflect the true logical likelihood of connectivity, resulting in false positives or missing connections. Existing benchmarks further overlook this issue by primarily evaluating continuous metrics, rather than assessing the discrete connectivity required for decision-making. To bridge these gaps, we propose TopoEnhance, a novel topology enhancement framework designed to unlock the latent potential of existing methods and improve the reliability of decision-ready topology. We formulate topology enhancement as a denoising-based reconstruction process, where the model learns to recover structural consistency from stochastically corrupted ground-truth graphs. This formulation enables the model to resolve logical inconsistencies and rectify unreliable connections, producing robust discrete topology graphs that closely approach theoretical maximum performance. Extensive experiments across different baselines show that TopoEnhance consistently improves both continuous topology metrics (TOP score), and discrete connectivity measured by our adapted Topology Jaccard Similarity (TJS) metric. As a flexible, source-agnostic framework, TopoEnhance delivers substantial gains across diverse state-of-the-art baselines without requiring retraining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TopoEnhance，一个用于自动驾驶场景拓扑增强的框架，通过去噪式重建来提升现有方法生成的可决策拓扑图的可靠性与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽能较好检测单个地图元素，但连通性推理不足，与理论上限存在明显差距；同时，基于连续拓扑分数阈值化得到的连通性常出现误连或漏连，且现有基准多评估连续指标而忽视决策所需的离散连通性。
AI.method: 将拓扑增强建模为基于去噪的重建过程：模型从随机破坏的真实拓扑图中学习恢复结构一致性，从而纠正逻辑不一致和不可靠连接，生成稳健的离散拓扑图。
AI.result: 在不同基线上，TopoEnhance 持续提升连续拓扑指标 TOP score，以及适配的离散连通性指标 Topology Jaccard Similarity (TJS)。
AI.conclusion: TopoEnhance 是一个灵活、与来源无关的框架，无需重新训练即可在多种先进基线上带来显著性能提升，并接近理论最大性能。

title: What to Admit and How to Present: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents
summary: Persistent memory can improve personalization in LLM agents but can also induce sycophancy and cross-domain leakage. We distinguish two governance decisions: admission, which determines what recalled information enters the working context, and presentation, which determines how admitted information is expressed. We implement two inference-time designs without retraining: factor-compiled admission (FC), which assesses whole memory entries, and permission-semantic admission (PS), which decomposes entries into typed units; both translate adjudicated attributes into eligibility decisions via deterministic policies. We evaluate on a four-backbone development suite and an external benchmark with four tasks of 300 samples each. Relative to verbatim injection, FC and PS reduce pooled judge-assessed failure rates on the external benchmark by 6.7 and 8.8 percentage points (p = 2.7e-7 and 4.1e-12), and development-set cross-domain leakage falls by up to 29.5 percentage points. A query-conditioned gating baseline shows no significant change in objective-fact failure or pooled failure. Under matched admission budgets, PS outperforms random and relevance-based selection on external objective-fact judgment after Holm correction. Holding presentation fixed, tightening admission cuts cross-domain failure by a further 17.5 percentage points (p = 1.6e-4); in contrast, no comparison between two renderings of identical adjudicated outputs survives multiple-comparison correction. Both designs increase personalization failures, and PS misses the preregistered improvement and personalization-preservation criteria. These results support evaluating admission and presentation separately: selection quality provides task-specific safety gains, while preserving beneficial memory use remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体持久记忆的治理问题，区分“准入”和“呈现”两类决策，并评估两种无需重训练的推理时方案FC与PS对安全性、个性化及跨域泄漏的影响。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆能提升LLM智能体的个性化，但也可能引发迎合与跨域信息泄漏，因此需要明确如何治理记忆信息进入工作上下文以及如何表达已准入信息。
AI.method: 提出两种推理时设计：因子编译准入（FC）评估完整记忆条目；权限语义准入（PS）将条目分解为带类型单元，并通过确定性策略把裁定属性转化为资格决策。在四个骨干模型开发集和外部基准上评估，外部基准含四个任务、每任务300样本，并与逐字注入、查询条件门控及随机/相关性选择等基线比较。
AI.result: 相比逐字注入，FC和PS将外部基准上评审判定的汇总失败率分别降低6.7和8.8个百分点（p=2.7e-7、4.1e-12），开发集跨域泄漏最多下降29.5个百分点。查询条件门控基线在客观事实失败或汇总失败上无显著变化。在匹配准入预算下，PS在Holm校正后在外部客观事实判定上优于随机和相关性选择。固定呈现时，收紧准入使跨域失败再降17.5个百分点（p=1.6e-4）；但相同裁定输出的两种呈现方式比较均未通过多重比较校正。两种设计都增加个性化失败，且PS未达到预注册的改进与个性化保持标准。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将准入与呈现分开评估：选择质量可带来任务特定的安全收益，但如何在利用记忆收益的同时保持有益记忆使用仍未解决。

title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
summary: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.

AI.tldr: LadderEdit 通过压缩每个 LoRA 适配器来解决 LLM 终身编辑中的存储增长问题，在保持编辑效果的同时显著减少内存占用。
AI.motivation: 终身编辑 LLM 需要存储数千个编辑，而现有方法为每个编辑附加一个 LoRA 适配器，导致存储线性增长，亟需压缩存储。
AI.method: 提出 LadderEdit，在获取每个 LoRA 适配器后压缩它：先以低秩草图存储编辑，检查是否满足重写、泛化和局部性契约；通过的保留草图，失败的沿阶梯提升秩直到满足契约。
AI.result: 在 ZsRE、CounterFact、WikiBigEdit 基准上，使用 LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B 模型，LadderEdit 以 5.2 倍更少内存达到与精确 LoRA 存储相当的效果，并在 50,000 次连续编辑后仍有效。
AI.conclusion: LadderEdit 通过自适应秩分配有效压缩存储，维持编辑覆盖，为终身编辑提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: SimVLA: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Learning for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Large-scale, diverse datasets have driven the success of LLMs and VLMs. But VLAs for robotics remain limited by the cost and complexity of real-world data collection. While simulation offers a scalable alternative, its potential for sim-to-real VLA learning in mobile manipulation remains largely underexplored. We introduce SimVLA, an end-to-end framework that trains VLAs entirely on synthetic simulation data without teleoperation for mobile manipulation. SimVLA is first pre-trained on two complementary simulation-derived datasets: SimAction, a large-scale robot action dataset spanning 35 diverse mobile manipulation tasks, generated by composing atomic skills, and SimVQA, which leverages privileged simulator state to provide spatial, geometric, and subtask-level visual-language supervision. We further post-train SimVLA on a mixture of SimAction and SimDeploy, a dataset collected from policy rollouts across diverse simulated environments. We evaluate SimVLA on tasks including restocking, pouring, and cleaning, and show zero-shot transfer to real-world mobile manipulation, including real home environments. SimVLA outperforms policies trained on 50 in-domain real-world demonstrations, suggesting that simulation can enable scalable sim-to-real mobile manipulation. We further demonstrate the value of multiple complementary forms of supervision for effectively leveraging simulation in VLA training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SimVLA，一个完全基于合成仿真数据、无需遥操作的端到端 mobile manipulation VLA 训练框架，并实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。
AI.motivation: 真实世界数据采集成本高、复杂度大，限制了机器人 VLA 的发展；仿真虽可扩展，但在移动操作中的 sim-to-real VLA 学习潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: SimVLA 先在两个互补仿真数据集上预训练：SimAction 覆盖 35 个移动操作任务，由原子技能组合生成；SimVQA 利用仿真器特权状态提供空间、几何和子任务级视觉语言监督。随后在 SimAction 与 SimDeploy 的混合数据上后训练，SimDeploy 来自多样仿真环境中的策略 rollout。
AI.result: 在补货、倒液和清洁等任务上评估，SimVLA 能零样本迁移到真实世界移动操作，包括真实家庭环境，并优于使用 50 个域内真实世界演示训练的策略。
AI.conclusion: 仿真可以支持可扩展的 sim-to-real 移动操作，多种互补监督形式对有效利用仿真进行 VLA 训练具有重要价值。

title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
summary: Personalized conversational AI relies on long-term memory systems that extract facts from user utterances and store them in persistent vector stores. Despite progress in retrieval, deduplication, and lifecycle management, the formation stage, the moment a fact is first written to storage has received almost no principled attention. We identify this as the binding constraint on memory quality in production systems. Critical contextual signals, such as the distinction between a permanent user attribute and a transient situation, exist only in the original utterance and are irreversibly lost the moment extraction produces a subject-relation-object triple. No downstream process can recover them. We propose Gated Memory, a lightweight, modular formation framework that interposes two decision checkpoints between conversation and storage: an admission gate that evaluates every candidate fact against the full utterance context before extraction runs, and a conditional enrichment stage that grounds admitted facts through an entity scope taxonomy with privacy constraints. The gate evaluates only the current exchange while using prior turns as read-only reference context, and produces a structured formation record. Admitted content is decomposed into atomic facts, each categorized, tagged with provenance (directly stated versus inferred), scoped to its condition of applicability, and grounded in resolved time and place, subject to a constraint that no entity absent from the context may be asserted. On the LoCoMo-10 benchmark with atypical emotional density in utterance data, Gated Memory achieves an overall +2.6% relative improvement in LLM-judge accuracy over a strong baseline with identical retrieval and generation, establishing formation quality as a measurable constraint on memory performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Gated Memory，一个轻量模块化的长期记忆形成框架，通过在对话与存储之间加入准入控制和条件化丰富，提升个性化对话 AI 的记忆质量。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆系统多关注检索、去重和生命周期管理，但事实首次写入存储的“形成阶段”缺乏原则性研究。用户话语中的永久属性与临时情境等关键上下文信号，在抽取为主-谓-宾三元组后会不可逆丢失，成为生产系统记忆质量的瓶颈。
AI.method: Gated Memory 在两个环节设置决策检查点：一是准入门，在抽取前结合完整话语上下文评估候选事实；二是条件化丰富阶段，通过实体范围分类法和隐私约束对已准入事实进行落地。系统仅评估当前交换，并将历史轮次作为只读参考上下文，生成结构化形成记录。已准入内容被分解为原子事实，并进行分类、标注来源（直接陈述或推断）、限定适用条件，以及基于已解析时间和地点进行 grounding，同时禁止断言上下文中不存在的实体。
AI.result: 在具有较高情感密度的 LoCoMo-10 基准上，在检索和生成组件完全相同的条件下，Gated Memory 相比强基线在 LLM 评判准确率上取得 +2.6% 的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 形成阶段的质量是可测量地影响记忆系统性能的关键约束，而 Gated Memory 表明通过原则性的形成控制可以提升个性化对话记忆表现。

title: AliO: Output Alignment Matters in Long-Term Time Series Forecasing
summary: Long-term Time Series Forecasting (LTSF) tasks, which leverage the current data sequence as input to predict the future sequence, have become increasingly crucial in real-world applications such as weather forecasting and planning of electricity consumption. However, state-of-the-art LTSF models often fail to achieve prediction output alignment for the same timestamps across lagged input sequences. Instead, these models exhibit low output alignment, resulting in fluctuation in prediction outputs for the same timestamps, undermining the model's reliability. To address this, we propose AliO (Align Outputs), a novel approach designed to improve the output alignment of LTSF models by reducing the discrepancies between prediction outputs for the same timestamps in both the time and frequency domains. To measure output alignment, we introduce a new metric, TAM (Time Alignment Metric), which quantifies the alignment between prediction outputs, whereas existing metrics such as MSE only capture the distance between prediction outputs and ground truths. Experimental results show that AliO effectively improves the output alignment, i.e., up to 58.2% in TAM, while maintaining or enhancing the forecasting performance (up to 27.5%). This improved output alignment increases the reliability of the LTSF models, making them more applicable in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对长期时间序列预测（LTSF）中同一时间戳在不同滞后输入下预测输出不一致的问题，提出 AliO 方法，通过减少时域和频域上的预测差异来提升输出对齐性，并引入新指标 TAM 进行衡量。
AI.motivation: LTSF 在天气预测、电力规划等实际应用中很重要，但现有先进模型对同一时间戳的预测输出常因输入序列滞后而波动，输出对齐性低，影响模型可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 AliO（Align Outputs）方法，在时域和频域中减少同一时间戳预测输出之间的差异，以提升 LTSF 模型的输出对齐性；同时引入 TAM（Time Alignment Metric）指标，用于量化预测输出之间的对齐程度。
AI.result: 实验表明，AliO 能有效提升输出对齐性，TAM 最高提升 58.2%，同时保持或提升预测性能，最高提升 27.5%。
AI.conclusion: AliO 通过改善输出对齐性增强了 LTSF 模型的可靠性，使其更适合实际应用场景。

title: AffordDrive3D: Affordance-Aware World-Action Modeling with Spatial Understanding
summary: World-action models have recently improved autonomous driving by jointly learning future scene prediction and trajectory generation. Most existing approaches model the future primarily through RGB appearance, and recent works have begun to incorporate geometric prediction to improve spatial understanding. However, dense geometry describes the spatial layout of the entire scene without indicating which parts are most relevant to the ego vehicle's action. For driving, the model must also identify and anticipate where it can safely move and which regions may pose collision risks. Jointly modeling action-relevant regions and future geometry can provide the policy with both driving-relevant cues and their corresponding spatial structure. We therefore propose AffordDrive3D, an affordance- and geometry-aware world-action model that jointly learns future action-relevant regions and spatial structure. In order to capture the scene semantics and driving context needed for driving affordance prediction, we build AffordDrive3D on a VLM backbone to forecast drivable areas and collision-critical regions that directly affect ego motion, while predicting future geometry from RGB world-model latents. On NAVSIM, AffordDrive3D achieves state-of-the-art performance with 91.3 PDMS and 89.9 EPDMS, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling future affordances and geometry for trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: AffordDrive3D：一个基于VLM的、结合可行驶区域与几何感知的世界-动作模型，用于自动驾驶轨迹规划，在NAVSIM上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型多依赖RGB外观，近期引入几何预测，但密集几何未指出与自车动作最相关的区域。驾驶需识别安全可行驶区域和碰撞风险区域，因此需联合建模动作相关区域与未来几何。
AI.method: 提出AffordDrive3D，基于VLM骨干预测可行驶区域和碰撞关键区域（驾驶可供性），同时从RGB世界模型隐变量预测未来几何，联合学习未来动作相关区域与空间结构。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM上取得SOTA性能，达到91.3 PDMS和89.9 EPDMS。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模未来可供性和几何对轨迹规划有效。

title: SafeInferCom: Safe Inference-Time Compute via Verifier-Guided Mid-Generation Intervention for Robotic Task Planning
summary: Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) enable multi-step reasoning for robotic task planning, but continued reasoning can overwrite valid intermediate plans or leave constraint violations unresolved, reducing planning reliability and wasting inference-time computation. We develop an inference-time monitor that exposes and verifies intermediate plans without disrupting the original decoding trajectory. Building on this monitor, we propose SafeInferCom, a formal verifier-guided framework that preserves valid intermediate plans and directs error correction during generation. Experiments across multiple LRLMs and planning domains reveal reasoning-response inconsistency and limited self-correction under one-shot inference. SafeInferCom improves planning success and accelerates error correction relative to one-shot inference. When combined with iterative refinement, it further improves success while reducing token usage compared with refinement alone. We additionally evaluate SafeInferCom in VirtualHome and provide a real-world robotic-arm demonstration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种推理时监控器及形式验证器引导框架 SafeInferCom，用于大型推理语言模型的机器人任务规划，可在不干扰原始解码轨迹的情况下暴露并验证中间计划，保留有效中间计划并指导纠错，从而提升规划可靠性与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 大型推理语言模型虽支持机器人任务规划中的多步推理，但持续推理可能覆盖有效中间计划，或遗留未解决的约束违反问题，导致规划可靠性下降并浪费推理时计算。
AI.method: 开发推理时监控器，在不干扰原始解码轨迹的前提下暴露并验证中间计划；基于该监控器提出 SafeInferCom 框架，利用形式验证器引导生成过程，保留有效中间计划并定向进行错误纠正。
AI.result: 实验覆盖多个大型推理语言模型和规划领域，发现一次性推理存在推理—响应不一致及自纠正能力有限的问题。SafeInferCom 相比一次性推理提高了规划成功率并加速纠错；与迭代细化结合时，进一步提高成功率并减少 token 使用；还在 VirtualHome 和真实机械臂演示中进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: SafeInferCom 通过推理时监控与形式验证引导纠错，能够提升大型推理语言模型在机器人任务规划中的可靠性和效率，并与迭代细化方法互补。

title: When Lower Reconstruction Loss Hurts: Distributionally Robust Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) relies heavily on reconstruction loss minimization to preserve model quality at low precision. We show that the weights favored by minimizing this loss need not yield better model performance on new tasks. In fact, we find that lower reconstruction loss can even degrade model performance on the same calibration data. Our analysis further shows that weights with lower reconstruction loss on calibration data can have higher loss than other weights when the distribution of input activations changes. Motivated by these observations and our analysis, we propose Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ), a post-hoc refinement process that minimizes worst-case reconstruction loss over a constrained set of input activation distributions. DRQ refines the integer codes representing quantized weights within the existing quantization grid, keeping quantization parameters and inference operators unchanged. Extensive experiments show that DRQ improves models quantized by six representative PTQ methods, including AWQ, GPTQ, and ParoQuant, and delivers gains across both dense and mixture-of-experts large language models. These results establish DRQ as a general post-hoc refinement framework for weight-only PTQ, achieving better downstream performance without adding inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅最小化重构损失的权重量化未必提升下游任务性能，甚至可能在激活分布变化时退化；提出分布鲁棒量化DRQ，通过在最坏情况输入激活分布上精化量化整数码，在不改变推理算子的前提下提升下游表现。
AI.motivation: 权重仅训练后量化高度依赖重构损失最小化，但作者发现更低重构损失不一定带来更好任务性能，甚至在同一校准数据上也会退化；低重构损失权重在输入激活分布变化时可能具有更高损失，因此需要更鲁棒的后处理精化方法。
AI.method: 提出Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ)，一种后处理精化过程，在受限的输入激活分布集合上最小化最坏情况重构损失；DRQ仅在已有量化网格内精化表示量化权重的整数码，保持量化参数和推理算子不变。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DRQ能改进六种代表性PTQ方法量化的模型，包括AWQ、GPTQ和ParoQuant，并在稠密和混合专家大语言模型上均取得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: DRQ可作为权重仅PTQ的通用后处理精化框架，在不增加推理开销的情况下实现更好的下游性能。

title: Diffusion Meta-Prompting and Steering for Generalizable Foundation Model Adaptation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://deepaksridhar.github.io/dmp.github.io/. Code: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
summary: Prompt learning is a popular method for adapting foundation models, but learned prompts are typically task-specific and fail to generalize to new classes, domains, or compositions of tasks. In this paper, we introduce a Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP) model , a framework that models the distribution of learned prompts using diffusion models. Given a repository of previously learned prompts, DMP is trained and sampled without access to the original task examples or task losses, and synthesizes new prompts conditioned on natural language task descriptions. To improve the sampling stability, we introduce a test-time steering strategy for DMP, which uses the best training-selected prompt in the repository as a latent anchor during diffusion sampling, without retraining the DMP or accessing test classes. DMP improves generalization across classification, retrieval and text-to-image generation tasks, supports concept composition and negative prompting without explicit training. It reduces storage and inference costs by over 90% compared to prompt retrieval methods. For composite classification, DMP achieves upto 2.0% average gain over prior meta-learning methods across 55 pairs of datasets with gains as high as 8.5% on specific pairs such as Eurosat and Flowers. DMP also enhances cross-task generalization with ~2-9% improvement for hierarchical classification task. We further provide a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected task loss of prompts sampled from a DMP. Code is available: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp

AI.tldr: 本文提出扩散元提示（DMP）模型，将已学习的提示视为数据分布并用扩散模型建模，从而在无需原始任务样本或任务损失的情况下，根据自然语言任务描述合成新提示，并提升跨任务、跨类别和组合任务的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有提示学习通常针对特定任务，学习到的提示难以泛化到新类别、新领域或任务组合，且提示检索方法存储和推理成本较高。
AI.method: 提出DMP框架，利用扩散模型建模已学习提示的分布；训练和采样不依赖原始任务示例或任务损失，仅以自然语言任务描述为条件生成新提示。引入测试时引导策略，在扩散采样中将仓库中最佳训练选择提示作为潜在锚点，无需重训练或访问测试类别。还给出关于DMP采样提示期望任务损失的理論保证。
AI.result: DMP在分类、检索和文本到图像生成任务上提升了泛化能力，支持概念组合和负提示且无需显式训练；相比提示检索方法，存储和推理成本降低超过90%。在复合分类中，55对数据集上平均提升最高2.0%，特定数据对如Eurosat和Flowers提升达8.5%；在分层分类任务中跨任务泛化提升约2-9%。
AI.conclusion: DMP能够有效建模并合成可泛化提示，在多种任务上优于或补充现有元学习方法，同时显著降低存储与推理开销，并为采样提示的任务损失提供理论保障。

title: Phonological Interference in Multilingual Speech Models
summary: Phoneme-level models transcribe or generate speech as a sequence of phonemes, the smallest sound units that distinguish words. These models enable fine-grained pronunciation control and understanding, yet often fail on input that does not match any single training language, such as speech alternating between two languages, known as code-switching, or low-resource languages absent from training. We identify a systematic failure mode behind this, phonological interference: models assume the input is in a single language and impose its phonology, overriding local phoneme-level decisions that conflict with the assumed language. We measure interference by how often a model retains phonemes that one language has but the other lacks. On code-switched input, two phone recognizers (speech-to-phoneme models) and a phoneme-conditioned text-to-speech model lose 32% to 79% of these phonemes, but lose far fewer of the phonemes both languages share. On unseen languages, we find that phone recognizers impose the phonology of the training language they assign to the speech, and the more confident the assignment, the more they lose phonemes the unseen language has but the assigned language lacks. We probe the models' language estimate from their internal activations, and trace interference to a low dimensional subspace. On monolingual speech, steering this subspace toward another language makes the model lose the phonemes that only the original language uses and produce phonemes that only the target language has. We introduce windowed language estimation (WLE), an inference time repair that replaces the model's language estimate in this subspace with one computed from a short window around each position. On code-switched input, WLE removes 34% to 69% of the interference in all three models, and in the recognizers it leaves monolingual performance essentially unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文研究音素级模型在多语言混合或未见语言上的系统性失败模式，提出语音学干扰概念，并给出推理时修复方法WLE。
AI.motivation: 音素级模型可实现细粒度发音控制与理解，但在代码转换、低资源或未见语言上常失败；作者希望揭示其共同原因。
AI.method: 作者定义并量化语音学干扰：模型假设输入为单一语言并强加其音系，统计模型保留某语言独有、另一语言缺失音素的频率；通过内部激活探测语言估计，并将干扰追溯到低维子空间；提出窗口化语言估计（WLE），用每个位置短窗口重新估计语言并替换子空间中的语言估计。
AI.result: 在代码转换输入上，两个音素识别器和一个音素条件TTS模型丢失32%至79%的语言独有音素，而共享音素丢失较少；在未见语言上，识别器会强加其判定训练语言的音系，且判定越自信，丢失未见语言独有音素越多；操控该低维子空间可导致对应音素丢失或产生；WLE在三个模型中移除34%至69%的干扰，识别器单语性能基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 语音学干扰是音素级模型跨语言失败的核心机制，源于单一语言假设在低维子空间中的语言估计；WLE可在推理时有效缓解代码转换干扰，同时保持单语性能。

title: Distributed Relative Localization for Homogeneous Multi-Robot Systems through UWB Ranging and Limited Communications
comment: This paper has been published in IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics
summary: Accurate and reliable relative localization is crucial for multi-robot applications like exploration, search, and rescue missions. LiDAR-based solutions offer high accuracy in localizing surrounding objects; however, distinguishing homogeneous robots with similar appearances remains challenging due to the lack of distinctive identification features. In this paper, we propose a fully distributed relative pose estimation approach by integrating LiDAR, UWB, and odometry measurements, allowing each robot to accurately and continuously localize its teammates without external infrastructure. Specifically, potential anonymous teammate robot clusters from LiDAR scans are tracked by a dynamic tracker. We then identify teammate robots from these tracked anonymous clusters using a joint matching strategy, ensuring reliable data association between robots and clusters. Finally, by combining the corresponding LiDAR observations, UWB ranging, and odometry measurements, each robot precisely localizes others while minimizing data exchange. The system requires only odometry data exchange through onboard UWB, eliminating the need for additional communication infrastructure like WiFi routers or mesh networks. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed relative localization approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合LiDAR、UWB与里程计的全分布式相对位姿估计方法，使每个机器人无需外部基础设施即可持续、准确地定位队友。
AI.motivation: 多机器人探索、搜索与救援等任务需要准确可靠的相对定位；LiDAR方案虽精度高，但外观相似的同构机器人缺乏区分特征，难以识别队友。
AI.method: 利用动态跟踪器跟踪LiDAR扫描中的匿名队友机器人簇；通过联合匹配策略识别队友并实现机器人-簇的数据关联；融合对应LiDAR观测、UWB测距和里程计数据进行相对定位，且仅通过机载UWB交换里程计数据。
AI.result: 大量仿真和真实世界实验验证了所提相对定位方法的有效性与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需WiFi路由器或网状网络等额外通信基础设施，即可实现多机器人系统中队友的准确、连续相对定位。

title: Harness Compilation: Which Decisions Should a Small Vision-Language Model Keep?
summary: Small vision-language models may be able to read external evidence yet struggle to obtain it. We introduce Harness Compilation (HC), an offline procedure that adapts the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness. A large teacher uses student execution traces to revise reusable content and control, while a separate validation set selects the deployed harness. Deployment requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls. Across seven visual question-answering settings with students of at most 9B parameters, HC improves scores over bare students by 9.9-23.9 points, averaged over three independent builds per setting. Interventions on five runtime decision types (invocation, selection, argument generation, evidence integration and abstention) show why this allocation matters: requesting evidence and generating open queries can be costly, whereas bounded choices and reading supplied text can remain useful student work. Fact cards benefit all ten evaluated students, but decision policies transfer unevenly. Recompilation for a new student model helps when the transferred interface no longer fits the student. With 100 practice items, HC exceeds answer-only LoRA on three tasks. Larger training budgets can match or surpass a fixed harness, while combining the two improves SlideVQA beyond either alone. These findings support allocating work from measured student behavior rather than uniformly removing decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Harness Compilation（HC），一种离线方法，用于适配冻结的小型视觉语言模型与其外部工具之间的分工。部署时无需更新学生模型权重，也无需调用教师模型。在七个视觉问答设置中，HC显著优于裸学生模型。
AI.motivation: 小型视觉语言模型可能能够阅读外部证据，但难以主动获取证据。因此，需要更合理地在学生模型和外部工具之间分配工作，而不是统一移除学生决策。
AI.method: HC使用大型教师模型，基于学生执行轨迹来修订可复用内容与控制策略，并通过单独验证集选择部署的harness。该方法还针对五类运行时决策（调用、选择、参数生成、证据整合和弃答）进行干预分析，并与LoRA、固定harness及二者结合进行比较。
AI.result: 在七个视觉问答设置中，学生模型参数量不超过9B，HC相比裸学生平均提升9.9至23.9分（三次独立构建平均）。干预实验表明，请求证据和生成开放查询成本较高，而有界选择和阅读给定文本仍适合学生完成。事实卡对全部十名学生均有益，但决策策略迁移不均衡。100个练习项时，HC在三个任务上超过仅答案LoRA；更大训练预算可匹配或超越固定harness，二者结合可进一步提升SlideVQA。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论支持根据测量到的学生行为来分配工作，而不是统一移除决策；为适应新学生模型，必要时可重新编译harness。

title: Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion and manipulation informed by future scene evolution and whole-body motion, yet learning these capabilities is constrained by scarce robot demonstrations. Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Being-M0.7潜在世界-动作模型，通过混合模态人类数据预训练、机器人中期训练和动作后训练，将视觉-运动先验迁移到人形机器人全身控制中，在仿真SIMPLE和真实Unitree G1任务上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人移动操作需要协调未来场景演化与全身运动，但机器人示范数据稀缺；人类视频和运动数据可扩展监督，但常缺少配对的视频-运动数据，且人类运动不能直接指定可执行的机器人动作。
AI.method: 构建超过1万小时人类中心原始数据，融合纯视频、纯运动和配对视频-运动流；联合预测未来潜在视觉状态与运动；采用预训练、机器人中期训练和动作后训练三阶段；动作后训练中，动作专家通过门控交叉注意力融合冻结适配先验的视觉预测表征、当前图像和本体感觉，输出可执行全身指令。
AI.result: 在SIMPLE基准上取得对比基线中最高的综合成功率；在真实世界Unitree G1移动操作任务上达到与最强基线相当的表现。
AI.conclusion: 从混合模态人类数据中学习并迁移视觉-运动先验，可有效支持人形机器人移动操作的全身控制，缓解机器人示范数据不足问题。

title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
summary: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.

AI.tldr: 提出 REMORY 神经记忆网络，在文本摘要之外附加少量软记忆 token，让冻结的大模型在有限上下文下逼近使用完整历史时的输出。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体需压缩历史以适应有限上下文窗口，但仅靠文本摘要不足以支撑后续所有决策。
AI.method: 基于历史与摘要，训练神经记忆网络生成有界数量的软记忆 token；token 以摘要为条件并追加其后，形成沿序列维度的残差连接，辅助冻结 LLM 近似完整历史下的续写。
AI.result: 在 SummHay 上提升来源归因且洞见覆盖几乎不变，仅用 5.2% 输入位置即接近全上下文联合得分；在长时程智能体基准上，Qwen3.8-27B 与 GLM-5.3-Flash 均获稳定增益，并在 BrowseComp 和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上显著减少重复工具输出与工具错误。
AI.conclusion: 残差式软记忆 token 可有效补充摘要，在极低上下文占用下提升长时程智能体表现与工具使用可靠性。

title: No Distillation Needed: Single-Pass Real-Time Talking Heads via Acausal Noise Shaping
summary: Audio-driven facial animation underpins real-time avatars, telepresence, and embodied virtual agents. And it must run online: each frame emitted from audio observed up to the current time, at interactive rates. Recent progress is dominated by diffusion models, which need many network evaluations per sample and are therefore a poor fit for streaming. We argue the cost is unnecessary in this domain. Audio-conditioned facial motion occupies a comparatively low-dimensional manifold, a regime where a single-pass GAN suffices. The obstacle is not capacity but stochastic structure. We show that a causal, time-invariant generator driven by i.i.d. noise cannot suppress its output spectrum over a band without collapsing its per-step innovation. We proposed FaceGAN, which dissolved the limitation by shaping the noise pathway acausally. Because the driving noise is synthetic, its future can be sampled now, so the audio-to-expression path stays causal, and the model supports fully causal operation. FaceGAN emits expression and head pose in a single forward pass per frame and matches or outperforms state-of-art approaches in generation quality. Being feed-forward with bounded attention windows, it generates indefinitely without drift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FaceGAN，一种用于音频驱动面部动画的流式单步生成模型。它通过非因果地塑造噪声路径，在保持音频到表情因果性的同时，实现每帧单次前向生成，并达到或超越当前最优方法的质量，且可无限生成而不漂移。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动面部动画需要在线、交互式运行。现有扩散模型虽质量高，但每样本需多次网络评估，不适合流式生成。作者认为音频条件的面部运动位于低维流形，单步 GAN 已足够，真正障碍是随机结构而非模型容量。
AI.method: 作者首先指出：由独立同分布噪声驱动的因果、时不变生成器，若想抑制某频带输出频谱，会不可避免地破坏每步创新。为此提出 FaceGAN，通过非因果地塑造噪声路径来解除该限制：由于驱动噪声是合成的，其未来值可提前采样，因此音频到表情的路径仍保持因果，模型支持完全因果运行。FaceGAN 每帧单次前向输出表情和头部姿态，采用前馈结构和有界注意力窗口。
AI.result: FaceGAN 在生成质量上匹配或超越当前最优方法；由于是前馈且注意力窗口有界，它能够无限生成而不出现漂移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在音频驱动面部动画领域，无需依赖扩散模型的多步采样；通过合理设计噪声路径，单步 GAN 可实现高质量、因果、低延迟的流式面部动画。

title: Contrast Enhancement or Noise Reduction? On Improving Cervical Cancer Classification
summary:
Purpose: Cervical cancer is one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. Deep learning has shown promising performance in medical image classification. The influence of image preprocessing algorithms on classification performance remains insufficiently investigated in the literature. This research aims to evaluate the impact of image preprocessing algorithms on the performance of CNNs for Pap smear image classification.
  Methods: Three CNN architectures (ResNet-34, MobileNet-V2, and DenseNet-121) were trained and evaluated using the SIPaKMeD dataset. Two preprocessing algorithms were applied: the PMD filter for noise reduction and CLAHE for contrast enhancement. The model performance was assessed using a confusion matrix.
  Results: Preprocessing improved the classification performance of all models. CLAHE significantly increased the accuracy of ResNet-34 from 76.73% to 84.16% and DenseNet-121 from 76.73% to 84.16%. The PMD filter yielded limited improvement and slightly reduced the MobileNet-V2 performance.
  Novelty: This research provides a systematic comparison of contrast enhancement and noise reduction techniques across CNN architectures. This research demonstrates that contrast enhancement is more effective than noise reduction in improving CNN performance. The research provides new pipelines for improving cervical cancer classification.

AI.tldr: 本文评估图像预处理算法对CNN在巴氏涂片图像分类中性能的影响，使用三种CNN架构和两种预处理方法在SIPaKMeD数据集上进行实验。
AI.motivation: 宫颈癌是全球主要致死原因之一，深度学习在医学图像分类中表现良好，但图像预处理算法对分类性能的影响在文献中研究不足。
AI.method: 训练并评估ResNet-34、MobileNet-V2和DenseNet-121三种CNN架构，使用SIPaKMeD数据集；采用PMD滤波器降噪和CLAHE对比度增强两种预处理算法；通过混淆矩阵评估模型性能。
AI.result: 预处理提升了所有模型的分类性能。CLAHE使ResNet-34和DenseNet-121的准确率均从76.73%提升至84.16%；PMD滤波器提升有限，并略微降低了MobileNet-V2的性能。
AI.conclusion: 对比度增强比降噪更能有效提升CNN性能；该研究系统比较了不同CNN架构下的预处理技术，为宫颈癌分类提供了新的流程。

title: TaReD: Tool-Aware Recursive Decomposition for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Agents combine reasoning with tools to interact with external systems and complete real-world tasks. Early agents typically interleave reasoning and actions along a single execution chain. On complex tasks, this chain becomes unreliable because growing histories obscure intermediate dependencies and allow early planning errors to propagate. Recursively decomposing a complex task into smaller subtasks offers a natural solution, yet effective decomposition must account for the system's capabilities so that each subtask can be executed by the available tools. In realistic systems, however, tool libraries can be too large to expose in full. Injecting every tool description consumes substantial context while making relevant tools harder to retrieve and useful task boundaries harder to identify. We propose tool-aware recursive decomposition, which organizes tools by functional relationships into a hierarchy of capabilities. During execution, the agent discovers tools on demand and uses the hierarchy to recursively decompose a complex task into a subtask tree whose levels are aligned with the capabilities required at each stage. Experiments on complex real-world tasks show that the proposed method improves end-to-end task success rate by up to 40 percentage points over the compared baselines. The implementation of TaReD is available on GitHub: https://github.com/WeiXiang-Mao/TaReD.

AI.tldr: 论文提出工具感知的递归分解方法 TaReD，通过将工具按功能关系组织成能力层级，让智能体按需发现工具并将复杂任务递归分解为与各阶段能力对齐的子任务树，从而提升复杂真实任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 早期智能体在单条执行链上交错推理与行动，面对复杂任务时历史增长会模糊中间依赖并传播早期规划错误；递归分解虽可缓解，但需考虑系统能力以确保子任务可由现有工具执行。同时，真实系统中工具库过大，全部注入描述会消耗大量上下文，并使相关工具检索和任务边界识别更困难。
AI.method: 提出工具感知递归分解（TaReD）：将工具按功能关系组织为能力层级；执行时智能体按需发现工具，并利用该层级将复杂任务递归分解为子任务树，使各层级与所需能力对齐。
AI.result: 在复杂真实世界任务实验中，TaReD 相比对比基线将端到端任务成功率最多提升 40 个百分点。实现已开源：https://github.com/WeiXiang-Mao/TaReD。
AI.conclusion: TaReD 通过工具能力层级与递归任务分解相结合，有效应对大规模工具库和复杂任务规划问题，显著提升任务成功率，并提供了开源实现。

title: When Do We Need On-Policy Distillation? Distilling on Offline Student Rollouts Is Often Better
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become increasingly popular for transferring teacher capabilities to student models. In this work, we ask a critical research question: Is on-policy sampling always beneficial for distilling arbitrary teacher-student pairs? We show that a simple alternative, Semi-OPD, which distills from offline rollouts generated by the initial student, can often outperform OPD in both accuracy and training efficiency. Across 17 teacher-student pairs ranging from 1.5B to 235B parameters, Semi-OPD outperforms OPD in 14 cases, with up to +13.6% accuracy and 11.4x training speedup. We further find that the choice between OPD and Semi-OPD depends on the alignment between the initial teacher and student, quantified by an output-token overlap ratio: OPD is beneficial only when the two are highly aligned with high overlap ratios. Our deeper investigation suggests that effective distillation requires on-policyness w.r.t. both the student and the teacher. For misaligned pairs, student rollouts can become increasingly off-policy w.r.t. the teacher as context length grows, weakening the distillation signal. In contrast, Semi-OPD is often more stable, as it distills on shorter contexts while covering full trajectories and exposing the student to more teacher-preferred tokens. Beyond proposing Semi-OPD as an efficient alternative, our work motivates the community to rethink when to use OPD and to study stronger OPD variants with meaningful teacher-student pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑在线策略蒸馏（OPD）是否总优于离线/半在线策略，提出Semi-OPD：使用初始学生模型生成的离线轨迹进行蒸馏。在17组师生模型对上，Semi-OPD在14组中优于OPD，最高提升13.6%准确率并实现11.4倍训练加速。
AI.motivation: OPD被广泛用于将教师能力迁移给学生，但尚不清楚在线采样是否对所有师生组合都有益。作者希望探究OPD的适用条件，并寻找更高效、稳定的蒸馏替代方案。
AI.method: 提出Semi-OPD，即从初始学生模型生成的离线rollout中进行蒸馏，而非持续使用当前学生在线采样。通过17组1.5B到235B参数的师生模型对比较OPD与Semi-OPD，并用输出token重叠率衡量师生对齐程度。
AI.result: Semi-OPD在17组中有14组优于OPD，最高提升13.6%准确率，训练加速最高达11.4倍。OPD仅在师生高度对齐、输出token重叠率高时更有益。深入分析表明，有效蒸馏需要对师生双方都保持一定on-policy性；错配师生中，学生rollout随上下文增长会越来越偏离教师策略，削弱蒸馏信号。
AI.conclusion: Semi-OPD是高效且常更稳定的替代方案。研究呼吁社区重新思考何时使用OPD，并基于有意义的师生对研究更强的OPD变体。

title: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Autonomous Discovery of Mechanistic World Models
summary: Large language model agents are being increasingly deployed as autonomous scientists, designing experiments and inferring mechanistic world models with minimal human oversight. Yet identifiability is often overlooked: when a plateau is reached, the agent needs to know whether it is not yet capable enough or the model simply is not identifiable from the data, in which case no amount of further experimentation of the same kind can help. We propose the Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent (LLM-IDEA) for closed-loop discovery with an identifiability engine that returns a three-way plateau verdict: capability limit, resolvable within the design class, or certified exhausted. On ODEBench, 60 of the 62 systems with free constants are identifiable at round 0; the RC circuit is certified exhausted for every experiment that protocol can run, and a harvesting model is resolvable by one added initial condition. The identifiability engine reproduces known verdicts on Lotka-Volterra, Van der Pol, Lorenz, and a pharmacokinetic model, where it recommends the intravenous arm pharmacologists use, and it ranks the depth scorer of our own benchmark last among four observation designs. On the DiscoverPhysics benchmark, it finds two public worlds whose explanation rubric rewards a distinction no legal experiment can make, and every model there with accurate trajectories failed the explanation grade (15 of 15, against 5 of 9 in identifiable worlds, p = 0.012). On the Alien Universe, a two-body testbed we propose in which a force law switches between a provably non-identifiable and an identifiable protocol, LLM-IDEA on the identifiable protocol reaches discovery depth at least three on 8/8 seeds versus 1/8 without it. An autonomous discovery agent can thus compute, rather than guess, whether a plateau calls for more search, a better experiment of the same kind, or a different kind of experiment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LLM-IDEA，一种面向闭环自主发现的智能体，核心是可识别性引擎，用于判断实验平台期属于能力上限、同类设计内可解决，还是已证明耗尽，并在多个基准上验证其能指导实验选择与发现。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体正被用作自主科学家，但常忽视可识别性：遇到性能平台期时，智能体需要知道是能力不足，还是模型从数据中根本不可识别；若是后者，继续同类实验无济于事。
AI.method: 提出 LLM-IDEA，包含可识别性引擎，返回三分类平台期判定：能力极限、设计类内可解决、认证耗尽。将其用于闭环发现，并在 ODEBench、DiscoverPhysics 及新提出的 Alien Universe 两体测试平台上评估；Alien Universe 中力律可在可证明不可识别与可识别协议间切换。
AI.result: ODEBench 中含自由常数的 62 个系统中 60 个在第 0 轮即可识别；RC 电路对协议可运行的每个实验均被认证耗尽，收获模型通过增加一个初始条件即可解决。引擎复现 Lotka-Volterra、Van der Pol、Lorenz 和药代动力学模型的已知判定，并推荐药理学家使用的静脉给药臂；在四种观测设计中将自己基准的深度评分器排最后。DiscoverPhysics 上发现两个公开世界，其解释评分标准奖励任何合法实验都无法区分的差异；所有轨迹准确的模型均未通过解释评分（15/15，对比可识别世界 5/9，p=0.012）。Alien Universe 中，LLM-IDEA 在可识别协议下 8/8 种子达到至少 3 的发现深度，而无其为 1/8。
AI.conclusion: 自主发现智能体可以计算而非猜测平台期意味着需要更多搜索、更好的同类实验，还是不同种类的实验。

title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
summary: Autonomous scientific discovery with LLMs requires generating and testing hypotheses adaptively as evidence accumulates while maintaining statistical validity. Existing anytime-valid methods can handle data-dependent hypotheses, but open-ended discovery poses a deeper challenge: the best discovered hypothesis may still be the best of a bad lot, with better explanations yet undiscovered, while even background knowledge such as physical laws may require revision in light of new findings. In response, we formalize the problem as Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory. We introduce abductive utility, a computable measure of discovery progress, and possibility frontier search, the first algorithm for AASD, which maintains anytime validity and achieves $\varepsilon$-optimal abductive utility asymptotically under suitable conditions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world scientific-discovery tasks show strong performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用可能性理论形式化开放式自主科学发现，并给出首个算法“可能性前沿搜索”，在保持任意时间有效性的同时，渐进达到ε最优的溯因效用。
AI.motivation: 现有任意时间有效方法虽能处理数据依赖假设，但开放式发现中已发现的最好假设可能只是“坏选项中的最好者”，更好解释尚未发现，甚至物理定律等背景知识也可能需要修正。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为溯因自主科学发现（AASD），基于可能性理论；引入可计算的发现进展度量“溯因效用”；提出“可能性前沿搜索”算法，保持任意时间统计有效性，并在合适条件下渐进实现ε最优溯因效用。
AI.result: 在合成与真实科学发现任务上取得强性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLM驱动的开放式科学发现提供了兼顾自适应假设生成与统计有效性的理论框架和算法基础。

title: BeliefScope: Diagnosing Evidence-Driven Revision and Pressure-Induced Shifts in Large Language Models
summary: A language model may revise the same proposition after receiving genuinely relevant evidence or after receiving directional user pressure that adds no relevant fact. The observable response shift alone therefore does not reveal which source drove the change. We introduce BeliefScope, a controlled black-box framework for separating these two sources of influence around a fixed target proposition. BeliefScope crosses Evidence and Pressure with factor-specific local controls and measures response changes through probability reports, categorical judgments, and action recommendations on channel-appropriate scales. To determine when these observable contrasts support reliable attribution, we evaluate the observation design under controlled synthetic conditions. Known-truth recovery and targeted ablations establish where Evidence- and Pressure-related effects can be separated, while semi-synthetic stress tests map how that recoverability changes as the observation process becomes noisier and more heterogeneous. Across a 36-family Qwen/Llama study, with targeted 12-family checks that also include Gemma3-12B, the resulting profiles show substantial evaluation-context dependence: broad model-level differences can change under matched controls, decoding, or response interfaces, while some narrower within-model patterns remain stable. Instruction interventions further show that reduced target-aligned Pressure following can reflect either stable resistance or movement in the opposite direction. BeliefScope summarizes these measurements as a conditional belief-response profile that keeps diagnostic effects tied to the evaluation conditions under which they are observed, together with explicit validity boundaries for that diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BeliefScope，一个受控黑盒框架，用于区分语言模型对固定命题的响应变化究竟来自真实相关证据，还是来自无新增事实的方向性用户压力。
AI.motivation: 仅凭可观察的响应偏移无法判断模型改变信念的原因：可能是真正相关的证据，也可能是方向性用户压力。因此需要分离并归因这两种影响来源。
AI.method: BeliefScope 将 Evidence 与 Pressure 交叉，并加入因素特异局部控制；通过概率报告、类别判断和行动建议等适合不同渠道的尺度测量响应变化。研究还用受控合成条件评估观察设计，包括已知真值恢复、定向消融和半合成压力测试，并在 Qwen/Llama 36 个家族及含 Gemma3-12B 的 12 个家族检查中验证。
AI.result: 模型层面的广泛差异在匹配控制、解码方式或响应接口变化下可能改变，而部分更窄的模型内模式保持稳定。指令干预显示，目标对齐的压力跟随减少，可能反映稳定抵抗，也可能反映向相反方向移动。
AI.conclusion: BeliefScope 将测量汇总为条件化信念-响应画像，把诊断效应绑定到其被观察时的评估条件，并给出该诊断的明确有效性边界。

title: Continuous Ground-Truth Construction and a Recovery Policy for Air--Water Robotic Tracking
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
summary: Visual tracking across the air-water interface is challenged by splashes, bubbles, refraction, reflections, and abrupt appearance changes that can temporarily invalidate observations. This setting poses two coupled difficulties: first, for evaluation, image-only annotation cannot reliably describe the target's physical location during visual blindness; second, for online tracking, corrupted observations can contaminate motion estimates and appearance templates. We address the first difficulty with a construction pipeline that synchronizes camera frames with motion-capture poses, projects known target geometry, corrects underwater projection with a medium-gated residual, and subjects the annotations to manual review. This yields an evaluation-only cross-medium test set of 22,346 frames. We further introduce a Cross-Medium Recovery Policy (CMRP) centered on confidence-triggered template selection. It supplies MixFormerV2 with the fixed initial template, a window-best pre-trigger template, and a trigger-frame Kalman-guided image crop, together with their associated weights, without retraining the visual backbone. In the accuracy evaluation, CMRP achieves 49.90 Macro Success AUC, 2.95 points above MixFormerV2 Official. On selected cross-medium transition and occlusion-recovery intervals, CMRP increases MixFormerV2 tracking coverage from 47.91\% to 50.43\% relative to Official updating, while mean loss-to-recovery latency over successfully recovered videos decreases from 55.3 to 49.3 frames.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨水-气界面的视觉目标跟踪，针对飞溅、气泡、折射、反射和外观突变导致的观测失效问题，构建了基于运动捕捉的跨介质评测集，并提出置信度触发模板选择的跨介质恢复策略CMRP。
AI.motivation: 跨水-气界面跟踪中，图像标注在视觉盲区无法可靠反映目标真实位置，且受损观测会污染运动估计与外观模板，因此评测和在线跟踪都面临挑战。
AI.method: 构建同步相机帧与运动捕捉位姿的标注流程，投影已知目标几何，并用介质门控残差校正水下投影，经人工审核得到22,346帧的评测集；提出CMRP，基于置信度触发模板选择，为MixFormerV2提供固定初始模板、窗口最佳预触发模板和触发帧Kalman引导图像裁剪及其权重，且不重训练视觉骨干。
AI.result: CMRP达到49.90 Macro Success AUC，比MixFormerV2 Official高2.95个百分点；在跨介质转换和遮挡恢复区间，跟踪覆盖率从47.91%提升至50.43%，成功恢复视频的平均丢失到恢复延迟从55.3帧降至49.3帧。
AI.conclusion: 所提评测流程和CMRP能改善跨介质视觉跟踪的评测可靠性与在线恢复能力，在无需重训练骨干网络的情况下提升跟踪覆盖率和恢复速度。

title: TKCAM: Text and Keyframe to Camera Trajectory Generation
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures. Paper accepted to NeurIPS2026 (submission number 15461)
summary: Generating high-quality and controllable camera motion is essential for AI-assisted cinematography, video synthesis, and 3D scene understanding. We introduce TKCAM, a Text- and Keyframe-conditioned CAMera-motion synthesis framework based on generative masked modeling. We represent camera dynamics using a 12-dimensional kinematic feature comprising position, velocity, and a continuous rotation representation and discretize them into hierarchical motion tokens via a Residual Vector Quantizer (RVQ). A two-stage masked transformer architecture then learns to reconstruct and refine these tokens, utilizing explicit self- and cross-attention modules for multimodal conditioning. A central feature of our framework is sparse visual keyframe conditioning: users can provide free-form text prompts together with RGB observations at selected timestamps, which provide temporally localized visual guidance for generating coherent in-between trajectories. Furthermore, to advance evaluation standards, we curate RealEstate10K-Cap, a large-scale text-camera dataset, and establish a cross-domain benchmark with a Universal CLaTr Evaluator. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TKCAM surpasses recent state-of-the-art baselines on Fréchet distance (FID), text-motion matching scores, and retrieval metrics (R@K), while additional analyses evaluate temporal smoothness and cross-domain generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/linearalgebrayhz/TKCAM.

AI.tldr: 提出 TKCAM，一种基于生成式掩码建模的文本与关键帧条件相机运动合成框架，并构建了新数据集与跨域评测基准，在多项指标上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高质量、可控的相机运动对 AI 辅助电影摄影、视频合成和 3D 场景理解至关重要，因此需要支持文本与稀疏关键帧控制且便于评测的相机运动生成方法。
AI.method: 用 12 维运动学特征表示相机动态（位置、速度、连续旋转），并通过 RVQ 离散化为层级运动 token；采用两阶段掩码 Transformer 重建和细化 token，结合自注意力与交叉注意力进行多模态条件建模；支持用户提供自由文本提示和部分时间戳 RGB 关键帧作为稀疏视觉条件；同时构建 RealEstate10K-Cap 数据集和 Universal CLaTr Evaluator 跨域基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TKCAM 在 FID、文本-运动匹配分数和检索指标 R@K 上优于近期最先进基线，并额外评估了时间平滑性和跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TKCAM 能有效生成连贯且可控的相机运动轨迹，并推动了文本-相机数据与跨域评测标准的发展，代码已开源。

title: From Retrieval to Reconstruction: Constructing Evolvable Cognitive Memory for Long-Term Dialogue
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) serving as long-term dialogue agents require memory systems that support reliable reasoning over extended interactions. However, existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks typically treat memory as passive storage, making it difficult to distinguish source-attributed beliefs from unattributed event/fact records and to connect evidence dispersed across sessions.
