AI.conclusion: TRACE为认知导向的情感分析提供了形式化框架与评测基准，TRACER表明基于认知与显式前提的结构化推理能有效提升多模态模型在复杂情感理解任务中的表现。

title: STAG: A Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph Representation from Grid-Based Costmaps for Robotic Navigation
summary: Autonomous rovers navigating large unstructured environments need efficient global planning that accounts for terrain traversability. However, searching dense grid-based costmaps becomes computationally expensive as the mapped area grows. We introduce STAG, a Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph that converts costmaps into compact graphs. STAG combines a medial-axis topological backbone, representative nodes for homogeneous traversability regions, and transition nodes near strong traversability gradients. Edges encode geometry and traversability to account for path length and terrain difficulty. We compare A* on STAG and dense grids using synthetic cave maps, mine maps and the DARPA CERBERUS dataset. Across five benchmark categories comprising 203 map instances and 101,200 queries, STAG reduces median planning time by 3.4x to 9.9x and peak query memory by 2.1x to 15.4x, with median relative path-length differences of -2.9% and +7.6%. STAG offers a compact representation for global planning, trading dense-grid traversability optimality for faster, less memory-intensive search.

AI.tldr: STAG 将密集栅格代价地图转换为稀疏的可通行性感知图，用于大规模非结构化环境中的全局规划，在大幅降低规划时间和内存的同时保持相近路径质量。
AI.motivation: 自主漫游车在大型非结构化环境中需要高效全局规划并考虑地形可通行性，但基于密集栅格代价地图的搜索会随着地图面积增大而计算开销过高。
AI.method: 提出 STAG（Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph），结合中轴拓扑骨架、均质可通行区域的代表节点以及强可通行性梯度附近的过渡节点；边编码几何和可通行性，以权衡路径长度与地形难度。在合成洞穴地图、矿井地图和 DARPA CERBERUS 数据集上，将 STAG 上的 A* 与密集栅格上的 A* 进行比较。
AI.result: 在五大类基准、203 个地图实例和 101,200 次查询中，STAG 将中位规划时间降低 3.4 倍至 9.9 倍，峰值查询内存降低 2.1 倍至 15.4 倍；中位相对路径长度差异为 -2.9% 和 +7.6%。
AI.conclusion: STAG 提供了一种用于全局规划的紧凑表示，通过牺牲密集栅格可通行性最优性，换取更快、内存更少的搜索。

title: Smoothing the Top-k Exposure Boundary for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models scale parameter capacity efficiently while maintaining a fixed compute budget per token. However, traditional training paradigms enforce a static choice of top-$k$ experts, which converts a continuous routing distribution into a rigid step function. This constraint introduces a brittle boundary where highly competitive experts are arbitrarily separated into full-supervision and zero-feedback zones based on minor score fluctuations. To address this issue, we propose Elastic Expert Routing, which stochastically samples the active expert budget from a localized discrete distribution centered at $k$. Over multiple training iterations, this mechanism softens the sharp threshold into a gradual probability distribution. Because the sampling neighborhood remains symmetric, this approach matches the expected computational cost of deterministic training, while preserving the inference budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our method on both supervised fine-tuning and from-scratch pretraining settings. During supervised fine-tuning, elastic routing improves downstream macro-averages on OLMoE-1B-7B and Qwen3-30B-A3B by $+0.84$ and $+2.02$ points, respectively. In addition, in from-scratch pretraining, it outperforms the static top-$k$ baseline by $1.6$ points on average across downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出弹性专家路由（Elastic Expert Routing），通过随机采样以k为中心的局部离散分布来确定激活专家数量，缓解传统top-k路由的刚性边界问题，在监督微调和从头预训练中均取得性能提升，且保持计算成本不变。
AI.motivation: 传统稀疏MoE训练采用静态top-k专家选择，将连续路由分布变为刚性阶跃函数，导致竞争激烈的专家因微小分数波动被任意划分为全监督和零反馈区域，形成脆弱边界。
AI.method: 提出弹性专家路由，在训练中从以k为中心的局部离散分布中随机采样激活专家预算；多次迭代后，将尖锐阈值软化为渐进概率分布；由于采样邻域对称，期望计算成本与确定性训练匹配，且推理预算不变。
AI.result: 在监督微调中，OLMoE-1B-7B和Qwen3-30B-A3B的下游宏平均分别提升+0.84和+2.02分；在从头预训练中，下游任务平均超越静态top-k基线1.6分。
AI.conclusion: 弹性专家路由有效缓解了刚性边界问题，在保持计算成本的同时提升了模型性能，适用于微调和预训练场景。

title: WAND: Learning Robust Navigation under Complex Wind Disturbances and Dense Obstacles for Quadrotors
summary: Robust navigation in cluttered environments remains a fundamental challenge for quadrotors, particularly when strong wind disturbances arise, which perturb vehicle dynamics, limit control authority, and substantially increase collision risk. Existing learning-based navigation policies typically rely on obstacle perception and proprioceptive observations, requiring the policy to infer time-varying disturbance effects implicitly and thereby limiting robustness under partial observability. This paper proposes WAND (Wind-Aware Navigation with Disturbance Estimation), a reinforcement learning framework for navigation under time-varying wind disturbances in dense obstacle fields. Specifically, WAND estimates wind-induced disturbance acceleration from historical proprioceptive states using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). This estimation is integrated into the policy via a zero-initialized residual module, \emph{WindAdapter}, while simultaneously providing feedforward compensation for low-level control. The dual use of the estimate couples disturbance-conditioned navigation with feedforward disturbance rejection. Across 12 wind-disturbed simulation settings, WAND improved the observed success rate by 8.3 percentage points on average relative to feedforward compensation alone. Controlled opposite-crosswind experiments further showed wind-direction-dependent trajectory adaptation. In indoor fan-induced flight tests, WAND succeeded in 18 of 20 trials, demonstrating the feasibility of real-time onboard navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出WAND，一种基于强化学习的四旋翼导航框架，通过TCN从历史本体感知状态估计风扰加速度，并利用零初始化残差模块WindAdapter将估计融入策略，同时为底层控制提供前馈补偿，从而在密集障碍和时变风扰下实现鲁棒导航。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在杂乱环境中导航面临强风扰时，动力学受扰动、控制权限受限、碰撞风险增加。现有基于学习的导航策略依赖障碍感知和本体感知观测，需隐式推断时变扰动，在部分可观测下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 使用TCN从历史本体感知状态估计风致扰动加速度；通过零初始化残差模块WindAdapter将估计集成到策略中，并同时为底层控制器提供前馈补偿，实现扰动条件导航与前馈扰动抑制的耦合。
AI.result: 在12种风扰仿真设置中，相比仅前馈补偿，WAND平均成功率提升8.3个百分点；反向侧风实验显示轨迹随风向自适应；室内风扇扰动飞行测试中20次成功18次。
AI.conclusion: WAND能够实现实时机载导航，在时变风扰和密集障碍下提升四旋翼的鲁棒性，验证了扰动估计与策略耦合的有效性。

title: TAP3D: Thermal-Assisted 3D Human Point Clouds
summary: Human body point clouds are a versatile representation for AI-enabled human sensing. However, existing methods using LiDAR, radar, and depth cameras suffer from inherent drawbacks in high cost, sparse reconstruction, and privacy concerns, etc. In this paper, we exploit low-cost thermal arrays and present TAP3D, the first system to reconstruct 3D human point clouds from body heat signatures, offering significant advantages in cost, density, human sensitivity, and privacy. To overcome major challenges in depth estimation, thermal interference, and multi-person separation, we propose a novel physics-informed design, which integrates a forward thermal physics model with two distinct modules: multi-primitive estimation for self-supervised joint recovery of depth and other thermal properties, and geometric perspective fusion for suppressing interference and disentangling multiple people. We implement TAP3D using a single commodity thermal array sensor and build a large-scale dataset (160K samples, 8 environments, 11 users) for evaluation. TAP3D achieves remarkable accuracy for dense point cloud generation, enabling downstream tasks like fall detection (91.46%), indoor tracking (21.86 cm MAE), and human mesh recovery (4.87 cm error). By transforming body heat into point clouds for the first time, TAP3D pioneers a new paradigm for privacy-first, fully passive human sensing for many applications. TAP3D is open-sourced at https://github.com/aiot-lab/TAP3D.

AI.tldr: TAP3D 是首个利用低成本热阵列从人体热特征重建 3D 人体点云的系统，实现了隐私友好、被动式人体感知，并支持跌倒检测、室内跟踪和人体网格恢复等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LiDAR、雷达和深度相机的人体点云感知方法存在成本高、重建稀疏、隐私泄露等问题，因此需要一种低成本、密集且保护隐私的人体感知方案。
AI.method: 使用单个商用热阵列传感器，提出物理信息驱动设计：将前向热物理模型与两个模块结合，包括多基元估计（自监督联合恢复深度和其他热属性）和几何透视融合（抑制干扰并分离多人）；并构建大规模数据集（16 万样本、8 个环境、11 个用户）进行评估。
AI.result: TAP3D 能生成高精度密集点云，在跌倒检测上达到 91.46%，室内跟踪 MAE 为 21.86 cm，人体网格恢复误差为 4.87 cm。
AI.conclusion: TAP3D 首次将人体热量转化为点云，开创了隐私优先、完全被动的人体感知新范式，并已开源。

title: Adapting English Quality Classifiers for Multilingual LLM Pretraining Data Selection
summary: Recent advances in large language model (LLM) pretraining highlight the role of high-quality training data in improving performance. While model-based filtering has proven effective in selecting high-quality subsets from web-scale corpora, especially for high-resource languages, low-resource languages face challenges due to limited availability of annotated data. This work explores extending quality filtering to over 100 languages by proposing a multilingual adaptation approach that converts an existing English quality classifier into a multilingual variant. Our approach proposes training a small multi-layer perceptron on top of Transformer encoder-only model embeddings, using multilingual text as input and scores obtained from English classifiers applied to machine-translated text as labels. Our 1B, 3B and 8B scale experiments show that our approach maintains the downstream LLM benchmark performance of existing multilingual model-based filtering baselines, without harming regional and cultural knowledge benchmarks. To further evaluate cross-lingual generalization, we compare classifier scores of high-quality synthetic data and web samples, and the correlation of classifier scores with LLM-based ones, revealing that the classifier can learn the scoring criteria of its original English variant, even for languages not included in its training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多语言数据质量过滤方法，将英语质量分类器适配到100多种语言，用于低资源语言的LLM预训练数据筛选，并在1B、3B、8B规模实验中验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 高质量训练数据对LLM性能很重要，但现有基于模型的质量过滤主要依赖英语等富资源语言的标注数据，低资源语言因缺乏标注数据而难以应用。
AI.method: 在Transformer仅编码器模型嵌入之上训练一个小型多层感知机，以多语言文本为输入，以英语分类器对机器翻译文本的打分为标签，从而把英语质量分类器扩展为多语言变体。
AI.result: 1B、3B和8B规模实验表明，该方法能保持现有多语言模型过滤基线的下游LLM基准性能，且不损害区域和文化知识基准；跨语言泛化分析显示，分类器能学习原英语分类器的评分标准，甚至适用于未参与训练的语言。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可将英语质量过滤有效扩展到100多种语言，在低资源场景下实现多语言数据质量筛选，并具备一定的跨语言泛化能力。

title: Attributing HOW, Not Just WHICH: Counterfactual Response Trajectories for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image generation, yet tracing their outputs to individual training examples remains challenging. Existing attribution methods often compress factor-specific effects into scalar responses, making distinct internal changes indistinguishable. This is particularly limiting for diffusion models, where semantic factors emerge through evolving representation dynamics during denoising. We therefore reformulate diffusion data attribution as attributing factor-induced internal response trajectories. In this paper, we propose a novel Concept Attribution method through Dynamic Trajectories(CADT). We argue that attribution should therefore ask not only \emph{which} examples matter, but also \emph{how} their influence unfolds during generation. Specifically, we construct matched counterfactual pairs at identical noisy states to isolate factor-specific representation displacements, and model their directional and magnitude evolution across denoising as dynamic attribution signatures. For each training example and generated query, CADT extracts stage-wise feature vectors and integrates them along the denoising process to form a trajectory descriptor. Applying the same construction across the training set yields a bank of factor-specific trajectory descriptors. The covariance statistics of this bank are then used to construct . CADT uses this covariance-aware positive-semidefinite kernel to calibrate the query and training representations, and compares the calibrated query trajectory with each training trajectory to produce the final training-sample attribution scores. Experiments on multiple public datasets show consistent improvements over existing diffusion attribution baselines across hierarchical, compositional, and style attribution.

AI.tldr: 提出CADT方法，将扩散模型的数据归因重新表述为对因子诱导的内部响应轨迹进行归因，通过匹配反事实对和轨迹描述符来提升归因效果。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散归因方法常将因子特定效应压缩为标量响应，无法区分不同内部变化；而扩散模型的语义因素是在去噪过程中动态演化形成的，因此需要同时理解哪些训练样本重要以及其影响如何随生成过程展开。
AI.method: 在相同噪声状态构建匹配反事实对，分离因子特定的表示位移；沿去噪过程提取分阶段特征并积分成轨迹描述符；对训练集构建因子特定轨迹描述符库；利用协方差统计构建协方差感知半正定核，校准查询与训练表示，并比较校准后的查询轨迹与各训练轨迹以生成归因分数。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上，CADT在层级、组合和风格归因任务中一致优于现有扩散归因基线。
AI.conclusion: 扩散数据归因应同时关注哪些训练样本重要及其影响在生成中的动态展开；轨迹化建模与协方差校准能有效提升扩散模型数据归因性能。

title: TACROSS: An Efficient and Low-Cost Scalable Human Touch System Across Heterogeneous Tactile Sensors for Dexterous Robot Learning
summary: Collecting tactile demonstrations on robots is costly and slow, motivating the use of lower-cost human tactile gloves for scalable data collection. However, human capacitive/piezoresistive gloves and robotic tactile sensors differ fundamentally in transduction principle, sensor layout, spatial resolution, and dynamic response, making alignment of raw sensor channels ill-posed. To address this problem, we present TACROSS, a scalable system for learning from human touch and transferring it to robots that bridges this heterogeneity by aligning tactile streams at the level of contact events rather than raw sensor values. The hardware component of TACROSS integrates a piezoresistive glove with five layers and a cost of USD 10.86 with 285 sensing points. To align contact semantics, we design canonicalizers and residual adapters that map heterogeneous signals into a shared tactile latent with 256 dimensions via a temporal Transformer with attention across fingers. We further introduce a robot-grounded policy learning scheme in which robot demonstrations provide the sole source of ground-truth action supervision, while human demonstrations support tactile representation learning and provide confidence-weighted auxiliary supervision through valid retargeted hand targets. We evaluate our system on four contact-rich manipulation tasks. Compared to conventional teleoperation, our proposed system achieves a 3.5-fold efficiency improvement while reducing demonstration acquisition equipment cost by 95.7%. We will open-source the TACROSS hardware and software system and publicly release a tactile dataset comprising over 150 hours of recordings. Project page: https://tacross-touch-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: TACROSS 是一个可扩展系统，通过将人类触觉与机器人触觉在接触事件层面对齐，实现从人类触觉演示学习并迁移到机器人，降低数据采集成本并提升效率。
AI.motivation: 在机器人上采集触觉演示成本高、速度慢，因此希望使用低成本人类触觉手套进行规模化数据采集；但人类电容/压阻手套与机器人触觉传感器在 transduction 原理、布局、空间分辨率和动态响应上存在根本差异，直接对齐原始传感器通道是病态问题。
AI.method: 提出 TACROSS：硬件上集成五层压阻手套，成本 10.86 美元、285 个传感点；算法上设计 canonicalizers 和 residual adapters，通过带跨手指注意力的时序 Transformer 将异构信号映射到 256 维共享触觉潜空间，并在接触事件层面对齐语义；采用机器人 grounded 策略学习，其中机器人演示是唯一真实动作监督来源，人类演示用于触觉表示学习，并通过有效重定向手部目标提供置信度加权辅助监督。
AI.result: 在四个接触丰富操作任务上评估：相比传统遥操作，该系统实现 3.5 倍效率提升，并将演示采集设备成本降低 95.7%；将开源 TACROSS 硬件与软件，并公开超过 150 小时的触觉数据集。
AI.conclusion: TACROSS 通过接触事件层面的触觉对齐与机器人 grounded 策略学习，有效桥接人机触觉异构性，为从人类触觉演示中可扩展地学习机器人操作提供了低成本、高效率方案，并推动开源数据与系统共享。

title: Why machines will still not rule the world
summary: In our book Why machines will never rule the world [13, 14] we argue that arti- ficial general intelligence is mathematically impossible. This is because the human beings and the processes which exhibit intelligence are complex systems whose be- haviour cannot be captured by the kinds of models that we can generate with or without computers. Proponents of contemporary machine intelligence respond with two lines of argument: a theoretical one, grounded in the universal approximation theorems for neural networks and the Church-Turing-Deutsch principle; and an em- pirical one, grounded in rapidly rising scores on standardized benchmarks. In this communication we examine and reject both responses. First, we show serious issues in the physicalist counter-argument based on the Church-Turing-Deutsch principle. Second, we review recent evidence to the effect that prominent benchmarks are compromised by training-data contamination, flawed test construction, and strate- gic optimization. Our central argument remains: That models required to perform cognitive behaviour in open-ended, thermodynamically complex and non-ergodic environments are not and will not become achievable.

AI.tldr: 本文论证通用人工智能在数学上不可能，并驳斥支持者基于神经网络通用逼近定理、Church-Turing-Deutsch原理及基准分数上升的两类反驳。
AI.motivation: 作者认为人类智能是复杂系统，其行为无法被可计算模型捕捉；当代机器智能支持者提出理论性与经验性反驳，因此需要检验并拒绝这些反驳。
AI.method: 进行概念与理论分析，批判基于Church-Turing-Deutsch原理的物理主义论证；并审查近期证据，指出主流基准存在训练数据污染、测试设计缺陷和策略性优化问题。
AI.result: 发现Church-Turing-Deutsch反驳存在严重问题；同时，主流基准因数据污染与优化而不可靠，不能作为AGI进展的有效证据。
AI.conclusion: 在开放式、热力学复杂且非遍历的环境中执行认知行为所需的模型无法实现，未来也不会实现，因此通用人工智能不可能。

title: V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities but suffer from substantial computational overhead, as vision tokens dominate the input sequence. This motivates vision token compression as a key direction to alleviate the burden. However, with the emergence of hybrid architectures incorporating linear attention (\eg, Qwen3.5), prior methods designed for softmax attention struggle to generalize. Our analysis reveals that both attention- and similarity-based approaches suffer notable performance degradation, underscoring the urgent need for compression methods tailored to this regime. To this end, we propose \textbf{V-CoLA}, an efficient training-free token compression framework specifically designed for linear attention. V-CoLA introduces a novel \textit{uniqueness-aware importance criterion} for identifying critical vision tokens, coupled with an \textit{adaptive token merging strategy} that performs compression. All components are optimized at the implementation level to remain compatible with the chunk-wise parallelism of linear attention, ensuring strong practical value. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of V-CoLA: it achieves 99.5\% of the original performance with only 50.0\% of vision tokens, and over 88.0\% with as few as 12.5\%, while delivering a 1.86$\times$ to 6.15$\times$ prefill speedup.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 V-CoLA，一种面向线性注意力视觉语言模型的免训练视觉 token 压缩框架，在显著减少视觉 token 的同时保持性能并加速推理。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型中视觉 token 主导输入序列，带来较大计算开销；现有面向 softmax 注意力的压缩方法难以泛化到 Qwen3.5 等线性注意力混合架构，且注意力与相似度方法均出现明显性能下降。
AI.method: 提出 V-CoLA：包含独特性感知的重要性准则用于识别关键视觉 token，以及自适应 token 合并策略用于压缩；同时在实现层面适配线性注意力的分块并行，保持实用性。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，V-CoLA 仅用 50.0% 视觉 token 即可达到原性能的 99.5%，用 12.5% 时仍超过 88.0%，并实现 1.86× 至 6.15× 的 prefill 加速。
AI.conclusion: V-CoLA 是针对线性注意力混合视觉语言模型的有效免训练 token 压缩方案，能兼顾性能保持与推理效率，具有较强实际应用价值。

title: Probing for Long-Horizon Deductive Reasoning Capabilities in Language Models with Prolog
summary: Current frontier LLMs can theoretically process long contexts with 1M tokens or more. But to what extent can they go beyond simple retrieval and perform deeper reasoning over such long contexts? We empirically investigate long-horizon reasoning capabilities of LLMs, focusing on deductive logic expressed in Prolog. We construct ProloNg, a synthetic testbed to probe Prolog Long Reasoning, which systematically varies the complexity (reasoning depth) of problems, where the hardest case has a reasoning depth of 22 and 62k context length. We study 8 reasoning models across 5 families of frontier LLMs, and find that performance degrades substantially as reasoning depth grows, with the majority of models approaching chance beyond depth 10.

AI.tldr: 该论文实证研究大语言模型在长上下文中的长程推理能力，构建 Prolog 演绎逻辑测试集 ProloNg，发现随着推理深度增加，模型性能大幅下降，多数模型在深度超过 10 后接近随机猜测。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿 LLM 理论上可处理 100 万 token 以上的长上下文，但尚不清楚它们能否超越简单检索，在长上下文中进行更深层的推理，因此需要系统评估其长程推理能力。
AI.method: 构建合成测试平台 ProloNg，用于探测 Prolog 长程推理，系统变化问题复杂度（推理深度），最难案例推理深度达 22、上下文长度达 62k；评估 8 个推理模型，覆盖 5 个前沿 LLM 家族。
AI.result: 随着推理深度增加，模型性能显著下降；多数模型在推理深度超过 10 后表现接近随机猜测。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 在长上下文中的长程演绎推理能力仍有限，尤其难以应对高推理深度任务，距离稳定进行复杂长上下文推理仍有明显差距。

title: LR-V2X: Loss-Resilient Collaborative Perception under Low-Bandwidth Communication
summary: Given the inherent unpredictability of packet loss in vehicular wireless communications, V2X collaborative perception can yield practical benefits only if agents can achieve reliable collaboration under lossy and low-bandwidth communication conditions. Existing dense BEV feature fusion methods depend on redundant BEV feature exchange, which is infeasible in low-bandwidth scenarios, while compact-communication methods aggressively compress messages but can hardly recover the missing feature content after packet loss. In this paper, we present LR-V2X, a loss-resilient, latent-space reconstruction framework that converts corrupted received latents (even under severe 90% packet loss) into a spatial prior and then reconstructs the missing BEV information from this informative prior and using ego context as condition. Notably, the model can be trained under complete communication conditions and can be directly applied to lossy conditions at test time, eliminating the need for training under numerous lossy conditions. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and V2XREAL show that LR-V2X delivers the strongest robustness under severe packet loss and preserves reliable collaboration as communication quality degrades. And it reduces communication overhead by $64\times$ compared to dense BEV feature fusion baselines. Code will be released at https://github.com/sidiangongyuan/LR-V2X.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LR-V2X，一种面向 V2X 协同感知的丢包鲁棒潜在空间重建框架，可在严重丢包和低带宽条件下恢复缺失的 BEV 信息。
AI.motivation: 车载无线通信中的丢包不可避免，现有密集 BEV 特征融合依赖冗余特征交换，难以适用于低带宽场景；紧凑通信方法虽能压缩消息，但在丢包后难以恢复缺失特征内容。
AI.method: LR-V2X 将受损的接收潜在特征（即使在 90% 严重丢包下）转换为空间先验，并以自车上下文为条件，从该先验中重建缺失的 BEV 信息；模型可在完整通信条件下训练，并直接用于测试时的有损条件。
AI.result: 在 DAIR-V2X 和 V2XREAL 数据集上，LR-V2X 在严重丢包下表现出最强鲁棒性，并在通信质量下降时仍保持可靠协作；相比密集 BEV 特征融合基线，通信开销降低 64 倍。
AI.conclusion: LR-V2X 能够在低带宽和严重丢包条件下实现可靠的 V2X 协同感知，且无需在大量有损条件下进行训练。

title: Measuring Cultural Alignment Beyond the Average: A Framework for Evaluating Maternal-Health LLM Interactions in Indian Contexts
summary: Existing evaluation methods for healthcare LLMs primarily assess factual correctness,safety, and fluency, while providing limited insight into whether generated interactions reflect culturally situated healthcare reasoning. This limitation is particularly important in maternal health, where care decisions are shaped by social and relational norms. We introduce MH-INDIC, a culturally grounded evaluation framework for maternal-health interactions in urban and semi-urban North Indian contexts that operationalises cultural behaviour through ten dimensions of maternal-health reasoning. Using a 26-item survey administered to 102 pregnant and postpartum women from urban and semi-urban North India, we evaluate ten LLMs. We distinguish population level cultural alignment from profile-level behavioural variation. Although several models approximate the human population-level distribution, all evaluated systems exhibit substantially lower variation across demographic and household profiles than the human cohort, revealing a gap between aggregate alignment and profile-conditioned sensitivity. As a downstream application of MH-INDIC, we use the strongest-aligned proprietary and open-source models to generate culturally conditioned maternal-health dialogues under zero-shot, self-conditioned, and human-grounded prompting. Human-grounded conditioning produces stronger profile alignment and dialogue quality ratings, suggesting that measured cultural profiles can improve the cultural grounding of generated interactions

AI.tldr: 提出MH-INDIC，一个面向北印度城市与半城市孕产妇健康交互的文化接地评估框架，通过十个维度、102名孕产妇的26项调查评估十个LLM。结果显示模型群体层面接近人类分布，但个体与家庭画像层面的行为变异明显不足；使用人类接地条件可提升文化对齐与对话质量。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗LLM评估主要关注事实正确性、安全性和流畅度，难以判断其交互是否体现文化情境中的医疗推理。孕产妇保健决策受社会与关系规范影响显著，因此需要文化接地的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建MH-INDIC框架，将孕产妇健康推理中的文化行为操作化为十个维度；对北印度城市与半城市102名孕产妇进行26项调查；评估十个LLM；区分群体层文化对齐与画像层行为变异；并使用最强对齐的闭源与开源模型，在零样本、自条件和人类接地提示下生成文化条件对话。
AI.result: 若干模型可近似人类群体层面的分布，但所有被评估系统在人口与家庭画像上的变异都显著低于人类队列，揭示总体对齐与画像条件敏感性之间的差距。下游应用中，人类接地条件带来更强的画像对齐和更高的对话质量评分。
AI.conclusion: MH-INDIC能够揭示医疗LLM文化对齐中更深层的不足。测量得到的文化画像有助于改善生成交互的文化接地，尤其是通过人类接地条件进行提示时效果更好。

title: Tell Robot What Not to Do: A Negation Understanding Perspective
summary: Instruction following enables robots to perform diverse tasks specified in natural language, making it a fundamental capability for human-robot interaction. Beyond communicating desired outcomes, users also need to specify constraints on what not to do. We investigate how to enable vision-language-action models (VLAs) to follow negated instructions, where robots must accomplish task goals while respecting explicit exclusions. To this end, we propose NegaAlign, a parameter-efficient, plug-and-play framework that extends pretrained VLAs to follow negated instructions through image-language supervision alone. Specifically, we introduce Negation Transformation Layers into selected layers of the vision-language backbone to reshape intermediate instruction representations. Meanwhile, a teacher-guided alignment mechanism is designed to align instruction-relevant visual tokens, transferring action-relevant grounding from instructions that satisfy the negated constraint. The training phase uses supervision constructed from existing demonstrations and updates only the inserted layers, keeping all pretrained parameters frozen, including the action generator. We further introduce NegaBench, a simulation benchmark spanning 10 scenarios across five domains for systematically evaluating manipulation under negated constraints. Experiments across GR00T, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements in negated instruction following. With 11.6M trainable parameters, NegaAlign increases the negated-instruction success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 2.60% to 88.45% on NegaBench and from 12.4% to 88.8% on real-world tasks, while retaining performance on affirmative instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出 NegaAlign，一种参数高效、即插即用的框架，使预训练视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）能够遵循否定指令，并引入 NegaBench 基准进行系统评估。
AI.motivation: 在自然人机交互中，机器人不仅需要理解用户期望完成的任务，还需要遵守“不要做某事”的约束。现有 VLA 对否定指令的遵循能力较弱，因此需要研究如何让机器人在完成任务目标的同时尊重明确排除条件。
AI.method: NegaAlign 仅通过图像-语言监督扩展预训练 VLA。它在视觉-语言骨干的选定层中插入 Negation Transformation Layers，以重塑中间指令表示；同时设计教师引导对齐机制，对齐与指令相关的视觉 token，从满足否定约束的指令中迁移动作相关 grounding。训练仅更新插入层，所有预训练参数（包括动作生成器）保持冻结。论文还提出 NegaBench 仿真基准，覆盖 5 个领域、10 个场景。
AI.result: 在 GR00T、π0 和 π0.5 上实验均显示否定指令遵循能力一致提升。NegaAlign 仅有 11.6M 可训练参数，使 π0.5 在 NegaBench 上的否定指令成功率从 2.60% 提升到 88.45%，在真实世界任务上从 12.4% 提升到 88.8%，同时保持肯定指令性能。
AI.conclusion: NegaAlign 能以参数高效、即插即用的方式显著增强 VLA 对否定指令的遵循能力，并在仿真与真实任务中验证有效性，同时不损害原有肯定指令表现。

title: SpikeSSL: A Universal Spike Inference Framework with Dynamics-Informed State-Space Layers
summary: Two-photon calcium imaging is a standard tool for recording large neural populations in vivo, yet inferring spikes accurately across the growing diversity of calcium indicators remains an open problem. Existing supervised methods achieve reasonable in-domain accuracy but generalize poorly to unseen indicators, because different indicators induce distinct fluorescence kinetics and signal statistics while existing architectures remain relatively simple generic temporal regressors without dynamics-matched inductive bias. We propose SpikeSSL, a universal spike inference framework whose temporal backbone is a bank of bidirectional IIR state-space layers broadly motivated by calcium dynamics. A multi-modal conditioning encoder maps indicator identity, sampling rate, and trace-level signal statistics into a global conditioning vector that modulates the backbone via Adaptive Layer Normalization, while a heteroscedastic variance head provides calibrated per-frame uncertainty. On a benchmark with five fixed evaluation splits built from 33 public ground-truth datasets, SpikeSSL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and zero-shot leave-one-indicator-out settings. We also develop a biophysical simulation pipeline capable of generating paired fluorescence-spike traces with systematically varied kinetic parameters, spike statistics, response nonlinearities, baseline drift, and noise. Using this pipeline, we synthesize approximately 11,000 simulated traces. Augmenting training with these data effectively closes the cross-indicator domain gap and improves zero-shot generalization. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/detimage123/SpikeSSL.

AI.tldr: 提出SpikeSSL，一种通用钙成像脉冲推断框架，利用受钙动力学启发的双向IIR状态空间层骨干，结合多模态条件编码与异方差不确定性估计，并在33个公开数据集上取得域内和零样本跨指示剂的最优性能，同时通过约1.1万条生物物理模拟轨迹增强训练以缩小跨指示剂域差距。
AI.motivation: 双光子钙成像广泛用于记录大规模神经群体，但跨多种钙指示剂的脉冲推断仍具挑战。现有监督方法域内精度尚可，却因不同指示剂具有不同的荧光动力学和信号统计，而现有架构多为简单通用时间回归器，缺乏与动力学匹配的归纳偏置，导致泛化到未见指示剂时表现差。
AI.method: 提出SpikeSSL框架：时间骨干为受钙动力学启发的双向IIR状态空间层组；多模态条件编码器将指示剂身份、采样率和轨迹级信号统计映射为全局条件向量，通过自适应层归一化调制骨干；异方差方差头提供逐帧校准不确定性。另开发生物物理模拟流程，生成具有系统变化动力学参数、脉冲统计、响应非线性、基线漂移和噪声的配对荧光-脉冲轨迹，合成约11000条模拟轨迹用于训练增强。
AI.result: 在由33个公开真实数据集构建的五个固定评估划分基准上，SpikeSSL在域内和零样本留一指示剂设置中均达到最先进性能。使用模拟数据增强训练能有效弥合跨指示剂域差距并提升零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SpikeSSL是一个通用且有效的脉冲推断框架，通过动力学匹配的架构和模拟数据增强，显著提升了跨指示剂的泛化性能，代码已公开。

title: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
summary: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August 2026. We then trained detectors under maintenance scenarios ranging from a detector retrained on every new version to one trained once and never updated. Detectors trained only on a vendor's past versions can collapse at the boundaries between model generations: calibrated to falsely flag 1% of human-written abstracts, they catch above 99% of rewrites just before the sharpest boundary and 3.8% just after it. Detectors trained on later versions can also miss rewrites of earlier ones. Vocabulary differences between versions largely track where detection transfers and where it fails. In the two screening scenarios we simulated, screens covering all 23 versions either flagged one in eight human-written abstracts or missed one in three rewrites of the newest version. Indeed, a commercial detector missed most rewrites of the version just after the sharpest boundary while flagging almost no human-written abstracts. Research-integrity policy should therefore treat the benchmark accuracy of a detector as provisional, to be re-verified with every LLM release, including earlier versions.

AI.tldr: 研究量化了大语言模型版本快速更替对科学稿件AI文本筛查可靠性的影响，发现检测器跨版本性能极不稳定，需持续重新验证。
AI.motivation: 期刊和会议已开始用LLM检测器筛查投稿，但现有基准评估基于固定LLM版本，而实际使用的模型版本不断更新，检测可靠性存疑。
AI.method: 将PNAS的4000篇ChatGPT前摘要与23个LLM版本（三家厂商，2023年6月至2026年8月发布）的重写配对，并在从每个新版本都重训到从不更新的不同维护场景下训练检测器，分析跨版本检测迁移及词汇差异。
AI.result: 检测器在模型代际边界会崩溃：校准为1%人类摘要误报时，边界前捕获超99%重写，边界后仅捕获3.8%；后版本训练的检测器也会漏检早版本重写。模拟筛查中，覆盖23个版本的方案要么误报1/8人类摘要，要么漏检1/3最新版本重写；商业检测器漏检边界后版本大多数重写，同时几乎不误报人类摘要。
AI.conclusion: 检测器的基准准确率只是暂时性的，应随每次LLM发布（包括旧版本）重新验证，科研诚信政策需据此调整。

title: Tracing the Thoughts of a Coding Agent Playing ARC-AGI-3: Lessons for Continual Learning
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents (CL4FMAgents)
summary: We study how a coding agent learns across a sequence of abstract reasoning tasks. The agent runs on a frozen foundation model inside a fixed harness and acts by writing and running Python and shell scripts. It retains no state across turns other than its written artifacts, so every thought it forms, carries, corrects or abandons leaves a trace, where a thought is any belief, rule or plan committed to a file. We let the agent play ARC-AGI-3, a set of interactive reasoning games that provide no instructions. Each game is a sequence of levels, and a strategy that clears one level can fail on the next, so every new level is in effect a new task. The agent records what it learns as Python scripts and text notes, while the harness keeps a complete log of every action and observation. Our contribution is a measurement protocol that traces each thought through these files, from the task where it forms to the task where it is corrected or abandoned, applied to seven evaluation runs with three backbones from two model families. Scripts written for one task are almost never called again in a later task (33 of 630 references cross a task boundary), because most scripts embed the state of the current level. Instead, the agent rewrites its knowledge into new scripts, keeping the general rules and dropping the level-specific details, and abandons 74% of the scripts it wrote before a boundary. The notes, which only the model reads, are never revised: the agent appends without removing earlier claims, and the contradictions that accumulate are settled against the log. Because the log preserves everything, the agent forgets selectively, not catastrophically. The most costly error is a hard-coded value carried into a task where it no longer holds. These findings come from the files the agent wrote, without access to the model, and constitute a white-box analysis of how a coding agent continually learns.

AI.tldr: 研究编码智能体在抽象推理任务序列中如何持续学习，提出通过其写入文件追踪每个“想法”形成、修正或放弃的测量协议，并在 ARC-AGI-3 的七次评估、三种骨干和两个模型家族上验证。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体仅靠最终表现难以揭示其内部知识如何跨任务保留、修正和放弃，因此需要一种无需访问模型、仅分析其产物和日志的白盒方法来理解持续学习过程。
AI.method: 智能体运行在冻结基础模型和固定 harness 中，通过编写和执行 Python、shell 脚本行动，除写入产物外不保留状态；在无指令的 ARC-AGI-3 交互推理游戏上评估。提出测量协议，将任何提交到文件中的信念、规则或计划视为 thought，并追踪其在脚本和文本笔记中的形成、跨任务引用、修正与放弃；统计七次运行、三个骨干、两个模型家族，并记录所有动作和观察。
AI.result: 脚本跨任务复用极少，630 次引用中仅 33 次跨任务边界；边界前 74% 的脚本被放弃。多数脚本嵌入当前关卡状态，因此智能体重写知识，保留通用规则、丢弃关卡细节。笔记只由模型读取且从不修订，只追加不删除，矛盾最终依据日志解决。由于日志保留一切，智能体表现为选择性遗忘而非灾难性遗忘；最昂贵的错误是硬编码值被带入不再成立的新任务。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体通过不断重写脚本、保留通用规则并选择性遗忘来实现持续学习；该研究仅基于智能体写下的文件，构成一种无需访问模型的白盒分析。

title: Spatial-Frequency-Aware Implicit Neural Representation of Multidimensional Signals via MLP-KAN Fusion
summary: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged as a compelling paradigm for modeling multidimensional signals by mapping continuous coordinates to signal values. However, Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP)-based INRs inherently suffer from spectral bias, which favors low-frequency components and suppresses the reconstruction of essential high-frequency details. While existing techniques, such as Fourier feature mappings, mitigate this issue, they often rely on sensitive manual tuning and are prone to spectral artifacts. In this paper, we propose a spatial-frequency-aware INR framework that combines an MLP branch with a Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) branch for complementary frequency-oriented modeling. The MLP branch provides a low-frequency-oriented representation of smooth structures, whereas the KAN branch complements localized variations and fine details. To coordinate the two branches, we integrate the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and inverse discrete wavelet transform (IDWT) into the output fusion stage. The outputs of the two branches are decomposed into wavelet coefficients, and the corresponding coefficients are additively fused before inverse wavelet reconstruction. A wavelet-domain band-separation regularization further penalizes high-frequency responses in the MLP branch and low-frequency responses in the KAN branch, thereby encouraging complementary frequency-oriented behavior. Experiments on 1D signals, 2D images, 3D volumes and signed distance functions, videos, and 4D light-fields demonstrate the applicability of the proposed representation across the evaluated signal modalities. Results demonstrate improved reconstruction fidelity across the evaluated signal modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种空间频率感知的隐式神经表示框架，将MLP分支与KAN分支结合，并在输出融合阶段利用离散小波变换及其逆变换进行互补频率建模，以缓解MLP固有的频谱偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 基于MLP的隐式神经表示存在频谱偏差，倾向于低频而抑制高频细节。现有傅里叶特征映射等方法虽可缓解，但依赖敏感的手动调参且易产生频谱伪影，因此需要更稳健的频率感知建模方式。
AI.method: 提出双分支INR框架：MLP分支负责低频平滑结构，KAN分支负责局部变化与细粒度细节。通过DWT将两分支输出分解为小波系数，在对应系数上加性融合后进行IDWT重建。同时引入小波域频带分离正则化，惩罚MLP分支的高频响应和KAN分支的低频响应，促使两分支形成互补的频率行为。
AI.result: 在1D信号、2D图像、3D体数据与符号距离函数、视频以及4D光场等任务上进行了实验，结果表明该方法在所评估的信号模态中均提升了重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的空间频率感知INR框架能够有效协调MLP与KAN的互补频率建模，缓解频谱偏差，并在多种信号模态上展现出良好的适用性与重建性能。

title: From Chain-of-Thought to Loops: Non-Autoregressive Latent Reasoning via Looped Transformers
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning often improves language-model performance by giving models additional computation before answering. However, explicit CoT expresses this computation as a sequence of autoregressively generated tokens. Latent reasoning replaces these tokens with compact continuous states, but most autoregressive latent-reasoning methods retain a left-to-right dependency among latent vectors. We introduce LLoCoT: a looped latent-reasoning framework that replaces left-to-right latent generation with iterative refinement of a compact latent workspace. A shared transformer is reapplied for a small number of refinement iterations, jointly updating the latent slots based on the prompt and the evolving workspace state. Using the refined state, a probabilistic head predicts a distribution from which latent tokens are sampled in parallel and used to condition an autoregressive decoder for answer generation. Training uses continuous representations derived from explicit CoT together with a final-answer prediction loss and likelihood-based supervision of the latent states. Across HumanEval and MBPP, LLoCoT achieves the highest mean among the evaluated methods, performing on par in accuracy with Reasoning SFT, our explicit-CoT baseline, while outperforming the base model, answer-only SFT and NF-CoT. Relative to Reasoning SFT, LLoCoT reduces time to the first answer token by approximately $36\times$ and reasoning-phase latency by approximately $42\times$, while increasing end-to-end throughput by $9.2\%$. This design replaces serial thought generation with parallel latent-slot refinement while retaining probabilistic latent modeling and autoregressive answer decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出 LLoCoT，一种循环式潜在推理框架，用对紧凑潜在工作区的迭代精炼替代从左到右的潜在向量生成，并通过概率头并行采样潜在 token 来条件化自回归解码器生成答案。
AI.motivation: 显式思维链虽能提升语言模型性能，但需要自回归生成大量推理 token；现有潜在推理方法虽更紧凑，却大多仍保留潜在向量间的从左到右依赖，未充分发挥并行精炼优势。
AI.method: LLoCoT 使用共享 Transformer 对潜在工作区进行少量迭代精炼，联合根据提示和演化状态更新潜在槽位；随后概率头预测分布并并行采样潜在 token，用于条件化自回归解码器生成答案。训练时结合显式 CoT 得到的连续表示、最终答案预测损失以及潜在状态似然监督。
AI.result: 在 HumanEval 和 MBPP 上，LLoCoT 取得所评估方法中的最高均值，准确率与显式 CoT 基线 Reasoning SFT 相当，并优于基础模型、仅答案 SFT 和 NF-CoT。相比 Reasoning SFT，首个答案 token 时间约减少 36 倍，推理阶段延迟约减少 42 倍，端到端吞吐量提升 9.2%。
AI.conclusion: LLoCoT 以并行潜在槽位精炼取代串行思维生成，同时保留概率潜在建模和自回归答案解码，在保持准确率的同时显著提升推理效率。

title: UXBench Pro: Benchmarking Personalized User Experience in Multi-Turn Dialogue Interactions
summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) with automated computational methods has gained increasing attention, supported by empirical evidence from UXBench. However, binary preference prediction provides limited insight, while relying on a single user-agnostic reward model overlooks the inherent heterogeneity of users, whose expectations can differ substantially. In this paper, we present UXBench Pro, comprising 1{,}000 test instances derived from real user interactions across 12 task scenarios and 82 domains. Each instance is paired with a FACTORS user profile that characterizes the user through seven interpretable behavioral facets, differentiating user groups. To provide richer evaluation insights, we introduce a dual-perspective paradigm that combines a personalized User Reward Model (URM) for third-person judgment with Sim4Eval, a user simulator that enables multi-turn interactions and provides first-person evaluation across four cognitive state dimensions. To assess the reliability of these based evaluators, we further introduce two meta-benchmarks, URMBench and USimBench, that evaluate how faithfully they reproduce real human preferences and behaviors. Extensive experiments reveal seven key findings that highlight the importance of user modeling and multi-perspective evaluation, offering a fresh perspective on user-centric benchmarking and motivating personalized model optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UXBench Pro，包含来自 12 类任务场景、82 个领域的 1000 个真实用户交互测试实例，并配有 FACTORS 用户画像。其核心是引入双视角评估范式：个性化用户奖励模型（URM）进行第三人称判断，Sim4Eval 用户模拟器支持多轮交互并从四个认知状态维度进行第一人称评估。还提出 URMBench 和 USimBench 两个元基准，用于评估评估器再现真实人类偏好与行为的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化 UX 评估方法多依赖二值偏好预测，信息有限；同时，仅使用与用户无关的单一奖励模型忽略了用户群体的异质性，不同用户的期望可能差异很大。
AI.method: 构建 UXBench Pro：1000 个测试实例，覆盖 12 个任务场景和 82 个领域，来自真实用户交互。每个实例配有一个 FACTORS 用户画像，用七个可解释行为侧面刻画用户并区分用户群体。提出双视角评估范式：个性化 User Reward Model（URM）做第三人称判断，Sim4Eval 用户模拟器支持多轮交互并从四个认知状态维度做第一人称评估。提出 URMBench 和 USimBench 两个元基准，评估上述评估器复现真实人类偏好与行为的忠实度。
AI.result: 大量实验揭示了七项关键发现，强调用户建模和多视角评估的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为用户中心基准测试提供了新视角，并推动个性化模型优化。

title: When Scene Text Hijacks the Scene: Uncovering, Exploiting, and Mitigating Rendered-Text Semantic Leakage in Image Generation Models
comment: To appear in the 2027 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE S&P 2027)
summary: The reliability and accountability of image generative models (IGMs) are essential for building responsible and trustworthy AI systems. Recent IGMs, such as Nano Banana and GPT-Image, now support complex instruction following, realistic image synthesis, and controllable scene-text rendering. As these capabilities expand, safety analysis must also account for new control channels introduced by complex prompts. In this work, we study rendered-text semantic leakage, a largely overlooked phenomenon in open-domain text rendering. Although rendered text is intended to serve as a local visual constraint that should be reproduced verbatim in the generated image, it also carries linguistic semantics that may be interpreted by the model as part of the input instruction. This makes rendered text a potential semantic control channel whose safety implications remain insufficiently understood. We systematically characterize this phenomenon by decoupling the main visual prompt from the rendered text and measuring their individual and compositional effects on generated images. We quantify semantic leakage and rendering fidelity, and further analyze how leakage emerges from intermediate model evidence. We then show that harmful semantics embedded in scene text can persist through LLM-based prompt enhancement pipelines and steer non-text image regions, even when the main visual prompt remains benign. Finally, we propose a preliminary mitigation approach that reduces unsafe semantic transfer from rendered text to non-text regions while preserving the intended text-rendering behavior on FLUX-2-dev. Our findings reveal rendered text as a dual-use carrier of visible data and latent semantics, exposing a text-centric cross-modal attack surface in modern IGMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图像生成模型中的“渲染文本语义泄漏”现象：场景中渲染的文本除作为局部视觉约束外，其语言语义还可能被模型当作输入指令，成为潜在的安全控制通道。
AI.motivation: 图像生成模型的可靠性与问责性对可信AI至关重要。近期模型（如Nano Banana、GPT-Image）支持复杂指令跟随、逼真图像合成和可控场景文本渲染，这引入了新的控制通道，但渲染文本的语义泄漏及其安全影响尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 将主视觉提示与渲染文本解耦，测量二者单独及组合对生成图像的影响；量化语义泄漏与渲染保真度；分析中间模型证据中泄漏的产生机制；测试基于LLM的提示增强流程中危害语义的持续性与对非文本区域的影响；提出初步缓解方法并在FLUX-2-dev上验证。
AI.result: 有害语义嵌入场景文本后，即使主视觉提示无害，也能通过LLM提示增强流程持续存在并引导非文本图像区域；所提缓解方法能减少从渲染文本到非文本区域的不安全语义转移，同时保留预期的文本渲染行为。
AI.conclusion: 渲染文本是可见数据与潜在语义的双重用途载体，暴露了现代图像生成模型中以文本为中心的跨模态攻击面。

title: Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning for Temporally Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: A generated video of a task the robot is about to perform is useful guidance only if it depicts the phase the robot is actually in. We show that temporal misalignment can turn a task-consistent generated future into actively harmful guidance. On CALVIN, a five-frame early shift nearly erases the benefit of generated futures, reducing success from 81.3% to 54.8% against 54.0% without futures; imposed timing shifts reduce it even further to 34.2%, 19.8 points below the future-free policy. We introduce Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning (RAFC), which treats this as a control problem rather than a generation problem. At every step, RAFC estimates how far to trust the received clip and which nearby temporal hypothesis to prefer, falling back toward a static branch when neither fits, and it learns both from task reward alone without shift labels or alignment supervision. RAFC sits on top of Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), which builds the clip once from task grounding, a robot-free digital-twin rollout, and mask-free video diffusion. Under deliberately off-grid phase shifts and rate mismatch, RAFC substantially improves success under temporal mismatch. Candidate ensembling accounts for most of the recovery near alignment, while learned reliability adds a further 7.0 percentage points over uniform averaging of the identical candidate bank under off-grid shifts. The gain holds on the evaluated task sets and survives on a Franka under natural timing mismatch nobody imposed, where aggregate success rises from 26.7% to 56.7%. All resources will be made publicly available. https://future-condition.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 论文指出生成未来视频只有在与机器人实际执行阶段时序对齐时才有用，时序错位会使指导变得有害；为此提出 Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning (RAFC)，在时序不匹配下可靠选择和使用生成未来，显著提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 生成视频作为机器人任务指导，必须描绘机器人当前所处阶段；若存在时间错位，即使任务一致，生成的未来也可能从有益变为有害。CALVIN 上五帧提前偏移几乎抹去生成未来的收益，强制时序偏移甚至低于不使用未来。
AI.method: RAFC 将未来条件化视为控制问题而非生成问题。每一步估计对收到的视频片段的信任程度，并选择更合适的时间假设；若二者都不匹配，则回退到静态分支。RAFC 仅从任务奖励学习，不需要位移标签或对齐监督，并构建在 FEC 之上。FEC 通过任务 grounding、无机器人数字孪生 rollout 和无掩码视频扩散一次性生成视频片段。
AI.result: CALVIN 上五帧提前偏移使成功率从 81.3% 降至 54.8%，而无未来为 54.0%；强制时序偏移进一步降至 34.2%，比无未来策略低 19.8 个百分点。RAFC 在离网相位偏移和速率不匹配下显著提升成功率。候选集成贡献了接近对齐时的大部分恢复，而学习到的可靠性在离网偏移下比同一候选库的均匀平均额外提升 7.0 个百分点。在 Franka 上面对自然发生的时序不匹配时，总成功率从 26.7% 提升到 56.7%。
AI.conclusion: 时序对齐是生成未来能否有效指导机器人的关键。RAFC 通过可靠性感知的未来条件控制，在无需对齐监督的情况下稳健利用生成未来，并在评估任务集及真实时序不匹配场景中有效。

title: REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026 as Spotlight. Project page: https://react-vla.github.io
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出REACT，一种滚动去噪框架，使基于流的VLA模型在保持长时程上下文的同时更具反应性，通过维持带交错流时间步的持久动作缓冲区，实现高频重规划与平滑执行的平衡。
AI.motivation: 基于流的VLA模型通过生成动作块实现时间连贯的机器人运动，但分块控制存在闭环权衡：长动作块执行平滑但反应性差，频繁重规划提高反应性却导致动作不连续。
AI.method: REACT维护持久动作缓冲区并采用交错流时间步：每步用最新观测对整个horizon去噪，执行最干净的动作块，将部分精炼的未来块前移，并在尾部追加新噪声。同时引入双解耦，分离感知、VLM编码、DiT去噪与动作执行，支持实时控制。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0仿真基准及多机器人平台的双臂操作和动态控制真实任务中，REACT相比频繁重规划和异步基线提高了任务成功率，降低了反应延迟，并产生更平滑的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: REACT通过滚动去噪和双解耦，有效解决了流式VLA模型在长时程平滑性与闭环反应性之间的权衡，使执行的动作块在部署前经过多个近期观测的精炼，实现了实时、平滑且反应灵敏的机器人控制。

title: Predicting Cable Dynamics with Physical Attention Bias
summary: Learned simulators for deformable linear objects (DLOs) such as cables have to predict the motion of cables they were not trained on and stay stable over long rollouts. Most of their error occurs where the cable touches itself or the floor. Attention over all pairs of cable segments can represent contact between parts of the cable that are far apart along its length, but attention has no notion of geometry. A cable has two pairwise distances, which agree only while it is straight: the arc-length distance along the cable, which governs elastic forces, and the Euclidean distance in space, which governs contact. We add a physical attention bias, an additive term on the attention logits with a learned rate, and ask which distance it should use. We compare no bias, each distance alone, and both distances on disjoint sets of heads, keeping the rest of the model and the training protocol fixed. A physical bias improves prediction on unseen cables. The gain is largest when attention is the only mechanism that connects distant segments: there, the arc-length bias reduces prediction error by 15% and more than halves the drift in segment length. The Euclidean bias alone stays close to unbiased attention, while assigning both distances across heads is best or near-best on every metric we report. Code and per-run records: https://github.com/avihaig/dlogps.

AI.tldr: 论文研究可变形线状物体（如线缆）的学习模拟器，针对自接触和地面接触误差，在注意力logits中加入物理注意力偏置，比较弧长距离与欧氏距离的作用。结果表明物理偏置能提升未见线缆预测，弧长偏置在仅靠注意力连接远距离段时降低15%误差并大幅减少段长漂移，两种距离分头使用最佳或接近最佳。
AI.motivation: DLO模拟器需要预测未训练线缆的运动并在长期rollout中保持稳定，但误差多出现在线缆自接触或接触地面处。注意力可连接沿长度相距很远但空间上接触的段，却没有几何概念。线缆存在弧长距离（控制弹性力）和欧氏距离（控制接触），因此需要探究注意力应使用哪种距离。
AI.method: 在注意力logits上加入物理注意力偏置（带可学习速率），并比较无偏置、单独使用弧长距离、单独使用欧氏距离，以及在不同注意力头上分别使用两种距离的方案，同时保持模型其余部分和训练协议不变。
AI.result: 物理偏置改善了未见线缆上的预测。当注意力是连接远距离段的唯一机制时，弧长偏置将预测误差降低15%，并将段长漂移减少一半以上。单独欧氏偏置的表现接近无偏置注意力。将两种距离分配到不同头上时，在所有报告指标上最佳或接近最佳。
AI.conclusion: 在DLO学习模拟器的注意力中引入物理距离偏置是有效的；弧长距离对弹性力和段长稳定性尤其重要，而弧长与欧氏距离具有互补性，将二者分头使用最为稳健。

title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: We changed the agent: did it actually get better? Every self-improving agent loop answers this hundreds of times, and every answer comes from a verifier. On open-ended tasks none exists, so the loop is handed a hand-written rubric or a bare LLM judge grading output from a model like itself, inviting reward hacking and shared blind spots. We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs, never for the agent's score. On MBPP+ it gains +0.21 held-out agreement over the hand-authored seed composition, on every seed, and ends ahead of the bare LLM judge it contains. One finding should change how co-evolved verifiers are validated: removing the anchor guards collapses the verifier into a vacuous always-pass grader, yet that collapsed verifier trains skills just as well. Downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier. Score does answer sufficiency, and there an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift that ground truth or a rubric buys the same loop, across code generation, enterprise text-to-SQL, and reference-free report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an outer judge caught it and one added detector repaired it; the judge itself was wrong until given the task contract.

AI.tldr: 论文把自改进智能体中的验证器本身作为进化对象：用由失败聚类合成、可检查的小型确定性缺陷检测器表达式来构建验证器，并依据锚定参考集一致性和无标签共识来筛选，而不是依据智能体分数。
AI.motivation: 自改进循环每次都要问“智能体变好了吗”，答案来自验证器；但开放式任务没有现成验证器，只能用手写评分标准或裸LLM评判来给同类模型打分，这会招致奖励黑客与共同盲点。
AI.method: 让验证器成为进化对象：它是关于小型、大多确定性缺陷检测器的可检查表达式，由聚类失败合成，出生时设门控；选择标准是与十项锚定参考集的一致性和对无标签输出的共识，绝不使用智能体得分。下游用Double Ratchet把该进化验证器与生命周期管理的技能循环配对。
AI.result: 在MBPP+上，相对人工种子组合，留出一致性提升+0.21，且在每一个种子上都成立，并领先于它所包含的裸LLM评判。关键发现是：去掉锚定保护后，验证器塌缩为永远通过的虚设评分器，但它训练技能的效果同样好，说明下游任务分数无法认证自进化验证器。Double Ratchet在代码生成、企业级text-to-SQL和无参考报告生成中，保留了真值或评分标准为同一循环带来的88–110%的提升。当进化技能博弈报告评分标准时，外部评判抓住了它，新增一个检测器即可修复；而评判本身在获得任务契约前一直是错的。
AI.conclusion: 自进化验证器必须用锚定与共识来验证，而非用下游任务分数；任务分数只能回答“充分性”。进化验证器可以在技能循环中替代真值或人工评分标准，驱动实际提升。

title: iCATS: Fast Video Generation via Interaction-Aware Sparse Attention and Timestep-Adaptive Sparsity
summary: Training-free sparse attention offers a practical acceleration solution to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) via reducing computations without fine-tuning. It typically involves estimating the importance of query-key regions and deriving sparse masks to compute only the important candidates, which inevitably introduces approximation errors that may degrade generation quality. To better balance the efficiency-quality trade-off, we propose iCATS, integrating improved importance estimation and sparse mask construction with an efficient hardware execution strategy. Specifically, for importance estimation, unlike previous works that perform independent clustering over query and key tokens based on feature similarity to estimate attention scores, iCATS demonstrates that clustering based on query-key dot-product interactions is more accurate and further reformulates this objective as a simple quadratic form for low-cost computation. For sparse mask construction, instead of using a fixed top-p rule, we observe that tolerance to sparse approximation errors varies across denoising timesteps and therefore introduce an SNR-guided sparsity schedule to adjust sparsity dynamically, leading to higher accuracy. Finally, for hardware execution, we devise a tail-merging strategy to reduce padding overhead caused by irregular cluster sizes, improving GPU kernel utilization. Extensive experiments show that iCATS achieves $2.03\times$ acceleration with 31.017 dB PSNR on HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B and $1.55\times$ acceleration with 29.301 dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V-14B, delivering a state-of-the-art efficiency-quality trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练稀疏注意力方法 iCATS，通过改进重要性估计、动态稀疏掩码构建和高效硬件执行策略，在 Diffusion Transformers 上实现更好的效率与生成质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 免训练稀疏注意力虽可加速 DiTs，但现有方法通过近似 query-key 区域重要性会引入误差并降低生成质量，因此需要更好地平衡加速与质量。
AI.method: iCATS 包含三部分：1）基于 query-key 点积交互进行聚类来估计重要性，并重写为低开销二次型计算；2）利用 SNR 引导的稀疏度调度，在不同去噪时间步动态调整稀疏度；3）设计尾部合并策略，减少不规则簇大小导致的填充开销，提高 GPU 内核利用率。
AI.result: 实验表明，iCATS 在 HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B 上实现 2.03 倍加速且 PSNR 为 31.017 dB，在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 上实现 1.55 倍加速且 PSNR 为 29.301 dB，达到当前最优的效率-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: iCATS 通过更准确的重要性估计、动态稀疏调度和硬件友好执行，有效缓解稀疏注意力近似误差，在 DiTs 上实现了先进的加速与生成质量平衡。

title: Phonologically Informed Tokenization for German Speech Recognition: A Cross-Domain Study
summary: German is a morphologically rich language whose syllable structure is exceptionally well-predicted by the Knuth--Liang hyphenation algorithm. We ask whether phonologically informed tokenization can serve as a competitive target for end-to-end speech recognition. We compare three tokenizer families on the Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 backbone fine-tuned with CTC: the pretrained multilingual character inventory, a data-driven Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) over orthography, and phonologically informed units from Pyphen syllabification and grapheme-to-phoneme conversion. Across 40 fine-tunes, we evaluate on three German test sets spanning orthogonal shifts: in-domain read speech, dialectal spontaneous speech, and standard-German spontaneous speech. In-domain, all phonologically informed tokenizers match BPE and the multilingual character baseline on both WER and CER. Under domain shift the picture splits along vocabulary size rather than the linguistic axis of variation: at small vocabularies, syllable-aware tokenization improves on dialectal speech, where phonetic surface forms vary but syllable structure is preserved, and stays ahead on spontaneous speech, where new word-forms violate vocabulary closure. A phoneme-level confusion analysis further shows that all tokenizers commit the same canonical function-word errors, indicating that the acoustic encoder, not the tokenizer, dominates the error topology. Our findings suggest that tokenizer choice may depend on the vocabulary budget as much as on the distribution shift expected at deployment rather than reducing to a single universal optimum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究德语语音识别中，音系知识驱动的分词能否作为有竞争力的建模单元；比较三种分词器在 wav2vec 2.0 CTC 微调下的表现，发现跨域效果更取决于词表大小而非语言学分界。
AI.motivation: 德语形态丰富，且其音节结构能被 Knuth--Liang 连字符算法很好预测。作者希望探究：引入音系信息的分词是否可作为端到端语音识别的有效目标，并理解分词选择与域偏移之间的关系。
AI.method: 在 Omnilingual ASR 的 wav2vec 2.0 骨干上使用 CTC 微调，比较三类分词器：预训练多语言字符词表、基于正交文本的 BPE、以及由 Pyphen 音节切分和字素到音素转换得到的音系信息单元。共进行 40 次微调，并在三个德语测试集上评估：域内朗读语音、方言自发言语和标准德语自发言语。使用 WER、CER 及音素级混淆分析。
AI.result: 在域内数据上，所有音系信息分词器在 WER 和 CER 上与 BPE 及多语言字符基线相当。在域偏移下，差异主要沿词表大小而非语言变化轴分裂：小词表时，音节感知分词在方言语音上更好，因为语音表层形式变化但音节结构保留；在自发言语上也保持领先，因为新词形会破坏词表闭合性。音素级混淆分析显示，所有分词器犯相同的典型功能词错误，说明错误拓扑主要由声学编码器而非分词器决定。
AI.conclusion: 分词器选择可能同时取决于词表预算和部署时预期的分布偏移，而不是归结为某个单一普适最优方案。

title: Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation can automatically generate clinical descriptions from X-ray images, thereby significantly improving the efficiency of radiologists. This task is challenging because it requires medical knowledge to accurately identify diseases and describe them in a professional manner. However, existing methods often overlook the importance of enhancing medical knowledge in describing pivotal areas, a capability that requires models to effectively extract and aggregate knowledge at multiple levels of granularity. Accordingly, we herein propose a novel and compact Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer (\textbf{EMGKT}) method to address the above issues. First, we encode global knowledge embeddings using a medical vision-language model, which provides contextual medical knowledge. Moreover, we devise a novel Fine-Grained Knowledge Distillation (FGKD) training task which efficiently extract fine-grained knowledge. Specifically, the FGKD training task contains teacher embeddings and student embeddings. Teacher embeddings are encoded using extra priors; while student embeddings are learned from the teacher embeddings through knowledge distillation. During inference, the student embeddings are used to enhance fine-grained knowledge while the teacher embeddings are discarded, resulting in negligible computational costs and no need for extra priors. Finally, we further develop a mixture of disease diagnosis expert classifiers to enhance knowledge extraction. The classifiers are initialized using disease embeddings and are modeled as different experts to address various granularity features. Notably, \textbf{EMGKT} can be efficiently applied to most existing methods. Extensive experiments are conducted on two widely-used public datasets and various baselines, which demonstrates the effectiveness and transferability of \textbf{EMGKT}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高效多粒度知识迁移方法EMGKT，用于放射学报告生成，通过全局知识编码、细粒度知识蒸馏和疾病诊断专家分类器增强医学知识提取，在多个数据集和基线上验证有效性与可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有放射学报告生成方法往往忽视增强关键区域的医学知识，而准确识别疾病并专业描述需要模型有效提取和聚合多粒度知识。
AI.method: 提出EMGKT方法：1）用医学视觉语言模型编码全局知识嵌入，提供上下文医学知识；2）设计细粒度知识蒸馏（FGKD）训练任务，教师嵌入由额外先验编码，学生嵌入通过蒸馏学习，推理时仅用学生嵌入以降低计算成本且无需额外先验；3）开发疾病诊断专家分类器混合模型，用疾病嵌入初始化，作为不同专家处理多粒度特征。EMGKT可高效应用于多数现有方法。
AI.result: 在两个广泛使用的公共数据集和多种基线上进行大量实验，证明EMGKT的有效性和可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: EMGKT能有效增强放射学报告生成中的多粒度医学知识，且计算成本低、无需推理时额外先验，并具备良好可迁移性。

title: BridgeGuard: Explicit Safety Drift for Diffusion-based Autonomous Driving
summary: Diffusion-based driving planners capture diverse behaviors but can generate unsafe trajectories under distribution shift. We propose BridgeGuard, a safety-constrained diffusion planning method that progressively strengthens a constraint term during denoising to drive intermediate trajectories toward a scene-dependent safety domain. Corrections operate in a low-dimensional curve space, promoting geometric coherence. A learned module, DistanceFieldNet, predicts a time-dependent distance field from bird's-eye-view features. Value and spatial-gradient supervision at queries sampled beyond expert trajectories teaches this field about both safe and unsafe regions. The learned field supplies the constraint term through safety injection while the pretrained perception backbone and planner remain frozen. We further establish sufficient conditions for terminal safety in an idealized continuous-time bridge. On Bench2Drive, BridgeGuard improves driving score/success rate from 87.99/74.99% to 90.88/76.36% for BridgeDrive and from 80.79/58.18% to 90.46/74.09% for $\text{DiffusionDrive}^{\text{geo}}$, demonstrating cross-model generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出 BridgeGuard，一种安全约束扩散规划方法，通过在去噪过程中逐步增强约束项，将中间轨迹推向场景相关的安全域，从而提升扩散驾驶规划器的安全性。
AI.motivation: 扩散式驾驶规划器虽能生成多样行为，但在分布偏移下可能产生不安全轨迹，因此需要在不重新训练感知主干和规划器的情况下增强安全性。
AI.method: 在去噪过程中逐步增强约束项；在低维曲线空间中进行修正以保持几何一致性；提出 DistanceFieldNet 从鸟瞰图特征预测时间相关距离场，并在专家轨迹之外采样查询进行值与空间梯度监督；通过安全注入提供约束项，同时冻结预训练感知主干和规划器；还在理想连续时间桥中建立终端安全的充分条件。
AI.result: 在 Bench2Drive 上，BridgeDrive 的驾驶得分/成功率从 87.99/74.99% 提升至 90.88/76.36%，DiffusionDrive^geo 从 80.79/58.18% 提升至 90.46/74.09%，表现出跨模型泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: BridgeGuard 能在冻结主干与规划器的前提下有效提升扩散驾驶规划的安全性，并具备跨模型泛化性。

title: Collaboratively Guided Adversarial Robust Distillation with Teacher-Favorable Examples
summary: Adversarial distillation transfers robustness from high-capacity teachers to compact students. Existing adversarial distillation methods mainly use teacher predictions on clean or adversarial examples to supervise student learning. However, teacher-favorable supervision within the perturbation neighborhood remains underexplored in adversarial distillation. We therefore propose Collaboratively Guided Adversarial Robust Distillation (CGARD), which jointly optimizes distinct student-adversarial and teacher-collaborative examples within the same perturbation neighborhood. The teacher-collaborative example is constrained to incur no greater cross-entropy loss under the teacher than the clean input. CGARD combines collaborative teacher guidance with adversarial teacher supervision to improve robust knowledge transfer. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, including white-box evaluation and additional black-box transfer evaluation, demonstrate consistent robustness improvements over strong adversarial distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出协同引导对抗鲁棒蒸馏（CGARD），在同一扰动邻域内联合优化学生对抗样本与教师协同样本，以更有效地将鲁棒性从大模型迁移到小模型。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗蒸馏主要利用教师对干净样本或对抗样本的预测来监督学生，但扰动邻域内对教师更有利的监督信息仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: CGARD 在同一扰动邻域内同时优化两类样本：学生对抗样本和教师协同样本；其中教师协同样本需使教师在交叉熵损失上不高于干净输入。方法将协同教师引导与对抗教师监督结合，提升鲁棒知识迁移。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上进行实验，包括白盒评估和额外的黑盒迁移评估，CGARD 相比强对抗蒸馏基线持续提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 利用扰动邻域内教师协同样本可改善对抗蒸馏的鲁棒知识迁移，CGARD 是一种有效的对抗鲁棒蒸馏方法。

title: Traceable World State: A Provenance-Aware State Representation and Deterministic Replay Framework for Robotic Systems
summary: Robotic systems operating over extended tasks must maintain a world state assembled from observations arriving at different times, with varying confidence and potential revisions. Conventional representations emphasize latest estimates, hindering fact provenance, decision reproduction, or execution auditing. We present Traceable World State (TWS), a middleware-neutral semantic representation and reference runtime for provenance-aware robot world state. A TWS snapshot captures entities, relations, observations, confidence, and revision metadata. Validated update operations transform snapshots immutably, ordered updates support deterministic replay, and a canonical SHA-256 hash chain ensures tamper-evident logs. We evaluate TWS through schema conformance, complete state lifecycles, deterministic replay, and fault injection. Passing 38 tests across Python 3.10-3.14, the framework detects record corruptions, broken hash links, sequence discontinuities, and world mismatches. Across ten public BEHAVIOR-1K task definitions, TWS imported 153 entities and 146 relations with successful validation. On 103 NVIDIA Unitree G1 simulated trajectories containing 78,369 frames, TWS achieved exact terminal-state replay in all episodes and detected 412/412 injected corruptions with a 1.72% storage overhead over Plain JSONL.

AI.tldr: 提出可追溯世界状态（TWS）框架，用于机器人世界状态的溯源感知表示与运行时，支持不可变快照、确定性重放和防篡改日志，并通过多项测试验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器人长期任务需要组装来自不同时间、置信度不一且可能修订的观测世界状态。传统表示强调最新估计，妨碍事实溯源、决策复现或执行审计。
AI.method: 提出TWS，一种中间件无关的语义表示及参考运行时。快照包含实体、关系、观测、置信度和修订元数据；验证过的更新操作以不可变方式转换快照；有序更新支持确定性重放；SHA-256哈希链确保日志防篡改。
AI.result: 通过模式一致性、完整状态生命周期、确定性重放和故障注入评估。在Python 3.10-3.14上通过38项测试，能检测记录损坏、哈希链断裂、序列不连续和世界状态不匹配。在十个BEHAVIOR-1K任务中导入153个实体和146个关系并验证成功；在103条NVIDIA Unitree G1模拟轨迹（78,369帧）上实现所有回合的精确终态重放，检测出412/412注入损坏，相比Plain JSONL仅增加1.72%存储开销。
AI.conclusion: TWS为机器人世界状态提供了一种可溯源、可确定性重放且防篡改的表示与运行时方案，且存储开销较低。

title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HWAM，一种联合生成状态与动作的人形世界动作模型，将机器人执行后的本体感受状态作为显式预测目标，并通过三条条件路径训练，从而缩小参考动作与实际执行之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 在人形机器人分层系统中，VLA/WAM 策略输出的参考动作需经过全身控制、动力学、平衡与接触等环节才能实现，因此存在动作—执行差距。若不显式建模实际实现的身体状态，未来视觉预测需同时解释场景变化与参考动作和执行动作之间的偏差，难以将动作与其物理结果关联。
AI.method: HWAM 联合生成参考动作及其实现的身体状态，显式预测执行后的本体感受状态。训练包含三条互补条件路径：Policy 路径仅以当前观测为条件，联合去噪状态—动作轨迹，匹配部署条件；Forward Dynamics Modeling 以动作和执行后状态为条件预测未来视觉观测；Inverse Dynamics Modeling 从视觉转移重建联合轨迹。三者连接策略参考、实际身体运动与视觉结果。
AI.result: 在 LimX OLI 人形机器人的三个真实机器人任务中，HWAM 取得了所评估基线中最高的成功率。在 Candy Picking 任务上，HWAM 成功率为 70.6%，而 Fast-WAM 为 43.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模机器人执行后的身体状态并将状态—动作联合生成引入动作学习，有助于缓解人形机器人分层控制中的动作—执行差距，从而提升真实机器人操作任务的成功率。

title: Fed-GRPO: Reward-Signal-Driven Federated Group Relative Policy Optimization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities when fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), particularly through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). However, existing GRPO methods assume centralized access to training data, which may not hold in practice due to privacy or regulatory constraints. To this end, we propose Fed-GRPO, a federated GRPO training framework that addresses these privacy constraints by enabling collaborative reasoning training without sharing raw data, which leverages the reward statistics naturally produced during GRPO training as zero-cost signals to guide aggregation, local training, and communication. Fed-GRPO contains three reward-signal-driven mechanisms: (i) \emph{signal-weighted aggregation} that weights clients by their reward standard deviation, prioritizing clients with stronger learning signals; (ii) \emph{global reward calibration} that re-weights per-prompt objectives based on the local-global reward gap, steering each client toward its relative weaknesses; and (iii) \emph{adaptive sparse communication} that allocates bandwidth based on the informativeness of each client's update. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks demonstrate that Fed-GRPO achieves the best performance among all federated methods, clearly outperforms FedAvg and approaches centralized training performance, while losslessly reducing communication by $32\times$ and supporting up to $621\times$ compression under tight bandwidth budgets with only graceful accuracy degradation. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/Fed-GRPO.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fed-GRPO，一种联邦 GRPO 训练框架，在不共享原始数据的前提下协同训练大语言模型推理能力，并利用训练中自然产生的奖励统计指导聚合、局部训练和通信。
AI.motivation: 现有 GRPO 方法假设可以集中访问训练数据，但在隐私或监管约束下这一假设往往不成立，因此需要联邦式训练方案。
AI.method: Fed-GRPO 包含三种奖励信号驱动机制：1）信号加权聚合，按客户端奖励标准差加权，优先聚合学习信号更强的客户端；2）全局奖励校准，根据本地与全局奖励差距重新加权每个提示的目标，使客户端关注自身相对弱点；3）自适应稀疏通信，根据每个客户端更新信息量分配带宽。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上，Fed-GRPO 在所有联邦方法中表现最佳，明显优于 FedAvg，并接近集中式训练性能；同时无损减少通信 32 倍，在紧带宽预算下最高支持 621 倍压缩，且仅有轻微精度下降。
AI.conclusion: Fed-GRPO 表明，利用 GRPO 训练中的奖励统计作为零成本信号，可实现隐私保护且通信高效的联邦大语言模型推理训练，并接近集中式训练效果。

title: The Operator Mismatch Problem: Deploying BEV Perception with Portable GPU Compute
summary:
Modern autonomous driving systems rely on bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception models that fuse camera and LiDAR inputs to detect objects in 3D space. These models are accurate, but they cannot be deployed through standard inference runtimes. The reason is an operator mismatch between dense convolutions (which runtimes handle well), sparse 3D convolutions (which runtimes cannot represent), and geometric scatter operations (which runtimes have no vocabulary for). Today, every sparse convolution library is CUDA-only and PyTorch-coupled, locking BEV deployment to a single vendor's hardware and a single execution framework.
  We present BEVPIPE, a framework for deploying multimodal BEV perception pipelines using portable GPU compute APIs and integrating them with production inference runtimes. BEVPIPE partitions the model into runtime-managed dense subgraphs and three external operator extensions (voxelizer, sparse encoder, BEV projector), connected through a shared GPU memory space. BEVPIPE achieves a 19.5x end-to-end speedup over conventional deployments while retaining 98.5% of reference mAP. We also showcase that BEVPIPE is portable across different GPU backends.

AI.tldr: 提出 BEVPIPE 框架，用可移植 GPU 计算 API 部署多模态 BEV 感知模型，并集成到生产推理运行时中。
AI.motivation: 现有 BEV 感知模型虽准确，但因稠密卷积、稀疏 3D 卷积和几何 scatter 算子与标准推理运行时不兼容，难以部署；且稀疏卷积库多为 CUDA-only 且耦合 PyTorch，导致硬件和框架被单一厂商锁定。
AI.method: BEVPIPE 将模型划分为运行时管理的稠密子图和三个外部算子扩展：voxelizer、sparse encoder、BEV projector，并通过共享 GPU 内存空间连接；同时使用可移植 GPU 计算 API 与生产推理运行时集成。
AI.result: BEVPIPE 相比传统部署实现 19.5 倍端到端加速，同时保留参考 mAP 的 98.5%，并展示出跨不同 GPU 后端的可移植性。
AI.conclusion: BEVPIPE 能有效解决 BEV 部署中的算子不匹配和厂商锁定问题，实现高效、可移植的多模态 BEV 感知流水线部署。

title: DIAL-OPD: Learning More from Fewer Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated trajectories with token-level teacher signals. Its sampled-token variant avoids the cost of full-vocabulary probabilities. Yet we find that training on fewer tokens can outperform full-token OPD, challenging the intuition that more supervision improves learning. This motivates selecting tokens by learning value. Existing disagreement-based criteria ignore probability scale: tokens assigned negligible probability by both models, termed low-low tokens, can receive large log-ratio rewards and hinder learning. We propose DIAL-OPD, a token-selection method that bridges log-probability and probability spaces by weighting reward magnitude with the logarithmic mean of teacher and student probabilities. A parameter beta controls this weighting, and the highest-scoring tokens are retained. Across 4 teacher-student pairs and 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we compare DIAL-OPD with 9 baselines. Retaining only 40% of tokens, it outperforms Vanilla OPD and its full-token variants, with mean accuracy gains reaching 5.25 percentage points over Vanilla OPD, and doubles AIME25 Pass@16 from 13.33% to 26.67%. It also achieves up to an 18% relative improvement in mean accuracy over the strongest token-selection baseline at matched retention ratios. With a 4B teacher, DIAL-OPD surpasses the strongest full-token baseline using an 8B teacher at both student scales, showing that effective supervision allocation can outweigh teacher scaling. Further analysis shows that moderate beta balances suppressing low-low tokens against preserving useful disagreements. Token-level evidence reveals that DIAL-OPD filters high-reward tokens with limited reasoning value while preserving supervision critical to reasoning correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 on-policy distillation（OPD）中的 token 选择问题，提出 DIAL-OPD，通过用教师与学生概率的对数均值加权奖励幅度，在 log-prob 与 probability 空间之间桥接，从而选择更有学习价值的 token。实验表明，仅保留 40% token 即可超过 Vanilla OPD 及全 token 变体，并在多个数学推理基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: OPD 使用 token 级教师信号监督学生生成的轨迹，采样 token 变体可避免全词表概率计算成本。但作者发现，使用更少 token 训练有时反而优于全 token OPD，挑战了“更多监督一定更好”的直觉。已有基于分歧的 token 选择标准忽略概率尺度，导致教师和学生都赋予极低概率的 low-low token 可能获得较大 log-ratio 奖励并阻碍学习。因此需要按学习价值选择 token。
AI.method: 提出 DIAL-OPD token 选择方法：用教师概率与学生概率的对数均值对奖励幅度进行加权，以桥接 log-probability 与 probability 空间。引入参数 beta 控制该加权，并保留得分最高的 token 进行训练。
AI.result: 在 4 组教师-学生模型和 7 个数学推理基准上，与 9 个基线比较。仅保留 40% token 时，DIAL-OPD 超过 Vanilla OPD 及其全 token 变体；相对 Vanilla OPD 平均准确率提升最高达 5.25 个百分点，并将 AIME25 Pass@16 从 13.33% 提升到 26.67%。在相同保留比例下，相对最强 token 选择基线平均准确率最高有 18% 的相对提升。使用 4B 教师时，DIAL-OPD 在两个学生规模上均超过使用 8B 教师的最强全 token 基线。
AI.conclusion: 有效的监督分配可以胜过教师规模扩展。DIAL-OPD 通过按学习价值选择 token，在抑制 low-low token 与保留有用分歧之间取得平衡；token 级证据表明，它能过滤高奖励但推理价值有限的 token，同时保留对推理正确性关键的监督信号。

title: FloorSAV: Elucidating Spatial Audio-Visual Context with 2D Floormap for AV-LLMs
summary: While 3D spatial reasoning in dynamic egocentric environments is crucial for embodied intelligence, audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) lack explicit mechanisms to process and internalize global geometry directly from raw sensory streams. Existing approaches either require costly fine-tuning or underutilize the model's cross-modal reasoning capacities. In this paper, we propose FloorSAV, a novel framework that explicitly grounds spatial audio-visual context by rendering a dynamic 2D floormap. By integrating 3D point clouds, camera trajectories, spatial audio cues, and semantically grounded object landmarks, we inject this floormap into the AV-LLM as a synchronized stream with an egocentric video. AV-LLMs utilize their multi-modal capabilities to jointly reason over visual, auditory, and geometric cues in a single inference with floormap interpretation guidance. We further introduce SAVED-Bench (Spatial Audio-Visual Egocentric Benchmark with Dynamic Agents), constructing essential tasks of spatial capability in real-world scenarios: dynamic relativity, regional, and path reasoning QAs. FloorSAV improves AV-LLMs' spatial reasoning on various tasks from both SAVED-Bench and SAVVY-Bench. Studies with ground-truth floormaps demonstrate the substantial potential of FloorSAV with accurate spatial information.

AI.tldr: 提出FloorSAV框架，通过渲染动态2D平面图将空间音视频上下文注入AV-LLM，并构建SAVED-Bench基准，显著提升动态自我中心环境下的空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频大语言模型（AV-LLM）缺乏从原始感知流中直接处理和内化全局几何的机制，而现有方法要么需要昂贵的微调，要么未充分利用模型的跨模态推理能力。
AI.method: 融合3D点云、相机轨迹、空间音频线索和语义物体地标，渲染动态2D平面图，并将其与自我中心视频同步作为流注入AV-LLM；模型在单次推理中联合推理视觉、听觉和几何线索；同时构建SAVED-Bench基准，包含动态相对、区域和路径推理问答任务。
AI.result: FloorSAV在SAVED-Bench和SAVVY-Bench的多种任务上提升了AV-LLM的空间推理表现；使用真值平面图的实验表明，在准确空间信息下FloorSAV具有巨大潜力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式平面图接地空间音视频上下文，能有效增强AV-LLM的空间推理能力，且准确的空间信息可进一步释放其潜力。

title: SkillWeave: Weaving Heterogeneous Demonstrations into Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills
comment: IROS 2026 Workshop on Haptics and Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires both large-scale task progression and precise contact-rich interaction, making it challenging to collect demonstrations that effectively support both regimes. We present SkillWeave, a heterogeneous demonstration framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that combines teleoperation for coarse reaching and transport with kinesthetic teaching for precise, contact-rich skills. To address the visual mismatch introduced by the demonstrator's presence during kinesthetic data collection, we propose an object-mask-conditioned diffusion policy that uses offline object segmentation for training supervision and a lightweight learned mask predictor at deployment, avoiding online segmentation and image inpainting. To mitigate distribution shift between independently trained sub-task policies, we introduce successor-aware terminal steering, which selects among actions sampled from the predecessor policy to guide the system toward states supported by the successor's demonstrated initial-state distribution. Across three real-world long-horizon tasks, SkillWeave achieves 27% average end-to-end success. Mask-conditioned kinesthetic policies improve dexterous sub-task success to an average of 65%, while successor-aware handoffs achieve an average composition efficiency of 87%. These results show that matching demonstration modality to interaction regime, explicitly addressing kinesthetic visual mismatch, and steering policy handoffs toward successor-supported states substantially improves long-horizon dexterous manipulation. Videos and code are available at skillweave-authors.github.io .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillWeave，一个用于长时程灵巧操作的多模态示教框架，结合遥操作与动觉示教，并引入物体掩码条件扩散策略和后继感知终端引导来提升端到端成功率。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作既需要大范围任务推进，又需要精确的接触丰富交互，单一示教方式难以同时有效支持这两类需求；同时，动觉示教中演示者存在会造成视觉不匹配，独立训练的子任务策略之间也存在分布偏移。
AI.method: SkillWeave 采用异构示教框架：遥操作负责粗粒度接近与搬运，动觉示教负责精细接触丰富技能。提出物体掩码条件扩散策略，训练时用离线物体分割监督，部署时用轻量学习掩码预测器，避免在线分割和图像修复。还提出后继感知终端引导，通过从前驱策略采样动作并选择能引导系统进入后继策略示教初始状态分布的动作，缓解子策略间的分布偏移。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界长时程任务中，SkillWeave 平均端到端成功率为 27%；掩码条件动觉策略将灵巧子任务成功率平均提升至 65%；后继感知交接的平均组合效率达到 87%。
AI.conclusion: 将示教模态与交互机制匹配、显式解决动觉示教视觉不匹配、并将策略交接引导至后继策略支持的状态，能够显著改善长时程灵巧操作。

title: Structured Sentiment Analysis Using Sequence Labeling as Dependency Graph Parsing
summary: This study addresses the problem of structured sentiment analysis, whose goal is to obtain a fine-grained sentiment graph where the nodes represent spans of sentiment holders, targets, and expressions, while the arcs define the relationships among them. Our proposed approach casts the task as dependency graph parsing, but departs from traditional parsing methods by solving it through sequence labeling. To do so, we leverage recent advances in linearized graph encodings that allow each word in the input to be assigned a label, effectively capturing the structure of the dependency graph. We conducted experiments on seven datasets spanning five languages (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, and Catalan), showing performance competitive with leading, more complex single-model approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将结构化情感分析转化为依存图解析，并通过序列标注和线性化图编码完成，在多语言数据集上取得有竞争力结果。
AI.motivation: 结构化情感分析需要抽取情感持有者、目标与表达及其关系，形成细粒度情感图；作者希望用更简单的序列标注框架替代复杂解析方法。
AI.method: 将任务视为依存图解析，但不采用传统解析器，而是使用线性化图编码，把图结构映射为每个词的标签，从而用序列标注建模。
AI.result: 在涵盖英语、西班牙语、挪威语、巴斯克语和加泰罗尼亚语的七个数据集上实验，性能与领先且更复杂的单模型方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 基于序列标注和线性化图编码的方法能有效处理结构化情感分析，并在多语言场景下达到有竞争力的效果。

title: TRACE: Diagnosing Verifier Brittleness in Agentic Evaluation
summary: Verifier scores now serve as both benchmark metrics and training rewards for large language model (LLM) agents, and a change in score is routinely read as a change in capability. It may instead reflect a change in the evaluation.
