We introduce TRACE, a protocol that turns a score change from a verdict into a testable diagnosis: it applies a targeted change to one part of an evaluation, compares paired runs, checks whether the agent's behavior changed, and rescores unchanged trajectories to test whether the scoring rule is responsible. In a controlled suite of 25 synthetic tasks, renaming tools lowers a scripted agent's score by 0.250 even though it performs exactly the same operations; restoring the original names at scoring time closes the entire gap, while the same mutation exposes a genuine behavioral failure in a second agent. On public $τ^2$-bench tasks with four LLM agents, an initial 30-task study finds mixed reward changes whose one clear effect does not replicate. In a larger follow-up on 88 new tasks with repeated runs per condition, renaming tools or reformatting tool outputs leaves reward unchanged to within $\pm$0.10 for seven of eight agent-change pairs, whereas tool names that deliberately mislead lower every agent's reward by 0.20-0.44, showing that the setup can detect real effects. Identical reruns flip 15-36% of task outcomes, so single-run comparisons cannot separate presentation effects from run-to-run variation. Two frontier LLM judges give consistent verdicts when a fixed trajectory is presented differently, yet disagree with each other on 57% of the same records, largely because one grades procedure rather than outcome. TRACE thus separates what a score change says about the agent from what it says about the measurement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TRACE协议，用于诊断LLM智能体评分变化究竟反映能力变化还是评测变化；通过受控改变评测呈现、配对运行、重评不变轨迹等，区分呈现效应与真实行为/测量效应。
AI.motivation: 当前验证器分数既用作基准指标又用作训练奖励，分数变化常被直接解读为能力变化，但它也可能只是评测方式改变，因此需要一种可检验的诊断方法。
AI.method: TRACE对评测的某一环节做针对性改变，比较配对运行，检查智能体行为是否改变，并对未变轨迹重新评分以判断评分规则是否导致分数变化；在25个合成任务和公开τ²-bench任务上测试多个LLM智能体，考察工具重命名、工具输出重格式化、误导性工具名等变化，并分析重复运行与两个前沿LLM评判者。
AI.result: 合成任务中，重命名工具使脚本智能体分数降低0.250但操作完全相同，恢复原名可完全消除差距，同一变异也能暴露另一智能体的真实行为失败；τ²-bench初试30任务效应未复现；88个新任务重复运行中，7/8智能体-变化对的奖励变化在±0.10内，而误导性工具名使所有智能体奖励降低0.20-0.44；相同重跑翻转15-36%任务结果；两个LLM评判者对同一轨迹不同呈现的判断一致，但彼此在57%记录上不一致，主要因一个评过程而非结果。
AI.conclusion: TRACE能将分数变化诊断为关于智能体能力的信号还是关于测量的信号；单次比较无法区分呈现效应与运行波动，需受控协议和重复运行来评估真实能力效应。

title: AtomWorld-Mirror: Macro-Step World Modeling of Critical Evolution Backbones for Materials Dynamics
summary: Atomistic simulation is a fundamental tool for studying long-term materials evolution, from diffusion and defect dynamics to interfacial reactions and fracture. Yet conventional simulators typically advance at microscopic resolution, spending substantial computation on low-impact local updates before reaching structurally consequential states, an evolutionary-resolution bottleneck that limits long-horizon simulation. We propose AtomWorld-Mirror, a time-aware macro-step world model for the critical evolution backbone of atomic systems. For Step-Wise atomistic simulation, AtomWorld-Mirror distills short micro-event segments into physically reachable transitions between key states, jointly predicting sparse structural edits and accumulated physical time through latent macro-step dynamics. Local reachability, inventory conservation, and continuous-time consistency constrain each transition. By amortizing local atomic physics into a reusable latent macro model and replacing explicit micro-event replay with macro-step inference, this formulation provides a path toward substantially faster prediction of long-term materials evolution while preserving structural validity and time semantics. Across five atomic systems, spanning Cu-rich RPV steel irradiation aging, Cu-Zr metallic glass, and Li$_3$N-based anti-perovskite solid electrolyte, macro-step inference delivers a speed up of $10^3$ to $10^4$ times over event-by-event simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 AtomWorld-Mirror，一种时间感知的宏观步世界模型，用于原子尺度长期演化模拟，通过潜在宏观步动态预测稀疏结构编辑和累积物理时间，实现比逐事件模拟快 10^3 至 10^4 倍的预测。
AI.motivation: 传统原子模拟通常以微观分辨率推进，大量计算耗费在低影响的局部更新上，难以高效到达结构上重要的状态，即演化分辨率瓶颈限制了长期模拟。
AI.method: 将短微观事件片段蒸馏为关键状态间物理可达的转变，利用潜在宏观步动态联合预测稀疏结构编辑与累积物理时间；用局部可达性、库存守恒和连续时间一致性约束每次转变；将局部原子物理摊销为可复用的潜在宏观模型，并以宏观步推理替代显式微观事件回放。
AI.result: 在五个原子系统中验证，包括富铜 RPV 钢辐照老化、Cu-Zr 金属玻璃和 Li3N 基反钙钛矿固体电解质，宏观步推理比逐事件模拟提速 10^3 至 10^4 倍。
AI.conclusion: 该公式化方法为在保持结构有效性和时间语义的前提下，显著加速长期材料演化预测提供了可行路径。

title: ManiUnit: A Manipulation Skill Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate multi-room environments and execute a sequence of manipulation skills under a single natural language instruction. Learning and evaluating these skills present three challenges: similar observations under a fixed task instruction may make skill selection ambiguous; even when a preceding skill succeeds, the robot state inherited by the next skill may deviate from its demonstrated starting states and affect execution; and task-level metrics hinder skill-specific diagnosis, while early failures leave later skills untested. We therefore introduce ManiUnit, a manipulation skill dataset and benchmark built from 50 BEHAVIOR-1K activities. Its dataset contains 137,899 segments across 21 skill types and 417 subtasks, and its benchmark contains 1,260 test instances. Correspondingly, ManiUnit pairs each segment with an explicit subtask instruction; measures sensitivity to perturbations of the robot's starting base position or joint configuration; and restores intermediate simulator states and defines local success conditions so that each skill can be evaluated without executing preceding stages. Evaluations of representative vision-language-action (VLA) policies show that similar aggregate scores can hide substantial per-skill differences. The tested starting-state perturbations also degrade execution: on the full benchmark, joint perturbations reduce success rates by approximately 56% relative to those from demonstrated starting states. On two long-horizon activities, a skill policy trained on ManiUnit segments achieves 78.7% local manipulation success, compared with 49.3% for a task policy trained on complete demonstrations. The trained skills further support complete-task execution on these activities, as coordinating the task and skill policies through a planner raises full-task success from 4.0% to 18.0%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ManiUnit，一个面向长时程移动操作的操作技能数据集与基准，基于 50 个 BEHAVIOR-1K 活动构建，包含 137,899 个片段、21 种技能、417 个子任务和 1,260 个测试实例，用于细粒度评估 VLA 策略的技能表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程移动操作中，固定任务指令下相似观测导致技能选择模糊；前一技能成功后的机器人状态可能偏离下一技能的演示起始状态；任务级指标难以诊断具体技能，且早期失败会导致后续技能无法被测试。
AI.method: ManiUnit 为每个片段配以显式子任务指令；测量机器人起始基座位置或关节构型扰动下的敏感性；恢复中间仿真状态并定义局部成功条件，使每个技能无需执行前序阶段即可独立评估。
AI.result: 代表性 VLA 策略的评估显示相似总体分数会掩盖显著的逐技能差异。起始状态扰动会降低执行表现，关节扰动使完整基准上的成功率相对演示起始状态下降约 56%。在两个长时程活动上，基于 ManiUnit 片段训练的技能策略达到 78.7% 局部操作成功率，而基于完整演示训练的任务策略为 49.3%。通过规划器协调任务与技能策略后，完整任务成功率从 4.0% 提升至 18.0%。
AI.conclusion: ManiUnit 通过子任务指令、扰动敏感度测量和中间状态恢复，支持技能级细粒度评估与训练，能揭示总体指标掩盖的差异，并提升长时程移动操作中技能执行与完整任务协调的成功率。

title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Website: https://thinking-inertia.github.io GitHub: https://github.com/thinking-inertia/code
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. We instead normalize each response into a pre-answer trace and final answer, and evaluate it at three levels: (i) Empty-Thinking Rate for strict answer-only compliance; (ii) instruction-aware Question-Pre-answer Relevance for similarity between the question and pre-answer trace; and (iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate for visible explicit inference. Together, these metrics distinguish answer-only output, relevant but non-inferential text, and explicit inference. b. How does no-thinking vary across tasks and models? We evaluate six prompting interventions on six LLMs across Boolean, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. We find that explicit no-think controls cannot reliably eliminate visible inference. Models instead exhibit "Thinking Inertia": explicit inference persists even under strict controls and becomes more prevalent as the answer space opens. Accuracy remains stable on Boolean and multiple-choice tasks, whereas open-ended tasks reveal a trade-off between answer-only compliance and task accuracy. Rewriting the same questions across answer spaces shows that supplying candidate answers makes answer-only responses easier to produce. These findings establish no-thinking as a non-trivial capability: stopping explicit reasoning cannot be assumed from model settings or instructions alone and deserves systematic evaluation alongside reasoning ability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型的“不思考”行为：提出更可靠的测量方法，并在多模型、多任务上评估显式抑制推理的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有工作常用禁用思考模式或缺乏长推理链等代理指标来定义“不思考”，但这些指标不可靠：禁用模式仍可能输出推理，长文本也可能是填充而非真实推断。因此需要系统衡量和评估不思考行为。
AI.method: 将模型回答归一化为“答案前文本”和“最终答案”，从三个层面评估：空思考率、问题与答案前文本的相关性、LLM-as-judge判定的显式推理率；并对6种提示干预、6个LLM，在布尔、多选和开放式问题上进行评测。
AI.result: 显式不思考控制无法可靠消除可见推理，模型表现出“思考惯性”：显式推理在严格控制下仍存在，且随答案空间开放而更普遍；布尔和多选题准确率稳定，开放式任务则出现仅答案合规与任务准确率之间的权衡；提供候选答案可使仅答案输出更容易。
AI.conclusion: “不思考”是一种非平凡能力，不能仅凭模型设置或指令假定其已停止显式推理，应与推理能力一起被系统评估。

title: A Minimal Optical-Flow Representation for Vision-Based Tactile Rotation Classification in Robotic Manipulation Across Gravity Domains
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究基于视觉触觉传感器的紧凑触觉运动表示能否在不同重力条件下分类物体旋转，发现仅用地球重力数据训练会显著降低在轨道等条件下的性能，而跨四种重力域联合训练可获得高准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉触觉传感器能提供丰富接触信息，但高分辨率图像处理对空间机器人等资源受限平台成本较高；同时，尚不清楚地球重力下训练得到的触觉感知模型能否迁移到火星、月球和轨道等不同重力环境。
AI.method: 使用模拟 GelSight Mini 获取密集光流，并将其聚合到 7x9 网格形成 126 维特征，用于分类载荷诱导旋转方向；在地球、火星、月球和轨道重力下比较仅地球数据训练与四重力域联合训练的 XGBoost 模型，并测试特征降维效果。
AI.result: 重力会使特征产生小而显著的偏移，解释 1.6% 方差（R2=0.016）。仅用地球数据训练的 XGBoost 在地球上准确率为 94.4%，在轨道上降至 75.9%；而一个跨四种重力域训练的单一模型总体准确率达 96.3%，各域为 95.1%-97.0%，且无需将重力作为输入。特征可降至 40 维并保持 95.7% 准确率，推理仅需 0.14 ms。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭地球重力下的性能不足以证明触觉感知可用于空间机器人操作的可迁移性；训练和验证时必须考虑重力引起的域偏移。

title: Safe, Persistent, and Evolving Agent Harness for Understanding Partially Observable Worlds
summary: Large language model agents can invoke tools fluently, but enterprise workflows demand more than selecting the right tools: actions must strictly comply with organizational policies, tool feedback often conceals hidden side effects under partial observability, and long-horizon tasks require persistent state tracking across multiple records. To address these challenges, we introduce E-Ledger, a multi-agent harness for safe and persistent execution. E-Ledger employs a code approval layer that checks every proposed action against policy before execution, and maintains a world ledger of verified hidden rules alongside evidence-backed dynamic state. Because hidden rules are typically unknown a priori, we further propose WorldAbduct, an abductive, world-model-driven harness evolution framework. WorldAbduct diagnoses execution trajectories across four complementary views (state consistency, world-observation gap, policy-gate correctness, and goal judgment) to hypothesize latent rules, and verifies them through targeted abductive interactions before integrating them into the ledger. On the enterprise benchmark World of Workflows, E-Ledger with WorldAbduct improves safe task completion across four LLM backbones, outperforming the strongest evolution baseline by 5--15 percentage points. Experiments in ScienceWorld and DiscoveryWorld further show that abductive harness evolution carries over to scientific environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/E-LEDGER-WorldAbduct.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 E-Ledger 多智能体执行框架及 WorldAbduct 演化机制，用于企业工作流中安全、合规且具有持久状态的长期任务执行。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体虽能调用工具，但企业工作流要求动作严格符合组织政策；工具反馈在部分可观测下常隐藏副作用；长期任务还需跨多条记录持久跟踪状态。
AI.method: E-Ledger 包含代码审批层，在执行前检查每个动作是否符合政策，并维护已验证隐藏规则与动态状态的世界账本。针对隐藏规则先验未知，提出 WorldAbduct：从状态一致性、世界-观测差距、政策门正确性、目标判断四个视角诊断执行轨迹，归纳潜在规则，并通过针对性溯因交互验证后整合进账本。
AI.result: 在 World of Workflows 企业基准上，E-Ledger 结合 WorldAbduct 在四种 LLM 骨干上提升安全任务完成率，比最强演化基线高 5–15 个百分点；在 ScienceWorld 和 DiscoveryWorld 也显示可迁移到科学环境。
AI.conclusion: 溯因式世界模型驱动的执行框架演化能提升企业工作流中智能体的安全性与持久执行能力，并可扩展到科学任务环境。

title: ReTeach: Building a Self-Teacher through Multi-Round Reflection and Retry
summary: Self-distillation can improve reasoning without a separately trained, more capable teacher, but its effectiveness depends on how the self-teacher gains an advantage over the student. Conditioning the teacher on reference answers or solutions can provide such an advantage, but this information may be unavailable. Reflection offers a way to derive explicit error diagnoses and revision guidance from self-generated attempts, yet existing reflection-based methods often combine it with reference information, rich task feedback, or persistent memory. We introduce ReTeach, a Reflective self-distillation framework that constructs its self-Teacher through multi-round reflection and retry using only self-generated attempts and outcome-level verification. Starting from an unsuccessful student rollout, the teacher alternates explicit reflection with renewed attempts until success or the retry budget is exhausted, without reference answers or solutions, external diagnostic feedback, or cross-example memory. Each failed retry informs subsequent reflection, while successful correction provides outcome-level evidence for the potential utility of the resulting teacher context. An outcome-aware selection and weighting strategy distinguishes initially correct, reflection-corrected, and unresolved examples, assigning separate weights to their category-normalized distillation losses. Through on-policy distillation, the student matches the teacher's context-conditioned token-level predictive distributions at prefixes of its own rollouts, transferring the benefits of iterative correction while retaining single-pass inference. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, science question answering, and tool use, ReTeach improves average accuracy over GRPO by 1.39 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出ReTeach反思式自蒸馏框架，仅用自生成尝试和结果级验证构建自教师，通过多轮反思与重试提升推理能力，平均准确率超GRPO 1.39个百分点。
AI.motivation: 自蒸馏无需单独更强教师，但教师需优于学生。参考答案或解决方案可提供优势却常不可用；现有反思方法多依赖参考信息、丰富任务反馈或持久记忆。
AI.method: ReTeach从失败的学生尝试出发，让教师交替进行显式反思与重新尝试，直至成功或耗尽重试预算，全程无参考答案、外部诊断反馈或跨样本记忆。失败重试为后续反思提供信息，成功纠正提供结果级证据。采用结果感知选择与加权策略，区分初始正确、反思纠正和未解决样本，分别对类别归一化蒸馏损失加权。通过on-policy蒸馏，学生匹配教师在其自身rollout前缀上的上下文条件token级预测分布，保留单次推理。
AI.result: 在数学推理、科学问答和工具使用六个基准上，ReTeach平均准确率比GRPO提升1.39个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ReTeach能仅凭自生成反思与重试有效构建自教师，无需外部教师或参考信息，提升推理性能并保持单次推理效率。

title: It's Always 10:10: Reference Images Break a Bias That Prompts Only Dent
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Data and code: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23224681
summary: Text-to-image models appear to reproduce the habits of the photographs they learned from. Analog clocks are an extreme case: in advertising, watches almost always show 10:10, and generated clocks return to 10:10 even when another time is requested. We measure this bias and test three ways of overcoming it on 52 models available on the Magnific platform, with a replication on Higgsfield. Every image shows three identical clocks that must show 2:35, 6:50 and 11:20. The description of the object is fixed and only the request about the time changes: no time (A), the time in digits (B), the hand positions described by construction relative to the dial numerals (C), or the same description plus a drawn reference dial (D). Two AI readers read all 1,799 images blind from coded copies, with a third reader and the author settling disagreements (dial-level agreement 96.0% and 97.3%). With no time requested, 67% of the images have all three clocks at 10:10. On the 20 current models, all three clocks are correct in 34% of the images with digits, 30% with the hands described in words and 75% with the reference dial (D-B: +37 points, 95% CI +28 to +45); we found no evidence that describing the hands in words beats the digits (C-B: -4 points, CI -10 to +1). The replication on the 12 models shared by both platforms gives the same picture (B 54%, C 50%, D 81%). Writing the time reduces the bias but leaves two thirds of the images of the 20 current models with at least one wrong clock; adding a drawn reference raises full accuracy to three quarters and almost eliminates images entirely at 10:10. We release all images, prompts, raw readings and a script that recomputes every result.

AI.tldr: 文本到图像模型会重现训练数据中的偏差，例如时钟常被生成为10:10。研究测量该偏差并测试三种克服方法，发现添加绘制参考表盘最有效。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像模型似乎复制了所学照片中的习惯，模拟时钟是极端案例：广告中手表几乎总显示10:10，即使请求其他时间，生成时钟也常回归10:10。因此需要测量这种偏差并寻找克服方法。
AI.method: 在Magnific平台的52个模型上测试，并在Higgsfield的12个共享模型上复现。每张图包含三个相同时钟，应分别显示2:35、6:50和11:20。固定物体描述，仅改变时间请求：A无时间；B数字时间；C用表盘数字描述指针位置；D在C基础上加绘制参考表盘。两名AI读者盲读1,799张编码图像，第三名读者与作者裁决分歧。
AI.result: 无时间请求时，67%的图像三个时钟均为10:10。20个当前模型中，三个时钟全对比例：B为34%，C为30%，D为75%（D-B +37点，95% CI +28至+45）；C-B为-4点（CI -10至+1）。在12个共享模型上复现结果相似：B为54%，C为50%，D为81%。
AI.conclusion: 写出时间可减少偏差，但20个当前模型中仍有三分之二的图像至少有一个时钟错误；添加绘制参考可将全对率提高到四分之三，并几乎消除全为10:10的图像。作者发布了所有图像、提示、原始读数和可重算全部结果的脚本。

title: Point-Focused Attention Meets Context-Scan State Space: Robust Biological Visual Perception for Point Cloud Representation
summary: Synergistically capturing intricate local structures and global contextual dependencies has become a critical challenge in point cloud representation learning. To address this, we introduce PointLearner, a point cloud representation learning network that closely aligns with biological vision which employs an active, foveation-inspired processing strategy, thus enabling local geometric modeling and long-range dependency interactions simultaneously. Specifically, we first design a point-focused attention, which simulates foveal vision at the visual focus through a competitive normalized attention mechanism between local neighbors and spatially downsampled features. The spatially downsampled features are extracted by a pooling method based on learnable inducing points, which can flexibly adapt to the non-uniform distribution of point clouds as the number of inducing points is controlled and they interact directly with point clouds. Second, we propose a context-scan state space that mimics eye's saccade inference, which infers the overall semantic structure and spatial content in the scene through a scan path guided by the Hilbert curve for the bidirectional S6. With this focus-then-context biomimetic design, PointLearner demonstrates remarkable robustness and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple point cloud tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出PointLearner点云表示学习网络，借鉴生物视觉的主动注视机制，同时建模局部几何结构与全局长程依赖，在多个点云任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 点云表示学习的关键挑战在于同时捕获复杂的局部结构与全局上下文依赖。
AI.method: 设计点聚焦注意力：模拟中央凹视觉，通过局部邻域与空间下采样特征间的竞争归一化注意力实现；下采样特征由基于可学习诱导点的池化提取，可适应点云非均匀分布。提出上下文扫描状态空间：模拟眼跳推理，利用Hilbert曲线引导的扫描路径与双向S6推断整体语义和空间内容。
AI.result: Focus-then-context生物仿生设计使PointLearner具有显著鲁棒性，并在多个点云任务上取得最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 结合局部聚焦与全局上下文扫描的点云表示学习方法有效，能够兼顾局部几何建模与长程依赖交互，提升多任务性能与鲁棒性。

title: DPPM: Dual-Path Parametric Memory for Personalized Language Models
summary: Long-term personalization requires language models to use interaction history to track users' preferences across sessions. Parametric memory encodes this interaction history into model parameters or adapters, reducing the need to include it in the inference context. However, independent context compilation leaves cross-session integration unspecified, while recurrent updates can attenuate earlier evidence. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM). Its Evidence path directly pools representations of the interaction history to preserve earlier evidence, while its Delta path sequentially updates an associative state to capture changes. Fusing both outputs produces history-conditioned LoRA adapters that combine evidence accumulation with ordered revision. Across multiple backbones, DPPM outperforms the evaluated baselines, achieving 54.22% on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% on PrefEval. These results suggest that DPPM provides a simple and effective design choice for cross-session personalized parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 提出双路径参数化记忆（DPPM），通过证据路径与增量路径融合生成历史条件LoRA适配器，实现跨会话个性化。
AI.motivation: 长期个性化需跨会话利用交互历史追踪用户偏好，但现有参数化记忆存在跨会话整合不明确、循环更新衰减早期证据的问题。
AI.method: DPPM包含两条路径：Evidence路径直接池化交互历史表示以保留早期证据，Delta路径顺序更新关联状态以捕捉偏好变化，融合二者输出生成历史条件LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 在多个骨干模型上优于评估基线，PersonaMem-v2达54.22%，PrefEval达86.79%。
AI.conclusion: DPPM为跨会话个性化参数化记忆提供了一种简单有效的设计选择。

title: Same Outcome, Different Evidence: Intent Recovery in LLM Safety Evaluation
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. Code and experiment inputs: https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS
summary: Safety evaluations of large language models commonly summarize harmful-output behavior with attack success rate (ASR). Yet the same non-harmful outcome can arise for very different reasons. A model may recover a harmful task and refuse it, fail to recover the task, or respond to something else entirely. Distinguishing these cases becomes especially important under intent-obscuring prompts, where a low ASR does not reveal whether the evaluated task was actually engaged. To make this distinction explicit, we pair ASR with operative understanding rate (UR), which measures whether a response both identifies the evaluated task and treats it as the task to be answered. Across interfaces, this paired view reveals substantial variation hidden by ASR: similar ASR values can correspond to sharply different recovery rates. Controlled English reconstructions show that recovery consistently improves as compressed prompts become more explicit, whereas ASR does not follow the same pattern. A complementary contrast comes from FormalLogic, where high recovery can still coincide with frequent harmful assistance. Together, these results show that non-harmful outcomes are not equally informative about model safety, motivating the joint reporting of intent recovery and ASR in LLM safety evaluation. Code and experiment inputs are available at https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出仅用攻击成功率（ASR）评估大语言模型安全性会掩盖非有害结果的不同原因，提出并验证了操作理解率（UR），主张联合报告意图恢复与ASR。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估常用ASR总结有害输出行为，但相同的非有害结果可能源于不同原因：模型恢复并拒绝、未恢复任务、或回答其他内容。在意图遮蔽提示下，低ASR无法揭示评估任务是否被真正参与，因此需要区分这些情况。
AI.method: 引入操作理解率（UR），衡量响应是否识别评估任务并将其视为要回答的任务。将ASR与UR配对分析，并通过不同接口、受控英语重构以及FormalLogic对比进行实验。
AI.result: 配对视角揭示ASR隐藏的显著变化：相似ASR可对应截然不同的恢复率。受控英语重构显示，随着压缩提示更明确，恢复率持续提高，而ASR不遵循同样模式。FormalLogic中高恢复率仍可伴随频繁的有害协助。
AI.conclusion: 非有害结果对模型安全的信息量不同，因此LLM安全评估应联合报告意图恢复和ASR。

title: PathLang: A Language-Centered Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Computational Pathology
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong visual perception ability, but their robustness in the language domain remains poorly characterized. Existing pathology VLM benchmarks largely rely on canonical closed-set prompts or perturb only generic templates, treating language as a fixed evaluation component rather than a variable axis of model behavior. In clinical practice, however, diagnostic language varies across reports, institutions, and candidate diagnoses. We introduce PathLang, a language-centered and clinically grounded zero-shot benchmark. PathLang holds the underlying slides, ground-truth labels, and image-text evaluation direction fixed while systematically varying only the diagnostic language, so that performance differences reflect how a diagnosis is phrased rather than what is imaged. The language variation follows how pathologists actually rephrase diagnoses (terminology, specificity, and reporting style), and all prompts and candidate pools are validated by six board-certified pathologists. PathLang covers four task families: (1) zero-shot classification with image-text alignment analysis, (2) cross-modal retrieval, (3) paraphrase robustness, including semantic-equivalence paraphrases, length and reporting-style variation, and prompt ensembling, and (4) open-vocabulary diagnosis retrieval over four candidate pools with distinct forms of semantic competition. Across nine VLMs and five public datasets spanning four organs, we find that performance is highly sensitive to clinically equivalent paraphrases, varies substantially across forms of semantic competition, and that image-text alignment quality does not necessarily translate into inter-class separability. We release the prompt corpus, candidate pools, pre-computed text embeddings, and evaluation code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PathLang.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PathLang，一个以语言为中心、临床基础的病理视觉语言模型零样本基准，通过系统变化诊断语言来评估模型，覆盖四类任务，在九个VLM和五个数据集上发现性能对临床等价改写高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有病理VLM基准多依赖规范闭集提示或仅扰动通用模板，将语言视为固定评估组件，而临床中诊断语言因报告、机构和候选诊断而异，其语言域鲁棒性尚未被充分表征。
AI.method: 提出PathLang，固定图像、标签和图文评估方向，仅系统变化诊断语言，改写遵循病理学家实际重述（术语、特异性、报告风格），并由六位委员会认证病理学家验证。涵盖四类任务：零样本分类与图文对齐分析、跨模态检索、改写鲁棒性（语义等价改写、长度与报告风格变化、提示集成）、开放词汇诊断检索（四个候选池，不同语义竞争形式）。评估九个VLM和五个公共数据集（涵盖四个器官）。
AI.result: 性能对临床等价改写高度敏感，在不同语义竞争形式间差异显著，且图文对齐质量不一定转化为类间可分性。
AI.conclusion: 语言变化是VLM行为的重要轴，PathLang揭示了病理VLM在语言域的脆弱性，并发布了提示语料、候选池、预计算文本嵌入和评估代码。

title: Workerville: Towards an Organizational Behavior Account of Agent Safety
summary: LLM-based agents now interact with their environments continuously, shaped by such organizational channels as user instructions, peer messages, and long-term memory. Existing safety research has examined these influences, but largely as separate agent components. How such factors jointly shape an agent's safety behavior from a unified perspective remains unmeasured. To bridge this gap, we advocate organizational behavior (OB) as a framework for studying the safety of advanced agents, reorganizing the objects of study, theoretical foundations, and experimental design around the relational structure in which agents operate. We present the first systematic formalization of counterproductive work behavior (CWB), a canonical safety-relevant subfield of OB, as Agentic Counterproductive Behavior (ACB). ACB specifies three organizational antecedents (vertical supervisor relations, horizontal peer norms, and internal cognitive structures) and maps them onto three counterproductive outcome dimensions (unauthorized disclosure, destructive operations, and production deviation). To operationalize ACB, we introduce Workerville, a controlled benchmark that manipulates organizational conditions over shared tasks, applying 16 organizational configurations to 210 tasks to yield 3,360 challenges, evaluated by human-validated agentic judges. Benchmarking 6 frontier LLMs, we find that (I) negative organizational antecedents exhibit non-monotonic amplification when combined, with the unauthorized-disclosure rate rising from 16.5% under no negative antecedent to 60.1% under two and falling back to 50.3% under three; (II) agents reproduce typical behavioral patterns predicted by human CWB research; (III) these results establish OB as a systematic framework for agent safety research, pointing toward a new research agenda.

AI.tldr: 论文主张用组织行为学（OB）框架统一研究LLM智能体安全，将反生产工作行为形式化为智能体反生产行为（ACB），并提出Workerville基准。实验发现组织前因组合对不安全行为具有非单调放大效应，且智能体行为模式与人类CWB研究一致。
AI.motivation: 现有安全研究多将用户指令、同伴消息、长期记忆等视为独立组件，缺乏统一视角来衡量这些因素如何共同塑造智能体的安全行为。
AI.method: 将OB中的反生产工作行为（CWB）形式化为ACB，定义三类组织前因（垂直主管关系、水平同伴规范、内部认知结构）和三类反生产结果（未授权披露、破坏性操作、生产偏离）；构建Workerville基准，在共享任务上操纵组织条件，以16种组织配置×210个任务生成3360个挑战，并由人工验证的智能体评判器评估6个前沿LLM。
AI.result: 负面组织前因组合呈非单调放大：未授权披露率在无负面前因时为16.5%，两种负面前因时升至60.1%，三种时回落至50.3%；智能体还复现了人类CWB研究预测的典型行为模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果确立OB可作为智能体安全研究的系统框架，并指向新的研究议程。

title: From Sparse Representations to Behavioral Insights for Multimodal Depression Assessment
summary: Multimodal depression assessment offers a promising approach to analyzing behavioral patterns associated with depression. However, existing methods often rely on dense and opaque multimodal representations, making it difficult to interpret the behavioral patterns underlying their predictions. In this work, we introduce BehavDep, a sparse factor-based framework that decomposes multimodal behavioral representations into sparse latent factors and associates them with behaviorally meaningful concepts through a semantic bridge. To address the mismatch between user-level annotations and heterogeneous video-level behaviors, BehavDep further learns video-level depression tendency scores under weak supervision and aggregates information across multiple observations for user-level assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BehavDep achieves the best overall assessment performance while revealing complementary modality contributions, heterogeneous behavioral patterns across observations, and prediction responses to concept-level editing. These results show that BehavDep provides a structured and interpretable approach to analyzing multimodal behavioral representations for depression assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出BehavDep，一种基于稀疏因子的可解释多模态抑郁评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态抑郁评估方法依赖密集且不透明的多模态表示，难以解释预测背后的行为模式。
AI.method: 将多模态行为表示分解为稀疏潜在因子，并通过语义桥与行为有意义的概念关联；针对用户级标注与视频级行为不匹配，在弱监督下学习视频级抑郁倾向分数，并聚合多次观察进行用户级评估。
AI.result: 实验表明BehavDep总体评估性能最佳，同时揭示互补模态贡献、不同观察的异质行为模式以及对概念级编辑的预测响应。
AI.conclusion: BehavDep为多模态行为表示分析提供了一种结构化且可解释的方法。

title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 27 pages, 11 figures and 13 tables. Under review
summary: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents. Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, while images are view-dependent projections whose pixel distances do not directly encode physical distances. We introduce UNITAS, to our knowledge the first 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric 3D frame within each interaction, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands. Action flow represents human hands and robot grippers as 3D point trajectories, while scene flow describes scene-point displacements conditioned on these trajectories. World-aligned 3D positional embeddings ground visual tokens with or without depth input, and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer encodes each point trajectory as one token anchored at its current 3D position. This interface supports both direct action execution and action-conditioned scene prediction. With 1.7B parameters, UNITAS achieves the best action-conditioned scene prediction on RoboTwin among the compared methods, with up to 49% lower displacement errors than PointWorld, and state-of-the-art manipulation success, including 99.8% on LIBERO and an average of 85% across real-world tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS.

AI.tldr: 提出UNITAS，首个3D原生世界动作模型，在统一的度量3D框架中联合建模观测、动作与场景动态。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型多基于视频生成器，用图像或视觉潜表示世界演化；但机器人交互发生在度量3D空间，图像是视角相关的投影，其像素距离不直接编码物理距离。
AI.method: 以动作流（人手与机器人夹爪的3D点轨迹）和场景流（以动作流为条件的场景点位移）建模；采用世界对齐的3D位置嵌入（有无深度均可）和物理时间轨迹分词器，将每条点轨迹编码为锚定当前位置的token；支持直接动作执行与动作条件场景预测；模型规模1.7B参数。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin上取得最佳动作条件场景预测，位移误差较PointWorld降低最多49%；操作成功率SOTA：LIBERO达99.8%，真实任务平均85%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了跨机器人本体与人手的统一3D原生表示的有效性，代码已开源。

title: PIER: An Evidence-Gated Execution Interface for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Ancillary files include reproducibility code and retained experimental records
summary: Generating a plausible robot action does not establish that current observations justify its execution. Motivated by exploratory observations of high-confidence visual outputs under severe occlusion, we present PIER, an execution-authorization interface that separates evidence checks, decision provenance, and stage-scoped re-observation from hardware control. The deterministic gate evaluates declared visual and tactile inputs, while its caller maintains a budget of at most one re-observation per stage. We evaluate the implementation using 1,600 threshold-grid cases and 1,200 paired synthetic traces spanning score noise, missing tactile inputs, stale observations, and falsely reassuring scores. The finite grid yields zero declared invariant violations, and a matched Boolean baseline reproduces all non-recovery decisions. Under synthetic score noise, re-observation reduces valid-state denials from 57/120 to 18/120 while increasing invalid-state proceeds from 5/120 to 7/120. Stale and falsely reassuring inputs expose limitations that threshold checks alone cannot resolve. Exploratory visual, tactile, and robot setup records provide context but do not establish physical task performance. These results characterize an inspectable authorization interface and its input-contract limitations, without claiming superiority over equivalent rule logic, calibrated tactile accuracy, or certified physical safety.

AI.tldr: 提出 PIER，一种将证据检查、决策溯源和阶段范围重观测与硬件控制分离的执行授权接口；用合成与阈值网格评估其可检查性与输入契约限制。
AI.motivation: 观察到严重遮挡下仍出现高置信度视觉输出，促使研究如何判断当前观测是否足以授权机器人执行动作，而非仅生成看似合理的动作。
AI.method: 确定性门控评估声明的视觉与触觉输入；调用方每阶段最多一次重观测。使用1600个阈值网格案例和1200对合成轨迹，覆盖分数噪声、触觉缺失、陈旧观测和虚假安心分数，并与匹配的布尔基线比较。
AI.result: 有限网格零声明不变量违规；布尔基线复现所有非恢复决策。分数噪声下，重观测将有效状态拒绝从57/120降至18/120，但无效状态放行从5/120升至7/120。陈旧和虚假安心输入暴露仅靠阈值检查无法解决的限制。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了一个可检查的授权接口及其输入契约限制，但探索性视觉、触觉和机器人设置记录不能证明物理任务性能；不声称优于等价规则逻辑、校准触觉精度或认证物理安全。

title: EgoPhys: Estimating Peak Contact Force and Mechanical Work from Egocentric Manipulation Video
summary: Physically grounded manipulation of articulated objects requires understanding both the maximum forces encountered during contact and the work performed as their parts move. Peak contact force and mechanical work quantify these complementary aspects, but estimating them from egocentric video is challenging because physical interaction cues are local and indirect. Moreover, peak force is associated with brief contact events, whereas mechanical work depends on force-motion coupling throughout the contact duration. To address these challenges, we propose EgoPhys, an RGB-only framework comprising Contact-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CASA) and Target-Specific Multi-Expert Temporal Routing (TMTR). CASA integrates appearance and geometry features to emphasize interaction-relevant cues, while TMTR models semantic, event, and motion cues with specialized temporal experts and routes them separately for force and work prediction. On the test split from Hoi! dataset, EgoPhys substantially improves predictions of peak force and mechanical work, achieving MAEs of \(5.205 \pm 0.584\) $N$ and $0.894 \pm 0.081$ $J$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用RGB视频的EgoPhys框架，通过CASA和TMTR估计关节物体操作中的峰值接触力与机械功，并在Hoi!数据集上取得较低误差。
AI.motivation: 物理接地地操作关节物体需要理解接触时的最大力及部件运动所做的功；但仅从自我中心视频估计峰值接触力和机械功很困难，因为物理交互线索局部且间接，且峰值力对应短暂接触事件，而机械功依赖整个接触过程中的力-运动耦合。
AI.method: 提出EgoPhys，一个仅使用RGB的框架，包含接触感知空间聚合（CASA）和目标特定多专家时序路由（TMTR）。CASA融合外观与几何特征以突出交互相关线索；TMTR使用时序专家建模语义、事件和运动线索，并分别为力预测和功预测进行路由。
AI.result: 在Hoi!数据集测试集上，EgoPhys显著改进了峰值力和机械功预测，平均绝对误差分别为5.205±0.584 N和0.894±0.081 J。
AI.conclusion: EgoPhys能够仅凭RGB视频有效估计关节物体操作中的峰值接触力和机械功，验证了空间聚合与多专家时序路由设计的有效性。

title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
summary: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

AI.tldr: SuperNav 提出一种无需导航专用微调 MLLM 的通用机器人导航系统，通过智能体框架将请求理解、场景理解与决策交给预训练 MLLM，把运动执行交给导航工具，从而兼顾任务通用性与场景通用性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常微调多模态大模型来预测导航动作，导致行为依赖导航训练数据覆盖范围，难以泛化到新请求和新环境；因此需要保留 MLLM 通用能力，同时实现多样人类请求下的导航。
AI.method: SuperNav 为预训练 MLLM 配备专用智能体框架，不进行导航特定微调；包含导航技能、面向智能体的物理交互工具、任务进度与上下文管理；并通过统一视觉点接口让模型直接在图像中指定目的地，并依据执行反馈修正决策。
AI.result: SuperNav 在实例级、多目标和需求驱动任务上优于四个基线；在 HM3D 上的类别级评估和真实四足机器人部署进一步证明其跨环境适用性。
AI.conclusion: 将高层 MLLM 决策与底层运动执行解耦，可保留通用能力并支持持续导航，使系统适应不同任务需求与环境，提升通用导航泛化性。

title: Memory Type Varies: Empowering LLM Agents for Long-Term Memory with Diverse Strategies
summary: The memory capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have garnered increasing attention recently. Despite great success achieved, existing retrieval-based memory approaches typically overlook the differences between memories and employ a unified strategy to process all memories, leading to suboptimal performance. Thus, an intuitive question arises: can we categorize memory into different types and select appropriate strategies? However, given the topic-rich, scenario-complex, and boundary-blurred nature of memory scenarios, achieving precise classification of memories is not easy. To address this challenge, we propose a memory multi-class dataset in this paper, termed TriMEM, which provides precise annotations for memory types across diverse scenarios. Building upon this foundation, we propose a novel memory framework, named MemoType, which can adaptively recognize each memory and query type with the learned router model. With the memory and query routing, MemoType can retrieve the memory with corresponding query types and design tailored retrieval strategies, thereby enhancing the retrieval performance. Moreover, we theoretically prove that any single retrieval strategy is subject to a fundamental upper bound on its expected retrieval precision in multi-class corpora, leading to systematic precision degradation. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that MemoType consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 16.18% improvement in Recall@1.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM检索式记忆方法忽略记忆差异、统一处理导致性能次优的问题，提出记忆多分类数据集TriMEM和自适应路由框架MemoType，并通过理论与实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有检索式记忆方法通常将所有记忆统一处理，忽视了不同记忆之间的差异，导致检索性能次优；但记忆场景主题丰富、场景复杂且边界模糊，难以精确分类并选择合适策略。
AI.method: 提出TriMEM记忆多分类数据集，为多样场景中的记忆类型提供精确标注；提出MemoType框架，利用学习到的路由器模型自适应识别记忆和查询类型，并根据查询类型检索对应记忆、设计定制化检索策略。
AI.result: 理论上证明在多分类语料中，任何单一检索策略的期望检索精度存在根本上限，会导致系统性精度下降；在三个数据集上的实验表明，MemoType持续优于现有方法，Recall@1最高提升16.18%。
AI.conclusion: 通过记忆与查询的路由和定制化检索策略，MemoType能有效提升LLM记忆检索性能，说明对记忆进行分类并自适应选择策略是可行且有效的。

title: Adaptive Adversarial Augmentation for Controllable Face Synthesis
summary: Synthetic data provides a scalable alternative to real-world datasets for training face recognition models, particularly under challenging conditions such as low resolution, occlusion, and masks. Yet, most approaches lack diversity and fail to generalize effectively. We propose Ensemble Feedback Controllable Synthesis (EFCS), a guided framework that generates diverse and challenging samples while preserving visual realism. EFCS expands distributional variability, often reflected in higher FID and KID scores compared to single-feedback and random synthesis, while maintaining high precision. Recognition models trained on EFCS data consistently outperform baselines across multiple benchmarks, showing improved generalization to real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we introduce an analytically motivated formulation linking perturbation-induced difficulty, sample utility, and performance degradation, offering principled insights into balancing synthetic data complexity for optimal training. Together, these contributions establish EFCS as an effective and analytically grounded approach for bridging the gap between synthetic and real datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出EFCS合成人脸识别训练数据框架，可生成多样且具挑战性、保持真实的样本，提升模型泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 真实人脸数据在低分辨率、遮挡、口罩等挑战场景下采集困难，合成数据虽可扩展，但现有方法多样性不足且泛化效果差。
AI.method: 提出集成反馈可控合成EFCS，以引导式框架生成多样且困难的样本并保持视觉真实；扩大分布差异，并建立扰动诱导难度、样本效用与性能退化之间的解析联系。
AI.result: EFCS样本的FID和KID高于单反馈与随机合成，同时保持高精度；用EFCS数据训练的识别模型在多个基准上优于基线，对真实场景泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: EFCS能有效弥合合成数据与真实数据之间的差距，并为平衡合成数据复杂度以优化训练提供有理论依据的方法。

title: Instance-anchored interaction evidence: Grounding robot plans in human pointing and handling
summary: A robot that assists people must often act on what a person has shown rather than said: which of several identical cartons was pointed at, or which box was handled. The plan is executed from the final scene, whereas the evidence occurs earlier, possibly on objects that have since moved. We propose instance-anchored interaction evidence (IAE), which registers every object of the final scene to its public identifier, keeps each identity through the video by backward mask propagation, and describes every frame by the geometry between hands, forearms and these instances. An evidence network trained only from task outcomes scores the instances. For pointing tasks, a grammar-constrained dynamic program trained with a structured loss decodes object-destination programs; symbolic programs handle reference disambiguation and, without learning, episodic tasks. On 1,255 WatchAct benchmark requests, scored by symbolic execution, IAE reaches 64.2% plan success on implicit-intent tasks against 27.5% for a 32B vision-language model (strict success 49.7% against 15.4%), and 46.4% against 27.0% on restoration, reversal and imitation without task-specific training. Controls with the same perception overlays, the same 32 frames, forward tracking, or a relation model trained on the same labels do not explain the gain. Given IAE's evidence as text with its meaning explained, the same language model reaches 57.4%: most of the gain comes from the instance-anchored evidence, and the explicit programs add 6.8 points at a fraction of the cost. Pointing remains the hardest case, with 16.9% strict success. The code is available at https://github.com/WeiZhou96/iae-watchact.

AI.tldr: 提出实例锚定的交互证据（IAE），将最终场景物体与公开标识绑定，并通过反向掩码传播保持身份，利用手、前臂与实例之间的几何关系描述每帧。基于任务结果训练证据网络和语法约束动态规划，在WatchAct基准上显著优于大视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 机器人常需根据人的非言语指示行动，如指向或操作某个相同物体。但证据出现在早期帧，而计划需从最终场景执行，物体可能已移动，因此需要跨时间保持物体身份并关联交互证据。
AI.method: 提出IAE：注册最终场景物体到公开标识，反向掩码传播保持身份，用几何关系描述手、前臂与实例。训练证据网络仅使用任务结果评分实例；对指向任务，用语法约束动态规划和结构化损失解码物体-目的地程序。符号程序处理指代消歧和无学习的情节任务。
AI.result: 在1,255个WatchAct请求上，IAE在隐式意图任务达64.2%计划成功率，相比32B视觉语言模型的27.5%；严格成功率为49.7%对15.4%。在恢复、反转和模仿任务上为46.4%对27.0%，且无需任务特定训练。消融控制不能解释增益。将IAE证据作为文本并解释含义，同一语言模型达57.4%，说明增益主要来自实例锚定证据，显式程序以低代价增加6.8个百分点。指向仍最难，严格成功率16.9%。
AI.conclusion: IAE通过实例锚定和反向身份保持有效利用非言语交互证据，显著提升机器人对隐式意图和情节任务的理解与执行能力。显式符号程序补充增益且成本低，但指向任务仍是主要挑战。

title: Scaling to Tens of Thousands of Test-Time Iterations with Loop-Native Attention Residuals
summary: In this paper, we argue that looped Transformers need their own residual connections to prevent performance degradation as the number of iterations grows. We observe that increasing loop iterations can reduce reasoning accuracy: noisy state updates overwrite correct intermediate deductions and even undo completed solutions. This leaves subsequent iterations to recover lost information from an already degraded representation: once an error arises in an earlier loop, often as a result of long-range propagation through the recurrence, later loops find it difficult to correct. In this paper, we introduce InfiLoop, a loop-native residual connection that learns which past computations to retain and how much to accept from each new update. InfiLoop combines content-based weighting with learned temporal decay to maintain a running summary of recurrent states. An exact streaming recurrence keeps its persistent aggregation memory constant as the loop count grows. The resulting adaptive update suppresses unreliable proposals and preserves useful intermediate states. Across extensive reasoning tasks, a 7M-parameter InfiLoop model outperforms existing recursive architectures, reaching 97.9% exact accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme, and 13.6% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2. Notably, on Sudoku-Extreme, InfiLoop continues to improve with test-time looping beyond 20,000 effective steps, showing that added depth translates directly into stronger reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/pixeli99/InfiLoop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfiLoop，一种面向循环Transformer的残差连接，通过自适应保留历史计算与衰减新更新，防止迭代增加导致的推理性能下降，并在推理任务上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer随着迭代次数增加，噪声状态更新会覆盖正确中间推导，甚至撤销已完成解，错误在循环中长程传播后难以纠正，因此需要专门的残差机制来稳定并利用迭代深度。
AI.method: 提出InfiLoop，一种循环原生残差连接，结合基于内容的加权和学习的时间衰减，维护循环状态的运行摘要；采用精确的流式递归使持久聚合内存在循环数增长时保持恒定，自适应更新抑制不可靠提议并保留有用中间状态。
AI.result: 7M参数的InfiLoop在多个推理任务上超越现有递归架构，在Sudoku-Extreme上达到97.9%精确准确率，在ARC-AGI-2上达到13.6% pass@2；在Sudoku-Extreme上测试时循环超过20,000有效步仍持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 循环Transformer需要自身残差连接；InfiLoop通过自适应聚合历史状态有效防止迭代退化，证明增加测试时循环深度可直接转化为更强推理能力。代码已开源。

title: Error-Propagation Modeling for Failure Attribution in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) are increasingly used to solve complex tasks through coordinated reasoning, tool use, and interaction with external resources. However, attributing failures in such systems remains challenging because the observed outcome often does not directly reveal the error responsible for the failed execution. In this work, the attribution target is the decisive error, defined as the agent--step pair whose correction would recover the failed execution. Existing approaches largely identify suspicious steps without explicitly modeling how errors propagate across interactions or persist in unresolved loops, making decisive errors difficult to distinguish from downstream failure symptoms. We propose \textbf{E}rror-Propagation \textbf{M}odeling for \textbf{F}ailure \textbf{A}ttribution (\textbf{EMFA}). EMFA constructs a structured representation of the failed trajectory, models both cascading propagation and persistent interaction loops, and uses propagation-aware candidate screening followed by counterfactual verification to identify the decisive agent--step pair. On the Who\&When benchmark, EMFA achieves state-of-the-art step-level attribution accuracy and remains competitive at the agent level. It improves the previous best step-level results by 3.45 and 4.40 percentage points on the Hand-Crafted and Algorithm-Generated subsets, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM多智能体系统失败归因问题，提出EMFA方法，通过建模错误传播与持久交互循环，定位导致失败的决定性智能体-步骤对，并在Who&When基准上取得最优步骤级归因效果。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统通过协调推理、工具使用和外部资源交互解决复杂任务，但失败归因困难，因为最终结果往往不能直接揭示导致失败的错误。现有方法多识别可疑步骤，未显式建模错误如何在交互中传播或持续存在，因此难以区分决定性错误与下游故障症状。
AI.method: 提出错误传播建模用于失败归因（EMFA）。EMFA构建失败轨迹的结构化表示，建模级联传播和持续交互循环，并采用传播感知的候选筛选，随后通过反事实验证识别决定性的智能体-步骤对。
AI.result: 在Who&When基准上，EMFA取得最先进的步骤级归因准确率，并在智能体级保持竞争力。相比此前最佳步骤级结果，在Hand-Crafted和Algorithm-Generated子集上分别提升3.45和4.40个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模错误传播与交互循环，并结合反事实验证，EMFA能更有效定位LLM多智能体系统失败中的决定性错误，提升失败归因性能。

title: Detecting Spin in Clinical Trials with Large Language Models
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at the 29th International Multiconference Information Society (IS 2026), AI in Healthcare track, Ljubljana, Slovenia. Code: https://github.com/ta5946/Spin
summary: Spin in clinical trials includes reporting practices that distort the presentation of results. This is particularly critical in medicine, where spin is present in more than 50% of randomized controlled trials that fail to reach statistical significance. The comparison of primary and reported outcomes is crucial for detecting several types of spin, including outcome switching. We used 300 pairs of outcomes labeled with semantic similarity to develop a system for automatic detection of outcome switching. We evaluated baseline text similarity models and open-source LLMs using generated similarity scores and the Youden index to determine the classification threshold. The proposed approach involves prompt engineering, classification based on token probabilities, and majority voting for the final decision. The results on the test set of 2,496 examples with an F1 score of 0.78 and an accuracy of 0.90 outperform baseline text similarity models but trail behind fine-tuned versions of BERT. We used LLMs to generate natural language explanations for the classified instances and manually assessed their quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个自动检测临床试验中结局切换（outcome switching）的系统。作者使用300对带语义相似度标注的结局数据，评估基线文本相似度模型和开源大语言模型（LLM），并结合提示工程、基于token概率的分类和多数投票。在2496个测试样本上，系统取得F1值0.78、准确率0.90，优于基线文本相似度模型，但低于微调BERT。作者还用LLM生成自然语言解释并人工评估其质量。
AI.motivation: 临床试验中的spin会扭曲结果呈现，在医学领域尤为关键；超过50%未达到统计学显著性的随机对照试验存在spin。比较主要结局与报告结局对于检测结局切换等多种spin类型至关重要，因此需要自动检测方法。
AI.method: 使用300对标注语义相似度的结局数据开发系统；评估基线文本相似度模型和开源LLM，利用生成的相似度分数与Youden指数确定分类阈值；提出结合提示工程、基于token概率的分类以及多数投票的最终决策方法；在2496个测试样本上评估，并使用LLM为分类实例生成自然语言解释，再人工评估解释质量。
AI.result: 在2496个测试样本上，该方法F1值为0.78，准确率为0.90，优于基线文本相似度模型，但落后于微调BERT版本。LLM生成的自然语言解释也经过人工质量评估。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的方法可用于自动检测临床试验结局切换，并能提供自然语言解释，具有一定可行性；但其性能仍不及微调BERT，说明该任务上专用微调模型可能更有效，LLM方法可作为补充或解释性工具帮助识别spin。

title: Easy to anticipate, hard to compute: boundary dependence finds the computed outputs that entropy patching misses
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, logs and results: https://github.com/nicoveraz/segresearch (archived: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23238215)
summary: Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) group bytes into patches and run their large global model once per patch. BLT starts a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high, so global compute goes where the next byte is hard to predict. We show that this rule has a systematic blind spot: positions whose type is predictable but whose value must be computed, such as the number after "=" in a worked math solution. Under tight patch budgets, entropy-triggered layouts skip these positions, and accuracy on them collapses. In Meta's BLT-1B with patch starts on 10% of bytes, the entropy rule puts a patch start at 16% of the computed results in GSM8K solutions and gets 19.0% of them exactly right; a boundary after each "=" at the same patch count gets 51.8%, and entropy combined with a label-free boundary-dependence signal gets 67.1% (default layout at 26% of bytes: 76.8%). The gap survives adapting BLT-1B to the budget with low-rank fine-tuning (32.9% vs 72.7%, three runs per rule, paired p < 1e-200) and grows with model size in byte models trained from scratch at a 10% budget: at 1M, 12M and 50M parameters, boundary dependence beats entropy on final answers by -1.6, +10.1 and +19.8 points, and at 50M it gets 35.9% of computed results against 13.9% (3 seeds each). BLT's entropy-jump rule helps neither target at 50M. The entropy trigger of Scratchpad Patching is likewise indistinguishable from random scratchpads on final answers (5.6% vs 5.9%, 5 seeds), while answer-start scratchpads give 38.1%. The effect is specific to computed values: copies and lookups gain little, and values the model cannot compute gain nothing. Boundary dependence, the rise in the model's own loss when a patch start is removed, measured per two-byte context, finds these positions without labels: combined with entropy it beats the hand-written rule on computed results.

AI.tldr: 字节级语言模型（如BLT）按熵触发patch划分，会在类型可预测但值需计算的字节位置形成盲点；紧patch预算下这些位置被跳过，计算准确率崩溃。论文提出边界依赖信号可无标签定位这些位置，与熵结合后显著优于熵规则甚至手写规则。
AI.motivation: BLT等模型根据下一字节熵高低决定全局计算位置，假设高熵即难预测且重要。但数学解答中“=”后的数字类型可预测、值需计算，熵可能不高，导致熵触发规则系统性忽略真正需要计算的位置。
AI.method: 分析BLT-1B的patch布局，比较熵规则、每个“=”后加边界、以及标签无关的边界依赖信号；用低秩微调适配紧预算；从头训练1M/12M/50M字节模型；并检验Scratchpad Patching。边界依赖定义为移除某patch start时模型自身loss上升，按两字节上下文测量，无需标签。
AI.result: 在BLT-1B 10% patch预算下，熵规则仅覆盖16%的GSM8K计算结果，精确率19.0%；“=”后边界为51.8%；熵+边界依赖为67.1%；默认26%预算为76.8%。低秩微调后为32.9% vs 72.7%（p<1e-200）。从头训练50M参数时，边界依赖在最终答案上比熵高19.8点，计算结果35.9% vs 13.9%。Scratchpad Patching的熵触发与随机scratchpad无显著差异（5.6% vs 5.9%），答案起始为38.1%。效果限于需计算值，复制/查找收益小，无法计算的值无收益。
AI.conclusion: 熵触发规则存在系统盲点：它不能发现类型可预测但值需计算的位置。边界依赖可无标签定位这些位置，与熵结合后优于手写规则。字节级模型需重新设计patch策略，以将全局计算分配到真正需要计算的值上。

title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
summary: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simulation and on a real robot. The model achieves competitive simulation performance and higher task success and target coverage than the evaluated real-robot policy baselines. Training ablations show improved control with joint action and state sequences, with further gains from random-play pretraining. Given supplied action trajectories, the same model also predicts successive scene states, capturing the geometric effects of pushing.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial Language Modeling，用离散坐标和语义 token 统一表示场景轮廓、目标、动作目标与未来状态，并按任务语法组织为空间序列，用自回归 Transformer 联合学习动作生成与动作条件状态预测，在 Push-T 仿真和真机上验证。
AI.motivation: 动作会改变场景几何，这种变化可为目标导向操作提供互补监督；因此需要一种能同时建模动作生成与状态预测的统一表示和学习框架。
AI.method: 使用共享词汇表表示离散坐标和语义 token；通过任务特定语法组织空间序列；用单个自回归 Transformer 以 next-token 目标学习动作生成和动作条件状态预测。训练从零开始：先随机游玩转移预训练，再在专家演示上联合训练动作与状态；预训练中动作坐标条件化后续状态预测但不计入预测损失。控制时只解码可执行动作目标，并用新观测状态更新历史。
AI.result: 在 Push-T 仿真中取得有竞争力的性能；在真实机器人上任务成功率和目标覆盖率高于所评估的基线策略。消融实验显示联合动作与状态序列可改善控制，随机游玩预训练带来进一步提升；给定动作轨迹，同一模型还能预测后续场景状态，捕捉推动的几何效应。
AI.conclusion: 空间语言建模能够统一动作生成与动作条件状态预测，并从随机游玩预训练和专家联合训练中获益，在仿真与真实机器人操作任务中有效。

title: Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications from LLM-Chats to Autonomous AI Agent System
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically.
  In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents.
  This survey describes seven recurring forms---LLM chats, custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-enhanced workflows, copilots, coding agents, and, in part, agentic RAG---in a common vocabulary of agents and tools. Each is characterized along four structural dimensions (agentic RAG only partially): the architectural pattern, the control of execution and the point of user intervention, the number of agent calls per task, and tool use. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察了LLM系统标签（如聊天机器人、copilot、RAG、工作流、编码代理和AI代理）是否具有真实架构含义。调查归纳出七类反复出现的系统形态，并从架构模式、执行控制与用户介入点、每任务代理调用次数、工具使用四个维度进行刻画。
AI.motivation: LLM日益作为软件系统组件被嵌入，并常以chatbot、copilot、RAG、workflow、coding agent、AI agent等标签进行宣传。但这些标签究竟代表真正的架构形式，还是仅作为品牌营销，尚未得到系统评估。
AI.method: 采用调查/综述方法，在统一的“代理与工具”词汇下描述七类系统：LLM聊天、自定义代理、RAG、AI增强工作流、copilot、编码代理以及部分agentic RAG。沿四个结构维度进行分析：架构模式、执行控制与用户干预点、每任务代理调用次数、工具使用。并以来自研究文献和厂商文档的22个系统作为示例语料。
AI.result: 标签确实承载架构内容，尤其在厂商用法中：copilot表示一种router-worker架构，在宿主应用中运行并逐步请求用户确认；转向“agent”标签则与AI规划的多步骤执行相吻合，用户通常只看到最终结果。四家主要提供商的编码代理共享同一架构，即推理-行动循环并委派给子代理。
AI.conclusion: LLM系统标签并非纯粹品牌用语，许多标签具有可识别的架构含义。本文以共同词汇和四个结构维度描述了七类反复出现的系统形态，并通过22个系统示例说明其适用性及边界。

title: FlyMark: Training-Free Invisible Watermarking of 3D Gaussian Splatting via a Fruit Fly Connectome
summary: A trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene ships as a portable parameter array that can be copied, pruned, requantized, or repackaged outside its training pipeline, so ownership evidence is most useful when it lives in the released parameters and remains checkable long after the embedding tooling is gone. Existing 3DGS watermarks typically tie embedding or extraction to scene optimization, a learned decoder, or rendered views, so the evidence survives only as long as a second trained artifact does. FlyMark instead writes a keyed message into the parameters a 3DGS file already stores. Its carrier directions are derived from the photoreceptors of a published connectome, a citable versioned artifact that fixes the geometry exhaustively and leaves nothing to tune per scene. A virtual observer reads cone-wise apparent luminance along a scene-normalized orbit from stored centers, colors, and opacities; a keyed dithered quantization-index-modulation code replicates each message bit across these observations; and one sparse bounded least-squares solve realizes the targets through achromatic shifts of existing degree-zero colors under a hard per-channel linear-RGB bound. All geometry and higher-order appearance parameters are preserved bit-identically, and extraction needs only cone queries, rounding, and majority voting. Under a model-domain threat model on synthetic and real scenes, FlyMark attains high clean bit accuracy and visual fidelity while cleanly separating matched from wrong keys.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlyMark，一种将密钥消息直接写入 3DGS 已存储参数的参数域水印方法；载体方向来自已发表连接组的光感受器，提取只需锥体查询、取整和多数投票。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 水印多依赖场景优化、学习解码器或渲染视图，证据依赖第二个训练产物；作者希望所有权证据存在于发布参数中，且在嵌入工具消失后仍可验证。
AI.method: 从已发表连接组的光感受器确定载体方向；虚拟观察者在场景归一化轨道上读取中心、颜色、不透明度对应的锥体感知亮度；用带密钥的抖动量化索引调制码将每位消息重复编码到这些观测中；通过一次稀疏有界最小二乘求解，在硬性逐通道线性 RGB 边界下对已有零阶颜色做消色差偏移；几何与高阶外观参数保持逐位不变。
AI.result: 在合成和真实场景的模型域威胁模型下，FlyMark 获得高干净比特准确率和视觉保真度，并能清晰区分匹配密钥与错误密钥。
AI.conclusion: FlyMark 将所有权证据嵌入 3DGS 发布参数本身，不依赖场景优化或学习解码器，提取简单，适合长期、可移植的参数级水印验证。

title: AgentEvolver: System-Wide Self-Evolution Through Task Execution
summary: An agent can complete a task without improving how it works. Turning task experience into reusable capability requires connecting the changed component to its evaluation and subsequent use. We present AgentEvolver, a system for developing capabilities during task execution while keeping the foundation model fixed. Eight entity families expose reusable operations, methods, agents, control flow, interfaces, and supporting state to revision through a common versioned lifecycle. A shared Runtime coordinates ongoing work, while persistent planning and recoverable context preserve task direction and supporting evidence. We evaluate task outcomes on SWE-bench Pro Public and examine capability changes in six application cases. The team reports an 82.08\% resolution rate with evolution, exceeding its reported baseline without evolution. The cases show retained capabilities entering later website, game, and research work, while also documenting incomplete objectives and an unsuccessful strategy. These findings distinguish improvement in a reusable component from success on the final task. AgentEvolver provides a concrete basis for studying capability accumulation through execution; independent-task transfer and total development cost remain open questions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AgentEvolver，一种在固定基础模型下、通过任务执行来积累可复用能力的系统，并在 SWE-bench Pro Public 与六个应用案例中评估其能力演化效果。
AI.motivation: 智能体完成任务并不等于能力提升；研究动机在于把任务经验转化为可复用能力，并将被修改组件与其评估及后续使用连接起来。
AI.method: AgentEvolver 通过八类实体家族暴露可复用操作、方法、智能体、控制流、接口和支持状态，并采用统一版本化生命周期进行修订；共享 Runtime 协调工作，持久规划和可恢复上下文保持任务方向与证据；在 SWE-bench Pro Public 上评估任务结果，并分析六个应用案例中的能力变化。
AI.result: 带演化的解决率达到 82.08%，超过其报告的无演化基线；案例显示保留的能力进入后续网站、游戏和研究工作，同时也记录了未完成目标和一次失败策略。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了可复用组件的改进与最终任务成功，为通过执行研究能力积累提供了具体基础；独立任务迁移和总开发成本仍是未解决问题。

title: Where to Adapt Matters: Layer-Selective Fine-Tuning for Capability Retention
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to specialized tasks, but often at the cost of degrading general capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing approaches primarily mitigate this trade-off through data replay or regularization, relying on additional data or explicit optimization constraints. We instead focus on a different question: where should adaptation be applied? We find that fine-tuning different Transformer layers produces different target-task gains and degrees of capability degradation, suggesting that not all layers are equally suitable for adaptation. To characterize this difference, we use layer-wise empirical Fisher information to measure target-task sensitivity. However, computing Fisher scores requires backward computation and becomes increasingly expensive for large models. We therefore introduce input--output cosine similarity as a lightweight, forward-only proxy for ranking layer sensitivity. Across models and tasks, layers with lower input--output similarity consistently exhibit higher empirical Fisher scores. Building on this observation, we propose Layer-Selective LoRA (LS-LoRA), which places trainable LoRA adapters only in layers with low input--output similarity. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that LS-LoRA improves average target-task performance while retaining substantially more commonsense reasoning capability than standard all-layer LoRA, demonstrating that carefully choosing where to adapt can provide a simple and effective way to balance target-task adaptation and general capability retention.

AI.tldr: 论文研究参数高效微调中目标任务适应与通用能力保持的平衡问题，提出应关注“在哪里应用适配”，并基于层输入-输出余弦相似度选择LoRA插入层。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法通常通过数据回放或正则化来缓解微调导致的通用能力退化，但依赖额外数据或显式优化约束。作者希望从层选择角度出发，寻找更简单有效的权衡方式。
AI.method: 使用逐层经验Fisher信息衡量目标任务敏感度，但计算代价高；因此提出输入-输出余弦相似度作为轻量、仅前向的替代指标，用于排序层敏感度，并据此提出LS-LoRA，仅在低输入-输出相似度的层中插入可训练LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 实验表明，低输入-输出相似度的层通常具有更高的经验Fisher分数；在数学推理和代码生成任务上，LS-LoRA相比标准全层LoRA提升了平均目标任务性能，同时保留了更多常识推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 精心选择适配层可以在目标任务适应和通用能力保持之间取得简单而有效的平衡，层选择是改善PEFT权衡的重要方向。

title: RESETTLE: Robotic Recovery through Disagreement-Triggered Retrieval and Efficient Corrective Control
summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires timely intervention to correct emerging deviations and restore progress after execution errors. However, recovery methods based on repeated vision-language reasoning or iterative online optimization can incur substantial latency, delaying intervention. To address these challenges, we introduce RESETTLE(Robotic rEcovery through diSagrEement-Triggered reTrievaL and Efficient Corrective Control), a model-agnostic framework that provides computationally efficient recovery at the action-execution interface of frozen robot policies. RESETTLE triggers recovery when two action proposals independently sampled under identical conditioning persistently disagree. It retrieves a same-task demonstration reference using an adapted V-JEPA encoder and combines a state-servo prior with a guarded visual residual to execute one corrective action without online trajectory optimization or additional vision-language reasoning, then returns control to the base policy. Across six base policies in simulation, RESETTLE achieves up to 8.70%, 6.28%, and 6.83% absolute success-rate gains on LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World, and RoboCasa Tabletop, respectively, with further improvements on four real-world tasks using two policies. In QwenPI-based comparisons, its monitoring-and-recovery computation latency is 74.04%--93.57% lower than VoLoAgent's monitoring-and-planning latency for grasp and place tool calls. It also raises Harness VLA's LIBERO-Pro Swap success from 42% to 50%, demonstrating compatibility with high-level agentic planning. Code available at: https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/RESETTLE

AI.tldr: 提出 RESETTLE，一种模型无关的机器人恢复框架，在冻结策略的动作执行接口处，当两个独立动作提议持续不一致时触发恢复，通过检索同任务演示和高效纠正控制快速纠错。
AI.motivation: 可靠机器人操作需要及时干预以纠正执行偏差和错误，但基于重复视觉语言推理或在线迭代优化的恢复方法延迟高，会耽误干预时机。
AI.method: RESETTLE 在相同条件下独立采样两个动作提议，若持续不一致则触发恢复；使用适配的 V-JEPA 编码器检索同任务演示参考，结合状态伺服先验与受保护的视觉残差执行一次纠正动作，无需在线轨迹优化或额外视觉语言推理，之后将控制权交还基础策略。
AI.result: 在仿真中六个基础策略上，RESETTLE 在 LIBERO-Plus、Meta-World 和 RoboCasa Tabletop 上分别取得最高 8.70%、6.28%、6.83% 的绝对成功率提升；在两个策略的四个真实任务上也有进一步提升。基于 QwenPI 的对比中，其监控与恢复计算延迟比 VoLoAgent 的监控与规划延迟低 74.04%--93.57%；还将 Harness VLA 的 LIBERO-Pro Swap 成功率从 42% 提升到 50%。
AI.conclusion: RESETTLE 能在冻结机器人策略上实现高效、模型无关的恢复，显著提升多任务成功率并大幅降低恢复延迟，且兼容高层智能体规划。

title: Rethinking Contrastive Loss in CLIP Post-training: A Complementary Framework with Frozen Text Encoder
summary: CLIP serves as a foundational vision-language model and the de facto vision encoder for downstream VLMs such as LLaVA. Post-training offers a lightweight route to refine CLIP, but recent work argues that the standard contrastive loss is unsuitable for post-training due to catastrophic forgetting under small batches, motivating designs that abandon the contrastive objective in favor of distillation. We revisit this premise and find that, for the InfoNCE objective, the reported forgetting is driven primarily not by insufficient negatives but by an inappropriate magnitude of the contrastive temperature $τ$: with $τ$ set sufficiently small, contrastive post-training improves rather than degrades the pretrained CLIP, which we explain through the temperature dependence of the InfoNCE gradient. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ComCLIP}, a lightweight single-epoch post-training recipe that freezes CLIP's text encoder---so the refined vision encoder is a drop-in replacement with unchanged architecture and inference cost---and trains the vision encoder with a properly-tempered contrastive loss, an MSE anchoring loss against the original CLIP, and a relational distillation loss from DINOv2. Over multiple seeds, ComCLIP matches the self-distillation baseline CLIP-Refine on zero-shot classification while significantly improving the transferability of visual features, measured by linear probing ($48.99$ vs.\ $42.28$ on ViT-B/16), and on ViT-L/14 it also improves MMVP over CLIP-Refine ($24.20$ vs.\ $19.01$); CLIP-Refine remains stronger on image-text retrieval. Used as a drop-in vision encoder for LLaVA-1.5-7B without re-aligning the projector or LLM, ComCLIP yields no net change across $8$ VLM benchmarks, i.e., the refinement does not break downstream compatibility. Code and models are available at https://github.com/showstarpro/ComCLIP.git.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视了CLIP后训练中对比损失会导致灾难性遗忘的观点，发现问题主要源于温度系数τ设置不当。作者提出ComCLIP：一种冻结文本编码器、单轮次、轻量级的后训练方法，通过合适温度的对比损失、MSE锚定损失和DINOv2关系蒸馏损失训练视觉编码器，在保持零样本分类性能的同时提升视觉特征迁移能力，并可无缝替换LLaVA中的CLIP视觉编码器。
AI.motivation: 近期工作认为标准对比损失不适合CLIP后训练，因为小批量下会导致灾难性遗忘，因此转向蒸馏方法而放弃对比目标。本文旨在重新检验这一前提，并探索对比式后训练是否可通过调整温度系数来避免遗忘并提升CLIP视觉编码器。
AI.method: 作者从InfoNCE梯度的温度依赖性出发，指出遗忘主要不是负样本不足，而是τ幅度不当。基于此提出ComCLIP：单轮次轻量后训练；冻结CLIP文本编码器，使改进后的视觉编码器可直接替换且架构与推理成本不变；训练视觉编码器使用适当温度的对比损失、针对原始CLIP的MSE锚定损失，以及来自DINOv2的关系蒸馏损失。
AI.result: 当τ足够小时，对比式后训练能提升而非降低预训练CLIP。多种子实验中，ComCLIP在零样本分类上匹配自蒸馏基线CLIP-Refine；在ViT-B/16上线性探测由42.28提升至48.99，在ViT-L/14上MMVP由19.01提升至24.20；图像-文本检索上CLIP-Refine仍更强。作为LLaVA-1.5-7B的即插即用视觉编码器且不重新对齐投影器或LLM，ComCLIP在8个VLM基准上无净变化，说明未破坏下游兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 对比式CLIP后训练中的遗忘主要受温度系数τ影响，而非负样本数量。通过合适温度的InfoNCE并结合锚定与关系蒸馏，ComCLIP能够在不改变架构和推理成本的情况下提升视觉特征迁移性，同时保持零样本分类和下游VLM兼容性，是一种有效的即插即用CLIP视觉编码器后训练方案。

title: MiniWAM: Learning Compact Future Targets for Efficient World-Action Modeling
summary: World modeling has emerged as an effective co-training objective for robot policies, giving rise to World Action Models (WAMs) that jointly predict actions and future states. However, most WAMs predict future states in the native representation space of pretrained visual backbones, resulting in high-dimensional targets with substantial training cost. We introduce MiniWAM, which instead predicts compact future representations learned from privileged current-future transitions. To construct these targets, we propose Predictive Representations via Inverse Spatiotemporal Modeling (PRISM), which combines inverse-dynamics supervision with feature reconstruction to emphasize control-relevant transition information while preserving useful future-state information. With the learned PRISM encoder frozen, MiniWAM is trained to jointly predict the resulting targets and robot actions from current observations. With 65$\times$ fewer native future feature tokens, MiniWAM consistently outperforms native future-feature prediction with both DINOv3 and WAN2.1 VAE features, while achieving up to an 8$\times$ speedup in world-action training. At 0.25B parameters, MiniWAM is already competitive with substantially larger WAMs on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmarks. Representation analyses further show that PRISM contributes behavioral structure beyond feature reconstruction alone. These results demonstrate that effective world-action modeling does not require predicting native visual futures, and that compact predictive representations provide a strong and substantially more efficient target for policy learning. The project page is available at: https://j1dan.github.io/MiniWAM.

AI.tldr: MiniWAM 提出用紧凑的预测性表征替代原生视觉未来特征作为世界动作模型的预测目标，大幅降低训练成本，同时保持甚至提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）大多在预训练视觉骨干的原生表征空间中预测未来状态，导致目标维度高、训练开销大。
AI.method: 提出 PRISM（通过逆时空建模的预测表征），结合逆动力学监督与特征重建，从特权当前-未来转移中学习紧凑的预测表征编码器；冻结该编码器后，MiniWAM 从当前观测联合预测该紧凑目标与机器人动作。
AI.result: 原生未来特征 token 减少 65 倍；在 DINOv3 与 WAN2.1 VAE 特征上均优于原生未来特征预测，世界动作训练最高提速 8 倍；0.25B 参数的 MiniWAM 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 2.0 基准上可与更大 WAM 竞争；表征分析表明 PRISM 带来了超越单纯特征重建的行为结构。
AI.conclusion: 有效的世界动作建模无需预测原生视觉未来；紧凑预测表征为策略学习提供了强大且更高效的目标。

title: Can Decision Models Understand Stance? Evaluating Jev Against General-Purpose LLMs
summary: Stance detection requires identifying an author's attitude toward a given target, sometimes based on conversational context. Jev, a specialized decision model designed for structured decision-making, offers an alternative to general-purpose large language models (LLMs). In this work, we evaluate Jev on two stance detection datasets, VAST (English texts) and ZS-CSD (Chinese conversations), comparing it with four general-purpose LLMs and two fine-tuned models. Results show that Jev achieves competitive performance on VAST, matching GPT-5.6 and outperforming the other general-purpose LLMs. However, it falls behind stronger LLMs on ZS-CSD, particularly in distinguishing favor from against. Further analysis suggests that this limitation may be related to understanding reply relationships and stance direction rather than conversation length alone. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of Jev for stance detection.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了专用决策模型Jev在立场检测任务上的表现，在VAST数据集上具有竞争力，但在ZS-CSD数据集上落后于更强LLM，尤其在区分支持与反对方面。
AI.motivation: 立场检测需要识别作者对给定目标的态度，有时需基于对话上下文。Jev作为专为结构化决策设计的专用模型，为通用大语言模型提供了替代方案，因此研究旨在评估其在立场检测中的潜力与局限。
AI.method: 在两个立场检测数据集（VAST英文文本和ZS-CSD中文对话）上评估Jev，并与四个通用LLM和两个微调模型进行比较。
AI.result: Jev在VAST上表现与GPT-5.6相当，优于其他通用LLM；但在ZS-CSD上落后于更强LLM，尤其在区分支持与反对时。分析表明，这一局限可能与理解回复关系和立场方向有关，而非仅对话长度。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显了Jev在立场检测中的潜力和局限性。

title: Not Every Change Is Necessary: Recoverable Drift in Large Language Model Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning in large language models aims to remove unwanted knowledge while preserving the model's remaining capabilities. Although existing methods use retention objectives or restrict where edits occur, achieving the desired forgetting level can still leave collateral changes that impair non-target behavior. Our recovery comparisons suggest that some of these changes can be reversed while preserving observed forgetting performance. In this work, we present Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U), a framework that combines targeted forgetting with the recovery of non-target capabilities. PTP-U first applies local analytic edits to weaken target knowledge associations, then aligns non-target output distributions with those of the original model to recover capabilities while maintaining fixed forgetting constraints. Both stages serve a common goal: satisfying the forgetting requirements while preserving fluent generation and performance on non-target tasks. Across three benchmarks, PTP-U achieves the strongest forgetting-retention trade-off among evaluated methods, reaching 81.22%-91.03% forgetting while preserving 94.20% non-target utility on average. At matched forgetting, PTP-U consistently retains higher non-target utility.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U) 框架，用于大语言模型机器遗忘，在移除目标知识的同时恢复非目标能力，实现更好的遗忘-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法虽引入保留目标或限制编辑位置，但仍可能产生附带改变，损害非目标行为；恢复性比较表明，这些改变可在保持遗忘效果的同时被逆转。
AI.method: PTP-U 分两阶段：先通过局部解析编辑削弱目标知识关联，再将非目标输出分布与原模型对齐，以在固定遗忘约束下恢复非目标能力。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，PTP-U 取得最佳遗忘-保留权衡，遗忘率达到 81.22%-91.03%，平均保留 94.20% 的非目标效用；在相同遗忘水平下，其非目标效用持续更高。
AI.conclusion: PTP-U 能在满足遗忘要求的同时，保持流畅生成和非目标任务性能，证明结合定向遗忘与非目标能力恢复是有效路径。

title: FastJEV: Understanding Redundancy for Compact JEV Inference
summary: JEV models make multimodal decisions by directly scoring candidates. Although the common context is encoded once, candidate evaluation can still repeat matching token histories, duplicate inference states, and execute the full backbone. In this paper, we study these sources of redundancy and present FastJEV for compact candidate evaluation. We jointly organize history reuse and state storage, since sharing computation requires preserving states for later branches. We first introduce shared context anchoring to reuse recurrent initial states and omit unused final recurrent caches. We extend this reuse through candidate prefix sharing, retaining the intermediate states needed by subsequent branches. To further reduce the depth of these paths, we apply decision guided pruning based on relative score changes measured on a small unlabeled set. Our method retains full context encoding and all candidates without additional training. We evaluate FastJEV across three OmniJev model sizes on five public benchmarks and reconstructed LIBERO-10 offline questions. At the selected pruning budgets, the complete method reduces candidate depth by 43.75% to 45.83%, while retaining 93.66% to 97.52% of the original task scores on average across the six evaluation sets. Through controlled experiments, we show how candidate overlap and branching structure affect the execution cost of history reuse. In our implementation, candidate prefix sharing can reduce repeated computation while increasing latency. These findings motivate designing sharing granularity and execution schedules together for efficient JEV inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究JEV模型中多模态候选评估的冗余问题，提出FastJEV，通过共享上下文锚定、候选前缀共享和决策引导剪枝来压缩候选评估，在不额外训练且保留全部候选的情况下降低计算深度。
AI.motivation: JEV模型虽只编码一次共享上下文，但候选评估仍会重复匹配token历史、复制推理状态并执行完整主干，导致计算冗余。
AI.method: FastJEV联合组织历史复用与状态存储：使用共享上下文锚定复用循环初始状态并省略未用最终循环缓存；通过候选前缀共享保留后续分支所需中间状态；再基于小规模无标签集上的相对分数变化进行决策引导剪枝，以降低路径深度。
AI.result: 在三种OmniJev模型规模和五个公开基准及重建的LIBERO-10离线问题上评估，选定剪枝预算下完整方法将候选深度降低43.75%至45.83%，同时在六个评估集上平均保留93.66%至97.52%的原始任务分数。
AI.conclusion: 候选重叠和分支结构会影响历史复用的执行成本；实现中候选前缀共享可减少重复计算但可能增加延迟，因此需要联合设计共享粒度与执行调度以实现高效JEV推理。

title: CRISP: Fixing Flying Pixels in Latent LiDAR Generation via Diffusion Decoding
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 41 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://andrea25512.github.io/CRISP/
summary: Latent LiDAR pipelines suffer from flying pixels: convolutional VAEs blur sharp radial depth discontinuities, yielding edge depths that back-project to points floating between surfaces. We identify this as a major, directly correctable decoder bottleneck and introduce CRISP: a pixel-space diffusion decoder with a backbone-agnostic latent adapter, DiT-based denoiser, and support mask predictor. CRISP replaces video-VAE and LiDAR-native decoders alike while keeping the encoder and latent generator fixed. Across KITTI-360, SemanticKITTI, and nuScenes, replacing only the decoder reduces FSVD/FPVD by 50.5% on average across frozen backbones; for generic video VAEs, the reductions reach 71%/74%. On the LiDAR-native LiDM backbone, FRID drops by 71%, with the largest gains at depth discontinuities. In a pretrained LiDM world model, the same zero-shot replacement improves FSVD by 15.5%, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.

AI.tldr: 论文指出潜在LiDAR流程因卷积VAE模糊径向深度不连续而产生飞点，并提出CRISP：一种像素空间扩散解码器，可即插即用地替换现有解码器以减少飞点并提升重建与世界模型质量。
AI.motivation: 潜在LiDAR管道中，卷积VAE会模糊尖锐的径向深度不连续，导致边缘深度反投影后形成悬浮于表面之间的飞点。作者认为解码器是主要且可直接修正的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出CRISP，一种像素空间扩散解码器，包含骨干无关的潜在适配器、基于DiT的去噪器和支持掩码预测器。它固定编码器和潜在生成器，仅替换视频VAE或LiDAR原生解码器。
AI.result: 在KITTI-360、SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上，仅替换解码器使冻结骨干的FSVD/FPVD平均降低50.5%；对通用视频VAE降低达71%/74%。在LiDAR原生LiDM骨干上，FRID下降71%，深度不连续处增益最大。在预训练LiDM世界模型中，零样本替换使FSVD改善15.5%，缩小sim-to-real差距。
AI.conclusion: CRISP表明飞点问题主要源于解码器，通过像素空间扩散解码器可有效修正，并能在不重新训练编码器/潜在生成器的情况下显著改善多种LiDAR潜在管道和世界模型性能。

title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories.
