MemTrial therefore pools them across dates and similar experiences with a hierarchical Bayesian model, acts on them only after they have predicted unseen dates, and otherwise stays anchored at a conservative reference such as 1/$N$. On four benchmarks, MemTrial not only benefits from experiences that matter (the best of 15 methods on a semi-synthetic benchmark with known experience quality) but also limits its losses when its values do not hold (at most 2.2\% below 1/$N$ on PortBench and InvestorBench, against 15--38\% for the best experience-learning agent). Averaged over five settings, it improves the utility of the best experience-learning agent by 21.2\%, and with eight LLMs it beats every LLM-based baseline on InvestorBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MemTrial，一种用于投资组合管理的 LLM agent 记忆归因方法。它通过比较有无某经验时的决策草案，用 Banzhaf 值估计经验贡献，并用分层贝叶斯跨日期与相似经验汇总，仅在预测未见日期有效后采用，否则锚定 1/N 等保守组合。
AI.motivation: 传统 LLM agent 依据决策结果给记忆中的经验记功，但金融市场结果主要反映当日市场共同走势，导致信用归因偏向市场而非经验，使 agent 常不如等权 1/N 组合。
AI.method: 对每个决策用分数因子设计生成八种经验组合草案；同一市场下比较有无某经验的草案差异，估计该经验的 Banzhaf 值。由于每个日期只出现一次且 LLM 采样有噪声，用分层贝叶斯模型跨日期和相似经验池化这些归因，并且只在经验值能预测未见日期后才行动，否则保持保守参考组合如 1/N。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，MemTrial 不仅能利用真正重要的经验，在半合成且已知经验质量的基准中为15种方法最佳；还能在经验值不成立时限制损失，在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上最多低于 1/N 2.2%，而最佳经验学习 agent 低 15% 到 38%。五个设置平均较最佳经验学习 agent 提升效用 21.2%，并在 InvestorBench 上以八种 LLM 击败所有 LLM 基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过差分归因与验证机制，LLM 投资组合管理 agent 可以识别真正有贡献的经验，并在经验不可靠时控制风险，从而优于现有经验学习方法。

title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis for Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Decoders
summary: Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) pair a visual encoder with a large language model (LLM) and perform well on diverse image-text tasks, yet their reliability is often limited by decoder attention pathologies that suppress visual evidence and exacerbate hallucinations. In this paper, we revisit visual attention sinks and uncover a structured, layer-dependent behavior: across prompts, early and late decoder layers exhibit prompt-invariant attention collapse onto the same few image regions, which we term PIS (Prompt-Invariant Sinks), whereas mid layers become prompt-conditioned and drive vision-language alignment. This split suggests that treating sinks as a uniform effect is incomplete. Building on this insight, we propose SAGE (Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis), a lightweight intervention that steers decoder attention away from PIS and toward query-dependent regions of interest (ROIs) using token-aligned ROI masks derived from standard vision backbones such as CLIP, ViT, and DINOv3. Evaluated on diverse vision-encoder + decoder-only LLM VLM families, SAGE improves visual grounding, reduces hallucinations, and yields consistent gains across public downstream vision-language benchmarks, including fine-grained visual discrimination settings where localized evidence is crucial, when instantiated with backbone-derived ROI masks.

AI.tldr: 论文重新审视视觉注意力汇（visual attention sinks），发现解码器层存在分层行为：早晚期层出现提示无关的注意力坍缩（PIS），中层则受提示调节并驱动视觉-语言对齐；据此提出轻量干预方法SAGE，引导注意力远离PIS并转向查询相关ROI，从而提升视觉 grounding、减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视觉-语言模型（VLMs）虽在图像-文本任务上表现良好，但其可靠性常受解码器注意力病理限制，这些病理会抑制视觉证据并加剧幻觉。作者认为将注意力汇视为统一效应并不完整，需揭示其分层结构。
AI.method: 作者重新审视视觉注意力汇，发现早/晚解码器层存在提示不变的注意力坍缩（PIS），中层为提示条件化。基于此提出SAGE（Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis），利用标准视觉骨干（CLIP、ViT、DINOv3）生成的token对齐ROI掩码，将解码器注意力从PIS转向查询相关的感兴趣区域（ROI）。
AI.result: 在多种视觉编码器+仅解码器LLM的VLM家族上评估，SAGE提升了视觉 grounding、减少了幻觉，并在公开下游视觉-语言基准上取得一致增益，包括局部证据关键的细粒度视觉辨别任务。
AI.conclusion: 注意力汇在解码器中具有分层结构，早晚期PIS与中层对齐存在分工；针对PIS的轻量干预SAGE能有效改善视觉证据利用，表明sink-aware注意力引导是提升VLM可靠性的可行方向。

title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP) 新范式：将具身世界视为图灵机，策略完全由代码实现，代码从相机图像和本体感觉中测量并跟踪状态，无需 VLM/VLA 在环。在 RoboDojo 的 42 个双臂任务上，测试时无模型达到 70.24% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人策略通常将模型保留在控制回路中，如 VLA 映射观测到动作，或 Agent Harness 在运行时查询 VLM 决策。作者认为若机器人、环境和任务状态能被准确表示，则决策可完全写成代码，从而避免运行时依赖大模型。
AI.method: 提出 COAP：代码负责从相机图像和本体感觉中测量并跟踪机器人、环境与任务状态，并据此做出所有决策。同一代码可跨回合应用，不同任务共享一个库，且不需要 VLM 或 VLA 在环。作者分析了三个优势：显式状态可存入代码、执行可控且快速廉价、可扩展性使新任务复用/继承/扩展共享库，并支持递归自我改进。
AI.result: 在 RoboDojo 的 42 个双臂任务上，所构建的代码库在测试时无模型参与的情况下达到 70.24% 的成功率。
AI.conclusion: COAP 的上限取决于状态表示的准确性和代码逻辑的鲁棒性。作者将其提出为具身任务的新范式，并指出由于跨回合适用，它也可作为 VLA 和 Agent Harness 的高效数据引擎。

title: Scalable AI Uncertainty Quantification via Generalized Laplace Active Subspaces
summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying neural networks in scientific and high-stakes applications, but full Bayesian inference over the network parameters is computationally infeasible. We propose a low-rank generalized Laplace approximation for neural-network UQ based on a small number of data-informed curvature directions. Starting from a generalized Bayesian posterior defined through an empirical loss, we construct a local Gaussian approximation around a pretrained set of weights in this active curvature subspace. The posterior variances in the retained subspace are available in closed form, and the prior variance is calibrated by an empirical Bayes procedure. The generalized Bayesian formulation allows us to compare two posterior scalings: the standard Bayesian scaling associated with the summed negative log likelihood, and a mean-loss scaling in which the empirical loss is normalized by the number of data. A central finding is that the standard scaling induces a data-size dependent contraction of the posterior variance in the leading active directions. In regression problems, this can force the low-rank framework to retain additional weak-curvature directions in order to achieve nominal coverage of calibration data. When posterior samples are propagated through the non-linear network, these additional directions can degrade the coherence of the predictive intervals and shift the posterior predictive mean away from the pretrained model. In contrast, the generalized mean-loss scaling yields a more stable, lower dimensional active subspace and produces calibrated, coherent predictive confidence intervals. These results indicate that generalized Laplace active subspaces provide a practical and scalable route to calibrated uncertainty quantification in neural networks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于少量数据驱动曲率方向的低秩广义拉普拉斯近似，用于神经网络不确定性量化，并比较标准贝叶斯缩放与平均损失缩放对后验和预测区间的影响。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在高风险与科学应用中需要可靠的不确定性量化，但对网络参数做完整贝叶斯推断计算上不可行。
AI.method: 从由经验损失定义的广义贝叶斯后验出发，在预训练权重附近、活跃曲率子空间中构建局部高斯近似；保留子空间的后验方差有闭式解，先验方差通过经验贝叶斯校准；比较标准贝叶斯缩放与按数据量归一化的平均损失缩放。
AI.result: 标准缩放会使后验方差随数据规模收缩，在回归问题中迫使低秩框架保留额外弱曲率方向以达到标称覆盖；这些方向经非线性网络传播后会损害预测区间一致性，并使后验预测均值偏离预训练模型。平均损失缩放则得到更稳定、更低维的活跃子空间，并产生校准且一致的预测置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 广义拉普拉斯活跃子空间为神经网络提供了一条实用且可扩展的校准不确定性量化路径。

title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
summary: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and it compresses faster than rereading the whole context.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 KV 缓存压缩：在紧预算下，让模型重读全文来筛选 KV 条目的传统“排练”方法反而失效；提出免训练方法 Attic-KV，通过问答式自测和自适应锚点来保留更可能被读到的条目。
AI.motivation: KV 缓存常在查询未知时就被压缩。主流方法假设模型重读上下文越完整，缓存记忆越好；但作者发现预算紧张时该假设会适得其反：完整重读会把预算摊薄到全文，答案相关条目几乎随机幸存。
AI.method: 提出 Attic-KV：一种免训练的缓存排练方法。让模型用引用上下文的问答对进行“自测”，并加入内容自适应数量的锚点 token，以落实两个原则：排练将被读取的内容，并按可用预算尽量多地排练。
AI.result: 在 RULER 和 LongBench 自然文本任务共八个设置中，Attic 单独使用即为最佳免训练方法；接入 KVgrad 与 RestoreKV+ 后分别最高提升 17.1 和 28.1 分。3% 保留率下，完整重读在 RULER 仅得 31.5/96.5 分，而 Attic 相对完整重读最高领先 41.9 分，且压缩速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 紧预算下的 KV 缓存应“自测”而非“重读”：只排练预期会被读取的内容，并尽可能充分排练。Attic-KV 验证了该思路，在不同评测方式、宿主方法和预算下均有效，且预算越小优势越明显。

title: Beyond Resolution: Object-to-Image Ratio Mismatch in Instance Retrieval
summary: Visual instance retrieval often fails when the same object appears at different apparent sizes in the query and gallery. We show that the dominant cause is usually not resolution loss but object-to-image (O2I) ratio mismatch: the object occupies different fractions of the two images. On a controlled benchmark of 3,021 Objaverse objects rendered at five camera distances, more than 80% of the cross-distance degradation is attributable to O2I mismatch rather than resolution for 9 of 12 pretrained backbones; multi-scale architectures cut the resolution-only effect to single digits yet remain equally susceptible. The failure is also asymmetric: tight queries retrieve more reliably against wide gallery images than the reverse. Guided by this analysis, query-side scale augmentation and an OWLv2 crop reranker reach state of the art on ILIAS 100M (29.2 mAP@1000 before reranking, 42.0 after) without training or modifying the precomputed gallery index, and a LoRA fine-tune matches the query-side gains at a single forward pass, showing that O2I robustness is learnable.

AI.tldr: 论文指出跨尺度视觉实例检索失败的主因是目标在查询与图库图像中占比不匹配（O2I ratio mismatch），而非分辨率损失；提出查询侧尺度增强与 OWLv2 裁剪重排，在 ILIAS 100M 上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 同一物体在查询和图库中表观大小不同时常导致视觉实例检索失败，而以往多将其归因于分辨率损失；作者希望厘清真正原因并提升跨距离检索鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建受控基准：将 3,021 个 Objaverse 物体在五个相机距离下渲染，评估 12 个预训练骨干；分离 O2I mismatch 与分辨率的影响并分析不对称性；提出查询侧尺度增强和 OWLv2 crop reranker，无需训练或修改预计算图库索引；另用 LoRA 微调验证可学习性。
AI.result: 12 个骨干中有 9 个超过 80% 的跨距离退化由 O2I mismatch 导致；多尺度架构将纯分辨率影响降至个位数但仍易受 O2I 影响。失败具有不对称性：紧查询对宽图库比反向更可靠。ILIAS 100M 上达到 29.2 mAP@1000（重排前）和 42.0（重排后）；LoRA 单次前向可匹配查询侧增益。
AI.conclusion: 跨尺度实例检索的核心问题是 O2I ratio mismatch；查询侧尺度增强与重排可显著提升性能且无需改动图库索引；O2I 鲁棒性可通过微调学习。

title: SciTBERT: A family of chronologically consistent language models for scientific and technological language processing
summary: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SciTBERT系列模型，按2013至2025逐年数据截止日期训练，覆盖论文、专利和高质量教育网页文本，并利用论文与专利引用进行时间一致的继续预训练，得到SciTBERT-CI。同时提出PatRepEval基准，用于评估科学与技术交界处的专利文本嵌入任务。
AI.motivation: 现有面向科学论文或专利的预训练编码器虽在下游任务中表现优于通用模型，但由于训练语料在时间和文本来源分布上不受约束，存在前视偏差和领域偏差，限制了其在研究科学、技术及其交互的时间依赖或档案属性方面的适用性。
AI.method: 构建SciTBERT：一组时间一致的BERT类模型，训练数据为科学论文、专利及高质量教育网页文本，截止日期覆盖2013至2025年每年。进一步使用论文和专利引用进行时间一致的继续预训练，形成SciTBERT-CI。并提出PatRepEval基准，包含专利相关文本嵌入任务，覆盖分类、回归和检索。
AI.result: SciTBERT系列模型通常优于此前的领域专用编码器，即使在早期年份限制导致训练数据有限时也是如此。在PatRepEval上，多种涉及论文和专利的分类、回归与检索任务表明，将编码器表示与下游任务领域分布对齐很重要，且时间一致的编码器可以匹配或超过无时间约束训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 时间一致的科学-技术文本编码器能够有效支持科学与技术交叉研究，并在减少前视和领域偏差的同时，保持或提升下游任务性能；编码器表示与任务领域分布的对齐是性能关键。

title: Language-Specific Effects of Tokenizer Choice in Multilingual Language Models
summary: Tokenizer choice affects multilingual language modeling, but vocabulary capacity is finite and vocabulary size is often constrained: improving representation for some languages often comes at the expense of others. We therefore ask whether tokenizer choice matters equally across languages, a question that the current literature leave unanswered. To this end, we train 123 language models spanning 54 tokenizers. In the main comparison, architecture, training corpus, training-token budget, and optimization are held fixed, so the models differ only in their tokenizer. We find that tokenizer choice matters more for languages with less language-model training data: across the 54 tokenizers, the standard deviation of a language's bits-per-byte (BPB) increases as its model training-data share decreases (Spearman rho = -0.52 over the 31 trained languages and -0.69 over the 28 written with word boundaries). Leaving a language out of tokenizer training raises its BPB in every language we study, and the penalty tends to be larger for languages with less language-model training data. Giving lower-resource languages a larger share of tokenizer-training data, however, does not unconditionally help those languages: both equal weighting and an allocation inverting the shares with respect to the language model training data increase their BPB, particularly when language-model training repeats data. Finally, which intrinsic tokenizer properties are associated with better BPB differs across languages, providing further evidence that what makes a good tokenizer depends on the language. We find that the metrics quantifying these properties can be successfully used to predict downstream models' pairwise BPB rankings, suggesting a practical strategy for screening tokenizer candidates before training language models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多语言语言建模中分词器选择的影响是否因语言而异。作者训练了123个语言模型、覆盖54个分词器，在固定架构、语料、训练token预算和优化设置下比较BPB，发现分词器选择对低资源语言影响更大，且“好分词器”的标准因语言而异，并可用内在指标预测下游BPB排序。
AI.motivation: 词汇容量有限，分词器选择往往在语言之间形成取舍：改善某些语言表征可能损害其他语言。现有文献未回答分词器选择对不同语言是否同等重要，因此需要系统研究其跨语言差异。
AI.method: 开展受控实验：训练123个语言模型，使用54个分词器；主比较中固定模型架构、训练语料、训练token预算和优化，仅改变分词器。分析BPB与语言训练数据占比的关系，进行留出某语言的分词器训练实验、不同分词器训练数据分配实验，并考察分词器内在属性与BPB及下游模型BPB排序的关系。
AI.result: 分词器选择对训练数据较少的语言影响更大：54个分词器下，各语言BPB标准差随其模型训练数据占比下降而上升，31种训练语言Spearman rho=-0.52，28种有词边界的语言rho=-0.69。将某语言排除在分词器训练之外会提高其BPB，且低资源语言惩罚通常更大。给低资源语言更大分词器训练数据份额并非无条件有利：等权重和与模型训练数据份额相反的分配会提高其BPB，尤其在语言模型训练数据重复时。与更好BPB相关的分词器内在属性因语言而异；这些属性指标可预测下游模型的成对BPB排序。
AI.conclusion: 分词器选择的重要性具有语言依赖性，低资源语言更敏感；简单增加低资源语言在分词器训练中的份额不一定带来收益。不存在普适最优分词器，好的分词器取决于目标语言。内在分词器指标可用于在训练语言模型前筛选候选分词器。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 论文研究树式投机解码中草稿树与目标模型不匹配的问题，提出目标流视角与退出律，并据此设计精确验证方法TEV和草稿树训练方法ExitTrain。
AI.motivation: 基于草稿分数构建的有限树存在草稿-目标不匹配；作者希望探究在固定树上更优的精确验证能否提高接受率，以及如何利用目标反馈改进草稿树本身。
AI.method: 从目标流视角识别规范退出律，证明一加目标覆盖率可严格约束任意精确路径验证器的期望输出块长度（含bonus token）；提出Tree Exit Verification (TEV)，一种仅需一次退出节点决策和一次bonus token决策的精确、层级并行验证过程；并利用退出律识别缺失目标概率，提出Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) 对推理时草稿树进行节点级反馈训练。
AI.result: 在对话、代码和数学推理任务上验证固定树等价性：ExitTrain将平均输出块长度提高13%，TEV将验证阶段延迟降低15%，相对DDTree取得14%的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了两类改进机会：通过更好的草稿树提高接受率，以及通过更直接的验证降低延迟。

title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
summary: The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

AI.tldr: 论文提出ARC方法，通过推理配方（推理轨迹、自动标注、适配策略）显著提升现有机器人基础模型的零样本任务性能，无需额外机器人演示或大规模训练。
AI.motivation: 现有提升机器人基础模型的方法依赖更大模型、更多演示和昂贵训练。本文旨在寻找一种高效互补的方法，即通过正确的推理配方提升现有SOTA RFMs的零样本性能。
AI.method: ARC包含三部分：1）推理轨迹，基于机器人下一步动作并解释因果结构（为何合适及应产生何效果）；2）可扩展自动标注流程，从现有演示自动生成轨迹，构建ARC-Trace-DROID；3）针对不同架构的预训练RFMs（如VLA π_0.5和WAM Cosmos3-Nano-Policy）进行微调和推理适配，使其利用轨迹进行控制。
AI.result: 在无需额外机器人演示或基础规模训练下，零样本性能提升前所未有。在RoboLab-120和MolmoSpaces上达到新SOTA，RoboLab-Reasoning-50提升达50个百分点。真实机器人上，π_0.5任务成功率提升82.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 正确的推理配方可作为互补且高效的方法，大幅提升现有机器人基础模型的零样本性能，为机器人学习提供新方向。

title: Stop My Dancing! Understanding, Detecting and Attributing Motion-Aware Deepfake Videos
summary: Pose-guided diffusion models can now synthesize entire human figures in motion, spawning a new class of deepfakes: Motion Aware Deepfake (MAD) that have already reached hundreds of millions of viewers. To better understand this emerging threat, we construct the first MAD-specific benchmark and measurement framework, containing over 1.5 million frames that mix 1,363 real and 30,122 synthetic videos from six controllable generators, with realistic perturbations and open-world evaluation splits. Then, we dissect MAD and discover that, despite their global coherence, these videos betray faint yet reliable cues: because the model relies on limited input frames for motion synthesis, it must predict and simulate coherent movement at motion boundaries, thereby producing high-frequency artifacts along with model-specific spectral fingerprints. Based on the observations obtained from analysis on dataset, we propose MoDA, the first defense framework tailored to detect and attribute MAD videos. MoDA couples spatial semantics with steganalysis-rich frequency features via cross-domain alignment and multi-scale aggregation, achieving 94.8% in-distribution and 89.1% cross-dataset detection accuracy gains of 10% to 25% over prior work and 91.5% model attribution accuracy. MoDA achieves 81.94% accuracy on 200 clips produced by two unseen commercial MAD platforms, indicating promising zero-shot transfer, and 78.13% detection accuracy on 1,200 unseen MAD video clips (55k frames in total) collected from the open Internet. Under white-box, gray-box, and black-box adaptive attacks, MoDA maintains relatively stable detection and attribution performance while the accuracies of the baselines drop rapidly.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个面向运动感知深度伪造（MAD）的基准与测量框架，并发现其运动边界处存在高频伪影和模型特定频谱指纹，进而提出检测与归因框架MoDA。
AI.motivation: 姿态引导扩散模型已能合成完整运动人体，催生大量MAD视频，观看量达数亿，构成新兴威胁，但缺乏专门的基准、测量与防御研究。
AI.method: 构建包含150万帧、1363个真实视频和30122个合成视频、覆盖六种可控生成器的MAD基准，并加入真实扰动和开放世界划分；分析MAD在运动边界的高频伪影与频谱指纹；提出MoDA，通过跨域对齐和多尺度聚合融合空间语义与隐写分析式频率特征，用于检测和归因。
AI.result: MoDA在分布内检测准确率94.8%，跨数据集89.1%，较先前工作提升10%至25%，模型归因准确率91.5%；在两个未见商业MAD平台200个片段上达81.94%，在互联网收集的1200个未见MAD片段（5.5万帧）上达78.13%；在白盒、灰盒和黑盒自适应攻击下检测与归因性能相对稳定，基线准确率则快速下降。
AI.conclusion: MAD虽全局连贯，但可通过运动边界高频伪影和频谱指纹识别；MoDA是首个面向MAD检测与归因的防御框架，具有较强跨数据集、零样本和抗攻击能力，显示实际部署潜力。

title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
summary: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索将语言模型用作“研究世界模型”（RWM），用于预测候选研究干预在不同实验环境中的结果，从而在有限实验预算下支持AI研究智能体的持续自我改进。基于9个研究环境、2600多条实验记录和超过17.1万H100 GPU小时的实验数据，发现真实研究经验能提升RWM对未见干预的预测能力，并可在环境间迁移。
AI.motivation: AI研究智能体提出实验的速度快于实际执行实验的能力，因此在有限实验预算下，准确预测实验结果成为持续自我改进的关键能力。
AI.method: 将语言模型评估为RWM，预测候选干预在预训练、后训练和推理等9个研究环境中的结果；使用2600多条真实实验记录，覆盖超过171000 H100 GPU小时；测试同环境研究知识和跨环境研究知识的迁移；在固定选择预算下进行多轮Autoresearch评估；并对13个作为RWM的语言模型进行消融比较。
AI.result: 真实实验经验能提升同环境中对未见干预的预测（Spearman +0.27），并可跨环境复用；仅使用OLMo3、Marin和Nanochat的预训练经验，RWM在Qwen3环境中将选择遗憾较零经验设置降低78%；在固定预算多轮Autoresearch中，具备同环境和跨环境研究知识的RWM分别将最佳增益提高15.8%和11.6%；消融显示，增加研究知识对干预排序的改进可超过更换模型或增加推理努力。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持语言模型作为RWM的可行性，并表明应积累实验数据以用于未来RWM训练，从而提升AI研究智能体在有限实验预算下的自我改进能力。

title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.

AI.tldr: LeWAM 是一种基于无解码器 JEPA 潜空间的双向 Transformer 世界动作模型，联合训练前向、后向、逆动力学与策略预测；在表征对齐、闭环执行和规划方面均表现出优势。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型通常依赖基于重建的表征，这类表征包含噪声和冗余信息，会干扰下游动作与观测预测。
AI.method: 提出 LeWAM：在端到端训练的无解码器 JEPA 潜空间上，使用双向 Transformer 同时进行前向动力学、后向动力学、逆动力学和策略预测。通过线性探针评估潜空间状态对齐，闭环实验与同编码器同规模的流匹配策略对比，并比较原始动作采样与策略头噪声空间规划的 MPC 效果。
AI.result: 1）对齐：线性探针从 LeWAM 潜空间读取机器人和物体状态优于仅前向的 LeWM，且对视觉干扰的忽略程度与 LeWM 相当，并远优于基于重建的 WAM。2）执行：闭环评估中，LeWAM 匹配同编码器同规模的常规流匹配策略，同时额外提供世界模型。3）规划：在 WAM 规划中直接采样原始动作会让 MPC 利用动力学模型误差；改为在策略头噪声空间规划可提升闭环性能。
AI.conclusion: LeWAM 表明，在无解码器 JEPA 潜空间上以多模式联合训练世界动作模型，可同时获得良好的状态对齐、有竞争力的策略执行和更优的规划性能；规划时应在策略头噪声空间而非原始动作空间进行。

title: GLIO2: A GPU-Parallelized Tightly-Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-GNSS System for Robust and Real-Time Global Localization and Mapping
summary: Globally consistent, real-time state estimation in large-scale, perceptually degraded environments is essential for autonomous vehicles and aerial robots, and requires fusing LiDAR, inertial, and GNSS measurements. Existing fusion methods, however, share a scan-to-map front-end with two failure modes. First, each scan is aligned to an incrementally built map that drifts under degeneracy, and once the estimate diverges the error is irrecoverable. Second, even without divergence, a registration biased by dynamic objects or wrong correspondences is propagated as a single pose constraint with an over-confident covariance, leaving its correspondences unavailable for GNSS to re-weight or relinearize. We propose GLIO2, a tightly-coupled LiDAR-Inertial-GNSS system whose GPU-parallel front-end jointly optimizes scan-to-multiscan LiDAR, IMU pre-integration, and raw GNSS measurements in a single sliding-window factor graph, sustaining real-time operation on edge hardware. A complementary offline back-end reuses the same cached factors to refine the entire trajectory in batch, completing the 30-min, 4.51-km UrbanNav Whampoa sequence in about 24 s. Across three public benchmarks (UrbanNav, MARS-LVIG, M3DGR) and self-collected UAV and vehicle data, GLIO2 attains the best overall accuracy among evaluated systems. On a 5.66-km bridge traversed at up to 96 km/h, where every competing baseline diverges under LiDAR degeneracy, it maintains 1.6 m horizontal accuracy. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, the full pipeline runs at about 25 Hz (39.60 ms per scan). The source code and datasets will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出GLIO2，一种紧耦合LiDAR-惯性-GNSS状态估计系统，通过GPU并行前端在滑动窗口因子图中联合优化scan-to-multiscan LiDAR、IMU预积分与原始GNSS观测，并辅以离线批后端，在多个公开数据集和自采数据上取得最佳总体精度，且可在边缘硬件实时运行。
AI.motivation: 大规模且感知退化环境中的全局一致实时状态估计对自动驾驶与空中机器人至关重要，但现有LiDAR-惯性-GNSS融合方法存在两个问题：一是scan-to-map前端在退化下增量建图漂移，一旦发散难以恢复；二是动态物体或错误对应导致的配准偏差被传播为单个过于自信的位姿约束，使GNSS无法重新加权或重新线性化这些对应关系。
AI.method: GLIO2采用紧耦合LiDAR-惯性-GNSS融合框架。前端在GPU上并行联合优化scan-to-multiscan LiDAR、IMU预积分和原始GNSS测量，统一置于滑动窗口因子图中，并可在边缘硬件实时运行。后端复用相同缓存因子，以批处理方式离线细化整条轨迹。
AI.result: 在UrbanNav、MARS-LVIG、M3DGR三个公开基准及自采无人机和车辆数据上，GLIO2总体精度最优。离线后端约24秒完成UrbanNav Whampoa 30分钟、4.51公里序列。在5.66公里、最高96 km/h的桥梁场景中，所有对比基线均因LiDAR退化发散，而GLIO2保持1.6米水平精度。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上全流程约25 Hz，每帧39.60毫秒。
AI.conclusion: GLIO2通过联合优化LiDAR、IMU和原始GNSS观测，缓解了退化环境中的漂移与不可恢复发散问题，并兼顾实时性与离线全局优化精度，适用于边缘平台上的大规模退化环境状态估计。源代码和数据集将公开。

title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.

AI.tldr: TokenRouter 是面向 token 级路由 LLM 推理的高效、开发者友好服务系统，采用请求中心编程与模型中心执行，为每个 LLM 启动子服务器并异步调度，使用延迟批处理调度器，解码吞吐量较现有系统提升 2.01-64.15 倍。
AI.motivation: 尽管会话或查询级粗粒度路由已被生产系统广泛采用，但近期研究表明 token 级细粒度路由能显著提升效率与质量。然而现有系统基于单 LLM 假设，在 token 级路由下存在严重步骤不同步和频繁批次准入延迟，且给开发者带来高实现复杂度。
AI.method: 设计 TokenRouter：遵循“请求中心编程、模型中心执行”原则，开发者以单请求视角描述路由逻辑，运行时为每个 LLM 启动子服务器并异步分发请求；每个子服务器采用延迟批处理调度器，其最优超参数由系统吞吐量数学模型推导得出。
AI.result: 在多种路由算法、工作负载和模型组合下，TokenRouter 的解码吞吐量比现有系统高 2.01-64.15 倍，显著提升了 token 级 LLM 路由的服务效率。
AI.conclusion: TokenRouter 有效解决了 token 级路由推理的服务挑战，在提升吞吐量的同时保持开发者友好，推动了 token 级 LLM 路由服务效率的进步。

title: Parametric Trajectory Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion and flow models require many sequential evaluations, making generation computationally expensive. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but poses a capacity allocation problem: a student must match the teacher's iterative generation with far less sequential computation. Existing trajectory methods ask the student to reproduce teacher transitions that are highly curved at high noise, which can exceed its capacity and degrade fine detail. We introduce Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD), which lets the student parameterize teacher trajectory segments as polynomials and learn from teacher guidance along its own predicted path. PTD is designed to let the learned curvature adapt to the backbone's predictive capacity, preserving motion and diversity. The curvature head is used only in training; inference keeps the original backbone architecture. On Wan2.1-14B, four-step PTD sets a new state of the art for trajectory distillation, significantly improving dynamic quality and naturalness over PDD, the best-performing trajectory-only method on this model, under the same training setting. On the 33B audio-video MiniMax-H3, LoRA-trained PTD significantly improves diversity and naturalness over the state-of-the-art LightX2V Turbo. Blinded human votes give PTD 55.1% and 63.4% preference shares against PDD and LightX2V Turbo. Project page: https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/PTD/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参数化轨迹蒸馏（PTD），用于视频扩散/流模型的少步蒸馏；学生模型将教师轨迹段参数化为多项式，并沿自身预测路径学习教师引导，从而在有限容量下保持运动与多样性。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散与流模型因需大量顺序评估而生成昂贵；少步蒸馏可降本，但存在容量分配问题：学生需以远少于教师的顺序计算匹配教师迭代生成。现有轨迹方法要求学生在高噪声处复现高度弯曲的教师转移，可能超出其容量并损害细节。
AI.method: PTD让学生参数化教师轨迹段为多项式，并沿自身预测路径学习教师引导，使学习到的曲率能适配骨干网络的预测容量，以保留运动和多样性。曲率头仅用于训练，推理时保持原骨干架构不变。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-14B上，四步PTD在相同训练设置下刷新轨迹蒸馏SOTA，动态质量和自然度显著优于最佳轨迹-only方法PDD；在33B音视频MiniMax-H3上，LoRA训练的PTD相比SOTA LightX2V Turbo显著提升多样性和自然度。盲测人类投票中，PTD对PDD和LightX2V Turbo的偏好占比分别为55.1%和63.4%。
AI.conclusion: PTD能有效缓解少步蒸馏中的容量分配问题，在多个大规模视频生成模型上提升质量、动态性、多样性和自然度，且训练专用曲率头不增加推理架构开销。

title: Safe Actions Alone Do Not Ensure Safe Agents: Identifying Unfulfilled Obligations with Guard Models
comment: 21 pages. Code, data, and supplementary materials: https://github.com/THU-Agent/ObligationGuard
summary: Guard models are increasingly used to safeguard LLM-based agents, primarily by identifying actions that agents are forbidden to perform. However, identifying forbidden actions alone is insufficient to ensure agent safety. In this paper, we argue that agent safety also depends on identifying required yet unperformed safety-critical actions, which we call obligations. Our preliminary study on a popular benchmark for evaluating safety shows that 56.92% of GLM-5.3 trajectories contain unfulfilled obligations, compared with only 30.00% containing forbidden actions. This finding reveals unfulfilled obligations as a major and previously overlooked source of safety risk. However, to our knowledge, no existing benchmark evaluates whether guard models can identify these obligations. To close this gap, we introduce ObligationBench, the first benchmark for evaluating the capability of obligation identification, comprising 240 expert-validated trajectories covering issue resolution, feature development, and terminal operations. Our evaluation of 14 representative models reveals substantial limitations: the highest recall and exact-match rate are only 48.97% and 10.00%, respectively. To address these limitations, we develop ObligationGuard using 40,000 synthetic training examples. ObligationGuard achieves 57.52% recall and an exact-match rate of 21.67%, surpassing all evaluated models on both metrics. We call on the community to incorporate obligation identification into the design and evaluation of future guard models to improve agent safety.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅识别禁止行动不足以保障LLM代理安全，还需识别未履行的安全关键义务。作者提出ObligationBench基准（240条专家验证轨迹）评估守卫模型的义务识别能力，并开发ObligationGuard模型（4万合成训练样本）以提升该能力。
AI.motivation: 现有守卫模型主要关注识别代理禁止执行的行动，但初步研究发现56.92%的GLM-5.3轨迹包含未履行的义务，远高于包含禁止行动的比例（30.00%）。这表明未履行义务是重大且被忽视的安全风险来源，而目前没有基准评估守卫模型能否识别这些义务。
AI.method: 构建ObligationBench基准，包含240条经专家验证的轨迹，覆盖问题解决、功能开发和终端操作三类场景。评估14个代表性模型。基于40,000个合成训练样本开发ObligationGuard模型。
AI.result: 评估显示现有模型义务识别能力有限：最高召回率和精确匹配率仅为48.97%和10.00%。ObligationGuard达到57.52%召回率和21.67%精确匹配率，在两个指标上均超越所有评估模型。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁社区将义务识别纳入未来守卫模型的设计和评估中，以提升代理安全性。

title: What Output-Only Review Cannot Verify: Study Contracts for Research Agents
comment: 15 pages, 4 tables. Preprint. Not peer reviewed. Companion manuscripts prepared in parallel
summary: Some defects in an AI-generated study can be identified from its artifacts; others require knowledge of what was approved before execution. We propose study contracts that bind declared experimental choices, run obligations and claim scope to recorded execution evidence, and distinguish this contract-relative verification from scientific truth. A diagnostic using eight self-authored clean/mutated pairs illustrates the information boundary. A deterministic checker applying a registered, fault-specific rule to approved and executed objects detected all eight registered mutations. Across eighteen recorded judge aliases given individual metadata-filtered packages without pair context or the registry-selected fault label, 104 of 144 mutated evaluation cases received defect flags; the remaining cases comprised 32 abstentions and eight terminal failures, with no explicit clean decisions on mutated cases. Some packages retained approval and execution fields, including digests. The prompt instructed judges to abstain when evidence was insufficient. These results characterize a deliberately information-asymmetric development setting; they do not isolate the effect of authoritative information from differences in task specification and rule selection, and they are not comparative verifier quality or agent reward hacking. We identify full-information comparisons, legitimate-adaptation controls and closed-loop agent evaluations as necessary tests of whether contract checks improve useful compliant completion under optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“研究合约”，将实验选择、运行义务和主张范围与执行证据绑定，并区分合约相对验证与科学真理。诊断实验显示确定性检查器可检出全部8个注册突变；在信息不对称条件下，多个评审别名对突变案例大量标记缺陷但未明确判为干净。
AI.motivation: AI生成研究中的部分缺陷只能从工件发现，另一些则需知道执行前批准了什么；因此需要一种能结合声明、批准与执行证据的验证机制。
AI.method: 提出研究合约，绑定声明的实验选择、运行义务、主张范围与记录的执行证据；设计8组自撰干净/突变配对诊断；使用基于注册的故障特定规则的确定性检查器；并让18个评审别名在缺失配对上下文和注册故障标签、仅见元数据过滤包的情况下进行判断，且提示证据不足时应弃权。
AI.result: 确定性检查器对批准与执行对象应用注册规则，检出全部8个注册突变。18个评审别名在144个突变评估案例中，104个被标记缺陷，32个弃权，8个终端失败，未出现对突变案例的明确干净判定；部分包保留批准与执行字段，包括摘要。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了一个刻意信息不对称的开发场景；不能分离权威信息效应与任务规范、规则选择差异，也不代表比较性验证器质量或智能体奖励黑客。需通过全信息比较、合法适应控制和闭环智能体评估，检验合约检查能否在优化下提升有用且合规的完成率。

title: MSGAT: Multi-Head Spiking Graph Attention with Similarity-Space Fusion for Image-Text Retrieval
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient computing paradigm through sparse event-driven computation, showing great potential for efficient multimodal learning. However, applying SNNs to high-level multimodal tasks, such as image-text retrieval (ITR), remains challenging, since sparse spike representations make it difficult to capture semantic structures required for cross-modal alignment. Existing spiking ITR methods rely on local alignment and additional soft-label supervision during training, while lacking awareness of structural and multi-granularity relationships. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-head Spiking Graph Attention Network (\textbf{MSGAT}) for structural modeling and equip it with dynamic attention heads to capture complementary relational patterns and enable spike-driven graph reasoning and aggregation. However, within a two-branch multi-granularity fusion framework, the fine-grained spike representations generated by MSGAT are sparse and discrete, whereas the global representations are continuous, making conventional feature-level fusion susceptible to interference across heterogeneous representations. Therefore, we introduce \textbf{Sim-Fuse}, a similarity-space fusion alignment strategy integrating coarse- and fine-grained matching relations while avoiding direct fusion of heterogeneous representations. Experiments on Flickr30K and MSCOCO show our method outperforms ANN methods under matched settings and existing SNN retrieval baselines. Moreover, with only two time steps, our SNN achieves comparable or superior performance to its ANN counterpart while reducing theoretical module-level energy by 55\%. The code is provided in the Supplementary Materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用于脉冲神经网络图像-文本检索的MSGAT与Sim-Fuse，通过脉冲图注意力结构建模和相似度空间融合对齐，在Flickr30K和MSCOCO上优于现有ANN匹配设置与SNN基线，并以仅2个时间步实现接近或更优性能，同时降低55%理论模块级能耗。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络具有稀疏事件驱动和低能耗优势，但在图像-文本检索等高层多模态任务中，稀疏脉冲表示难以捕捉跨模态对齐所需的语义结构。现有脉冲ITR方法依赖局部对齐和额外软标签监督，缺乏对结构关系和多粒度关系的感知。
AI.method: 提出多头脉冲图注意力网络MSGAT进行结构建模，并引入动态注意力头以捕获互补关系模式，实现脉冲驱动的图推理与聚合；在双分支多粒度融合框架中，为避免稀疏离散细粒度脉冲表示与连续全局表示直接融合带来的干扰，提出Sim-Fuse相似度空间融合对齐策略，整合粗粒度和细粒度匹配关系。
AI.result: 在Flickr30K和MSCOCO数据集上，该方法在匹配设置下优于ANN方法，并超过现有SNN检索基线；仅使用2个时间步时，性能可与ANN对应方法相当或更优，同时理论模块级能耗降低55%。
AI.conclusion: MSGAT与Sim-Fuse能够有效提升脉冲神经网络在跨模态图像-文本检索中的结构建模与对齐能力，在保持低能耗优势的同时取得有竞争力的检索性能。

title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
summary: A generalist robot should not only perform diverse tasks but also improve through experience, turning what it learns during execution into capabilities that later tasks can reuse. Robot agents that act through code can already repair programs from execution feedback, yet it remains a central challenge to organize this experience around the task structure that gives it meaning, so that each repair is attributed to the responsible capability, supported by execution evidence, and validated before it is reused. We introduce RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system built on Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR). TSR decomposes tasks into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input--output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines revision to that branch. Building upon this structure, a Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer coordinate planning, execution, diagnosis, and the validated release of new skills, while people steer the process through objectives and corrections; stable skill sequences are further consolidated into reusable compound skills. On a mobile manipulator, RoboRSI develops multi-object household cleanup over 104 rounds. In simulation, it achieves the highest success rate on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.7 to 11.0 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboRSI机器人自我改进系统，基于自顶向下技能精炼（TSR），通过技能分解与多角色协作，将执行反馈转化为可复用技能，在真实移动操作和仿真基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人不仅需完成多样任务，还应从执行经验中持续改进，将学习成果转化为可复用能力。尽管基于代码的机器人智能体已能利用执行反馈修复程序，但核心挑战在于围绕任务结构组织经验，使每次修复能归因到相应能力、有执行证据支持，并在复用前得到验证。
AI.method: RoboRSI建立在自顶向下技能精炼（TSR）之上。TSR将任务分解为复合、原子和基础技能，赋予各自作用域并定义显式输入输出契约，把执行结果归因到对应分支，并将修改限制在该分支内。系统由Manager、Planner、Engineer和Reviewer四个角色协同完成规划、执行、诊断及新技能的验证发布，人类通过目标和纠正进行引导；稳定的技能序列进一步固化为可复用的复合技能。
AI.result: 在移动操作机器人上，RoboRSI经过104轮迭代开发出多物体家庭清理能力。在仿真中，其在LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin上取得最高成功率，超过最强基线2.7至11.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化技能精炼与多角色协作验证机制，RoboRSI实现了从执行反馈到可复用技能的自我改进闭环，并在真实与仿真环境中验证了其有效性和优越性。

title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://egocentricvoice.github.io/
summary: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EgoVoice，一个用于训练和评估主动式第一人称语音助手的框架。它基于 HoloAssist 视频构建数据，微调全模态大模型，并用直接偏好优化改进主动干预行为。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴 AR 助手需要连续感知第一人称视频和音频，并在未被显式询问时主动提供适时的语音指导。现有主动视频助手、口语对话系统和第一人称任务理解虽各自发展，但尚未解决连续第一人称流中“何时说”和“说什么”的联合问题。
AI.method: 从 HoloAssist 的真实人类指导员视频中，通过源分离和语音重合成构建干净音频流，并将每个视频会话转换为模型需在每个时刻决定沉默或提供语音指导的格式。随后微调一个全模态 LLM，并进一步用直接偏好优化（DPO）改进其主动干预行为。
AI.result: 在闭源和开源模型上的实验表明，现有系统很少能产生时机恰当且有意义的主动干预；EgoVoice 相比零样本骨干模型，在干预时机、内容相关性和人类偏好方面均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: EgoVoice 为主动式第一人称语音助手提供了训练与评估框架，说明通过数据构建、全模态微调和 DPO 可有效提升主动语音指导的时机与内容质量。

title: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
comment: 33 pages (12 non-appendix pages), 7 figures, published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
summary: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain. However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful. We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain. Leveraging the SSH, we introduce RouterInterp, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations. On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with ${\sim}65\%$ higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods. This work provides a scalable method for generating more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 论文研究稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型中专家的路由与专业化机制，提出“叠加专业化假设”，并给出可解释专家路由的方法 RouterInterp。
AI.motivation: 稀疏 MoE 通过仅激活部分专家来高效扩展模型，但主流假设认为每个专家专精于单一连贯领域；然而基于该假设的可解释性研究大多不成功。
AI.method: 提出 Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis（SSH），认为专家专精于一组不相交的细粒度特征，而非一个宽泛领域；并基于 SSH 提出 RouterInterp，通过识别最能预测路由决策的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征，生成统一的自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，RouterInterp 对专家路由的解释检测准确率比先前基于 token 统计的方法高约 65%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可扩展的方法，能生成更准确的专家路由解释，并加深了对基础模型中此前难以解释组件的理解。

title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
summary: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出HarnessSQL框架，在完整数据库交互环境中进行后训练（SFT+RL），解决文本到SQL模型训练与部署不匹配问题，显著提升执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL模型通常直接映射问题到静态查询，而真实数据库智能体需要多轮有状态交互（检查模式、执行探测、诊断错误、修正假设）。执行框架仅在推理时引入，导致训练-部署不匹配。
AI.method: HarnessSQL构建隔离的可执行数据库环境与隐藏执行预言机，在目标SQL harness中直接运行教师模型，保留验证过的轨迹进行全序列监督微调，再执行基于执行奖励的强化学习。
AI.result: 在Spider 2.0-SQLite上，Qwen3-8B执行准确率从15.5%提升至45.2%，Qwen3-14B从22.2%提升至54.8%，并有效迁移到BIRD-Interact和LiveSQLBench等分布外交互基准。
AI.conclusion: 直接在执行harness中训练数据库智能体，对于掌握复杂长周期数据库工作流至关重要。

title: OX-NeRF: 3D X-ray Tomography Reconstruction from Sparse Views Using Implicit Neural Representation
summary: NeRF and Gaussian splatting methods have been successfully applied on X-ray scenes where the views are too sparse for 3D reconstruction via classical methods. Ultra-sparse scenes with 10 or fewer views such as those with high-rate or low-dose acquisition still, however, present a significant challenge. To address this problem we present a new framework, Optimised X-ray Neural Radiance Fields (OX-NeRF), that combines cross-scene feature learning with scene-specific optimisation to reconstruct sets of related scenes. OX-NeRF employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify cross-scene features while maintaining scene-specific multi-resolution hash grids of spatial features. The paired representations are fused and passed to a multilayer perceptron (MLP); the CNN, hash grids and MLP are then jointly optimised end-to-end. Benchmarking on parallel-beam and cone-beam X-ray datasets shows OX-NeRF provides significantly higher reconstruction accuracy on ultra-sparse scenes compared to existing radiance field methods.

AI.tldr: 提出OX-NeRF框架，结合跨场景特征学习与场景特定优化，用于超稀疏X射线视图的3D重建。
AI.motivation: 经典方法在稀疏视图下难以重建，NeRF和高斯泼溅虽已用于X射线场景，但视图数不超过10的超稀疏场景仍面临重大挑战。
AI.method: 使用CNN提取跨场景特征，同时为每个场景维护多分辨率哈希网格空间特征；将两种表示融合后输入MLP，并对CNN、哈希网格和MLP进行端到端联合优化。
AI.result: 在平行束和锥束X射线数据集上，OX-NeRF在超稀疏场景中的重建精度显著高于现有辐射场方法。
AI.conclusion: OX-NeRF能有效提升超稀疏X射线场景的重建精度，适用于相关场景集合的重建任务。

title: HAND: A Biologically-Inspired Activation Function that Improves Generalisation and Sample Efficiency in Image Classification
summary: DNNs exhibit robustness and generalisation issues not seen in humans. They are also far less data-efficient learners, requiring considerably more training samples to accurately classify novel exemplars. Inductive bias could help with these issues by providing in-built mechanisms to improve generalisation, and hence, reduce reliance on learning from data. We incorporate a biologically-inspired inductive bias into a new activation function, HAND (Homeostasis, Accelerating Nonlinearity, and Divisive-nomalisation), and show its effectiveness with CNNs trained on image classification. Using HAND a ConvNeXt-tiny required 25 training epochs to reach the same accuracy on ImageNet1k as the unmodified model achieved after 200 epochs. Consistent with the effects of an inductive bias, the performance gap reduced with training time and increased data augmentation. When the volume of training data was reduced and unevenly distributed between classes (Long-tailed ImageNet) the improvements in accuracy were even larger and did not reduce with increased training time. Generalisation performance with the common-corruptions data, and the ability to reject samples from unknown classes, were unaffected or improved by HAND. Results generalised across CNN architectures and training data-sets. HAND can, therefore, reduce the required training time and/or the required volume and variety of training data, helping to improve sample efficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种受生物启发的激活函数 HAND（稳态、加速非线性与除法归一化），将其作为归纳偏置引入 CNN 图像分类中，以提高样本效率。
AI.motivation: DNN 存在鲁棒性、泛化和数据效率不足的问题，需要大量训练样本才能准确分类新样本；归纳偏置可通过内置机制改善泛化并减少对数据学习的依赖。
AI.method: 将生物启发的归纳偏置融入新的激活函数 HAND，并在 CNN 图像分类任务中验证；使用 ConvNeXt-tiny 在 ImageNet1k、长尾 ImageNet、常见损坏数据和未知类别拒绝任务上测试，并跨 CNN 架构和数据集验证。
AI.result: HAND 使 ConvNeXt-tiny 仅需 25 个训练 epoch 就达到未修改模型 200 epoch 的 ImageNet1k 精度；性能差距随训练时间和数据增强增加而缩小；在数据量减少且类别分布不均的长尾 ImageNet 上精度提升更大且不随训练时间消失；常见损坏泛化和未知类别拒绝能力未受影响或有所改善。
AI.conclusion: HAND 可减少所需训练时间以及训练数据的数量和多样性，从而提升样本效率，且结果可跨 CNN 架构和数据集泛化。

title: VFold: Symmetry-Aware Cross-Layer Value Cache Compression
summary: While caching key-value (KV) states accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) decoding, this cache can dominate memory usage at long context lengths. One solution is to compress this memory by exploiting inter-layer cache similarities. However, most existing techniques necessitate architectural changes to LLMs and incur substantial overhead. In this work, we propose a symmetry-aware value cache merging strategy that reduces cache memory while avoiding both harmful performance degradation and architectural overhead during decoding. Furthermore, we show that this approach can be exploited alongside existing cache compression techniques, composing with high-ratio quantization or key cache pruning to reach compression ratios that neither method reaches alone, with minimal additional cost. Ultimately, our findings reveal a major source of underutilized capacity in the value cache, offering a simple yet highly effective direction for scaling context windows under memory constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种对称感知的值缓存合并策略，在解码过程中降低KV缓存内存，且不造成明显性能下降或架构改动，并可与其他缓存压缩方法结合使用。
AI.motivation: 长上下文场景下，KV缓存会主导LLM解码时的内存占用；现有利用层间缓存相似性的压缩方法通常需要修改模型架构并带来较大开销。
AI.method: 提出对称感知的值缓存合并策略；在解码时减少缓存内存，同时避免有害的性能退化和架构开销；并将其与高比例量化或键缓存剪枝等现有压缩技术组合使用。
AI.result: 该方法能有效降低缓存内存，并可与高比例量化或键缓存剪枝结合，达到单一方法无法达到的压缩率，且额外成本很小。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明值缓存中存在未被充分利用的容量，为内存受限下扩展上下文窗口提供了一个简单且高效的方向。

title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
summary: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

AI.tldr: Memento 3 让冻结的 LLM 智能体通过外部记忆持续学习显式世界模型：维护可修订的自然语言规则书，将其编译为可执行代码用于预测与规划，并利用预测误差和验证机制迭代更新，从而实现基于模型的递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 智能体在陌生环境中需要推断世界如何运作，并随着新证据修正理解。但有限观察可能对应多个都能解释过去交互、却对未见状态预测不同的世界模型，因此需要一种能持续学习、修订并验证世界模型的方法。
AI.method: 智能体以自然语言规则书作为持久语义记忆，记录关于环境动态的可修订假设并保留未知部分；将规则书编译为可执行代码用于预测和规划。通过观察、反思、规则修订、编译、验证的持续循环，利用预测误差改进规则书和代码。更新代码仅在 LLM 判断其忠实于规则书且逐单元重放能复现观察到的状态转移时才被接受。还提出群体扩展，并行维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据并以其预测指导探索。
AI.result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的所有关卡，平均 Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) 为 100.0，仅使用人类动作数的 44%。在 Atari Pong 案例中，学习到的反馈控制器在三个不同开局回合中均以 21:0 获胜，且无需进一步调用 LLM。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，冻结的 LLM 智能体可以通过外部记忆和编译式世界模型实现持续自我改进：自主探索、修订世界模型，并用经验证的更新指导后续交互与学习。这为基于模型的递归自我改进提供了一条可行路径。

title: Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Learning for Parallel MRI Reconstruction
summary: Parallel magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction is an ill-posed inverse problem under undersampling. Multi-coil acquisition and Hankel lifting expose complementary repeated information: observations of the same anatomy across coils and repeated local k-space neighborhoods in overlapping windows. These dependencies guide recovery of missing k-space data. However, splitting lifted Hankel entries for self-supervision can place the original sample in both input and target, causing data leakage. We propose Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Reconstruction (HSSRecon), a scan-specific reconstruction framework for parallel magnetic resonance imaging. HSSRecon partitions data by physical acquisition units before Hankel lifting and applies multiplicity normalization to repeated Hankel copies in overlapping windows. Rather than learning a mapping that directly predicts missing data, the network learns a compact complex-valued Hankel subspace operator. Reconstruction is performed over the original k-space variables using a conjugategradient solver with hard data consistency. This design separates structural learning in the Hankel domain from data consistency in the physical domain: the former exploits multi-coil and local Hankel correlations, while the latter solves over unacquired degrees of freedom. We provide theoretical analyses of physicalgroup splitting and multiplicity normalization, and establish positive definiteness, uniqueness, hard data consistency, and a finite-step conjugate-gradient error bound for the system. On fastMRI brain data with three contrasts and three sampling masks, HSSRecon achieves competitive peak signal-to-noise ratio, structural similarity, and normalized mean squared error across six aggregated conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向并行磁共振成像的扫描特定重建框架HSSRecon，通过学习紧凑的复数Hankel子空间算子，并在原始k空间上用共轭梯度求解器结合硬数据一致性完成重建。
AI.motivation: 并行磁共振重建在欠采样下是病态逆问题。多线圈采集和Hankel提升会暴露重复信息，但直接拆分Hankel条目用于自监督可能导致原始样本同时出现在输入和目标中，造成数据泄漏。
AI.method: HSSRecon在Hankel提升前按物理采集单元划分数据，并对重叠窗口中重复的Hankel副本做多重性归一化。网络不直接预测缺失数据，而是学习紧凑的复数Hankel子空间算子。重建在原始k空间变量上通过共轭梯度求解器进行，并施加硬数据一致性，从而将Hankel域的结构学习与物理域的数据一致性分离。
AI.result: 作者从理论上分析了物理组划分和多重性归一化，并证明了系统的正定性、唯一性、硬数据一致性以及有限步共轭梯度误差界。在fastMRI脑部数据上，使用三种对比度和三种采样掩膜，HSSRecon在六个聚合条件下取得了有竞争力的峰值信噪比、结构相似性和归一化均方误差。
AI.conclusion: HSSRecon通过避免自监督中的数据泄漏，并有效利用多线圈与局部Hankel相关性，为并行磁共振欠采样重建提供了一种具有理论保证且性能有竞争力的扫描特定重建框架。

title: Control-Ready Uncertainty for Trajectory Diffusion
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026 as a Spotlight presentation. 39 pages, 12 figures
summary: Diffusion models can represent complex, multimodal trajectory distributions, but extracting uncertainty from them typically requires costly Monte Carlo sampling. This limits their use in real-time control, where robots must rapidly assess risk and maintain safety margins. We introduce Score-Curvature for Online Precision Estimation (SCOPE), a lightweight module that augments diffusion trajectory models with control-ready uncertainty. SCOPE learns a structured precision matrix around each nominal trajectory by distilling score-curvature information and producing calibrated Gaussian tubes with low overhead and without repeated Monte Carlo sampling. These tubes provide per-timestep covariance estimates that can be used both as predicted occupancy for moving agents and as adaptive exploration guides for robot control. We evaluate SCOPE with mode-conditioned multimodal diffusion backbones in pedestrian forecasting, crowd navigation, Maze2D control, and real-world Franka Panda manipulation. Across these settings, SCOPE provides fast uncertainty estimation, which leads to better closed-loop performance. Project page: https://zackaxue.github.io/SCOPE-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出SCOPE，一种轻量模块，为扩散轨迹模型提供无需蒙特卡洛采样的快速不确定性估计，生成校准高斯管，用于实时控制。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型能表示复杂多模态轨迹分布，但提取不确定性通常需要昂贵的蒙特卡洛采样，限制了其在需要快速风险评估和安全裕度的实时机器人控制中的应用。
AI.method: SCOPE通过蒸馏score-curvature信息，围绕每个名义轨迹学习结构化精度矩阵，生成校准的高斯管，以低开销提供每时间步协方差估计，可用作移动智能体的预测占用和机器人控制的自适应探索引导。
AI.result: 在行人预测、人群导航、Maze2D控制和真实Franka Panda操作中，结合模式条件多模态扩散骨干网络进行评估，SCOPE实现了快速不确定性估计，并带来更好的闭环性能。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE使扩散轨迹模型能够提供控制就绪的不确定性，支持实时机器人控制，无需重复蒙特卡洛采样。

title: Probability-Signature Dynamics: Unpacking Modular Addition Learning Within Two-Layer Networks
summary: Neural networks trained on modular addition tasks often develop Fourier-structured representations that support exact generalization. While prior work has identified these Fourier circuits, the mechanism by which gradient-based training selects them from the data distribution remains unclear. We address this question using probability signatures, which express leading gradient interactions through conditional statistics of the training distribution. For modular addition, these signatures are cyclic shift operators and are diagonalized by the discrete Fourier transform, yielding approximately decoupled Fourier-mode dynamics. This explains the emergence of Fourier sparsity, frequency matching, and phase alignment. The same framework resolves a puzzle under label noise: corrupted examples can show faster early loss decrease than clean examples, despite lacking a coherent generalization rule. We show that noise increases conditional label collisions, strengthening early shared-coordinate reinforcement. Finally, this method can be applied to other operators. Taking XOR as an example, we observed the predicted frequency in experiments.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经网络在模加法任务中为何会形成傅里叶结构表征，并用“概率签名”解释梯度训练如何从数据分布中选出傅里叶电路。
AI.motivation: 已有工作发现了模加法中的傅里叶电路，但梯度训练如何从训练分布中机制性地选择这些电路仍不清楚；同时标签噪声下损坏样本早期损失下降更快这一现象也缺乏解释。
AI.method: 提出概率签名，用训练分布的条件统计量表达主导梯度交互；在模加法中，这些签名是循环移位算子，并可由离散傅里叶变换对角化，从而得到近似解耦的傅里叶模态动力学。
AI.result: 该框架解释了傅里叶稀疏性、频率匹配和相位对齐的出现；并说明标签噪声会增加条件标签碰撞，增强早期共享坐标强化，从而解释噪声样本早期损失下降更快的现象；在XOR等算子上也观察到预测频率。
AI.conclusion: 概率签名框架能够统一解释模加法中傅里叶电路的形成机制及标签噪声下的反直觉训练动态，并可推广到其他算子。

title: VioLA: Learning Generalist Humanoid Control Policies from Human Data
summary: Teaching a humanoid to follow instructions with its whole body runs into two obstacles. Its action space is large and tightly coupled: legs, arms, and fingers must move together while the robot keeps its balance, which makes joint-level actions hard to learn. And humanoid demonstrations are scarce, so current humanoid generalist policies do not follow new instructions out of the box and are fine-tuned on teleoperated demonstrations of each task before deployment. Human demonstrations exist in far larger numbers, but a person's motion is not a robot command. We remove both obstacles by changing what the generalist policy predicts. We introduce VioLA, a generalist humanoid policy that predicts body and hand motion latents instead of joint commands. A pretrained body- and hand-controller execute these latents on the robot. Their corresponding motion encoders map human and robot motion into the same latent spaces. A human recording is therefore labeled in the policy's action space, and the training demonstration pool contains 140.6 million frames, 93.2% of them human. As a result, VioLA follows locomotion instructions on the real robot zero-shot, without task-specific fine-tuning, reaching 100% success where GR00T N1.7 and $Ψ_0$ reach 16.7% and 0%, respectively. It also reaches 88.6% manipulation success without task-specific fine-tuning. The same approach works across two VLA and one world-action model backbones. A generalist policy trained on human demonstrations alone performs locomotion tasks on the real robot zero-shot. Code and checkpoints will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VioLA，一种通用人形机器人策略，通过预测身体和手部运动潜变量而非关节命令，使机器人能零样本遵循全身指令，并大幅提升真实机器人上的运动与操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人遵循全身指令面临两大障碍：一是动作空间大且强耦合，腿部、手臂和手指需协同并保持平衡，导致关节级动作难学；二是人形机器人演示稀缺，现有通用策略通常需针对每个任务进行遥操作微调。人类演示数量远更多，但人类运动不能直接作为机器人命令。
AI.method: VioLA 改变通用策略的预测目标：预测身体和手部运动潜变量，而不是直接预测关节命令。预训练的身体和手部控制器在机器人上执行这些潜变量，对应的运动编码器将人类和机器人运动映射到同一潜空间，从而把人类录像标注到策略的动作空间中。训练演示池包含 1.406 亿帧，其中 93.2% 来自人类。该方法也在两种 VLA 和一种 world-action model 骨干上验证。
AI.result: VioLA 在真实机器人上零样本遵循运动指令，无需任务特定微调，成功率达 100%；对比 GR00T N1.7 为 16.7%，Ψ0 为 0%。在操作任务上，无需任务特定微调达到 88.6% 成功率。仅用人类演示训练的通用策略也能在真实机器人上零样本完成运动任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将动作空间改为身体和手部运动潜变量，VioLA 有效利用大规模人类演示，缓解人形机器人演示稀缺与动作空间耦合问题，实现无需任务特定微调的零样本全身指令跟随。代码和检查点将发布。

title: LEVER: Adaptive Cost-Aware Proof Search Over AND/OR Graphs
summary: Mathematicians value proofs for more than correctness: among correct proofs, simplicity, purity and the computational cost of finding them vary widely. Yet LLM-powered theorem provers largely search for any correct proof, and improve its quality only after it is found. We propose LEVER, a proof search algorithm that makes the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizes it during search. LEVER scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph, combining realized objective values with predictions for open subgoals, so the objective guides search before a proof is complete. The same mechanism optimizes computational cost, proof length, topical impurity, and even their weighted combinations, while the Lean kernel enforces correctness. On PutnamBench in Lean 4, under matched budgets, LEVER costs 34% less than a strong single-conversation agent while raising the solve rate from 80% to 96%. On reducing topical impurity, i.e., how far a proof strays from its theorem's subject, it improves over post-hoc refactoring (42% reduction against 33%) at two-thirds of the cost and more reliably; on proof length, the metric refactoring is built for, it approaches refactoring. Varying the objective's weights traces a quality-cost trade-off curve, so the user can choose how much a better proof is worth. Overall, LEVER is a performant, cost-efficient and tunable proof search algorithm for navigating the space of correct proofs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LEVER，一种可编程目标驱动的证明搜索算法，在搜索过程中优化证明质量，而非仅在找到证明后改进。
AI.motivation: 数学家不仅关心证明正确性，也关心简洁性、纯粹性和计算成本；但现有 LLM 定理证明器主要搜索任意正确证明，质量优化通常滞后。
AI.method: LEVER 在 AND/OR 证明图上对部分证明打分，结合已实现目标值与开放子目标预测，使目标在证明完成前引导搜索；同一机制可优化计算成本、证明长度、主题不纯度及其加权组合，并由 Lean 内核保证正确性。
AI.result: 在 Lean 4 的 PutnamBench 上，匹配预算下 LEVER 比强单轮对话代理成本低 34%，求解率从 80% 提升至 96%；主题不纯度降低 42%，优于事后重构的 33%，成本为其三分之二且更可靠；在证明长度上接近重构效果；调整目标权重可得到质量-成本权衡曲线。
AI.conclusion: LEVER 是一种高效、成本友好且可调优的证明搜索算法，能够导航正确证明空间并优化用户定义的证明质量目标。

title: Generative Neural Retargeting for Human-to-Robot Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning dexterous manipulation, but the embodiment gap prevents human motion from being executed directly on robots. Inverse kinematics (IK) retargets human motion to robots efficiently but ignores dynamics, often producing infeasible motions. Reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) are commonly employed to yield dynamically feasible motions, but both are sample-inefficient and sensitive to hyperparameters. RL suffers from costly and unstable training and tedious reward engineering; MPC avoids policy optimization, yet retargets each trajectory in isolation, and solving one does not make the next easier. Sampling cost grows rapidly with dataset size and task difficulty. We hypothesize that dynamically feasible trajectories concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold shared across demonstrations, so that retargeting can be reduced to sampling from that manifold, conditioned on human motion, rather than solving a fresh optimization problem for every demonstration. We propose \textbf{Generative Neural Retargeting} (GNR), which uses a flow matching model to sample feasible trajectories. GNR outperforms MPC with only $8.5\%$ of the samples required by MPC, achieving a success rate of $56.20\%$ compared to $27.20\%$ for MPC. GNR can be used for scalable and efficient retargeting of large-scale, long-horizon, and millimeter precision human demonstrations: by applying GNR within a real-to-sim data engine, we produce a dexterous manipulation dataset with dense contact-force labels, spanning $223$k demonstrations and $3.3$k object geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出生成式神经重定向（GNR），用流匹配模型从跨演示共享的低维可行轨迹流形中采样，实现高效、动态可行的人类动作到机器人重定向，并用于构建大规模灵巧操作数据集。
AI.motivation: 人类演示是灵巧操作的可扩展数据源，但人机具身差异使人类动作无法直接部署到机器人。IK高效却忽略动力学，常产生不可行动作；RL和采样MPC虽能生成动态可行动作，但样本效率低、对超参敏感，且MPC需对每条轨迹单独求解，采样成本随数据规模和任务难度快速增长。
AI.method: 基于假设：动态可行轨迹集中在跨演示共享的低维流形附近，因此将重定向视为以人类动作为条件、从该流形中采样，而非逐条求解新优化问题。为此提出GNR，使用流匹配（flow matching）模型生成可行轨迹。
AI.result: GNR仅需MPC约8.5%的样本量，成功率56.20%，高于MPC的27.20%。将GNR用于real-to-sim数据引擎，可重定向大规模、长时域、毫米级精度的人类演示，生成包含22.3万条演示、3300种物体几何且带密集接触力标签的灵巧操作数据集。
AI.conclusion: GNR能够高效、可扩展地完成人类动作到机器人的动态可行重定向，并支持构建带接触力标注的大规模灵巧操作数据集。

title: SpatialHarness: Test-Time Spatial Scaffolding for Fine Robotic Manipulation
summary: Frontier multimodal foundation models (e.g., GPT-6 Astra) have recently shown strong potential for direct robotic control, yet their performance on fine manipulation remains limited. We argue that an important source of failure is not necessarily insufficient policy capability, but insufficient spatial observability, where task-critical spatial relationships may be poorly revealed by the existing physical camera setup. We introduce SpatialHarness, a test-time embodied harness that provides test-time spatial scaffolding for fine robotic manipulation without policy fine-tuning or changes to the physical sensing setup. SpatialHarness maintains an online simulated scene synchronized with real-world execution, identifies task-critical spatial relationships, and renders complementary virtual views that expose them to a frozen multimodal policy. To keep the simulated scene aligned during interaction, we develop interaction-aware scene synchronization that distinguishes static, held, and transition modes. We evaluate SpatialHarness on four real-robot manipulation tasks spanning precise geometric alignment, object-relative placement, and articulated-object interaction. Using the same frozen GPT-6 Astra policy, SpatialHarness substantially improves task success, including from 26.7% to 66.7% on plug insertion and from 0% to 100% on Tower of Hanoi. These results indicate that improving spatial observability at test time can unlock fine-manipulation capabilities already present in strong multimodal foundation models. Project website: https://emilia113.github.io/SpatialHarness/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpatialHarness，一种测试时具身增强框架，通过维护与真实执行同步的在线仿真场景并渲染互补虚拟视角，为冻结的多模态基础模型提供空间可观测性，从而提升精细机器人操作性能。
AI.motivation: 前沿多模态基础模型已展现直接控制机器人的潜力，但在精细操作上仍受限。作者认为失败的关键原因不一定是策略能力不足，而是现有物理相机设置导致任务关键空间关系未被充分呈现，即空间可观测性不足。
AI.method: SpatialHarness 在不微调策略、不改变物理传感设置的前提下，于测试时提供空间脚手架。它维护与真实世界执行同步的在线仿真场景，识别任务关键空间关系，并渲染互补虚拟视角输入给冻结的多模态策略。为保持仿真与真实交互对齐，还提出交互感知场景同步，区分静态、持握和过渡模式。
AI.result: 在四类真实机器人操作任务上评估，涵盖精确几何对齐、物体相对放置和铰接物体交互。使用同一个冻结的 GPT-6 Astra 策略，SpatialHarness 显著提升成功率：插头插入从 26.7% 提升至 66.7%，汉诺塔从 0% 提升至 100%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在测试时改善空间可观测性，可以释放强大多模态基础模型中已具备但未被激发的精细操作能力，而无需策略微调或改变物理传感配置。

title: PAM-ToD: Plug-and-Play Appearance Modeling for Cross-Time-of-Day 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Adapting a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) road scene to a new time of day requires learning appearance changes from a few anchor images while preserving consistent, real-time rendering. We propose PAM-ToD, a lightweight plug-in that learns color corrections while keeping the pre-trained 3DGS parameters fixed. PAM-ToD scales each Gaussian's existing color to model illumination changes and uses an additive term for additional brightness, such as when street lamps turn on at night. Under a simplified image formation model, unchanged surface albedo can be eliminated from the relation between source and target appearances, allowing us to learn these corrections without separately estimating albedo and illumination. The model corrects colors across the scene while allowing the corrections to vary by location and by Gaussian. To guide learning from a few anchor images, it discourages abrupt spatial changes in these corrections. We also introduce CARLA-ToD, a benchmark with matching geometry, camera poses, and moving-object trajectories across three times of day. A few target-time anchor images are used to train each plug-in, while separate views are used for evaluation. Across the static and dynamic settings, PAM-ToD achieves higher PSNR and lower LPIPS than the baselines, even when the anchor images come from a single synchronized capture across multiple cameras.

AI.tldr: 提出PAM-ToD，一种轻量级插件，可在固定预训练3D高斯泼溅参数下，用少量锚点图像学习颜色校正，将道路场景适配到新的时间段，并保持实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 将预训练3DGS道路场景适配到新时间段需要从少量锚点图像学习外观变化，同时保持一致的实时渲染，避免重新估计反照率和光照。
AI.method: PAM-ToD缩放每个高斯现有颜色以建模光照变化，并添加加性项处理额外亮度（如夜间路灯）。基于简化成像模型消除不变反照率，学习位置和高斯相关的颜色校正，并抑制校正的急剧空间变化。同时提出CARLA-ToD基准，包含三个时间段匹配的几何、相机位姿和运动物体轨迹。
AI.result: 在静态和动态设置下，PAM-ToD的PSNR高于基线，LPIPS低于基线，即使锚点图像来自多相机单次同步采集。
AI.conclusion: PAM-ToD能有效利用少量锚点图像将3DGS道路场景适配到新时间段，并保持实时渲染性能。

title: Which Skill to Distill? SGUID: Selecting a Compact Skill Bank for Model-Skill Co-Evolution
summary: Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SGUID，一种从技能库中选择少量有效技能用于 on-policy 蒸馏的方法。研究表明并非所有技能都值得蒸馏，选择高价值技能可在更小技能集下达到或超过全库蒸馏效果，并支持稳定的模型-技能协同进化。
AI.motivation: 已有工作通常按语义相关性检索技能并用于推理时补丁或模型蒸馏，但忽略了每个技能的个体效用。作者发现，在 on-policy 蒸馏中，检索到的技能里少于 25% 能提供有用蒸馏信号，因此需要筛选真正有效的技能。
AI.method: 提出 SGUID：仅保留在训练过程中持续产生有效学习信号的技能，形成一个紧凑技能子集，再将其蒸馏到模型中。该方法还支持多轮模型-技能协同进化：每轮蒸馏后，从更新模型的 rollouts 中构建新候选技能库，再由 SGUID 选择下一轮要内化的技能。
AI.result: 在 Olmo 和 Qwen 系列四个模型上，蒸馏 6 个选定技能在四者中的三者上达到或超过全库蒸馏的平均 avg@12；第二轮再选 3 个新技能后，四个模型全部达到或超过全库蒸馏，而全库规模最多大 11 倍。第二轮循环将 Qwen3-8B 从 64.3% 提升到 66.3%。选择步骤对稳定性关键：Qwen3-4B 上，用未过滤技能朴素更新会降性能，HMMT25 下降 0.3 个百分点；SGUID 则第一轮提升 0.5 点，第二轮提升 1.1 点。
AI.conclusion: 技能选择是稳定模型-技能协同进化的关键机制。不是所有技能都值得蒸馏，筛选紧凑且持续有效的技能子集，比直接使用全量技能库更高效、更稳定，并能支持模型与技能的迭代共同提升。

title: SV-TAD: Native Sparse Convs for Efficient Temporal Action Detection
summary: To adapt billion-parameter Vision Transformers for long-video understanding, recent methods freeze the backbone and train lightweight convolutional modules. While effective for parameter-efficient training, existing adapters do not reduce inference-time computation, leaving scalability with respect to video length largely unaddressed. Token selection can reduce attention cost by pruning redundant tokens, but it breaks the spatial grid structure required by convolutional adapters. This forces an expensive dense reconstruction, nullifying much of the potential speedup. We address this by introducing native sparse 2D convolutions, a primitive that allows these adapters, for the first time, to operate directly and efficiently on dynamically pruned token sets. We integrate this primitive into SV-TAD, an adapter framework for temporal action detection, reducing VideoMAEv2-L computation by up to 64% and achieving 2.2x faster inference, while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy on THUMOS-14 and ActivityNet-1.3. When scaled to InternVideoNext-L, our approach surpasses the previous state of the art at roughly half its computational cost. Moreover, the sparse formulation naturally supports auxiliary task tokens, which improves fine-grained assembly detection on ATTACH.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出原生稀疏二维卷积，使卷积适配器能直接高效处理动态剪枝后的 token 集合，并集成到 SV-TAD 框架中，用于长视频时序动作检测，在保持精度的同时显著降低计算量并加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法为将十亿参数级视觉 Transformer 适配到长视频理解，通常冻结骨干并训练轻量卷积模块，但这只减少训练参数，不降低推理计算，难以应对视频长度扩展。token 选择虽可剪枝冗余 token 以降低注意力开销，却破坏了卷积适配器所需的空间网格结构，导致昂贵的稠密重建，抵消了加速效果。
AI.method: 引入原生稀疏二维卷积这一基本算子，使适配器首次能够直接在动态剪枝后的 token 集合上高效运行；将其集成到用于时序动作检测的 SV-TAD 适配器框架中，并利用稀疏形式自然支持辅助任务 token。
AI.result: 在 VideoMAEv2-L 上减少高达 64% 的计算量，实现 2.2 倍推理加速，同时在 THUMOS-14 和 ActivityNet-1.3 上保持最先进精度；扩展到 InternVideoNext-L 时，以约一半计算成本超过此前最先进方法；在 ATTACH 上提升了细粒度装配检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过原生稀疏二维卷积避免了剪枝后稠密重建，使卷积适配器可高效处理稀疏 token，为长视频理解提供了可扩展、低推理成本的适配方案，并在多个任务和数据集上验证了有效性。

title: Predicting Alignment Generalization with Value Representations
summary: LLM developers post-train their models to exhibit prosocial values and behavioral traits, which are enumerated in an alignment target. However, while recent post-training developments have yielded models that score highly on alignment evaluations, training models on sets of narrow behaviors still influences their behavior across unseen contexts and environments in unexpected ways. In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values.
