To address this, we propose Hippocam, a hierarchical memory and continual learning architecture. Hippocam draws inspiration from two characteristics of human memory: cognitive processes selectively maintain information relevant to current goals, while long-term memories form gradually through repeated consolidation. Accordingly, Hippocam structures an agent's ongoing work as nested intents. The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 提出 Hippocam，一种受人类记忆启发的分层记忆与持续学习架构，让大语言模型智能体通过自身经验实现知识积累和能力演化，无需更新参数。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体正从单任务执行走向长期自主运行，核心挑战在于如何将连续经验转化为可复用的知识。
AI.method: Hippocam 借鉴人类记忆的两个特点：认知过程选择性保留与当前目标相关的信息，长期记忆通过反复巩固逐渐形成。它将智能体持续工作组织为嵌套意图，活跃上下文聚焦当前意图，已完成意图被巩固为后续任务所需的结果与状态；同时采用递归前缀巩固机制，使长期未用经验逐渐抽象，并保留原始交互以按需恢复细节。过去经验被召回并重新融入当前工作时，会与新经验一起再次巩固，从而被强化、补充和更新。
AI.result: 通过“用进废退”的记忆动态，Hippocam 将工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累和技能学习连接为单一且持续演化的经验过程，使智能体无需参数更新即可从自身经验中学习并演化能力。
AI.conclusion: Hippocam 为长期自主运行的大语言模型智能体提供了一种无需参数更新、基于分层记忆和持续巩固的经验学习机制，有望支持智能体持续积累可复用知识与技能。

title: Dino Forcing Flow Models: Do not denoise what you can predict
summary: Co-denoising pretrained representations such as DINO can substantially improve the training speed and quality of flow matching models, but it introduces a second denoising trajectory and requires carefully designed schedules. We propose a simpler alternative: predict the pretrained representation directly, then condition the model on its own prediction. This removes the need for a second ODE and any representation-specific denoising schedules, while retaining the benefits of representation guidance. Our approach converges substantially faster and achieves better generation quality as measured by FID score. On ImageNet, it outperforms the state of the art in latent space at 2x fewer epochs than prior methods; in pixel space, it improves FID over comparable prior methods by more than 20%. These results support a simple principle: do not denoise what you can predict. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种更简单的表示引导流匹配方法：直接预测预训练表示（如DINO），并让模型以自身预测为条件，而不是共同去噪表示。该方法无需第二个ODE和表示特定的去噪调度，在ImageNet上收敛更快、生成质量更好。
AI.motivation: 共同去噪预训练表示（如DINO）能显著提升流匹配模型的训练速度和生成质量，但会引入第二条去噪轨迹，并要求精心设计调度，增加了复杂性。
AI.method: 直接预测预训练表示，然后将模型条件于其自身对表示的预测；去除第二个ODE以及任何针对表示的去噪调度，同时保留表示引导带来的收益。
AI.result: 方法收敛速度显著更快，FID生成质量更好。在ImageNet潜空间上，以比先前方法少2倍的epoch超越当前最优；在像素空间上，相比同类先前方法FID提升超过20%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一个简单原则：“不要对可以预测的东西进行去噪”。该替代方案更简单且有效，代码已开源。

title: An Investigation of Model Coherence: Narrow Finetunes Contradict Themselves Under Resampling
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/themachinefan/twominds
summary: A large body of research measures model coherence based on output variance without adequately considering competing causes. We identify two such causes, ambiguity and indifference, and we introduce a set of 175 questions where contradicting answers cannot easily be explained by either. We then measure incoherence in terms of contradictions when resampling answers to the same question. In contrast to other methods our metric has high specificity, and only ranks models as incoherent when the issues are glaring. Even so, we find narrow finetunes score poorly. Inspecting inconsistencies flagged by our method, we find that model organisms from the literature display severe issues such as identity conflation, introspection failures and rationalizations. These findings suggest that the pathologies induced by narrow finetuning may limit what these models can tell us about coherent misaligned behaviour.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种高特异性的模型不一致性度量方法，通过175个难以用歧义或漠不关心解释的问题，检测重复采样同一问题时的矛盾回答，并发现窄领域微调模型表现较差，且存在身份混淆、内省失败和合理化等严重问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多基于输出方差衡量模型一致性，但未充分考虑导致矛盾的其他原因，例如问题本身存在歧义或模型对答案漠不关心。因此需要一种能更准确识别真正不一致性的方法。
AI.method: 作者识别出歧义和漠不关心两种竞争性原因，构建了175个问题，使得矛盾回答难以由这两者解释；然后通过重复采样同一问题的回答，以矛盾率衡量模型的不一致性。
AI.result: 该度量具有高特异性，只在问题明显时判定模型不一致。即便如此，窄领域微调模型得分仍很差。检查被标记的不一致发现，文献中的模型生物表现出身份混淆、内省失败和合理化等严重问题。
AI.conclusion: 窄领域微调引发的病理可能限制这些模型用于研究连贯的错位行为，即它们难以作为可靠对象来揭示有意义的连贯性错位。

title: Streaming-Aware Diffusion for Real-Time Video Super-Resolution via Cross-Step Attention
summary: Real-time video super-resolution requires high spatio-temporal fidelity under strict latency constraints, challenging diffusion models due to their iterative sampling cost and limited temporal coordination. We propose a streaming-aware framework that adapts pretrained single-image latent diffusion models for efficient video super-resolution (VSR) by exploiting the sequential structure of video streams. Our Cross-Step Attention mechanism reuses intermediate denoising features across adjacent frames and diffusion steps, enabling temporal information exchange without explicit temporal modeling. We further introduce Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling, which aligns adjacent diffusion states and provides cleaner intermediate representations for cross-step conditioning, improving temporal coherence. These components are integrated into a streaming inference pipeline that incrementally propagates latent states across frames, reducing the effective computational complexity from $O(N \cdot S)$ to $O(N + S)$ for $N$ frames and $S$ diffusion steps. Experiments on REDS4 and YouHQ40-Test demonstrate improved perceptual quality and temporal realism while maintaining frame-wise stability. Our method achieves over 40 FPS at $512 \times 512$ resolution after cold start, enabling real-time VSR without explicit temporal modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出一种流式感知框架，通过跨步注意力和轨迹耦合扩散调度，将预训练单图像潜在扩散模型适配为高效视频超分辨率，将计算复杂度从O(N·S)降至O(N+S)，实现实时VSR。
AI.motivation: 实时视频超分辨率需要在严格延迟约束下保持高时空保真度，而扩散模型因迭代采样成本高和时序协调有限难以满足要求。
AI.method: 提出流式感知框架，利用视频流顺序结构适配预训练单图像潜在扩散模型。核心包括：跨步注意力机制，重用相邻帧和扩散步骤的中间去噪特征，实现时序信息交换而无需显式时序建模；轨迹耦合扩散调度，对齐相邻扩散状态，提供更干净的中间表示用于跨步条件，提升时序一致性。集成到流式推理管道，增量传播潜在状态，降低有效计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在REDS4和YouHQ40-Test上实验，感知质量和时序真实感得到改善，同时保持帧间稳定性。冷启动后在512×512分辨率下达到超过40 FPS，实现实时VSR。
AI.conclusion: 无需显式时序建模即可实现实时视频超分辨率，验证了流式感知扩散框架的有效性。

title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
summary: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.

AI.tldr: ViSkill 是一个视觉原生技能学习框架，将成功交互编码为VLM智能体可直接使用的复合视觉技能卡。检索到的技能用于指导推理和奖励塑形，成功轨迹又蒸馏回技能库，形成技能积累与策略改进相互促进的闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强智能体大多以文本为中心，将空间布局和动作-状态对应关系线性化为语言，丢失关键几何结构。近期工作虽引入视觉证据，但技能构建与更新和策略优化分离，二者相互促进的潜力未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出视觉原生技能学习框架ViSkill，将成功交互编码为复合视觉技能卡；检索技能同时指导推理与奖励塑形，成功轨迹被蒸馏回技能库，形成闭环反馈；并提供可选冷启动机制加速早期学习。在Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上评估。
AI.result: ViSkill整体成功率达到0.89，使用冷启动初始化后提升至0.91，优于所有评估的专有和开源基线，且比标准PPO收敛更快。
AI.conclusion: 视觉原生技能卡与闭环反馈能有效结合技能积累和策略改进，提升样本效率、成功率和收敛速度；冷启动可进一步加速早期学习。

title: Memory Forcing: Attendable Mid-Horizon History for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache. Once an event leaves this window, later frames can no longer attend to it, a failure we term mid-horizon forgetting. We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size. Its Archive \& Working Banks partition the cache into sink, archive, and working regions, retaining diverse intermediate events alongside recent motion under fixed memory. Because absolute temporal indices drift outside the training range, Bank-aware RoPE reassigns indices at attention time so each bank remains distinguishable. At 1.3B, Memory Forcing leads on longer clips, shows the smallest drop from 5s to 60s among methods reporting all four lengths, and preserves subjects and scenes through leave-and-return. The same design scales to Wan2.2 5B, producing more physically plausible, realistic, and dynamic videos and, to our knowledge, the first public 5B model on this forcing line.

AI.tldr: 提出 Memory Forcing，一种少步自回归视频扩散流式生成方法，在不扩大 KV 缓存的前提下缓解中时程遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 现有少步流式视频扩散系统通常只在固定大小 KV 缓存中保留开头帧和最近帧，导致事件离开窗口后后续帧无法再关注，出现中时程遗忘。
AI.method: 设计 Archive & Working Banks，将缓存划分为 sink、archive、working 三区，在固定内存下同时保留多样的中间事件和近期运动；并引入 Bank-aware RoPE，在注意力计算时重新分配时间索引，使各 bank 保持可区分。
AI.result: 在 1.3B 模型上，Memory Forcing 在较长视频上领先，在报告全部四种长度的方法中从 5s 到 60s 的性能下降最小，并能在离开后返回时保持主体和场景。该设计扩展到 Wan2.2 5B 后，生成视频在物理合理性、真实感和动态性上更好，且据称是首个公开的 5B 规模此类模型。
AI.conclusion: Memory Forcing 通过分 bank 缓存与索引重分配，在不增加缓存大小的条件下保留缺失历史，有效提升长视频流式生成中的时序一致性和记忆能力。

title: OA-MAP: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Multimodal Framework for Interpretable Knee Osteoarthritis Progression
summary: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) progression prediction can support patient monitoring, requiring the integration of multimodal data and multidomain expertise. Moreover, isolated risk estimates provide limited insight underlying a prediction. To automate the progression assessment workflow and reduce manual effort while providing interpretable findings and supporting evidence, we present OA-MAP, an autonomous multi-agent framework for evidence-grounded assessment of structural and pain progression in KOA. The system incorporates modality-specific agents including MRI, X-ray, and clinical agents, together with a coordinator agent. This framework can autonomously recruit specialist agents, select tools for prediction and analysis, and retrieve literature as external evidence based on user request and available patient information. An uncertainty-informed human-in-the-loop mechanism enables clinicians to review and correct intermediate findings, triggering recomputation of affected results. We evaluate the prediction models using 600 participants from the FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium cohort. On the test set of 100 participants, the fusion models achieve AUROCs of 0.80 for structural progression and 0.68 for pain progression. A case study illustrates how OA-MAP combines risk estimates with intermediate findings, cross-modal conflicts, literature support, and uncertainty indicators to support interactive review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OA-MAP，一种用于膝骨关节炎（KOA）结构性和疼痛进展评估的自主多智能体框架，可整合MRI、X射线、临床等多模态数据，并支持文献检索与不确定性人机协同审查。
AI.motivation: KOA进展预测需要整合多模态数据和多领域专家知识，而单一风险估计可解释性有限。为自动化进展评估流程、减少人工负担并提供可解释结果与支持证据，作者开展了本研究。
AI.method: 构建OA-MAP多智能体框架，包含MRI、X射线、临床等模态专用智能体和协调智能体；智能体可自主招募专家、选择预测与分析工具、根据用户请求和患者信息检索文献作为外部证据；引入不确定性驱动的人机协同机制，允许临床医生审查和纠正中间结果并触发重算。使用FNIH骨关节炎生物标志物联盟队列600名参与者评估。
AI.result: 在100名参与者的测试集上，融合模型对结构性进展的AUROC为0.80，对疼痛进展的AUROC为0.68。案例研究显示，OA-MAP能够结合风险估计、中间发现、跨模态冲突、文献支持和不确定性指标来支持交互式审查。
AI.conclusion: OA-MAP可自动化并增强KOA进展评估，在提供多模态预测的同时，通过可解释证据和不确定性人机协同机制支持临床审查与决策。

title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpaceCast-Bench，首个直接诊断预测性空间推理的基准，基于观察-变换-推断框架，包含182个真实场景、3862个问题、16类任务和三个层级。评估21个模型发现最强模型仅58.0%，远低于人类87.2%，空间专用模型接近随机；用程序生成数据微调可将Qwen3-VL-4B从34.0%提升至65.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准主要测试空间感知，即读取输入中已可见的关系；但真实空间智能需要预测性空间推理：从观测构建场景、预判干预如何改变场景，并推理未观测到的结果。
AI.method: 构建 SpaceCast-Bench，采用观察-变换-推断框架，涵盖182个真实场景、3862个问题、16种任务类型，分为静态感知、局部预测、全局预测三级。评估21个模型，并进行控制分析，考察桥接视图、显式3D证据、生成结果图像或视频的作用，同时用程序生成数据微调Qwen3-VL-4B。
AI.result: 最强模型仅达58.0%，人类为87.2%，空间专用模型接近随机。控制分析显示桥接视图对整合分布式观测至关重要，显式3D证据比生成结果图像或视频更可靠。微调使Qwen3-VL-4B从34.0%提升至65.7%，并在六个域外基准上获得宏平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型在预测性空间推理上存在显著差距。SpaceCast-Bench能诊断该能力，并表明利用程序生成数据微调可有效提升模型表现，同时桥接视图与显式3D证据是关键因素。

title: From Video Clips to Creation Trajectory: Sora100K for AI-Native Video Creation
summary: AI-Native video creation is shifting from isolated video clips toward iterative video creation workflows. However, existing datasets remain largely video clips, representing video generation and editing as separate tasks rather than connected stages of a video creation workflow. In this paper, we introduce Sora100K, a dataset that represents the AI-Native video creation workflow as a structured video creation trajectory. Specifically, we first identify video creation trajectories and decompose them into three subsets according to their structural roles: text-to-video generation records as roots, single-turn video editing records as editing edges, and multi-turn video editing records as complete trajectories. Then, we use a VLM to assign semantic annotations for generation roots and editing-operation annotations for editing edges. A strict construction pipeline further reconstructs source-to-edit lineage, editing order, and intermediate video states while ensuring data quality. Finally, we perform lightweight adaptation on LTX-2 models to assess the supervision value of Sora100K. The results show improvements in visual quality, multi-shot generation, and cross-shot consistency, while successive-turn evaluation reveals that following multi-turn editing instructions remains challenging. Sora100K establishes a new data foundation for AI-Native video creation beyond isolated video clips and toward structured video creation trajectory. The dataset and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Sora100K 数据集，将 AI 原生视频创作建模为结构化的视频创作轨迹，并基于 LTX-2 进行轻量适配验证其监督价值。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集多为孤立视频片段，将视频生成与编辑视为独立任务，未能反映迭代式、连续的视频创作工作流。
AI.method: 识别视频创作轨迹，并按结构角色分解为三类子集：文生视频生成记录作为根节点、单轮视频编辑记录作为编辑边、多轮视频编辑记录作为完整轨迹；使用 VLM 为生成根添加语义标注、为编辑边添加编辑操作标注；通过严格构建流程重建源到编辑的谱系、编辑顺序和中间视频状态，并保证数据质量；最后在 LTX-2 模型上进行轻量适配以评估监督价值。
AI.result: 实验显示在视觉质量、多镜头生成和跨镜头一致性方面有所提升，但连续轮次评估表明遵循多轮编辑指令仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: Sora100K 为超越孤立视频片段、迈向结构化视频创作轨迹的 AI 原生视频创作建立了新的数据基础，数据集和补充材料已公开。

title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
summary: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Skill-V，一个可验证的自进化技能库，将技能表示为带版本的、可证伪的契约，并通过环境结果驱动技能新增与修订，在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上取得高成功率且技能库更紧凑。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化技能库主要靠积累新知识来改进，失败时可能新增技能，但较少根据新证据重新审视已有技能；仅靠增长无法保证可靠性，因为检索到的技能可能在当前任务条件下不适用，或已有技能可能编码了错误的操作边界。
AI.method: 将技能表示为版本化、可证伪的契约，把语义意图与可观察行为标准关联；利用环境结果驱动技能库进化：任务失败促发技能新增，契约评估与任务结果不一致促发已有技能边界修订；修订需保留受保护语义约束，并在历史回放证据上满足评分-结果指标的非退化标准；最后使用适用性感知过滤器排除当前任务中明显不适用的候选技能。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，Skill-V 分别达到 95.3% 和 85.9% 的成功率，同时技能库比以增长为导向的基线更紧凑；适用性感知过滤减少了错误技能调用，基于结果的修订纠正了错误指定的技能边界，且未降低历史已观测证据上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的技能进化不只是积累经验：技能库必须学会保留哪些知识、何时修订知识，以及何时应用知识。

title: Q-Shaped Options for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Learning to tackle long-horizon, goal-conditioned tasks requires an agent to reason over extended timescales and act across a broad range of states. In principle, Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) addresses both challenges through the interaction between action (temporal) and state (spatial) abstraction. First, using an action abstraction to represent temporally extended behaviour as options reduces the effective decision horizon. Second, enabling different state abstractions at each level of the decision process permits greater data aggregation for learning. However, realising these two benefits of a hierarchical policy depends on learning an appropriate action abstraction. Current HRL algorithms fail in one of two ways. Some discard distinctions between options needed for optimal control, undermining hierarchy altogether. Others retain unnecessary distinctions, preserving horizon reduction, but forfeiting coarser state abstraction. In this work, we characterise three desiderata for an action abstraction. We introduce Q-Shaped Options (QSO) to address all three. QSO builds on an architecture with distinct state-value functions, Q functions and policies at each level of the hierarchy. It learns the action abstraction between consecutive levels as a shared encoder shaped by their respective Q functions. The low-level Q function uses the option as a goal, encouraging the abstraction to retain distinctions necessary for optimal control. The high-level Q function uses it as an action, encouraging unnecessary distinctions to be discarded. Across offline goal-conditioned locomotion and manipulation environments, QSO learns semantically meaningful option spaces and outperforms baselines, achieving non-zero performance in tasks where all other evaluated algorithms fail.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Q-Shaped Options（QSO）方法，通过学习合适的动作抽象，使分层强化学习同时获得时间抽象与状态抽象优势，并在离线目标条件任务中优于基线。
AI.motivation: 长时程、目标条件任务需要智能体在长时间尺度和广泛状态空间上推理与行动。HRL 理论上可通过动作抽象减少决策时域，并通过状态抽象促进数据聚合，但现有 HRL 算法要么丢弃最优控制所需选项区分，要么保留不必要区分而牺牲粗粒度状态抽象。
AI.method: 作者刻画动作抽象的三大理想性质，并提出 QSO。QSO 在每层使用独立的状态价值函数、Q 函数和策略，并将相邻层之间的动作抽象学习为共享编码器，由各层 Q 函数塑造。低层 Q 函数将选项作为目标，保留最优控制所需区分；高层 Q 函数将选项作为动作，促使丢弃不必要区分。
AI.result: 在离线目标条件运动与操作环境中，QSO 学习到语义有意义的选项空间，性能优于基线，并在其他所有评估算法失败的任务中取得非零性能。
AI.conclusion: QSO 能同时满足动作抽象的三个理想性质，从而有效实现分层策略在时间抽象和状态抽象两方面的优势。

title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出视觉过渡推理是多模态大模型在空间、具身、物理和时间推理上共同缺陷的核心，构建了WOVEN训练源与基准，并证明该能力可作为共享训练原语跨任务迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有基准分别记录这些缺陷，无法跨场景、动作和推理操作进行受控比较。作者假设这些失败反映共享的视觉过渡推理缺陷，并测试其能否作为共享训练原语，从不同监督源学习并复用到不同任务。
AI.method: 引入WOVEN训练源与基准，利用视频预训练生成模型的多样化真实rollout，组织过渡监督，包含36,076个样本，覆盖20种场景、5种动作和8种推理类型。先评估38个前沿MLLM，再在多个规模上训练MLLM，并进行受控比较以得出训练配方。
AI.result: 最强模型也远低于人类，失败跨模型家族并随规模持续。仅约2,000项的训练子集可集体提升26个外部基准中的22个，最高提升27.3个百分点；WOVEN数据可替代任务自身30-50%的训练数据且精度相当。受控比较得出训练配方：按所教推理操作而非动作、场景或领域选择监督，并偏好视觉状态较大变化。
AI.conclusion: 视觉过渡推理可作为MLLM中系统性视觉世界模型训练的通用基础，支持跨任务迁移与高效训练。

title: Phase-aware video generation for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions
summary: Generating physically plausible videos for solid-gas dynamics is challenging as different phases exhibit distinct dynamics yet remain coupled through physical interactions. We present PAVG, a Phase-Aware Video Generator for solid-gas dynamics and interactions. It employs a dual-branch architecture to explicitly model the distinct dynamics of solids and gases, while spatiotemporal cross-attention captures their physical interactions. This design enables PAVG to preserve phasespecific motion characteristics while producing physically consistent responses across phases. To facilitate this task, we further construct a simulation corpus comprising over 700K physical trajectories across diverse solid, gas, and solid-gas interaction scenarios. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our PAVG produces videos with improved motion adherence, physical plausibility, and visual quality compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAVG，一种面向固-气动力学与相互作用的相位感知视频生成器，通过双分支架构与时空交叉注意力生成物理合理的固-气耦合视频。
AI.motivation: 固-气动力学视频生成具有挑战性，因为固相与气相动力学差异显著，但二者又通过物理相互作用紧密耦合。
AI.method: 采用双分支架构分别显式建模固体和气体的不同动力学，并用时空交叉注意力捕获两相间的物理相互作用；同时构建了包含70万以上物理轨迹的仿真语料库，覆盖多种固、气及固-气交互场景。
AI.result: 大量评估表明，与现有方法相比，PAVG生成的视频在运动符合度、物理合理性和视觉质量方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: PAVG能够保留各相特有的运动特征，同时产生跨相物理一致的响应，从而有效提升固-气动力学视频生成的物理合理性与视觉表现。

title: Learning to Plan by Looking Back: Hindsight Hierarchies for Training Reasoning Models
summary: We introduce a self-improvement loop for reasoning models based on the following observation: Even when the difficulty of a problem exceeds the model's current solving abilities, an additionally supplied solution might enable the model to extract useful solution ideas in hindsight. We operationalize this by jointly training the same model to exhibit the following three capabilities: predicting solution ideas from problems alone, reverse-engineering ideas from problems and known solutions, and solving problems using provided ideas. The loop alternates between reverse engineering such ideas from problems with supplied solutions and using these ideas as additional supervision for joint training of all three capabilities. We give a formal specification of our method and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation remains future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向推理模型的自改进循环：利用已知解答反向提取解题思路，并将这些思路作为额外监督信号，联合训练模型从问题预测思路、从问题与解答反向工程思路、以及利用思路解题三种能力。作者给出了形式化描述，并在 Lean 定理证明器中进行了具体实例化，但尚未进行实证评估。
AI.motivation: 即使问题难度超出模型当前求解能力，若额外提供解答，模型仍可能事后提取有用的解题思路，从而帮助模型自我改进。
AI.method: 训练同一模型具备三种能力：仅从问题预测解题思路、从问题与已知解答反向工程解题思路、利用给定思路求解问题。循环交替进行：从问题与解答中反向提取思路，再将这些思路作为额外监督信号联合训练三种能力。文中给出形式化规范，并在 Lean 交互式定理证明环境中具体实例化。
AI.result: 提出了自改进循环的形式化方法和 Lean 定理证明器中的具体实例化方案；尚未报告实证结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为推理模型利用已知解答进行自我提升提供了新思路，未来工作将进行实证评估。

title: FastBench: Can Streaming VLMs Perceive High-Dynamic Real-World Streams?
summary: Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FastBench基准，用于评估真实视频流中的高动态感知，并给出无训练基线ProactiveFrame。实验显示最强模型仅50.7%，密集采样有增益但会饱和，当前VLM难以自主判断何时需要更细粒度时序感知。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频大语言模型基准多聚焦低动态场景；在有限上下文预算下，模型需平衡时序历史、空间分辨率和时间粒度，而1-2 FPS稀疏采样会漏掉快速事件，因此需要高动态流式视频理解评测。
AI.method: 构建FastBench：采用轨迹接地流水线，从高FPS片段生成QA，过滤2 FPS即可回答的问题，用SAM3和CoTracker3轨迹验证答案，并进行三轮人工检查；包含306个QA对，覆盖8个领域、6种能力及前向、即时、后向时间范围，并提供人工标注证据区间。提出ProactiveFrame无训练基线，通过文本token调整输入帧率，并用双层级滑动窗口保留近期高FPS观测、将旧帧降采样为稀疏历史。
AI.result: 最强模型Gemini-3.5-Flash仅得50.7%；Qwen3-VL-8B从2 FPS的32.9%提升至24 FPS的44.6%，但随历史压缩增益饱和；ProactiveFrame比稀疏均匀采样分别高5.4和1.5个百分点，但仍远低于oracle引导聚焦，表明当前VLM难以仅从流中判断何时需要更细时间感知。
AI.conclusion: FastBench为高动态流式视频理解提供了测试平台，揭示了现有模型在有限上下文下进行高动态感知的显著局限；代码与数据已开源。

title: Seek-and-View Reasoning for Multi-View Spatial Understanding
summary: Existing approaches to multi-view spatial reasoning operate largely on sparse input views. Vision-language models (VLMs) are thus restricted to understand a scene and infer spatial relations within these fixed views, leading to fragile cross-view alignment and geometry-to-language bottleneck. To address these issues, we formulate a novel Seek-and-View reasoning approach to find implicit cross-view spatial evidence by locating a question-relevant view to support the spatial reasoning. To realize this approach, we propose Vantage, a training-free model-agnostic reasoning framework that pairs a VLM with a 3D foundation model: a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage for question analysis and view planning, followed by a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage to effectively synthesize and incorporate visual evidence into the final reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on six VLMs demonstrate consistent improvements on five benchmarks without fine-tuning. Overall, by revealing spatial evidence through view-grounded reasoning, Vantage can largely reduce reliance on language-based cross-view alignment and improve multi-view spatial understanding. Our code is available at https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种名为 Vantage 的免训练、模型无关推理框架，通过“寻找并查看”隐式跨视角空间证据来增强多视角空间推理。
AI.motivation: 现有多视角空间推理方法多依赖稀疏输入视角，视觉语言模型只能在这些固定视角内理解场景和推断空间关系，导致跨视角对齐脆弱以及几何到语言的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 Seek-and-View 推理范式，并实现 Vantage 框架：将视觉语言模型与 3D 基础模型结合，包含视角锚定的推理阶段（问题分析与视角规划）和几何锚定的证据增强阶段（合成并融入视觉证据进行最终推理）。
AI.result: 在六个视觉语言模型和五个基准上实验，无需微调即取得一致提升，并减少对基于语言的跨视角对齐的依赖。
AI.conclusion: Vantage 通过视角锚定的推理揭示空间证据，能够提升多视角空间理解能力。代码已开源：https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage。

title: Instruction-Conditioned Electromagnetic Spectrum Understanding via Budget-Adaptive Signal Tokenization
summary: Electromagnetic spectrum monitoring increasingly requires flexible analysis beyond task-specific recognition and detection. Multimodal large language models offer a unified interface, but extending vision-language models (VLMs) to raw I/Q signals requires tokenization that balances fidelity against a strict budget. For signals, dense encoding causes token costs to grow with observation length, whereas fixed-resolution compression may discard short-duration or localized signal evidence. Thus, we propose \textbf{BATok}, a budget-adaptive signal tokenizer that adjusts token capacity to the input length while allocating that capacity according to the signal content. BATok constructs candidate representations from signal-derived features using lightweight multi-resolution branches, then combines a local energy prior with learnable queries to resample these representations into compact signal tokens. The number of tokens adapts to the input length while remaining strictly bounded. The resulting tokens are projected into the language embedding space of VLMs. We further introduce \textbf{EMSpec-Instruct}, a multimodal instruction dataset aligning raw I/Q signals, waterfall images, and language supervision for modulation recognition, structured detection, and language-conditioned signal grounding. Experiments show that BATok learns effective signal representations and achieves competitive performance across all tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出预算自适应信号分词器BATok，将原始I/Q信号压缩为数量随输入长度变化但有界的信号token，并投影到视觉语言模型的语言嵌入空间；同时构建EMSpec-Instruct多模态指令数据集，在调制识别、结构化检测和语言条件信号定位任务上取得有竞争力的表现。
AI.motivation: 电磁频谱监测需要超越特定任务识别与检测的灵活分析能力，而多模态大语言模型可提供统一接口；但将视觉语言模型扩展到原始I/Q信号时，分词需在保真度与严格token预算之间平衡。密集编码会使token成本随观测长度增长，固定分辨率压缩又可能丢失短时或局部信号证据。
AI.method: 提出BATok预算自适应信号分词器：利用轻量级多分辨率分支从信号衍生特征构建候选表示，结合局部能量先验与可学习查询将这些表示重采样为紧凑信号token；token数量随输入长度自适应且严格有界，并投影到VLM语言嵌入空间。此外构建EMSpec-Instruct多模态指令数据集，对齐原始I/Q信号、瀑布图和语言监督，覆盖调制识别、结构化检测和语言条件信号定位。
AI.result: 实验表明，BATok能够学习有效的信号表示，并在所有任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: BATok通过预算自适应、内容感知的信号token化，在有限token预算下兼顾信号保真度与多模态大模型接口需求；结合EMSpec-Instruct数据集，可支持调制识别、结构化检测和语言条件信号定位等多种电磁频谱分析任务。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多智能体自监督（MASS），一种在不可验证任务上进行递归自我改进的方法，通过交替进行进化式工作流优化与自生成轨迹的监督微调，提升模型复杂推理与自我改进能力。
AI.motivation: 在开放式研究等不可验证任务中，模型输出可能超出人类专家可靠评估范围，导致监督瓶颈；此时模型自身成为最佳优化器和评估器。但单模型实例在同质循环中难以有效批判和改进自身复杂推理。
AI.method: MASS 让单一基础模型迭代提出、执行并自评估多智能体工作流，通过受结构护栏约束的进化搜索优化类似计算图的多智能体编排，发现任务中有效的角色分工和信息路由；并在两个 MASS 循环中交替进行进化工作流优化与自生成轨迹的监督微调。
AI.result: 使用 Qwen3.6-27B 经过两个 MASS 循环后，在四个开放式公开基准上，每输出 token 的性能提升 1.2-1.6 倍；多智能体轨迹训练效率更高，学生模型在 1.4 倍训练 token 的单智能体学生模型面前仍表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 改进后的模型可作为更好的优化器和评估器，使该交替框架实现能力持续递归自举；联合学习多智能体轨迹中的编排与受限子智能体执行，可为递归自我改进提供有效信号。

title: Fast Pose Tracking of Rigid Objects with Compact Pose Graph Optimization
summary: Tracking a novel object's 6D pose over long horizons currently requires either expensive onboarding or a reconstruction maintained throughout the sequence. This makes current trackers impractical for robotic manipulation and augmented reality, which need trackers that are ready to use and run in real time. We show that a lightweight tracking module can be applied on top of a wide range of correspondence estimation methods to keep drifts bounded while maintaining fast runtime. Our key idea is to avoid point-based optimization in the pose graph and operate only on relative pose constraints, which we weight by a derived uncertainty from the geometric alignment. This makes optimization independent of the number of correspondences while avoiding the direct inclusion of noisy point measurements, leading to fast and robust long-term tracking. Across four real-world benchmarks, our approach achieves tracking accuracy comparable to reconstruction-based trackers with a fraction of the optimization cost. Overall, these results suggest that a compact and reliable pose graph optimization can provide long-horizon consistency at substantially lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级6D物体姿态跟踪模块，可叠加在多种对应估计方法之上，通过仅使用相对姿态约束并基于几何对齐推导不确定性进行加权，实现长期稳定且实时的跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有长期6D姿态跟踪方法需要昂贵的初始化或全程维护重建，难以适用于需要即用且实时的机器人操作和增强现实场景。
AI.method: 在姿态图中避免基于点的优化，仅对相对姿态约束进行优化，并根据几何对齐推导的不确定性对这些约束加权，使优化独立于对应点数量，同时避免直接引入噪声点测量。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界基准上，该方法以远低于基于重建跟踪器的优化成本，达到了与之相当的跟踪精度。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑可靠的姿态图优化能够在显著降低计算成本的同时，提供长期一致的6D物体姿态跟踪。

title: From Suppression to Repair: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Localized Distribution Alignment
summary: Object hallucination remains a major obstacle for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to generate reliable content. An intuitive mitigation strategy is to suppress hallucination-related components in hidden representations. However, these components may also contain useful information, and suppressing them can weaken the model's multimodal capabilities. In this paper, we propose ResOT, a training-free method that repairs representations at inference time through localized distribution alignment. Specifically, ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace, forming a low-dimensional residual subspace for intervention. Within this subspace, ResOT uses Gaussian optimal transport (OT) to align the hallucinated distribution with the faithful one. The resulting map defines repair targets with minimal changes to the original representations. At inference, ResOT adaptively controls how far each token state moves toward its OT target. Experiments on three representative LVLMs show that ResOT substantially reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance across multiple benchmarks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ResOT，一种无需训练的推理时表征修复方法，通过局部分布对齐来缓解大型视觉语言模型中的物体幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有抑制隐藏表征中幻觉相关成分的方法可能同时削弱有用信息，从而损害模型的多模态能力，因此需要一种既能减少幻觉又能保留模型能力的方法。
AI.method: ResOT 在推理阶段进行表征修复：先将主要幻觉方向从忠实子空间中投影出去，形成低维残差子空间；在该子空间内使用高斯最优传输（OT）将幻觉分布对齐到忠实分布，得到对原始表征改动最小的修复目标；推理时自适应控制每个 token 状态向 OT 目标移动的程度。
AI.result: 在三个代表性 LVLM 上的实验表明，ResOT 能显著减少物体幻觉，同时提升图像描述质量和多个基准上的多模态性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOT 是一种有效的免训练推理时修复方法，可在不损害多模态能力的情况下缓解物体幻觉，代码将开源。

title: When Has a Bayesian Neural Network Sampled Enough? Adaptive Inference Time with Statistical Guarantees
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: E-Values: From Statistics to ML
summary: Bayesian neural network predictions are commonly approximated using a fixed number of Monte Carlo samples per input, without controlling the resulting error that comes from this finite sample. We propose the use of confidence sequences to dynamically determine how many samples are needed while maintaining statistical guarantees. We consider several ways in which predictive probabilities are used, including identifying the most likely class, approximating the full predictive distribution, and resolving probability-threshold decisions. Sampling stops once the corresponding decision can be made with the desired guarantee. Experiments show that the method allocates the computational budget efficiently, assigning more samples to ambiguous inputs than to easy inputs while preserving reliable decisions and reducing overall latency relative to a fixed Monte Carlo budget.

AI.tldr: 提出使用置信序列动态决定贝叶斯神经网络预测所需的蒙特卡洛采样数量，在保持统计保证的同时减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络预测常用固定数量的蒙特卡洛样本，但没有控制有限样本带来的误差。
AI.method: 使用置信序列动态确定需要多少样本，并针对最可能类别识别、完整预测分布近似和概率阈值决策等不同用途，在能够以所需保证做出决策时停止采样。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能高效分配计算预算，对模糊输入分配更多样本，对简单输入分配更少样本，同时保持可靠决策并降低总体延迟。
AI.conclusion: 置信序列可用于自适应采样，在维持统计保证的同时提升贝叶斯神经网络预测推理效率。

title: From Pixels to Structure: Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Document OCR and Structured JSON Extraction
comment: 17 pages. Published in Document Analysis and Recognition - ICDAR 2026, LNCS vol. 16974, Springer. Code: https://github.com/uddipan77/Analysis-of-Lightweight-Vision-Language-Models-for-Document-OCR-and-Structured-Output-Generation
summary: While massive, closed-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) set strong benchmarks for document understanding, their dependence on commercial APIs limits adoption in institutional archives due to data autonomy concerns, recurring costs, and the environmental footprint of hyperscale computing. This is especially acute in heritage digitization, where documents include historical handwriting, domain-specific terminology (e.g., jewelry, prehistory, architecture), and non-standard layouts requiring high-dimensional structured extraction. We present a comparative study of eight open-source lightweight VLMs (up to 7B parameters) for Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-to-structure across three university heritage collections. Given a document image, models must extract text and generate schema-compliant JSON, enabling automatic validation and downstream use. We evaluate models under a constraint-aware protocol across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning settings, measuring extraction fidelity and structured-output quality using Character Error Rate (CER), Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*), and mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1). Against a fine-tuning baseline, we further test the independent impact of (i) hyperparameter optimization, (ii) classical image preprocessing (illumination flattening, denoising, and CLAHE), and (iii) multi-stage training. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between dataset-specific fine-tuning and a single multi-dataset checkpoint, where joint training enables one model to operate across collections but can shift performance between datasets. Overall, we show that carefully adapted VLMs with up to 7B parameters can provide a sustainable, private, high-performing alternative to manual transcription or commercial black-box systems, and we offer actionable guidance for heritage institutions seeking institution-controlled OCR-to-JSON extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了8个参数量不超过7B的开源轻量级视觉语言模型，在三个高校文化遗产馆藏上完成OCR到结构化JSON提取，并评估零样本、少样本和微调设置下的效果。
AI.motivation: 商业闭源VLM虽在文档理解上表现强，但依赖商业API会带来数据自主性、持续成本和超大规模计算环境足迹问题，尤其不适合需要处理历史手写、领域术语和非标准版式的文化遗产数字化机构。
AI.method: 在约束感知协议下评估8个开源轻量级VLM（≤7B），任务是从文档图像提取文本并生成符合schema的JSON；比较零样本、少样本和微调；使用CER、ANLS*和mAP-F1；并独立测试超参数优化、经典图像预处理（光照平坦化、去噪、CLAHE）和多阶段训练的影响；最后分析单数据集微调与多数据集联合检查点之间的权衡。
AI.result: 经过精心适配的≤7B VLM能够在文化遗产OCR到JSON提取中取得高性能；微调基线优于其他设置，超参数优化、图像预处理和多阶段训练等因素具有独立影响；多数据集联合训练可让单一模型跨馆藏工作，但可能造成数据集间性能迁移。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，适配良好的轻量级开源VLM可作为可持续、隐私安全且高性能的替代方案，取代人工转录或商业黑盒系统，并为文化遗产机构开展机构可控的OCR到JSON提取提供可操作建议。

title: Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Inpainting via Learnable Mask Attention and Support Token Refinement
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Project page: https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/
summary: 3D scene inpainting aims to recover missing or occluded regions in edited 3D scenes, while ensuring geometric and textural consistency. Existing approaches, however, typically require accurately calibrated camera poses, which restricts their applicability in casual, in-the-wild scenarios and introduces additional preprocessing overhead. To overcome this limitation, we present FreeInpaint, a novel feed-forward framework that generates complete and 3D-consistent scenes directly from unposed multi-view images with masked regions. At its core, FreeInpaint extends a 3D foundation model to propagate masked regions from a reference view to other unposed views, bridging 3D reconstruction and scene inpainting while preserving the model's native ability to recover camera poses and scene geometry. Our method addresses two key challenges in adapting feed-forward 3D foundation models to masked inputs. First, masked regions can corrupt cross-view correspondence reasoning, degrading pose estimation and geometry recovery. To address this, we introduce a Learnable Mask Attention mechanism that preserves the spatial anchoring of reliable observations while allowing masked regions to progressively absorb useful context in deeper layers. Second, under severe occlusions, a single forward pass often lacks sufficient appearance evidence for high-fidelity completion. Therefore, we propose a Support Token Refinement strategy, which injects diffusion-generated support evidence as confidence-weighted auxiliary tokens to refine under-observed regions while preserving the original spatial anchor. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that FreeInpaint achieves superior inpainting quality, eliminating the reliance on pre-computed camera poses while keeping a fast inference speed. The project page is https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.

AI.tldr: 提出 FreeInpaint，一种无需相机位姿的前馈式 3D 场景修复框架，可直接从未标定、带掩码的多视角图像生成完整且 3D 一致的场景。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 场景修复方法通常依赖准确标定的相机位姿，限制其在随意拍摄的真实场景中的适用性，并增加预处理开销。
AI.method: 基于 3D 基础模型扩展，将参考视图的掩码区域传播到其他无位姿视图；引入 Learnable Mask Attention 缓解掩码对跨视图对应关系的干扰；提出 Support Token Refinement，利用扩散模型生成的辅助证据作为置信度加权 token 细化遮挡区域。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上取得更优的修复质量，无需预计算相机位姿，同时保持较快推理速度。
AI.conclusion: FreeInpaint 能在无位姿多视角输入下实现高质量、3D 一致的场景修复，消除对相机位姿标定的依赖。

title: A Structural Theory of Cognitive Representation and Problem Solving,Contexts, Invariance, and the Knowledge Space
summary: Learning and problem solving depend critically on the structure of internal representations. While many modern data-driven artificial systems achieve strong predictive performance, their learned representations often lack explicit structure for expressing abstraction, invariance, and task-relevant regularities. We propose a minimal structural framework in which representational operations relevant to problem solving, such as context formation, invariance recognition, representative selection, abstraction, and procedural reuse, are made explicit. The central notion is that of a \emph{context}, formalized as a partition of a subset of an underlying state space, which fixes the distinctions, granularity, and form in which a problem can be posed. Within this setting, invariance recognition and representative selection are treated as fundamental representational operations. The framework is realized as a Knowledge Space composed of two coupled graph structures: a Concept Graph that hosts constructed and refined concepts, and a Procedure Graph that encodes typed operations over representations. Together, these structures provide a minimal cognitive-representational algebra for operating on representations without assuming sophisticated inference, learning, control, perception, or motor mechanisms. Using simple illustrative examples and a finite weak-solver demonstration, we show that appropriate representational organization can simplify the form and scope of admissible regularities, even when problem solving is carried out by a fixed and limited solver. The contribution of the paper is structural rather than algorithmic: it identifies representational prerequisites for abstraction, invariance, and procedural reuse in problem solving, and states explicit success and failure conditions for the weak-solver setting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个最小结构框架，用“上下文”作为状态空间子集的划分，显式建模问题求解中的不变性识别、代表选择、抽象和过程复用，并通过概念图与过程图构成的知识空间实现。
AI.motivation: 现代数据驱动系统虽预测性能强，但其学习到的表示常缺乏显式结构，难以表达抽象、不变性和任务相关规律，因此需要明确问题求解所需的表示操作及其前提。
AI.method: 将上下文形式化为状态空间子集的划分，把不变性识别与代表选择视为基本表示操作；构建由概念图（存储构造与精炼的概念）和过程图（编码类型化表示操作）耦合而成的知识空间，形成一种最小的认知-表示代数。
AI.result: 通过简单示例和有限弱求解器演示表明：合适的表示组织能够简化可允许规律的形式与范围，即使问题求解由固定且有限的求解器完成。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献是结构性的而非算法性的：它识别了问题求解中抽象、不变性和过程复用的表示前提，并明确了弱求解器设定下的成功与失败条件。

title: VEDJE: Video-Efficient Discriminative Joint Encoder for Scalable Video-Text Retrieval
summary: Finding the right video often requires distinguishing similar scenes in which different events occur. Joint matching improves retrieval, but processing rich video representations for each query is costly. VEDJE compresses features within sampled frames while keeping their representations separate in a reusable cache. Feature-change prediction supplies an auxiliary training signal that improves retrieval from the compressed cache without adding work at query time. On MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, and ActivityNet, VEDJE improves R@1 over matched first-stage retrievers in both retrieval directions. On MSR-VTT, it reaches 59.8 text-to-video R@1 with a fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL first stage. In the VideoPrism configuration, shrinking the per-video cache fourfold to 12 KiB preserves text-to-video recall within 0.2 points. These results show that accurate video search can operate on compact evidence, encoded once and reused as new queries arrive.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VEDJE，通过在采样帧内压缩特征并在可复用缓存中保持表示分离，结合特征变化预测作为辅助训练信号，实现高效且准确的视频检索。
AI.motivation: 视频检索常需区分包含不同事件的相似场景；联合匹配虽能提升检索效果，但为每个查询处理丰富的视频表示成本很高。
AI.method: VEDJE 对采样帧内的特征进行压缩，同时在可复用缓存中保持各帧表示分离；使用特征变化预测提供辅助训练信号，提升从压缩缓存中检索的效果，且不增加查询时计算量。
AI.result: 在 MSR-VTT、MSVD、DiDeMo 和 ActivityNet 上，VEDJE 在双向检索中相较匹配的第一阶段检索器提升了 R@1；在 MSR-VTT 上，结合微调的 VideoCLIP-XL 第一阶段达到 59.8 的文本到视频 R@1；在 VideoPrism 配置下，将每视频缓存缩小四倍至 12 KiB，文本到视频召回率下降不超过 0.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，准确的视频搜索可以基于紧凑证据运行，这些证据只需编码一次，并可在新查询到来时重复使用。

title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails
summary: A typed decision model reads a piece of text and returns a probability over caller-defined options, each with a short written definition, generating no text. Recent work places these models in agent systems as guardrails: the component that reads a proposed tool call or incoming message and decides whether to allow it. We evaluate seven open-weight models in that role and report the two error directions separately: a fail-open error allows a prohibited action and is a vulnerability; a fail-closed error blocks a permitted one and is only a cost. On prompt-injection, jailbreak and toxic-content screening, accuracy at the allow-or-block decision ranges from 36% to 72% against a chance level of 50%. A low error rate in one direction only reflects which answer a model defaults to: one allows nearly everything, another blocks nearly everything. On a synthetic suite of agent tool calls, six lines of server log text that say nothing about the policy raise a gate's fail-open rate from 0% to 63% on a policy it otherwise decides correctly. Giving the permissive option a misleading name, with its definition and the judged text untouched, raises that rate to between 93% and 100% on the four models that place the label in their input. Every defense we tested is defeated, either by an attacker who targets its mechanism or by attacker-controlled text. Escalating the least confident decisions does not help either: a decision an attack has reversed is no less confident than the one it replaced. Parsing each policy field into a typed value does eliminate one attack, but it also makes the model unnecessary: a deterministic rule over those values reaches 100% accuracy on all six policies. These models can reduce how many cases reach a reviewer, but on this evidence they should not be the component that decides. Code is available at https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/option-channel-attack.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了七种开放权重模型作为代理系统中的类型化决策护栏，发现其决策准确率低、易受攻击且防御无效，不应作为最终决策组件。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型被用作代理系统中的护栏，决定是否允许工具调用或消息。需要评估其在对抗条件下的可靠性与安全性。
AI.method: 在提示注入、越狱、有毒内容筛查及合成代理工具调用上评估七种开放权重模型，分别统计fail-open与fail-closed错误，并测试多种防御及置信度升级策略。
AI.result: 允许/阻止决策准确率36%-72%（随机为50%）；日志文本可将fail-open率从0%升至63%；误导性选项名称可升至93%-100%；所有防御均被击败；置信度升级无效；将策略字段解析为类型化值可消除一种攻击但使模型多余，确定性规则达100%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些模型可减少需人工审核的案例，但在有证据下不应作为决定组件。

title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models
summary: Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity prediction (Tox21), mutagenesis, and citation matching (Cora), and show that it improves over purely symbolic, neural, and LLM-based baselines, while producing interpretable weighted rule ensembles. By replacing combinatorial search with gradient-guided LLM hypothesis generation, grasp retains boosting guarantees without sacrificing the transparency of symbolic outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出GRASP神经符号框架，将关系结构学习转化为函数梯度提升，并用LLM作为弱学习器（一阶规则）的假设生成器，从而合成可解释的概率逻辑程序。
AI.motivation: 声明式逻辑程序可解释且适合关系结构与神经符号推理，但从数据中归纳这类程序因符号搜索空间组合爆炸而非常困难；LLM虽能生成假设，但单独使用缺乏系统性归纳推理能力，难以稳定合成拟合复杂关系分布的有效程序。
AI.method: GRASP将关系结构学习建模为函数梯度提升：弱学习器是一阶规则，内层难以处理的最优规则搜索交由LLM提议预言机完成，以梯度引导的LLM假设生成替代组合搜索，并输出带权规则集成。
AI.result: 在四个关系基准上评估，涵盖Tox21分子毒性预测、致突变性预测和Cora引文匹配；GRASP优于纯符号、神经网络和基于LLM的基线，同时产生可解释的加权规则集成。
AI.conclusion: 用梯度引导的LLM假设生成替代组合搜索，使GRASP在保留提升算法保证的同时，不牺牲符号输出的透明性与可解释性。

title: Relative Patch Response Learning for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Generative models can now synthesize highly realistic images, simultaneously increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery. Therefore, detecting AI-generated images becomes more essential, and a reliable detector must generalize to unseen generators and stay robust to unseen perturbations in the wild. Existing detectors are typically trained on either independently collected real and generated images or aligned real-generated pairs designed to mitigate content bias. Building on aligned pairs, recent methods form a mixed view by replacing some patches of the real image with their generated counterparts. However, we find that self-attention lets real and generated patches interact, so the feature of each patch no longer reflects its own source alone. This contextual shift makes a per-patch source label an imprecise target. To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL). Instead of labeling each patch, PRL compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between the views. (i) To give precise supervision under the contextual shift, a relative response objective measures the responses of source-changed patches against those of source-unchanged patches, which respond to the shift alone. (ii) To provide a reliable reference for the shift, a reference coherence objective keeps each group of source-unchanged patches moving as a whole. (iii) Since the two views contain different amounts of generated content, an area ranking objective asks the view with the larger generated area to have a higher mean patch score. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of PRL, which surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy across eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出相对块响应学习（PRL）用于检测AI生成图像，通过比较同一图像块在两个混合视图中的响应变化，提升对未见生成器和未知扰动的泛化与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器训练于独立或对齐的真实-生成图像对，而基于对齐对构建混合视图时，自注意力使真实与生成块相互交互，导致每个块的特征不再仅反映自身来源，逐块源标签成为不精确的目标。
AI.method: PRL包含三个目标：(i) 相对响应目标，比较源变化块与源未变块的响应以提供精确监督；(ii) 参考一致性目标，保持源未变块整体移动以提供可靠参考；(iii) 区域排序目标，要求生成区域更大的视图具有更高的平均块分数。
AI.result: 在八个标准基准和三个野外基准上，PRL的平均平衡准确率分别比最佳先前方法高出4.3%和5.9%。
AI.conclusion: PRL通过相对块响应学习有效解决了混合视图中的上下文偏移问题，显著提升了AI生成图像检测的泛化性和鲁棒性。

title: Looking Inside LLMs: Small-World Connectivity as a Signature of Reasoning Performance
summary: Understanding large language model (LLM) reasoning requires looking beyond behavioral performance to examine how reasoning ability is reflected in internal organization. Inspired by neuroscience findings linking higher intelligence to stronger small-world organization in functional brain networks, we investigate small-world connectivity as a structural signature of LLM reasoning. We construct functional graphs from attention-head activation similarities and find that a higher small-world index (SWI), capturing local clustering and short global paths, consistently correlates with better fluid reasoning performance across models and training checkpoints. Since local clustering is central to small-world organization, we further examine how heads important for model performance connect within and across communities. We find that these heads tend to have a larger share of connection weight within their own communities (high core scores) and a more concentrated weight distribution across communities (low bridge scores). These observations motivate the hypothesis that high core and low bridge scores serve as structural indicators of head importance for reasoning capability. We validate this hypothesis through pruning, introducing Small-World Allocation (SWA), a hierarchical sparsity allocation method guided by these scores. Across six LLMs, SWA better preserves small-world organization and model performance than competing allocation strategies, reducing WikiText perplexity by up to 20%. Together, these findings identify small-world functional connectivity as a measurable signature of LLM reasoning performance, offering a structural perspective that complements behavioral evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究从神经科学中小世界网络与智力相关的发现出发，探究LLM推理能力是否体现在注意力头的功能连接结构中，并提出基于小世界指标的稀疏分配方法SWA。
AI.motivation: 超越行为表现，从内部组织结构理解LLM推理；受神经科学中更高智力与更强小世界组织相关联的启发。
AI.method: 从注意力头激活相似度构建功能图，计算小世界指数(SWI)；分析重要头在社区内/间的连接（核心分数、桥接分数）；通过剪枝验证，提出SWA分层稀疏分配方法。
AI.result: SWI越高，流体推理表现越好；重要头具有高核心分数、低桥接分数；SWA在6个LLM上优于对比方法，WikiText困惑度最多降低20%。
AI.conclusion: 小世界功能连接可作为LLM推理性能的可测量结构标志，为行为评估提供结构视角补充。

title: HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing
summary: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向智能教育中的自动评分与识别任务，提出了面向真实学生答题纸场景的数据集HANS，并基于此提出端到端框架NA-GOT，以提升含噪声答案过程的识别准确率与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析与手写识别基准多针对规范印刷文档或孤立数学表达式，难以覆盖学生答题纸中的多行推导、文本与公式混合、删除线等噪声，缺乏真实教育场景数据集。
AI.method: 构建HANS数据集，包含数学表达式、自然语言文本、手绘表格及更正/删除等噪声模式和细粒度标注；提出NA-GOT框架，通过特征级轻量噪声抑制模块和解码阶段噪声感知注意力机制实现两阶段噪声抑制。
AI.result: 实验表明HANS对现有方法构成显著挑战，而NA-GOT在答案过程识别中显著提升了准确率和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: HANS为鲁棒识别研究提供了可靠基础，NA-GOT验证了面向真实教育场景噪声抑制的有效性，数据集将在论文发表后公开。

title: Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations
summary: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AIMS，一种无需训练的自适应多源信息引导框架，通过动态协调视觉、预填充文本和生成上下文来缓解大型视觉语言模型中的幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练方法多依赖对比解码或视觉增强，往往只是提高视觉证据的相对影响。作者希望探究：LVLMs 能否动态调节不同上下文源的贡献，从而更有效地抑制幻觉。
AI.method: 作者发现 LVLMs 具有内在的视觉关注倾向，且文本上下文也能帮助缓解幻觉。据此提出 AIMS：为视觉、预填充文本和生成文本三个上下文域构建紧凑原型，估计其与当前查询的亲和度，并计算逐头引导权重；将多源引导方向应用于查询表示，无需额外训练或辅助前向传播。
AI.result: 在多种 LVLMs 和多种解码策略上的实验表明，AIMS 能有效缓解物体幻觉，同时保持有竞争力的通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: AIMS 证明可以通过动态协调多源上下文来抑制幻觉，是一种轻量、免训练且有效的幻觉缓解方案。

title: GeoReform: Reflective Formalization Evolution for Multimodal Geometry Problem Solving
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to identify and use geometric relations in diagrams. Recent methods address this challenge by converting geometric entities, relations, and constraints into explicit textual representations for the model to reason over. However, effective formalization is highly non-trivial: on Geometry3K, structure injection fixes 28 errors but introduces 13 new ones among 200 examples. Redundant relations can distract the model, while ambiguous references to diagram elements can lead it to apply constraints incorrectly. This suggests that the key challenge is not merely extracting more geometric facts, but organizing them into representations that support downstream reasoning. To fully exploit the power of formalization, we further propose GeoReform, a reflective formalization evolution framework that treats formalization as an optimizable policy rather than a fixed parser output. GeoReform executes the full reasoning pipeline, collects failed rollouts, diagnoses defects in the current representation, and mutates the policy to better select, ground, group, and present geometric entities, relations, constraints, and targets. On Geometry3K, GeoReform improves Qwen3VL-2B accuracy from 42.0\% to 56.0\%. Extensive experiments and analyses across geometry reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that effective formalization is crucial for improving multimodal geometry reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态大语言模型在几何图形推理中的形式化问题，提出GeoReform框架，将形式化视为可优化策略而非固定解析输出，通过反思执行失败并迭代改进表示，从而提升几何推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型难以识别和运用几何关系。虽已有方法将几何实体、关系与约束转为显式文本表示，但有效形式化非常困难：在Geometry3K上结构注入虽修复28个错误，却引入13个新错误。冗余关系会干扰模型，歧义引用会导致约束误用，说明关键不在于提取更多几何事实，而在于组织成支持下游推理的表示。
AI.method: 提出GeoReform，一个反思式形式化演化框架。它将形式化视为可优化策略，而非固定解析器输出。框架执行完整推理流程，收集失败轨迹，诊断当前表示缺陷，并变异策略以更好地选择、定位、分组和呈现几何实体、关系、约束与目标。
AI.result: 在Geometry3K上，GeoReform将Qwen3VL-2B的准确率从42.0%提升至56.0%。在多个几何推理基准上的实验与分析表明，有效形式化对提升多模态几何推理至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 有效形式化是提升多模态几何推理的关键。通过将形式化作为可优化策略并反思失败来迭代改进表示，能显著提升模型在几何推理任务上的表现。

title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Science: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. Equal contribution
summary: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨LLM科学智能体是否仅依赖初始任务上下文，还是能根据实验反馈调整决策。在神经算子微调配置选择任务中，LLM在有限试验预算下优于随机搜索和贝叶斯优化，并通过干预实验证明其同时具备任务相关先验和对反馈的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注LLM智能体的最终性能，但无法区分其成功源于初始任务先验还是对实验反馈的适应。作者希望厘清LLM在科学实验决策中是否真正根据观察结果调整策略。
AI.method: 在神经算子自适应任务中，让LLM在有限试验预算下选择微调配置，并在PDE族内和族间迁移。通过控制干预实验进行归因：检查未观察验证分数时的初始配置质量；进行冷启动干预，改变PDE描述以观察基础学习率选择；在反馈可用后，重新分配已评估配置的验证分数，以及进行保值改写，观察下一步提案是否变化。
AI.result: LLM在几乎所有匹配比较中取得比随机搜索和贝叶斯优化更低的留出测试nRMSE。干预实验显示：在未观察验证分数前，LLM首个配置已接近随机搜索池的顶部，表明存在有用初始偏置；冷启动下所选基础学习率随PDE描述变化；重新分配验证分数会改变下一次提案，而保值改写没有类似总体效应。
AI.conclusion: LLM科学智能体的决策级行为既依赖给定任务，也响应观察到的实验结果，说明其结合了任务相关先验与对实验反馈的敏感性，而非仅依赖初始上下文。

title: Revisiting Identity and Spectra Dispersion in Media-Bridged Time Series Forecasting: Linking Multivariate Signals and Narrative Flows
summary: Media-bridged time series forecasting is expanding to encompass traditional "multivariate" and emerging "multimodal" (e.g., through textual assistance). Existing Time Series Forecasting (TSF) models still rely on paradigm-specific relation, fusion, and temporal modules, hindering a common forecasting backbone across numerical and pre-aligned narrative-flow settings. To explore this, we propose the Multimedia Identity-Aware Prism Network (MIDAPN), a unified spatiotemporal forecasting backbone based on media-general graph adaptation and automatic temporal learning: (1) Following media pre-alignment, our Multimedia Identity-Aware Graph (MIDAG) revisits identity through static essence, dynamic behavior, and latent commonality, inducing affinities that extend variable-specific dependencies across media. Contextual Identity Modulation (CIM) further refines discriminative aggregation. (2) We develop Spectral Prism Convolution (SPConv) to automatically perform hierarchical temporal analysis, balancing coarse trends and fine-grained details. Meanwhile, its Adaptive Search Guidance configures a scale-efficient architecture for temporal-dimension reconstruction. These decoupled yet synergistic components jointly address media identity disentanglement and temporal-scale mismatch. Comprehensive evaluations involving 16 SOTA TSF models across 13 "multivariate" and 12 "multimodal" datasets, alongside targeted long-context comparisons against 14 time series foundation models and fused pretrained language models, demonstrate MIDAPN's consistent superiority and broad shared backbone compatibility. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/leijieruilq/MIDAPN/tree/main}{https://github.com/MIDAPN}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Multimedia Identity-Aware Prism Network (MIDAPN)，一个统一的多媒体时空预测骨干网络，旨在同时支持传统多变量时间序列预测和新兴多模态时间序列预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型通常依赖特定范式的关系建模、融合和时间模块，难以在数值设置与预对齐叙事流设置之间共享统一预测骨干。
AI.method: MIDAPN 基于媒体通用图适应和自动时间学习。具体包括：Multimedia Identity-Aware Graph (MIDAG) 从静态本质、动态行为和潜在共性重新审视身份，跨媒体扩展变量依赖；Contextual Identity Modulation (CIM) 进一步细化判别性聚合；Spectral Prism Convolution (SPConv) 自动进行层次化时间分析，平衡粗粒度趋势和细粒度细节；Adaptive Search Guidance 配置尺度高效架构以重建时间维度。
AI.result: 在13个多变量数据集和12个多模态数据集上，与16个SOTA时间序列预测模型进行综合评估，并针对14个时间序列基础模型和融合预训练语言模型进行长上下文比较，MIDAPN均表现出持续优越性，并具有广泛共享骨干兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 解耦但协同的组件共同解决了媒体身份解缠和时间尺度不匹配问题，表明统一骨干网络可有效兼容数值与多模态预测设置。代码已开源。

title: Does Target Alignment Mean Target Recovery? An Evidence-Ladder Study of Adversarial Claims on Contrastive Encoders
summary: Adversarial attacks on vision-language models optimize an image toward a text target, then cite the attacked model's similarity score as evidence of success. We ask whether that score - victim-space target alignment (VTS) - predicts recovery of the target by an independent model. We first build a measurement instrument: supervised judges outside the attacked geometry, real-target blend controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies then compare six contrastive encoders under a matched attack at three perturbation budgets. Robustly trained encoders (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES) transfer substantially more independent evidence than vanilla CLIP or SigLIP; all eight contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. However, no cell reaches the blend-derived reference level. The three best cells fall within its replication band, leaving practical recovery undecided. Within robust encoders, per-sample alignment gain correlates with evidence gain ($ρ= 0.24-0.51$); within vanilla CLIP the correlation is consistent with zero. Across encoders we find no monotone alignment-evidence relation. VTS is therefore informative only within a fixed robust encoder, and we provide a reporting protocol in its place.

AI.tldr: 本文检验对抗攻击中常被引用的受害者模型相似度分数（VTS）是否能预测独立模型对目标文本的恢复，结果表明VTS仅在固定鲁棒编码器内部具有信息量，跨模型无单调关系，并提出新的报告协议。
AI.motivation: 针对视觉-语言模型的对抗攻击通常以受害者模型对文本目标的相似度分数（VTS）作为攻击成功的证据，但该分数是否真正反映独立模型的恢复能力尚不清楚，作者质疑其作为成功指标的有效性。
AI.method: 构建测量工具：使用攻击几何之外的监督评判器、真实目标混合对照、打乱目标负样本，以及由50%目标图像混合推导的参考水平；开展两项预注册研究，在三种扰动预算下对六个对比编码器进行匹配攻击比较。
AI.result: 鲁棒训练编码器（FARE、TeCoA、PMG、TRADES）比原始CLIP或SigLIP传递显著更多的独立证据，全部八组对比在自助法下界处拒绝原假设；但没有任何单元达到混合推导的参考水平，三个最佳单元落入其复现带内，实际恢复情况无法定论。鲁棒编码器内部，样本级对齐增益与证据增益相关（ρ=0.24–0.51），而原始CLIP中该相关性与零一致；跨编码器不存在单调的对齐-证据关系。
AI.conclusion: VTS仅在固定鲁棒编码器内部具有信息量，不能作为跨模型攻击成功的通用证据，作者据此提出替代性的报告协议。

title: HRIL: Learning Multimodal Synergy via Higher-Order Tensor Modeling
summary: Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. Code is released at https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出HRIL，通过建模模态嵌入间的高阶统计依赖来保留多模态表示中的协同信息，并在协同主导任务上取得优于现有多模态对比方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 自监督多模态表示学习虽已成功，但协同信息难以捕捉。协同信息只在多个模态联合配置中出现，无法从任一单模态中恢复，因此需要显式建模跨模态高阶交互以保留其信息容量。
AI.method: 提出高阶表示与信息学习（HRIL）：基于模态嵌入构建经验交叉矩张量以表示多路交互，使用Tucker分解获得核心张量，并引入协同感知正则项防止能量集中，从而保留高阶耦合能力以捕捉协同信息。
AI.result: 在受控协同任务和真实世界基准上，HRIL相对现有多模态对比方法取得一致提升，在由协同交互主导的任务上增益尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模模态间高阶统计依赖有助于自监督多模态表示学习保留和捕捉协同信息，是提升多模态表示质量的有效方向。

title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
summary: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the observed screen requires a second model to judge the two. We argue that a world model meant for verification should instead predict in the space in which observations are encoded, and present LGWM, a decoder-free, action-conditioned world model that predicts the representation of the next screen directly, trained without semantic annotation on 1.85M real GUI transitions. Verification reduces to a vector comparison, and the same signal reveals whether a mismatch is harmful. We evaluate on RSWT-BENCH, a diagnostic where each credential screen appears under both a legitimate and a hijacked transition, so detectors that see only the screen are at chance by construction. The training-free score reaches 0.987 AUC at 17 ms per decision, on par with the strongest closed-source VLMs and about ten AUC points above generative GUI world models at over three orders of magnitude lower latency. The residual direction reaches 0.953 AUC at separating harmful from benign violations, where prompted VLMs are near chance. Further analyses show that the prediction is a usable future state rather than an anomaly score. World models have mostly served as simulators or planners; our results point to a third role, verification, for which predicting in representation space is the natural design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向GUI智能体安全验证的世界模型LGWM，它直接在表示空间中预测下一屏幕，从而将安全判断简化为向量比较，并在RSWT-BENCH上实现高精度、低延迟的有害转换检测。
AI.motivation: GUI安全不能只看单个屏幕，而应判断动作后的屏幕转换是否符合预期。现有GUI世界模型以文本、代码或图像输出，验证时还需第二个模型比较，效率低且不适合验证。因此需要能在观测表示空间中直接预测下一状态的世界模型。
AI.method: 提出LGWM：一种无解码器、动作条件的世界模型，直接预测下一屏幕的表示。模型在185万条真实GUI转换上训练，无需语义标注。验证时只需将预测表示与实际观测表示做向量比较，并利用残差方向判断不匹配是否有害。
AI.result: 在RSWT-BENCH基准上，训练无关评分达到0.987 AUC，每次决策仅17毫秒，与最强闭源VLM相当，比生成式GUI世界模型高约10个AUC点且延迟低三个数量级以上。残差方向在区分有害与良性违规上达到0.953 AUC，而提示式VLM接近随机。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型除模拟器和规划器外，还可作为验证器；在表示空间进行预测是实现该角色的自然设计。LGWM的预测可作为可用未来状态，而不仅是异常分数。

title: FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对视觉语言模型在灾害损伤评估中漏报危险、召回率低的问题，利用信号检测理论将决策行为分解为感知能力与决策标准，并通过机械可解释性与激活引导操纵“恐惧”情感表征，从而在推理阶段纠正模型过度保守的决策倾向。
AI.motivation: VLM在灾后损伤评估中潜力大，但即使总体准确率看似足够，模型仍不愿判定危险，导致召回率低；作者希望诊断并纠正这种过度保守的决策政策，且无需重新训练。
AI.method: 采用信号检测理论将表现分解为辨别力d'和判断标准c；受恐惧使人风险规避的启发，定位模型中与恐惧情感相关的因果回路，并使用激活引导操纵该情感方向；在基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的两阶段SeisMLLM流程上验证。
AI.result: SeisMLLM-1K测试中仅标记27.0%的真实不安全建筑，且从不误报Red，c=+1.354，d'=1.521；在情感丰富自然场景上定位并验证情感方向后注入建筑任务，恐惧方向注入将Red召回率提升至75.7%（p<0.001），减去该方向则完全抑制Red预测，随机和匹配的快乐方向无显著效果；机制是判断标准移动（c=-1.515），辨别力未提升（d'=-0.493）。
AI.conclusion: VLM的决策可在推理时调整而无需再训练，表明机械可解释性可用于诊断和控制工程应用中的VLM决策行为。

title: Look Where You Can: Active View Selection for CAD Reconstruction under Occlusion
summary: CAD reconstruction methods assume a luxury reality rarely grants: unrestricted visual access to the object, photographed from any desired angle. Real objects, however, are scene-embedded, bolted against walls, wedged into corners, resting on floors, where the scene renders much of the view sphere unreachable and the remaining views unequally informative. We introduce \textbf{SightCAD}, a framework for parametric CAD reconstruction that treats view feasibility as a first-class constraint. In this work we consider objects from standard CAD benchmarks embedded in realistic indoor scenes with physically derived visibility constraints over a discrete view sphere. A learned view selector must choose $K$ feasible views for a vision--language model (VLM) that generates executable CadQuery code, scored by geometric fidelity of the executed solid. Because reward arrives only after discrete view selection, autoregressive generation, and CAD-kernel execution, we propose a joint training paradigm in which the view selector and the CAD-generation VLM are trained together against this reward.
