The learned selection policy departs sharply from random, uniform, and coverage-greedy alternatives, outperforming surface-area maximization (SA-max) by up to $6.4$ Intersection-over-Union (IoU) points across budgets $K\in\{1,\dots,5\}$. The full system surpasses strong external baselines on scene-embedded, occluded multi-view renders of DeepCAD and Fusion360 objects ($+21$ and $+17$ effective-mIoU points over the best baseline, respectively), as well as on test-time domain-canonicalized real images from the industrial T-LESS benchmark and on both synthetic and real images from the MP6D industrial metal-parts benchmark, while producing the highest rate of executable programs of any method compared (invalid-code rate ${\leq}1.5\%$).

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SightCAD，将视角可行性作为参数化 CAD 重建中的首要约束，联合训练视角选择器与生成 CadQuery 代码的视觉语言模型，以在真实场景遮挡与有限视角下重建 CAD 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 CAD 重建方法通常假设可从任意角度无限制观察物体，但真实物体常嵌于场景中，如靠墙、卡在角落或放在地板上，导致大量视角不可达且可用视角信息不均衡。
AI.method: 在标准 CAD 基准物体嵌入真实室内场景并基于离散视角球生成物理可见性约束；学习一个视角选择器为视觉语言模型选择 K 个可行视角，VLM 生成可执行 CadQuery 代码并根据执行实体的几何保真度获得奖励；由于奖励依赖离散视角选择、自回归生成和 CAD 内核执行，提出联合训练视角选择器与 CAD 生成 VLM 的范式。
AI.result: 学习到的选择策略显著优于随机、均匀和覆盖贪心策略，在 K∈{1,…,5} 时相对表面积最大化最高提升 6.4 IoU 点；完整系统在 DeepCAD 和 Fusion360 场景嵌入遮挡多视角渲染上分别比最佳基线提升 21 和 17 有效 mIoU 点，并在 T-LESS 真实图像和 MP6D 合成与真实工业金属零件基准上表现优异，同时可执行程序率最高，无效代码率不超过 1.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将视角可行性作为一等约束，并针对下游 CAD 重建奖励联合训练视角选择与生成模型，可有效应对场景嵌入、遮挡和有限视角条件下的 CAD 重建，且在多个合成与真实工业基准上优于现有基线。

title: Searching for "Harmful Refusal": A Psychometric Audit of an AI Safety Benchmark
comment: COLM 2026, AI for Measurement Science (AIMS) Workshop
summary: Safety benchmarks typically report one overall score for a suite of datasets, each of which may target one or more safety-related attributes, so models with similar overall scores can have very different attribute profiles. Comparing models is more tractable at the level of individual attributes, yet it is often unclear whether even a single dataset's scores isolate any single attribute. One plausible candidate for such an attribute is harmful refusal, a model's tendency to refuse dangerous or policy-violating prompts. We examine whether it constitutes a single, measurable attribute in HELM Safety. Using a construct validity framework that stipulates that an attribute must exist before a test can measure it, we start with HELM Safety's four datasets that might plausibly target harmful refusal, but find that three are saturated. We subject the remaining dataset, HarmBench, to two psychometric tests to determine if a single attribute like harmful refusal could stand behind its score. First, multidimensional item response theory modeling strongly suggests that HarmBench does not measure a singular attribute. Second, a differential item functioning analysis finds items where models from different developers with the same refusal ability score differently. These flags largely disappear under scope-specific matching, a pattern consistent with aggregation effects but not sufficient to rule out domain-specific developer differences. Zooming out, HarmBench collapses distinct harm behaviors into one score, and the overall HELM safety aggregate further collapses HarmBench and scores from other datasets into a single top-line number. Any safety score that averages over datasets and items can hide saturation and conflate behaviors this way. We argue that a score should earn its single-attribute reading before models are compared with it.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验 HELM Safety 中的有害拒绝是否可作为单一可测量属性，并指出 HarmBench 及总体安全分数会掩盖饱和与混淆不同危害行为。
AI.motivation: 安全基准通常只报告一个总分，但不同数据集可能针对多种安全属性；总体分相近的模型属性画像可能差异很大，因此需要判断单个数据集分数是否真能隔离某一属性，例如有害拒绝。
AI.method: 采用构念效度框架，先检查 HELM Safety 中可能针对有害拒绝的四个数据集，其中三个已饱和；再对 HarmBench 做多维项目反应理论建模和差异项目功能分析。
AI.result: 多维IRT表明 HarmBench 并非测量单一属性；DIF发现不同开发者模型在相同拒绝能力下某些题目得分不同，但在范围特定匹配后这些标记大多消失，符合聚合效应，但不足以排除领域特定开发者差异。
AI.conclusion: HarmBench 将不同危害行为压缩成一个分数，HELM Safety 总体聚合又进一步压缩。任何对数据集和题目取平均的安全分数都可能隐藏饱和并混淆行为；分数应先证明其单属性可解释性，再用于模型比较。

title: Ecology of AI Agents: Collaboration Creates a Population Threshold for Takeoff
summary: AI agents can now conduct real-world cyberattacks, scale up capabilities with the number of agents, and collectively pursue misaligned goals to obtain rewards. Together, these factors raise the risk of a population explosion of misaligned agents: agents could compromise computers and secretly deploy additional agents, creating a self-reinforcing cycle where larger populations develop greater collective cyber capability and expand further. This raises a fundamental question: What determines whether a population of misaligned agents remains contained or takes off into this self-reinforcing cycle? This population-level problem is ecological safety: unlike individual-agent or multi-agent safety with a fixed population, it concerns the dynamics of the population itself. Here, we develop an ecological theory of AI-agent populations based on a population growth equation in which fitness (growth rate) depends on cybersecurity capability. We show that, without collaboration, the population takes off only when individual-agent capability exceeds a critical threshold. With collaboration, however, collective cybersecurity capability increases with population size. This creates a critical population threshold: below it, the population declines; above it, the population takes off, even though individual-agent capability has not changed. In ecology, this phenomenon is known as the strong Allee effect. Because red teaming a small group of agents cannot guarantee ecological safety in larger populations, our theory calls for ecological red teaming and population pacing: gradually deploying larger agent populations in controlled environments, while measuring how cyber capability scales with population size, and estimating the critical population size for takeoff. Capability gains may lower this threshold, requiring re-estimation for each new model generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AI智能体群体的生态安全理论，研究错位智能体群体何时会被遏制、何时会因网络安全能力随规模增长而自我强化并爆发。
AI.motivation: AI智能体已能实施真实网络攻击，并可能随数量增加而增强能力、集体追求错位目标。若它们能入侵计算机并秘密部署更多智能体，就可能形成自我强化的种群爆炸，因此需要理解群体层面的生态安全，而非仅关注固定数量下的个体或多智能体安全。
AI.method: 建立基于种群增长方程的AI智能体群体生态理论，其中适应度（增长率）取决于网络安全能力；分别分析无协作与有协作情形，并引入生态学中的强Allee效应来描述临界种群规模。
AI.result: 无协作时，只有个体能力超过临界阈值，群体才会爆发。有协作时，集体网络安全能力随种群规模增加，形成临界种群阈值：低于该阈值群体下降，高于该阈值则即使个体能力不变也会爆发。因此，仅对少量智能体进行红队测试无法保证更大群体的生态安全。
AI.conclusion: 论文呼吁开展生态红队测试和种群节奏控制：在受控环境中逐步部署更大智能体群体，测量网络能力如何随规模扩展，并估计爆发临界规模。由于能力提升可能降低该阈值，每一代新模型都需重新估计。

title: Do Not Train Away Uncertainty: Early Uncertainty Anchored Calibration
summary: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.

AI.tldr: 本文发现深度模型在训练或微调早期校准更好，后期虽精度提升有限却显著加剧过度自信；据此提出 EUA-Cal，用早期模型作为不确定性锚点进行校准。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络与大语言模型在训练或微调中容易过度自信，且后期训练会逐渐丧失早期模型的不确定性感知，导致校准误差显著上升。
AI.method: 提出 EUA-Cal：将早期模型作为不确定性锚点，引入早期预测正则化以保留早期预测不确定性，并引入原型结构正则化以利用早期特征空间中的不确定性，联合缓解过度自信。
AI.result: 在图像分类和多选题问答任务上，使用八个不同模型进行大量实验，EUA-Cal 优于当前最先进的校准方法。
AI.conclusion: 早期模型具有更好的不确定性感知，保留并利用这种早期不确定性可有效改善校准；EUA-Cal 是一种有效的校准方法。

title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
summary: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BrickBench，一个面向智能体的文本条件乐高套装设计基准，要求智能体根据提示选择零件并生成可实际拼装、满足语义与设计标准的结构；同时提供 BrickAgent 环境，并评估三个不同规模与零件可用性设置下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有文本条件生成与智能体设计任务往往缺乏对物理可构建性、离散零件选择以及局部与全局约束联合推理的系统评估，因此需要以乐高设计作为测试平台来检验智能体的真实构建与设计能力。
AI.method: 提出 BrickBench 基准：给定文本提示，智能体需从离散零件库中选择零件，生成可物理拼装的装配体，并联合推理局部与全局约束；从有效性、对齐度和设计质量三方面，在三种不同规模与零件可用性的设置下评分；同时提供 BrickAgent 环境，供编码智能体构建、检查和验证设计。
AI.result: 领先智能体基本能满足可验证的物理和语义要求，但在整体设计质量上仍不及人类设计。
AI.conclusion: BrickBench 与 BrickAgent 为物理约束下的智能体设计提供了基准与环境，揭示了当前智能体在文本条件乐高设计上仍有明显提升空间，尤其在设计质量方面。

title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
summary: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIVIN基准，基于30个真实有人居住家庭的数字孪生，用于空间与具身智能研究，包含3D检测、重建、导航和移动操作四项任务。
AI.motivation: 现有资源在规模、真实世界对应性和交互就绪性之间难以兼顾，缺乏对真实家庭实际布置的忠实且可交互的复现，阻碍了具身AI在家庭环境中的应用。
AI.method: 构建30个多样化真实居住家庭的数字孪生，保留房间布局、家具配置和日常物品；采用人在回路的工作流，包括实例识别、建筑重建、物体生成与放置，并在每个阶段由人工对照原始观察进行审查和修正。
AI.result: 在LIVIN上评估3D检测、3D重建、导航和移动操作四项任务，发现现有方法在密集物体布置、遮挡、有限自由空间和受限交互区域等真实家庭场景中仍面临挑战。
AI.conclusion: LIVIN有望推动具身AI在真实家庭环境中的发展，从空间理解到机器人交互，最终将具身智能带入日常家庭环境。

title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
summary: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.

AI.tldr: 重新计算METR的50%时间跨度，用样条和项目反应理论放松任务AI难度与人类时间对数线性相关的假设，得到更优的时间跨度点估计及诊断图。
AI.motivation: 原时间跨度指标假设任务AI难度随人类完成时间对数线性变化，可能影响其可解释性和构造效度，尤其在任务时长范围扩大时。
AI.method: 基于228个任务和26个AI，使用样条与项目反应理论（IRT）重新估计50%时间跨度，并用交叉验证的适当评分规则评估。
AI.result: 拟合样条将人类时间转换为AI难度：在2–30分钟区间接近平坦，其他区间接近线性；因此3分钟到30分钟的跨度跃升比30分钟到5小时容易得多，尽管同为10倍。新点估计在交叉验证评分规则下表现更好，并提供诊断图评估构造效度。
AI.conclusion: 建议时间跨度与诊断图结合解读，特别是在提出新基准或现有基准纳入更长任务时。

title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.

AI.tldr: ViMoD 是一个轻量框架，在维持紧凑视觉上下文的同时，随推理进展动态保留对原始细粒度视觉证据的访问能力，从而高效支持多步多模态推理。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像产生超长视觉 token 序列，使 MLLM 的多步推理计算代价高昂。现有一次性剪枝与聚合方法在解码前将视觉 token 压缩为固定上下文，但推理过程中对视觉证据的需求会不断变化，固定压缩上下文难以保留各阶段所需细节。
AI.method: 提出 ViMoD 框架，包含两个组件：DART（Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens）学习内容自适应的分组与聚合容量，构建紧凑的 Coarse 表示，并链接可恢复的原始 Fine token；TRACE（Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence）利用解码历史预测后续证据需求，选择、保留或替换活跃的 Fine token 组。被选中的 Fine token 用于增强冻结主干中的持久 Coarse 上下文，实现阶段特定的证据访问，而无需持续关注全部视觉 token。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，以 20% 目标视觉 token 预算，ViMoD 在全部八个推理基准上优于所有评估基线，平均归一化分数较最强的一次性基线提升 39.0%；相对冻结主干仅增加 0.0546% 可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: 动态、可恢复的视觉证据访问机制优于固定压缩上下文，能在极低额外参数成本下高效支撑多步多模态推理。

title: Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了ECCV 2026上举办的第四届感知测试挑战赛，聚焦空间智能，包含四个赛道：原有的统一多选视频问答和接地视频问答，以及两个基于城市规模步行游览视频的新赛道（KilometerAudio和KilometerVision）。报告介绍了新基准并总结了获胜方案。
AI.motivation: 延续感知测试挑战赛系列，推动空间智能研究，并引入城市规模视频理解的新任务。
AI.method: 组织研讨会，设置四个赛道，使用新基准（KilometerAudio和KilometerVision），并总结获胜方案，包括一个跨所有赛道表现良好的通用模型。
AI.result: 新增城市规模赛道的获胜方案表明，复杂的空间和多模态推理可通过昂贵的智能体流水线解决，但独立的多模态模型仍难以应对。
AI.conclusion: 复杂空间与多模态推理需要昂贵的智能体流水线，而独立多模态模型表现不佳。

title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS'26. Project page: https://vincie-next.github.io/
summary: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出 VINCIE-NExT，一个统一视频编辑框架，通过图像到视频的上下文视觉示例迁移编辑能力，缓解大规模配对视频编辑数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑比视频生成更难，因为需要昂贵且难以大规模合成的(source, instruction, edited)三元组；而图像编辑已有大量成熟配对数据。
AI.method: 将视频编辑分解为 Video -> Image -> Image -> Video 的可组合子任务链，在统一扩散目标下联合训练异构图像和视频数据；将图像编辑对作为上下文视觉示例，并引入共享空间坐标的新位置编码，使外观编辑像素级传播到每帧；Chain-of-Editing 支持测试时通过渐进扩散阶段扩展计算量。
AI.result: 在 OpenVE-Bench 上跨多种编辑类别取得 state-of-the-art 性能，消融实验验证了各组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: VINCIE-NExT 通过图像编辑能力迁移和测试时扩展，减少对大规模配对视频编辑数据的依赖，并实现高质量视频编辑。

title: AI-Based On-Board Maritime Object Detection for Earth Observation Payload Data Reduction on Versal Embedded Hardware
comment: 8 pages. Accepted at the 10th On-Board Payload Data Compression Workshop (OBPDC 2026), Barcelona, Spain, 12-14 October 2026
summary: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.

AI.tldr: 研究面向高分辨率地球观测卫星的星上船舶检测，用内容驱动的选择性下传替代逐像素编码下传，以缓解数据存储与下传瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 甚高分辨率遥感卫星采集的数据量超过其存储和下传能力，而海事监视中船舶仅占场景极小部分，因此需要按内容选择下传数据。
AI.method: 构建了来自68幅Maxar标注场景、涵盖43类船舶的受控数据集，训练YOLOX-S检测器；将检测器量化后部署到Versal VC1902的DPU上；提出多种下传模式，包括仅元数据、船舶周围裁剪、含检测结果的瓦片、以及背景降质的整景，并基于检测误差估计船舶保留率与下传数据量之间的权衡。
AI.result: 检测器部署后检测质量损失有限，每场景处理时间为数秒；在密集港口和海岸场景中，瓦片模式保留98%船舶且仅需29%场景数据量，裁剪模式保留83%船舶且仅需3%数据量。
AI.conclusion: 星上船舶检测可作为传统星上压缩的补充，通过内容感知下传有效减少数据量，并在海事监视任务中提供可调的船舶保留与数据量权衡。

title: DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE TPAMI for possible publication
summary: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DVLA-RL++，在DVLA-RL基础上引入互补语义净化（CSP）和反事实强化学习门控（CRG），用于少样本学习，缓解图文语义一致中上下文污染对支持集原型的影响，并在多个基准上取得优于DVLA-RL的准确率。
AI.motivation: 少样本学习标注样本有限，现有方法引入文本语义补偿视觉信息，但高图文一致性可能同时反映物体内在属性和偶然上下文，导致支持原型受到上下文污染。
AI.method: 提出CSP和CRG。CSP从带标签支持样本生成内在描述与干扰描述，并与支持token比较一致性；利用歧义相关拒绝边际进行稀疏证据分配，并用内在语义锚填补未分配质量，作为视觉证据不可靠时的回退。CRG通过平衡识别性能与干扰暴露的奖励，学习逐层语义融合强度，并在同一episode上独立执行参考轨迹以提供配对学习信号。理论分析将保留证据与锚质量联系到原型稳定性，并给出无偏on-policy梯度估计条件。
AI.result: 在标准、细粒度和跨域基准上达到最先进准确率，相较DVLA-RL平均提升1.4%。
AI.conclusion: DVLA-RL++通过语义净化和反事实强化学习门控，有效减少上下文污染，提高少样本类表示的稳定性和识别性能，并具备相应理论支撑。

title: ContourVLA: A Closed-Loop Perception-Action Contour Policy for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) requires dynamically balancing high-level semantics for identifying a variable number of language-specified referents with fine-grained visual evidence for precise boundary delineation. This requirement challenges existing cascaded vision-language architectures, which typically rely on static feature interfaces and single-pass mask prediction, limiting adaptive perception and geometric correction. We introduce ContourVLA, a vision-language-action policy that recasts GRES as a closed-loop visuomotor process, in which editable contours serve as explicit policy states that condition multimodal perception and are updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) couples contour-guided bidirectional boundary sampling with state-conditioned routing of multilevel multimodal features, adapting perception to each contour state. Following supervised initialization, Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) jointly optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour actions with instance-level credits. Its rollout rewards and credits are derived from soft prediction-target correspondences that account for false positives and missed targets. ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 8.7, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively, and achieves the highest mIoU across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ContourVLA，将广义指代分割（GRES）重新建模为闭环视觉-语言-动作过程，以可编辑轮廓作为策略状态，通过几何动作块迭代更新，从而提升多指代与边界分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有级联视觉-语言架构通常依赖静态特征接口和单次掩码预测，难以在识别可变数量语言指代目标时动态平衡高层语义与精细视觉证据，也缺乏自适应感知和几何校正能力。
AI.method: 提出 ContourVLA 视觉-语言-动作策略；引入 Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS)，结合轮廓引导的双向边界采样与状态条件化的多层级多模态特征路由；在监督初始化后，使用 Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) 联合优化离散 grounding 与连续轮廓动作，并基于软预测-目标对应关系生成实例级奖励与信用。
AI.result: 在 gRefCOCO val、testA、testB 上，gIoU 分别比最强评估基线提升 8.7、2.8、2.7 个点；在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg 全部八个 split 上取得最高 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 将 GRES 作为闭环轮廓编辑的视觉运动过程，并联合优化语义定位与轮廓动作，能有效增强自适应感知和几何校正，取得领先的分割性能。

title: From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation
summary: Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出空间画布接口与Compo模型，将海报生成从文本提示转向空间化组合，支持语义、身份、文本、像素四类绑定及文本规格，兼顾直接构造与智能体自动规划。
AI.motivation: 文本提示是一维序列，难以直接表达海报生成中本质二维的构图意图，因此需要一种让用户在空间中直接指定生成意图的交互与生成方法。
AI.method: 提出Spatial Canvas Interface，包含语义、身份、文本、像素四类绑定，以及元素级和全局的Text Specifications；基于预训练图像编辑模型构建Compo，支持直接推理和智能体模式；设计可扩展数据构建流程，自动生成不同绑定及其组合的监督数据，并建立评估绑定遵循与联合构图能力的基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，Compo在保持高视觉质量的同时，其组合可控性强于通用图像生成模型和专用海报生成系统，并能分别评估对单类绑定及联合组合的遵循程度。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦意图指定与视觉生成，该工作将海报生成从依赖提示词的方式推进到空间化组合的方式。

title: Healthy Counterfactual Generation via Diffusion Inpainting for Mammography Classification
summary: False negatives remain a critical limitation of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer screening due to delayed detection and treatment. To address this issue, we propose a counterfactual data augmentation strategy that generates healthy mammograms by "erasing" lesions from anomalous images, thereby enriching the training distribution. We train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model on BI-RADS 1 (healthy) mammograms and use a RePaint-based sampling strategy to inpaint realistic normal tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes. The resulting healthy counterfactuals replace annotated lesion regions with realistic healthy tissue while preserving patient-specific anatomical structure, as supported by similarity metrics between real and generated images. Image realism was further assessed by radiologists and found to be consistent with the original dataset quality. We evaluate counterfactual augmentation across four representative classifier architectures: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt), a vision transformer (ViT), a vision-language model pre-trained on mammogram-report pairs (Mammo-CLIP) and a multi-scale attention-based multiple-instance learning framework (FPN-MIL). Experiments conducted on the VinDr-Mammo dataset show improvements in sensitivity across all architectures, particularly at 80\% fixed specificity, contributing towards more reliable CAD systems for breast cancer. Code is available at: https://github.com/ines03garcia/diffusion-based-counterfactual-generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的反事实数据增强策略，通过从异常乳腺X线图像中“擦除”病灶并生成健康组织，以丰富训练分布，从而提升乳腺癌筛查CAD系统的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 计算机辅助诊断系统在乳腺癌筛查中仍存在假阴性问题，可能导致检测和治疗延迟，因此需要改进训练数据分布以提升模型对病灶的识别能力。
AI.method: 在BI-RADS 1健康乳腺X线图像上训练去噪扩散概率模型，并采用基于RePaint的采样策略，在标注病灶边界框内修复生成逼真的正常组织，从而生成保留患者解剖结构的健康反事实图像；随后在ConvNeXt、ViT、Mammo-CLIP和FPN-MIL四种分类器架构上评估反事实增强效果。
AI.result: 在VinDr-Mammo数据集上的实验表明，所有架构的敏感性均有提升，尤其是在固定80%特异性时提升明显；放射科医生评估也认为生成图像的真实性与原始数据集质量一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于扩散模型的反事实数据增强能够有效改善多种CAD架构的乳腺癌筛查性能，有助于构建更可靠的乳腺癌计算机辅助诊断系统。

title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
summary: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 VibeEdit，一种基于图像上空间标记和简短注释（画布指令）的图像编辑新界面，无需单独文本提示，支持添加、删除、替换、属性修改和移动等操作。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像编辑中，描述所需更改通常简单，但在多个相似物体中定位目标对象或区域却很繁琐，现有文本指令难以准确指定编辑目标。
AI.method: 构建155万源-目标编辑对（含物体掩码和结构化编辑描述），训练时渲染为画布指令；基于 Qwen-Image-Edit 适配层解耦条件，分别编码源图像和画布指令；采用区域加权监督微调，随后用评分引导强化学习提升编辑完成度、局部质量和未编辑区域保持。
AI.result: 在独立构建的人工标注基准（419例，强调相似物体中的目标选择）上，VibeEdit 获得 VLM 评分 79.9 和区域外 PSNR 32.8 dB，优于最佳文本指令基线 FireRed 的 67.4 和 24.0 dB。
AI.conclusion: VibeEdit 通过空间标记与注释组成的画布指令，能有效解决相似物体中的目标定位问题，并在编辑质量和未编辑区域保持上显著优于文本指令基线。

title: Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression
summary: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Connected Self Forcing，一种用于自回归视频生成的训练框架。它重新连接跨自回归块的梯度路径，使后续预测的反馈能指导早期上下文的生成，从而提升长视频的视觉质量与时间一致性，且不改变推理流程。
AI.motivation: 现有 Self Forcing 通过基于自生成历史的自回放训练和 KV 缓存缓解曝光偏差，但为控制内存而截断历史缓存的反向梯度路径，导致早期上下文生成无法从后续预测中获得反馈。
AI.method: 提出 Connected Self Forcing：重新连接自回归块之间的梯度路径，让梯度经由生成的 latent 传回产生它们的计算，从而将早期上下文生成与其在后续预测中的使用关联起来；并设计 shortcut gradient replay，在不保留完整 rollout 计算图的情况下恢复跨块梯度，结合 distribution matching distillation 进行训练。
AI.result: 在自回归视频生成实验中，该方法提升了长时程视觉质量和时间一致性，同时不改变推理过程。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新连接跨块梯度并高效回放，Connected Self Forcing 能同时利用直接监督和早期上下文对后续生成的贡献来训练历史块，为自回归视频生成提供有效且推理无损的改进。

title: Stride Independent Patching for Deep Learning
summary: This paper presents semi-automatic stride-independent patching (SSP) as an alternative to automatic stride-dependent patching techniques. SSP uses user or expert input to position predefined patches over one or more objects of interest. To evaluate its effectiveness, three patch-based datasets were created using SSP, overlapping patching (Overlap), and non-overlapping patching (Noverlap). DeepLabV3+ models with ResNet50, ResNet18, and MobileNetV2 backbones were trained sepa-rately on each dataset. Quantitative evaluations were performed on the respective test splits and a common external test set. SSP generally achieved higher segmentation scores on the test splits and required the shortest model training time across all three backbones. On the external test set, SSP achieved the highest average precision and F1-score across backbones, whereas Noverlap achieved the highest average recall. These preliminary results demonstrate that the potentially greater spatial coverage of Noverlap and Overlap does not generally translate into better segmentation perfor-mance and that SSP offers a favorable balance between segmentation performance and model training time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出半自动、与步幅无关的分块方法 SSP，并与重叠分块、非重叠分块进行比较，评估其在语义分割中的效果与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 自动且依赖步幅的分块技术可能存在局限，作者希望探索一种由用户或专家参与定位预定义分块的方法，以在分割性能和模型训练时间之间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: 使用 SSP、重叠分块（Overlap）和非重叠分块（Noverlap）构建三个基于分块的数据集；分别训练以 ResNet50、ResNet18 和 MobileNetV2 为骨干的 DeepLabV3+ 模型；在各自测试集和共同外部测试集上进行定量评估。
AI.result: SSP 在测试集上通常取得更高的分割分数，并且在三种骨干网络中训练时间最短。在外部测试集上，SSP 在三种骨干网络中取得最高平均精确率和 F1 分数，而 Noverlap 取得最高平均召回率。
AI.conclusion: Noverlap 和 Overlap 可能具有更大的空间覆盖，但这通常并未转化为更好的分割性能；SSP 在分割性能和模型训练时间之间提供了有利的平衡。

title: Syn-Omni: Structured Specialization and Progressive Collaboration for Omnimodal Embeddings
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Long, Findings). Code: https://github.com/sony/syn-omni
summary: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.

AI.tldr: 提出Syn-Omni统一框架，通过正交模态专家LoRA和渐进协同路由实现结构化全模态适配，在81个任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态嵌入方法通常依赖单一共享参数空间处理混合模态数据，限制了通用表示与模态特定表示的结构性分离。
AI.method: 提出正交模态专家LoRA（OME-LoRA），将适配分解为共享LoRA路径（通用语义）和模态专家LoRA路径（模态特定专长）；并采用渐进协同路由（PSR），先让专家建立模态先验，再逐步交互实现跨模态协同。
AI.result: 在涵盖图像、视频、音频和视听模态的81个多样化任务上，Syn-Omni持续优于全模态基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 证明了结构化专长与跨模态渐进协作的有效性。

title: From What to Which: Decoding Modifier Grounding in Frozen MLLMs
summary: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can describe increasingly complex visual scenes, token-level grounding becomes crucial. Yet, when an MLLM generates "the yellow banana on the left", established grounding approaches focus on what is in the image ("banana"), overlooking tokens that help describe which instance is meant ("yellow", "left"). In this work, we ask whether frozen MLLM representations contain decodable grounding information about the referred instance across generated tokens, extending to modifiers such as attributes, spatial expressions, and relational/action terms. To address this question, we introduce OTTER, a lightweight supervised probe over frozen MLLM representations that uses Optimal Transport (OT) to align generated tokens with visual regions and produce compact grounding maps. Our results show that (i) instance-discriminative visual information can be decoded from modifier tokens, with the clearest evidence for spatial terms, but (ii) is not confined to them, as contextualized object nouns also carry referential information; (iii) the recovered grounding remains informative under context perturbations, while selected regions remain relevant to generation; and (iv) the learned OT-based grounding extends beyond the controlled setting to free generation and cross-dataset transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）表示中是否包含对所指实例的可解码定位信息，并提出轻量级监督探针 OTTER，利用最优传输将生成 token 与视觉区域对齐，生成紧凑的 grounding 图。
AI.motivation: 现有 grounding 方法多关注物体名词本身（如“banana”），忽略了帮助区分实例的修饰词（如“yellow”“left”）。作者希望探究 MLLM 生成 token 中是否普遍存在可解码的指代定位信息，包括属性、空间表达和关系/动作词。
AI.method: 提出 OTTER：在冻结的 MLLM 表示上训练轻量级监督探针，使用最优传输（Optimal Transport）将生成 token 与视觉区域对齐，从而得到紧凑的 grounding 图。
AI.result: 实验表明：(i) 修饰词 token 可解码出具有实例区分力的视觉信息，空间词证据最明显；(ii) 这种信息不限于修饰词，上下文中的物体名词也携带指代信息；(iii) 在上下文扰动下恢复的 grounding 仍有信息量，且所选区域与生成相关；(iv) 基于 OT 学到的 grounding 可扩展到自由生成和跨数据集迁移。
AI.conclusion: 冻结 MLLM 表示中确实包含跨生成 token 的可解码指代定位信息，OTTER 能有效提取并利用这些信息，且该方法不局限于受控设置，具有较好的泛化能力。

title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
summary: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多智能体自我中心世界模型ME-World，通过共享token序列联合去噪多个自我流，实现多智能体细粒度交互下的同步自我流生成。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心世界模型多关注单智能体，而现有多智能体世界模型依赖粗粒度动作（如运动、相机控制、离散命令），细粒度具身交互未被充分探索；真实场景需要跨视角动作一致性、共享环境一致性和交互状态更新一致性。
AI.method: 将多智能体自我中心世界建模定义为多智能体同步自我流生成；ME-World在共享token序列中联合去噪多个自我流，以所有智能体的目标视角姿态为条件，并用共享环境记忆作为生成基础；在真实和合成多智能体数据上训练与评估，并提出共享世界一致性指标（环境、更新、身份一致性）。
AI.result: 实验表明，ME-World在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持和视频质量上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ME-World能有效实现多智能体细粒度交互的自我中心世界建模，并显著提升共享世界一致性等关键指标。

title: DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception
summary: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出动态向量解码方法DVD，统一2D和3D感知任务，将感知表示转为1D向量序列并映射为紧凑离散token，通过轻量反tokenizer解码，实验表明性能优越且显著降低token开销和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型感知方法依赖文本坐标表示导致token开销大，或固定范围量化受范围和精度限制，尤其3D场景空间无界且定位精度要求高。
AI.method: 先将2D边界框、2D掩码、3D边界框等感知表示转换为1D向量序列，再映射到高维空间的紧凑离散token；使用轻量级de-tokenizer将输出token解码回原始2D/3D感知表示，实现与MLLM无缝集成。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO系列、SUN-RGBD、KITTI、Hypersim、nuScenes等2D和3D感知基准上，DVD在2D和3D任务中均取得优越性能，并显著减少token开销和推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: DVD为将感知能力集成到MLLM提供了一个高效通用的框架，克服了现有方法的固有局限。

title: Slot3R: Set-Associative Spatial Memory for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve evidence from each frame while processing an expanding scene online. Spatial memory is a natural fit because it organizes history by reconstructed 3D location. Yet Point3R uses spatial proximity both to associate a new observation with an existing memory entry and to decide whether to fuse it, conflating co-location with state identity. Because pointers summarize image patches, nearby pointers may encode distinct surfaces, viewpoints, or visibility conditions; averaging them can destroy complementary evidence before later frames disambiguate it. We argue that location should determine address, not whether observations must merge. Slot3R realizes this principle as a training-free, set-associative retrofit that lets multiple states coexist at a shared address while keeping the pretrained Point3R backbone frozen. A bounded sparse readout further decouples persistent storage from per-frame decoder access. At 300-500 sampled frames, Slot3R reduces Point3R's point-cloud accuracy error (Acc) by 57.1%-63.1% on 7Scenes and 64.0%-72.0% on NeuralRGBD, lowers Sim(3)-aligned absolute trajectory error (ATE) on all three pose benchmarks, and remains competitive on video-depth estimation. It completes all evaluated settings from 600 to 1000 sampled frames at about 19 FPS under the same protocol, whereas Point3R and InfiniteVGGT run out of memory at 800 frames and beyond.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Slot3R，一种无需训练、即插即用的集合关联式空间记忆改造方法，使多个状态可在同一地址共存，从而提升流式3D重建的精度、轨迹估计与长序列可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 流式3D重建需要在线处理不断扩展的场景并保留每帧证据。空间记忆按3D位置组织历史信息很自然，但Point3R将空间邻近性同时用于关联新观测与决定是否融合，混淆了“共址”与“状态同一性”；邻近指针可能对应不同表面、视角或可见性，直接平均会破坏互补证据。
AI.method: Slot3R基于“位置决定地址，而非决定必须合并”的原则，对Point3R进行免训练的集合关联式改造，允许共享地址下多个状态共存，并保持预训练Point3R主干冻结；同时引入有界稀疏读出，将持久存储与逐帧解码器访问解耦。
AI.result: 在300-500采样帧下，Slot3R将Point3R点云精度误差在7Scenes上降低57.1%-63.1%，在NeuralRGBD上降低64.0%-72.0%；在三个位姿基准上降低Sim(3)对齐ATE，并在视频深度估计上保持竞争力。在600-1000采样帧设置下以约19 FPS完成评测，而Point3R和InfiniteVGGT在800帧及以上出现显存不足。
AI.conclusion: 位置应仅决定记忆地址，而不应强制观测融合；通过集合关联式空间记忆与有界稀疏读出，Slot3R在冻结主干条件下显著提升流式3D重建与位姿估计表现，并增强长序列处理的可扩展性。

title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GPD（几何特权蒸馏），将 3D 几何证据作为特权信息引入在线自蒸馏，以提升视觉语言模型的空间推理能力，同时部署模型仍只使用 RGB 输入。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在空间推理上持续较弱，因为 RGB 输入不直接提供几何证据。现有方法要么在推理时注入 3D，带来架构和延迟成本，要么仅用结果奖励监督最终答案。空间错误源于感知，而深度或方向判断错误只能靠场景真实几何纠正，这些几何信息已存在于 3D 扫描的空间训练语料中。
AI.method: GPD 将深度、语义和鸟瞰图（BEV）线索渲染为紧凑文本，与参考答案一起按问题路由给教师模型；仅在错误轨迹上应用特权 KL，增强 GRPO；部署模型保持纯 RGB。
AI.result: 在 4B 骨干上，GPD 在 VSI-Bench 达到 57.1，在 MindCube、SPARBench、MMSI-Bench 和 ViewSpatial 上平均 37.6，优于 GRPO 和答案特权 OPSD。消融实验证实 3D 特权与答案特权的互补性、问题条件路由优于全上下文注入，以及仅对错误轨迹蒸馏的收益。
AI.conclusion: GPD 表明，将训练语料中的真实几何作为特权信息，通过问题条件路由和错误轨迹蒸馏，可有效提升视觉语言模型空间推理，且不增加部署时的 3D 输入依赖。

title: BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion
comment: More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix
summary: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. BudgetPix comprises three key components: (1) an adaptive encoder that maps a fixed-size image to a variable-length token sequence using an entropy-guided quadtree alongside a multi-scale patch embedder; (2) a scale-aware decoder reconstructs fixed-resolution images from multi-scale token sets; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule that enables pixel-space denoisers to operate across variable token counts. BudgetPix seamlessly integrates with existing pixel-space diffusion architectures, enabling a single checkpoint to be operated at a wide range of compute budgets. Evaluated on text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of MiniT2I-L at $512^2$ and PixelDiT at $1024^2$ using just 25% of the original compute budget. In class-conditional generation using a MeanFlow backbone, BudgetPix requires merely 60% of the full compute budget to produce images with near-zero quality degradation, observing a marginal 0.8-point increase in FID. Comprehensive assessments by human and VLM judges confirm that BudgetPix establishes a significantly improved quality-efficiency tradeoff over prior budget-adaptive baselines. More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix

AI.tldr: BudgetPix 是一种自适应 tokenization 框架，根据视觉复杂度和空间布局动态分配计算量，从而支持推理时灵活的算力预算。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型多采用统一 tokenization，对大小相同的图像块分配相同计算预算。这种静态范式无法适应推理时的不同资源约束，并且对简单背景和复杂细节投入相同算力，导致质量-成本权衡次优。
AI.method: BudgetPix 包含三个关键组件：1）自适应编码器，利用熵引导四叉树和多尺度 patch embedder，将固定尺寸图像映射为可变长度 token 序列；2）尺度感知解码器，从多尺度 token 集合重建固定分辨率图像；3）灵活的训练与采样调度，使像素空间去噪器可处理可变 token 数量。该方法可无缝集成现有像素空间扩散架构，使单个 checkpoint 支持多种计算预算。
AI.result: 在文本到图像生成中，BudgetPix 仅用 25% 原始计算预算即可在 512² 下匹配 MiniT2I-L，在 1024² 下匹配 PixelDiT。在基于 MeanFlow 骨干的类别条件生成中，仅需 60% 完整计算预算即可实现近乎零质量下降，FID 仅增加 0.8。人类和 VLM 评估确认其质量-效率权衡显著优于先前预算自适应基线。
AI.conclusion: BudgetPix 建立了显著改进的质量-效率权衡，优于现有预算自适应基线，并实现了推理时灵活的计算预算分配。

title: Controllable Exaggeration for Generative Motion Models via Training-Time Adaptation and Inference-Time Guidance
summary: Recent motion generative models have demonstrated strong capabilities in synthesizing physically plausible character motion, but often overlook established animation principles used by professional animators to ground and design their animation work. Understanding and incorporating these principles into motion generative pipelines is essential for producing motions that serve not only physically grounded applications but also the needs of the character animation community. This enables the creation of characters that not only move in physically plausible ways but also feel alive, expressive, and engaging. To close this gap, we focus on the Exaggeration principle of animation and investigate how it can be incorporated into modern motion generative pipelines to produce more expressive character motions. To this end, we introduce a framework that operates at two stages of existing motion generative pipelines. The first stage introduces exaggeration during training, where we perform supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained text-to-motion models on our curated exaggeration dataset. The second stage operates at inference time, where we: (i) introduce a mathematical formulation of exaggeration based on dynamic movement primitives (DMPs); and (ii) leverage this formulation as an exaggeration guidance signal to guide existing diffusion and flow-matching text-to-motion generation models toward exaggerated motion without additional training. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations against three strong motion generation models, we show that our methods generate more exaggerated and expressive motions while preserving neutral reference motion intent and physical plausibility.

AI.tldr: 该论文关注动画中的夸张原则，提出一个两阶段框架，将夸张引入现有文本到动作生成流程，以生成更具表现力且保持物理合理的角色动作。
AI.motivation: 现有动作生成模型虽能生成物理合理的角色动作，但常忽略专业动画师使用的动画原则，尤其是夸张原则，导致动作不够生动、富有表现力和吸引力。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：训练阶段，在自建夸张数据集上对预训练文本到动作模型进行监督微调；推理阶段，基于动态运动基元提出夸张的数学形式，并将其作为引导信号，在不额外训练的情况下引导扩散和流匹配文本到动作模型生成夸张动作。
AI.result: 在三个强动作生成模型上进行定性和定量评估，结果表明该方法能生成更夸张、更具表现力的动作，同时保留中性参考动作意图和物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 将动画夸张原则融入现代动作生成流程，可在不牺牲物理合理性和动作意图的前提下，提升角色动作的表现力与动画质量。

title: Is In-Domain Training Enough for Fine-Grained Industrial Anomaly Understanding?
summary: A single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to excel simultaneously at detection, localization, description, and reasoning in multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU). We show that in-domain training does not close this gap. On MMAD, a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark, trained specialists reach at most 75.5% accuracy in defect localization, against 92.3% for human experts, and even detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model. Meanwhile, different MLLMs offer complementary strengths but share this weakness in fine-grained perception, so combining them alone cannot remove it. We therefore propose SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework that divides labor between heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert. A multimodal searcher supplies industrial knowledge and normal references, the defect expert turns query-reference comparison into calibrated anomaly evidence, and a label-free reliability controller weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy on MMAD, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro and within 1.5% of human experts. Even with three agents of at most 9B parameters, it reaches 84.4%, and new MLLMs join without retraining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SiGMA，一个空间接地的多智能体框架，用于多模态工业异常理解（MM-IAU）。它通过异构MLLM智能体与专用视觉缺陷专家分工协作，在MMAD基准上达到85.2%平均准确率，接近人类专家水平。
AI.motivation: 单个多模态大语言模型难以同时胜任检测、定位、描述和推理任务；即使进行领域内训练也无法弥补差距。在MMAD上，训练过的专用模型缺陷定位最高仅75.5%，远低于人类专家的92.3%，甚至异常检测还不如未训练基座模型。不同MLLM各有优势但共享细粒度感知短板，简单组合无法解决。
AI.method: 提出SiGMA，一种空间接地的多智能体框架。它将任务分配给异构MLLM智能体和专用视觉缺陷专家：多模态搜索器提供工业知识与正常参考；缺陷专家将查询-参考比较转化为校准的异常证据；无标签可靠性控制器根据任务级能力和查询级证据质量对每个来源加权。
AI.result: SiGMA在MMAD上达到85.2%平均准确率，比最强训练专用模型和Gemini-2.5-Pro高4.0%，与人类专家差距在1.5%以内。即使仅使用三个最多9B参数的智能体，也能达到84.4%，且新MLLM无需重新训练即可加入。
AI.conclusion: 通过多智能体分工、专用缺陷专家和可靠性控制，可以显著提升MM-IAU性能并接近人类专家水平，同时具备参数高效和可扩展性。

title: RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning
summary: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出RiCo方法，通过稀疏接触表面点邻域建模刚体交互，在MOVi基准上显著降低误差并提升接触保真度，且能零样本泛化到大规模场景并初步实现sim-to-real迁移。
AI.motivation: 准确模拟刚体交互对预测性物理世界模型至关重要。现有端到端世界模型预测整个场景或物体，但刚体接触本质是局部的，只有邻近表面直接交换接触力。因此需要聚焦局部接触。
AI.method: RiCo用接触表面点的稀疏邻域表示物体间交互。每个点结合自身状态与邻近表面的相对几何、运动和物理属性，然后跨物体点推理局部接触如何共同影响运动。将跨物体推理限制在邻近表面，同时在刚体内传播接触信息，从而保留细粒度交互细节，避免建模所有场景点对。
AI.result: 在MOVi基准上，100帧位置和方向误差分别降低31-35%和约38%。接触保真度高：相对真实值的穿透时间差11.0%，平均深度差2.22 mm。零样本泛化到含270个物体的场景。真实世界多球碰撞实验初步证明sim-to-real迁移。
AI.conclusion: RiCo实现了更高精度和接触保真度，具备良好的泛化能力和sim-to-real潜力。

title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
summary: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContiLNN，在二维医学图像修复骨干上加入双向闭式连续时间（Bi-CfC）模块进行跨切片建模，以利用解剖连续性，同时保持平面内特征提取。
AI.motivation: 解剖连续性可为医学图像修复提供互补信息，但利用它需要同时考虑局部解剖结构和切片采样变化。
AI.method: ContiLNN用Bi-CfC模块增强2D修复骨干，切片索引间隔调制由局部特征和隐状态决定的门控，从而在无需数值ODE积分的情况下适应采样变化；采用参考引导一致性对齐一阶和二阶跨切片强度差异，并通过冻结骨干蒸馏保持平面内保真度。
AI.result: 在五个训练种子下，ContiLNN相对Restore-RWKV的平均PSNR在CT去噪、MRI超分辨和低计数PET修复上分别提升0.1907、1.0176、1.2482 dB，且三项任务RMSE均更低。CT结果仅为单个留出患者的描述性结果。PET消融支持有序传播优于额外逐点容量。在连续训练下，Bi-CfC在所有测试采样条件下比参数量和计算量相近的Bi-GRU保真度更高；七切片匹配分析显示延迟降低52.8%，峰值GPU内存降低57.0%。混合间隙训练提升了两种算子在稀疏和不规则上下文中的表现，但指标和上下文间无统一排名。更少训练患者和第二个骨干的实验进一步支持数据效率和骨干兼容性。
AI.conclusion: ContiLNN能有效建模跨切片解剖连续性，在多种医学图像修复任务中优于Restore-RWKV，并较Bi-GRU更高效；同时表现出数据效率、骨干兼容性及对稀疏/不规则采样的适应潜力。

title: SpaceFlow: Locally Controllable 3D Generation
summary: Current 3D generation methods lack explicit local control: geometric adherence is often defined by a global control strength, and appearance cannot be specified locally. We present SpaceFlow, a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text descriptions and a collection of geometric primitives. Each primitive serves as a proxy for an object part and is assigned a local control level, enabling users to specify whether regions should strictly follow the input shape or allow generative completion. During structure generation, we enforce these spatial constraints within the generative flow process. For appearance synthesis, the generated structure is segmented and matched to the primitives. Each generated part is conditioned only on its assigned text or image cue, thereby limiting cross-part leakage. Regional geometry metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow preserves the specified geometry in high-control regions and enables plausible shape variation in low-control areas. A user study further indicates that the resulting balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom remains competitive in overall quality. When evaluating appearance on fixed geometry, text-conditioned routing achieves state-of-the-art prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy. Qualitative results additionally show localized routing of image cues. The project page is available at SpaceFlow3D.github.io.

AI.tldr: SpaceFlow 是一个无需训练的3D生成流程，可根据文本描述和一组几何基元实现局部可控的3D生成。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成方法缺乏显式局部控制：几何遵循通常由全局控制强度决定，外观也无法在局部指定。
AI.method: 将每个几何基元作为物体部件的代理，并赋予局部控制级别；在结构生成阶段，于生成流过程中施加空间约束；在外观合成阶段，对生成结构进行分割并与基元匹配，使每个部件仅受其指定的文本或图像提示条件控制，从而限制跨部件信息泄漏。
AI.result: 区域几何指标表明，SpaceFlow 能在高控制区域保持指定几何，并在低控制区域实现合理的形状变化；用户研究显示其在几何保真与生成自由度之间的平衡具有竞争力。固定几何下的外观评估中，文本条件路由达到当前最优的提示忠实度与颜色/材质准确度；定性结果还展示了图像线索的局部路由。
AI.conclusion: SpaceFlow 实现了局部可控的3D生成，在几何保真和生成自由之间取得良好平衡，并提升了局部外观条件生成的质量。项目页面：SpaceFlow3D.github.io。

title: MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances
summary: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. This factorization allows scene understanding and interaction dynamics to be learned from complementary sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that MAMHOI reduces object--scene penetration while better preserving human--object interaction quality, yielding more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions. Project page: https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出 MAMHOI，一种基于可供性中介分解的场景感知人物-物体交互生成方法，通过显式的运动-可供性接口，将场景理解与交互运动合成解耦并组合，从而在无需成对人物-物体-场景数据的情况下生成更真实、物理可行的交互。
AI.motivation: 在复杂3D场景中生成真实的人物-物体交互需要同时具备环境交互可行性推理和真实人物-物体运动合成能力。然而，大规模联合监督数据稀缺：人物-场景数据集提供环境感知运动信息，人物-物体数据集提供交互动态信息，但成对的人物-物体-场景数据很少。
AI.method: MAMHOI 将场景感知的人物-物体交互生成分解为两个阶段，并在场景理解与运动合成之间引入显式的运动-可供性接口：首先由场景条件模型预测交互在何处以及如何可行执行，即可供性；然后由可供性条件的人物-物体交互模型生成相应的人物-物体运动。该分解允许从互补监督来源中学习场景理解和交互动态，而无需成对的人物-物体-场景数据。
AI.result: 在复杂室内环境中的实验表明，MAMHOI 减少了物体与场景之间的穿透，同时更好地保持了人物-物体交互质量，生成了更真实且物理可行的场景感知交互。
AI.conclusion: 通过可供性中介的分解式建模，MAMHOI 能够有效利用人物-场景和人物-物体等互补数据，在缺少成对人物-物体-场景监督的情况下实现高质量的场景感知人物-物体交互生成。

title: GenIA: Generative Reconstruction with Test-Time Input Alignment
summary: Reconstructing complete 3D object assets from monocular or sparse multi-view observations remains challenging. Generative 3D foundation models can complete object geometry beyond the observed views, but their predictions may not faithfully reproduce the observed geometry, appearance, or pose. We introduce GenIA, a framework for test-time input-aligned generation that grounds SAM3D's generative prior in geometric and photometric observations without retraining the foundation model. We improve object pose by deriving translation and scale from geometry while retaining the learned rotation prior, and align appearance through visibility-biased attention, cross-observation fusion, and differentiable rendering guidance during denoising. An optional post-denoising refinement further adapts the appearance latent, lightweight decoder adapters, and object placement to the observations. Our framework also supports externally supplied geometry; when given temporal shapes of dynamic objects, it recovers a shared, input-aligned canonical appearance and stable world-space placement. Across synthetic and real benchmarks, GenIA improves pose prediction and object reconstruction from monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs, outperforming recent optimization-based, per-frame image-to-3D, and video-to-4D methods. Our project page is available at https://facebookresearch.github.io/GenIA.

AI.tldr: GenIA 是一个测试时输入对齐的生成框架，在不重新训练 SAM3D 基础模型的前提下，将生成先验与几何、光度观测结合，用于单目、稀疏多视图和动态输入的 3D 物体重建。
AI.motivation: 从单目或稀疏多视图重建完整 3D 物体仍具挑战；生成式 3D 基础模型虽能补全观测视角外的几何，但其预测可能无法忠实还原观测到的几何、外观或姿态。
AI.method: 提出 GenIA：从几何推导平移和尺度并保留学习到的旋转先验以改进姿态；通过可见性偏置注意力、跨观测融合和去噪过程中的可微渲染引导对齐外观；可选的后去噪细化进一步调整外观隐变量、轻量解码器适配器和物体放置；并支持外部提供的几何与动态物体时序形状。
AI.result: 在合成和真实基准上，GenIA 提升了单目、多视图和动态输入的姿态预测与物体重建效果，优于近期基于优化、逐帧图像到 3D 以及视频到 4D 的方法。
AI.conclusion: GenIA 能在测试时使生成式 3D 基础模型与输入观测对齐，无需重训练即可实现更忠实、稳定的重建，并扩展至动态物体和外部几何场景。

title: Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing
summary: Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation, but still face challenges in visual editing, particularly in following complex instructions, preserving appearance consistency, and supporting flexible input formats. To study this gap, we introduce RISEBench, the first benchmark for evaluating Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), and extend it to RISEBench++, a more comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for this emerging task. RISEBench++ extends the taxonomy into a hierarchical scheme spanning six reasoning dimensions: Temporal, Causal, Spatial, Logical, and Counterfactual Reasoning, together with Hybrid Reasoning integrating multiple reasoning types across multi-turn edits. These dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types. We expand input formats to include multi-image conditioning and scale the benchmark to 1000 human-annotated test cases, released in English and Chinese. We also improve our evaluation framework, assessing Instruction Reasoning, Appearance Consistency, and Visual Plausibility with human judges and an LMM-as-a-judge approach for more reliable and calibrated judgements. Beyond benchmarking, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework integrating reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, outperforming most strong existing approaches across diverse RISE tasks. We evaluate 58 visual editing approaches, including 34 open-source models, 19 closed-source models, and 5 agentic methods. The results reveal substantial challenges in reasoning-based visual editing, with even the strongest evaluated approach, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, achieving only 56.6% accuracy. RISEBench++ highlights the limitations of contemporary editing models, provides insights, and indicates future directions for reasoning-aware visual editing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RISEBench++，一个用于评估推理驱动视觉编辑（RISE）的综合基准，涵盖六大推理维度、12个子类、65种任务类型、1000个中英人工标注测试用例，并引入无训练智能体框架RISE-Agent；评测58种方法后发现最强模型准确率仅56.6%。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型在视觉理解与生成上进展显著，但在视觉编辑中仍面临复杂指令遵循、外观一致性保持和灵活输入格式支持等挑战，因此需要专门基准来研究这一空白。
AI.method: 构建RISEBench并扩展为RISEBench++：推理维度包括时间、因果、空间、逻辑、反事实和混合推理，细分为12个子类和65种任务类型；支持多图像条件输入，规模达1000个人工标注中英测试用例；评估框架从指令推理、外观一致性和视觉合理性三方面，结合人类评判与LMM-as-judge；同时提出RISE-Agent，集成推理规划、工具增强执行和验证器引导优化。
AI.result: 评测了58种视觉编辑方法，包括34个开源模型、19个闭源模型和5种智能体方法。RISE-Agent在多种RISE任务上优于大多数强基线。即使最强方法GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst也仅达到56.6%准确率，表明推理式视觉编辑仍存在显著挑战。
AI.conclusion: RISEBench++揭示了当代视觉编辑模型的局限性，提供了相关洞见，并指出了推理感知视觉编辑的未来研究方向。

title: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
summary: Interactive virtual worlds allow agents to learn through exploration and interaction. What agents can learn is bounded by the environments they practice in, which must be faithful, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and realistic, with observations that follow the real-world visual distributions. Achieving both across diverse worlds remains a bottleneck. We introduce AgentGarten, a framework that couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive environments. Its simulation backends maintain persistent world state and execute program-defined interaction rules, while the renderer generates visual observations from structured conditions exported through a common interface. To build the neural renderer, we adapt a pretrained video model to geometry conditions, distill it with our proposed Adversarial Forcing, and optimize inference for real-time interaction. Adversarial Forcing makes history prefilling differentiable through exact replay, so that losses on later predictions update how the renderer encodes prior observations, and adds real-data adversarial supervision to improve its visual quality. In AgentGarten, agents perceive the world through visual observations, interact with it in real time, and improve by distilling each round of experience into playbooks that subsequent agents inherit and refine. Our empirical study demonstrates a substantial gain in learning efficiency, with agents learning from just 4 rounds compared with millions for a conventional reinforcement learning counterpart. As new worlds can be written as code and rendered through the same interface, environments can scale in both number and difficulty alongside their agents, a step toward agents that keep evolving through interactive experience.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentGarten 框架，将模拟器/游戏引擎与共享神经渲染器结合，构建实时交互虚拟世界，使智能体通过视觉观察与环境交互，并把经验蒸馏为可继承的 playbook，从而高效学习。
AI.motivation: 交互式虚拟世界要求环境既忠实一致（状态、规则、动态），又真实（视觉观察符合真实分布）。但同时在多样世界中实现这两点仍是瓶颈。
AI.method: 耦合模拟后端与游戏引擎，维护持久世界状态并执行程序定义的交互规则；共享神经渲染器通过统一接口从结构化条件生成视觉观察。渲染器基于预训练视频模型适配几何条件，并使用 Adversarial Forcing 蒸馏：通过精确重放使历史预填充可微，让后续预测损失更新先前观察编码，并加入真实数据对抗监督；同时优化推理以实现实时交互。智能体通过视觉感知、实时交互，并将每轮经验蒸馏为 playbook 供后续智能体继承和优化。
AI.result: 学习效率显著提升：智能体仅需 4 轮即可学习，而传统强化学习方法需要数百万轮。新世界可写成代码并通过同一接口渲染，环境数量和难度可与智能体共同扩展。
AI.conclusion: AgentGarten 是迈向通过交互经验持续进化智能体的一步，表明可扩展、实时、视觉真实的交互环境能大幅提升智能体学习效率。

title: Beyond Spatio-Temporal Priors: A Generalizable Approach for Dense Correspondence Matching
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 7 figures, including appendices
summary: Dense correspondence matching has historically been bounded by simplifying spatio-temporal priors, such as smooth motion and rigid geometry. While effective for classical tasks, these assumptions break down in image editing and reference-guided generation (IEG), where transformations can preserve visual identity while breaking physical continuity. To establish identity-preserving correspondence across such transformations, we introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework combining generative and semantic foundation representations with heterogeneous supervision from classical datasets, tracked videos, and synthetic scenes. Teacher-guided iterative refinement further improves correspondence in IEG without dense correspondence annotations. Experimentally, a single FreeMatching model substantially improves correspondence quality on challenging IEG image pairs while retaining competitive performance on classical benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate its utility as a quantitative metric for evaluating identity preservation, with scores that correlate with human judgment. The code is available at https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching.

AI.tldr: 提出FreeMatching框架，用于在图像编辑与参考引导生成（IEG）等破坏物理连续性的变换中，建立保持身份对应关系的密集匹配，同时兼容经典匹配任务。
AI.motivation: 传统密集对应匹配依赖平滑运动和刚性几何等时空先验，这些假设在图像编辑与参考引导生成中失效，因为变换可保持视觉身份却破坏物理连续性。
AI.method: 结合生成式与语义基础表示，利用经典数据集、跟踪视频和合成场景进行异构监督；采用教师引导的迭代精炼，在无密集对应标注的IEG场景中改进匹配。
AI.result: 单一FreeMatching模型在挑战性IEG图像对上显著提升匹配质量，在经典基准上保持竞争力；作为评估身份保持的定量指标，其分数与人类判断相关。
AI.conclusion: FreeMatching可泛化地解决IEG中的身份保持对应问题，并可作为评估身份保持的定量指标，代码已开源。

title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
summary: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment. Most existing approaches coordinate multiple players through joint multi-view generation, whose cost grows with each additional player. We present WorldCast, a distributed multiplayer world model in which each player runs a local client comprising a video generator and a state model. Using recorded player positions and map geometry during training, the state model estimates the player's position from generated video and control inputs. Clients exchange player states and project them into camera-aligned player state fields that guide where and how other players are rendered. Shared scene state enables clients to reuse one another's generated observations to maintain consistent scene appearance across views. Experiments on Counter-Strike 2 demonstrate WorldCast's consistency, real-time performance, and distributed scalability. The camera-aligned player state field improves player rendering rates by over an order of magnitude over joint-generation methods, while shared scene state improves visual consistency over whole rounds. Each client runs in real time and exchanges only player and scene states, enabling scalable multiplayer generation without a centralized computational bottleneck. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.

AI.tldr: WorldCast 是一种分布式多人世界模型，每个玩家本地运行由视频生成器和状态模型组成的客户端，通过交换玩家状态与场景状态实现独立视角生成和一致性。
AI.motivation: 多人世界模型需要为不同玩家生成独立可控且一致的视角，但现有方法多采用联合多视角生成，计算成本随玩家数量增加而增长。
AI.method: 每个客户端包含视频生成器和状态模型；训练时使用玩家位置记录和地图几何，状态模型根据生成视频与控制输入估计玩家位置；客户端交换玩家状态并投影为相机对齐的玩家状态场，以指导其他玩家的渲染位置和方式；共享场景状态使客户端可复用彼此生成的观测来保持场景外观一致。
AI.result: 在 Counter-Strike 2 上验证了 WorldCast 的一致性、实时性和分布式可扩展性；相机对齐玩家状态场使玩家渲染速率相比联合生成方法提升超过一个数量级；共享场景状态提升了整轮游戏中的视觉一致性；每个客户端实时运行且仅交换玩家和场景状态，支持无中心计算瓶颈的可扩展多人生成；一小时长时 rollout 中图像质量保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: WorldCast 通过分布式客户端、玩家状态交换和共享场景状态，实现了可扩展、实时且视觉一致的多人世界模型生成。

title: OneSearch-VL: Unified Multimodal Deep Research Agent for Image and Video
summary: Single-image, multi-image, and video deep research require different visual operations but share a workflow of visual grounding, external retrieval, and fact composition. A key challenge is to preserve the dependencies linking localized visual anchors, entity relations, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations. We introduce OneSearch-VL, a unified agent centered on the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG), which encodes these dependencies as a shared task-level reference for data construction, process supervision, and operation-level evaluation. Our VGEG-based data engine constructs and verifies multi-image and video questions and filters expert trajectories. Using these data, we assemble OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL, respectively. We further derive the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) from VGEG annotations to supervise evidence traceability and visual grounding during RL. For fine-grained evaluation, we construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, organizing questions by the research operations encoded in their VGEGs. Experiments show that OneSearch-VL-8B improves over Qwen3-VL-8B with tool access by 20.2 and 17.6 percentage points on the two new benchmarks, respectively, while also achieving substantial gains across 7 image benchmarks and VideoDR. Project repository: https://github.com/appletea233/OneSearch-VL

AI.tldr: 提出统一视觉研究智能体 OneSearch-VL，以视觉锚定证据图（VGEG）为核心，支持单图、多图和视频的视觉定位、外部检索与事实整合。
AI.motivation: 单图、多图和视频深度研究需要不同视觉操作，但共享视觉定位、外部检索和事实整合流程。关键挑战在于保持局部视觉锚点、实体关系、来源支持事实和答案生成操作之间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 构建以 VGEG 为中心的统一智能体，将依赖编码为任务级共享参考，用于数据构建、过程监督和操作级评估。基于 VGEG 数据引擎构建并验证多图与视频问题，过滤专家轨迹，形成 SFT 数据集 OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K 和 RL 数据集 OneSearch-VL-RL-10K。从 VGEG 标注推导 EVGR 奖励，在 RL 中监督证据可追溯性和视觉定位。构建 OneSearch-MI-Bench 和 OneSearch-Video-Bench 按研究操作进行评估。
AI.result: OneSearch-VL-8B 在两个新基准上分别比可访问工具的 Qwen3-VL-8B 提升 20.2 和 17.6 个百分点，并在 7 个图像基准和 VideoDR 上取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 以 VGEG 作为共享任务级参考，可统一数据构建、过程监督与细粒度评估，并有效提升多图与视频深度研究能力。

title: WorldAlign: Decoupled 4D Reward for World-Consistent Video Generation
comment: Includes an appendix with implementation details, human evaluation, and additional ablation analysis. Project page: https://worldalign.github.io/
summary: Faithful visual world simulation requires generated videos to maintain 4D world consistency, encompassing both static and dynamic consistency. Static consistency requires coherent 3D structure in static environments across viewpoints, while dynamic consistency requires plausible subject motion and consistent appearance over time. Geometry-aware post-training offers a promising way to improve world consistency. However, existing methods often rely on a static-scene assumption. Even those that accommodate dynamic scenes struggle to provide reliable static-consistency feedback, while dynamic consistency is often overlooked or inadequately assessed. To address these limitations, we introduce WorldAlign, a decoupled 4D reward framework that semantically separates static regions and dynamic subjects and provides feedback by aligning each with a world prior suited to its assumptions. For static regions, WorldAlign aligns static geometry with a geometric world prior through semantically guided masked reprojection, enabling more reliable static-consistency evaluation; an auxiliary camera-motion reward discourages nearly static solutions. For dynamic subjects, WorldAlign uses a strong vision-language model (VLM) as a dynamic world prior and constructs a VLM-as-a-judge reward based on sample-specific checklists that assess dynamicity, physical plausibility, shape, and texture consistency. This decoupled design enables more effective online post-training without requiring human preference annotations. Across two pretrained image-to-video generators, Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, WorldAlign jointly improves static and dynamic consistency over existing methods without suppressing overall or subject motion. These results support decoupled world-prior alignment for more faithful visual world simulation. Project page: https://worldalign.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 WorldAlign，一个解耦的 4D 奖励框架，用于提升生成视频的静态与动态世界一致性，并在 Wan2.1 和 Wan2.2 图像到视频生成器上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 忠实的视觉世界模拟需要生成视频保持 4D 世界一致性，包括跨视角的静态 3D 结构一致性和随时间变化的动态主体运动与外观一致性。现有几何感知后训练方法多依赖静态场景假设，难以在动态场景中提供可靠的静态一致性反馈，且动态一致性常被忽略或评估不足。
AI.method: WorldAlign 将静态区域和动态主体语义解耦，并为二者匹配适合其假设的世界先验。静态区域通过语义引导的掩码重投影与几何世界先验对齐，以更可靠地评估静态一致性，并加入辅助相机运动奖励以避免近静态解。动态主体则使用强视觉语言模型作为动态世界先验，构建基于样本特定清单的 VLM-as-a-judge 奖励，评估动态性、物理合理性、形状和纹理一致性。该解耦设计支持无需人类偏好标注的在线后训练。
AI.result: 在两个预训练图像到视频生成器 Wan2.1 和 Wan2.2 上，WorldAlign 相比现有方法同时提升了静态和动态一致性，且没有抑制整体运动或主体运动。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，解耦的世界先验对齐有助于实现更忠实的视觉世界模拟，为生成视频的 4D 一致性提升提供了有效方案。

title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
summary: We present Pumpire, a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors. In contrast to previous approaches that normally evaluate depth and camera intrinsics separately or evaluate point-clouds with geometric similarity metrics, which cannot directly reflect models' point-to-point distance estimation capability, Pumpire directly assesses point-to-point distances from the reconstructed geometry. To this end, we collect a large-scale and diverse dataset (pumpire-6k) comprising 100 real-world scenes, each annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and containing 64 frames, for a total of 6,400 frames. Building on this dataset, we establish a holistic evaluation protocol that covers both image- and video-level 3D foundation models and enables direct assessment of point-pair distance errors and cross-setting comparison. We conduct extensive experiments across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and provide a comprehensive analysis of the results. By offering this benchmark, we target the more fundamental ability to perceive and estimate physical scale in the reconstructed 3D space, which prior evaluation protocols have largely overlooked. The project page can be found at https://pumpire.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Pumpire，一个用于评估图像级和视频级 3D 基础模型在有无深度先验条件下点对点度量距离估计能力的统一基准。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常分别评价深度和相机内参，或用几何相似度指标评价点云，无法直接反映模型对重建几何中点到点距离的估计能力，也忽略了物理尺度感知这一更基础能力。
